```go
package rebuild

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha1"
	"encoding/binary"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"slices"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"

	clickhouse "github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-go/v2"

	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/lthash"
	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay"
	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay/chexec"
	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay/payloadexec"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/dataplane/chparts"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/dataplane/chtest"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/dataplane/ddl"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire"
)

// The rebuild's ClickHouse tests run on scripts/ci/clickhouse-mechanics.sh's
// pair: node A (CH_ADDR, the shared Keeper and the backups disk) is the
// rebuilt owner's server, node B (CH_REPLICA_ADDR) holds the pool verifier's
// hg_unsafe replica and, for the fence tests, the replicas of an old server.
// The lost owner's tables live on node A in databases of their own, so its
// Disk backup is readable where the rebuild restores.

const rebuildIndexer = 2

func requireRebuildCH(t *testing.T) (a, b clickhouse.Conn) {
	t.Helper()
	if os.Getenv("ARBITER_CH_REBUILD") != "1" {
		t.Skip("set ARBITER_CH_REBUILD=1 and run scripts/ci/clickhouse-mechanics.sh, which runs this package on its pair (README § ClickHouse mechanics)")
	}
	var missing []string
	if os.Getenv("ARBITER_CH_KEEPER") != "1" {
		missing = append(missing, "ARBITER_CH_KEEPER=1")
	}
	for _, name := range []string{"CH_ADDR", "CH_REPLICA_ADDR"} {
		if os.Getenv(name) == "" {
			missing = append(missing, name)
		}
	}
	if len(missing) > 0 {
		t.Fatalf("ARBITER_CH_REBUILD=1 requires %s", strings.Join(missing, ", "))
	}
	a, b = chtest.Open(t, os.Getenv("CH_ADDR")), chtest.Open(t, os.Getenv("CH_REPLICA_ADDR"))
	for name, conn := range map[string]clickhouse.Conn{"CH_ADDR": a, "CH_REPLICA_ADDR": b} {
		deadline := time.Now().Add(time.Minute)
		for {
			var n uint64
			err := conn.QueryRow(context.Background(), "SELECT count() FROM system.zookeeper WHERE path = '/'").Scan(&n)
			if err == nil {
				break
			}
			if time.Now().After(deadline) {
				t.Fatalf("the server at %s does not reach its Keeper: %v", name, err)
			}
			time.Sleep(500 * time.Millisecond)
		}
	}
	var disks uint64
	if err := a.QueryRow(context.Background(), "SELECT count() FROM system.disks WHERE name = 'backups'").Scan(&disks); err != nil || disks != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("ARBITER_CH_REBUILD=1 requires the backups disk on CH_ADDR (scripts/ci/clickhouse-mechanics-backups.xml): %d, %v", disks, err)
	}
	return a, b
}

func suffixOf(t *testing.T) (string, uint32) {
	sum := sha1.Sum([]byte(t.Name()))
	return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])[:10], 3_000_000 + binary.BigEndian.Uint32(sum[10:14])%1_000_000
}

func mustExec(t *testing.T, conn clickhouse.Conn, query string) {
	t.Helper()
	if err := conn.Exec(context.Background(), query); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("%s: %v", query, err)
	}
}

func dropDatabasesAtEnd(t *testing.T, conn clickhouse.Conn, databases ...string) {
	t.Helper()
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		for _, db := range databases {
			_ = conn.Exec(context.Background(), "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS `"+db+"` SYNC")
		}
	})
}

func rebuildSchema(s string) payloadexec.TableSchema {
	return payloadexec.TableSchema{TableID: "rb.t_" + s, PartitionBy: "p",
		Columns: []lthash.Column{{Name: "p", Type: "String"}, {Name: "v", Type: "UInt64"}}}
}

// insertRows writes n rows of partition into db.table as one part, with
// _hg_row_id derived from the partition and v.
func insertRows(t *testing.T, conn clickhouse.Conn, db, table, partition string, from, n uint64) {
	t.Helper()
	ctx := clickhouse.Context(context.Background(), clickhouse.WithSettings(clickhouse.Settings{"max_threads": 1, "max_insert_threads": 1}))
	q := fmt.Sprintf("INSERT INTO `%s`.`%s` (`%s`, `p`, `v`) SELECT SHA256(concat('rb:', '%s', ':', toString(number))), '%s', number FROM numbers(%d, %d)",
		db, table, ddl.RowIDColumn, partition, partition, from, n)
	if err := conn.Exec(ctx, q); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("%s: %v", q, err)
	}
}

// diskStore is an ObjectStore over a BACKUP ... TO Disk('backups', ...) of
// the lost owner's hg_safe table, as Plan S3-C1's index describes an S3
// backup.
type diskStore struct {
	backup, sourceDB, promoteDB string
	parts                       map[string][]BackupPart // logical partition -> parts
	restored                    []string
	mu                          sync.Mutex
}

func (s *diskStore) Parts(_ string, partitionID string) []BackupPart { return s.parts[partitionID] }

func (s *diskStore) RestorePartitions(ctx context.Context, conn clickhouse.Conn, tableID string, partitionIDs []string, scratch string) error {
	clause, err := partitionsClause(partitionIDs)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	s.mu.Lock()
	s.restored = append(s.restored, partitionIDs...)
	s.mu.Unlock()
	return conn.Exec(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("RESTORE TABLE `%s`.`%s` AS `%s`.`%s` %s FROM Disk('backups', '%s')",
		s.sourceDB, ddl.CHTableName(tableID), s.promoteDB, scratch, clause, s.backup))
}

// rebuildFixture is one owner whose ClickHouse is lost and rebuilt on node A,
// with the pool verifier's replica on node B.
type rebuildFixture struct {
	t        *testing.T
	a, b     clickhouse.Conn
	schema   payloadexec.TableSchema
	old      ddl.Pinned // the lost ClickHouse's databases
	cfg      Config     // the rebuild of the new one
	verifier ddl.Pinned
	unsafe   map[string][]string // logical partition -> hg_unsafe part names, as inserted
	states   wire.PartitionStates
	store    *diskStore
}

// newRebuildFixture builds the owner before the loss: hg_unsafe with two
// parts in p_p0 and one in p_p1, replicated to the verifier; each partition
// promoted into hg_safe (ATTACH PARTITION FROM, as a promotion's REPLACE
// leaves it); the arbiter's SafeParts and base roots read from that hg_safe;
// a Disk backup of it; and the journal at the arbiter's PublishSeqs.
func newRebuildFixture(t *testing.T) *rebuildFixture {
	t.Helper()
	a, b := requireRebuildCH(t)
	s, shard := suffixOf(t)
	f := &rebuildFixture{t: t, a: a, b: b, schema: rebuildSchema(s), unsafe: map[string][]string{}}
	node := "snode-rb-" + s
	f.old = ddl.Pinned{UnsafeDB: "hg_unsafe_o" + s, SafeDB: "hg_safe_o" + s, PromoteDB: "hg_promote_o" + s, NodeID: node, KeeperShardID: shard}
	newDBs := ddl.Pinned{UnsafeDB: "hg_unsafe_n" + s, SafeDB: "hg_safe_n" + s, PromoteDB: "hg_promote_n" + s, NodeID: node, KeeperShardID: shard}
	f.verifier = ddl.Pinned{UnsafeDB: "hg_unsafe_v" + s, SafeDB: "hg_safe_v" + s, PromoteDB: "hg_promote_v" + s, NodeID: "verifier-" + s, KeeperShardID: shard}
	dropDatabasesAtEnd(t, b, f.verifier.UnsafeDB, f.verifier.SafeDB, f.verifier.PromoteDB)
	dropDatabasesAtEnd(t, a, f.old.UnsafeDB, f.old.SafeDB, f.old.PromoteDB, "hg_evil_"+s)
	// Cleanups run last-in first-out: the new databases go first.
	dropDatabasesAtEnd(t, a, newDBs.UnsafeDB, newDBs.SafeDB, newDBs.PromoteDB)
	ctx := context.Background()
	for conn, p := range map[clickhouse.Conn]ddl.Pinned{a: f.old, b: f.verifier} {
		if err := ddl.EnsureTable(ctx, conn, p, f.schema, 0, ddl.ModeCreateAndVerify); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	table := ddl.CHTableName(f.schema.TableID)
	for _, ins := range []struct {
		partition string
		from, n   uint64
	}{{"p0", 0, 100}, {"p0", 100, 100}, {"p1", 0, 10}} {
		before := f.unsafeParts(a, f.old.UnsafeDB)
		insertRows(t, a, f.old.UnsafeDB, table, ins.partition, ins.from, ins.n)
		for _, p := range f.unsafeParts(a, f.old.UnsafeDB) {
			if !slices.Contains(before, p) {
				f.unsafe["p_"+ins.partition] = append(f.unsafe["p_"+ins.partition], p)
			}
		}
	}
	mustExec(t, b, fmt.Sprintf("SYSTEM SYNC REPLICA `%s`.`%s`", f.verifier.UnsafeDB, table))
	for _, value := range []string{"p0", "p1"} {
		mustExec(t, a, fmt.Sprintf("ALTER TABLE `%s`.`%s` ATTACH PARTITION '%s' FROM `%s`.`%s`", f.old.SafeDB, table, value, f.old.UnsafeDB, table))
	}
	// A later promotion of p0 replaced the partition with itself through its
	// shadow, as REPLACE PARTITION does: the same parts under new names.
	mustExec(t, a, fmt.Sprintf("ALTER TABLE `%s`.`%s` ATTACH PARTITION 'p0' FROM `%s`.`%s`", f.old.PromoteDB, table, f.old.SafeDB, table))
	mustExec(t, a, fmt.Sprintf("ALTER TABLE `%s`.`%s` REPLACE PARTITION 'p0' FROM `%s`.`%s`", f.old.SafeDB, table, f.old.PromoteDB, table))
	mustExec(t, a, fmt.Sprintf("ALTER TABLE `%s`.`%s` DROP PARTITION 'p0'", f.old.PromoteDB, table))
	publish := map[string]uint64{"p_p0": 3, "p_p1": 2}
	f.states = wire.PartitionStates{PromotionSeq: 3}
	f.store = &diskStore{backup: "rb_" + s + "_" + fmt.Sprint(time.Now().UnixNano()), sourceDB: f.old.SafeDB, promoteDB: newDBs.PromoteDB, parts: map[string][]BackupPart{}}
	for _, partitionID := range []string{"p_p0", "p_p1"} {
		parts, content := f.content(a, f.old.SafeDB, partitionID)
		state := wire.PartitionState{TableID: f.schema.TableID, PartitionID: partitionID, PublishSeq: publish[partitionID], BaseSafeSnapshotID: "0xsnap"}
		var rows []string
		for i, p := range parts {
			state.SafeParts = append(state.SafeParts, replay.PartManifestEntry{TableID: f.schema.TableID, PartitionID: partitionID,
				PartName: p.Name, PartPhysHash: p.PhysHash, PartRowLtHash: content[i].Row, RowCount: p.Rows})
			rows = append(rows, content[i].Row)
			f.store.parts[partitionID] = append(f.store.parts[partitionID], BackupPart{Name: p.Name, HashOfAllFiles: p.PhysHash, Rows: p.Rows})
		}
		root, err := payloadexec.SumPartRowLtHashes(rows)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		state.BasePartitionRoot = root
		f.states.Partitions = append(f.states.Partitions, state)
	}
	mustExec(t, a, fmt.Sprintf("BACKUP TABLE `%s`.`%s` TO Disk('backups', '%s')", f.old.SafeDB, table, f.store.backup))
	dir := t.TempDir()
	journal := map[string]any{"watermarks": map[string]uint64{f.schema.TableID + "\x00p_p0": 3, f.schema.TableID + "\x00p_p1": 2},
		"last_acks": map[string]any{}, "base_roots": map[string]string{}, "base_snapshot_ids": map[string]string{}, "unpromoted_sums": map[string]string{}}
	b2, err := json.Marshal(journal)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "state.json"), b2, 0o600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	f.cfg = Config{NetworkID: "devnet2", IndexerID: rebuildIndexer, Pinned: newDBs, StateDir: dir,
		GenesisTables: []payloadexec.TableSchema{f.schema}, UnsafeSyncTimeout: 2 * time.Minute}
	return f
}

func (f *rebuildFixture) unsafeParts(conn clickhouse.Conn, db string) []string {
	parts, err := chparts.ActiveParts(context.Background(), conn, db, ddl.CHTableName(f.schema.TableID))
	if err != nil {
		f.t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var out []string
	for _, p := range parts {
		out = append(out, p.Name)
	}
	return out
}

func (f *rebuildFixture) content(conn clickhouse.Conn, db, partitionID string) ([]chparts.Part, []partContent) {
	parts, content, err := localContent(context.Background(), conn, db, ddl.CHTableName(f.schema.TableID), f.schema, partitionID)
	if err != nil {
		f.t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return parts, content
}

// cleanUnsafePart drops one promoted part from hg_unsafe on the live owner,
// as its cleanup does (the drop replicates to the verifier), so only the
// backup still holds it.
func (f *rebuildFixture) cleanUnsafePart(partitionID string, i int) {
	f.t.Helper()
	table := ddl.CHTableName(f.schema.TableID)
	mustExec(f.t, f.a, fmt.Sprintf("ALTER TABLE `%s`.`%s` DROP PART '%s'", f.old.UnsafeDB, table, f.unsafe[partitionID][i]))
	mustExec(f.t, f.b, fmt.Sprintf("SYSTEM SYNC REPLICA `%s`.`%s`", f.verifier.UnsafeDB, table))
}

// lose loses the owner's ClickHouse: hg_safe and hg_promote are gone and its
// hg_unsafe replica stays registered in Keeper, inactive, as a dead server's
// does.
func (f *rebuildFixture) lose() {
	f.t.Helper()
	mustExec(f.t, f.a, fmt.Sprintf("DETACH TABLE `%s`.`%s`", f.old.UnsafeDB, ddl.CHTableName(f.schema.TableID)))
	mustExec(f.t, f.a, fmt.Sprintf("DROP DATABASE `%s` SYNC", f.old.SafeDB))
	mustExec(f.t, f.a, fmt.Sprintf("DROP DATABASE `%s` SYNC", f.old.PromoteDB))
}

func (f *rebuildFixture) inputs() Inputs {
	owner := uint64(rebuildIndexer)
	db, table, _ := strings.Cut(f.schema.TableID, ".")
	return Inputs{
		Registry: wire.TableRegistrySnapshot{QuarantinedIndexers: []uint64{rebuildIndexer}, Incarnations: []wire.TableIncarnation{{
			Seq: 1, DatabaseID: db, TableID: table, Origin: wire.TableOriginGenesis, Status: wire.TableStatusActive, OwnerIndexerID: &owner}}},
		States: []wire.PartitionStates{f.states},
	}
}

// wantSafeParts requires the new hg_safe to equal the arbiter's SafeParts by
// (row LtHash, hash_of_all_files) in every partition and returns the names
// it holds them under.
func (f *rebuildFixture) wantSafeParts() map[string][]string {
	f.t.Helper()
	names := map[string][]string{}
	for _, state := range f.states.Partitions {
		parts, content := f.content(f.a, f.cfg.Pinned.SafeDB, state.PartitionID)
		left, ok := subtract(manifest(ownedPartition{state: state}), content)
		if !ok || len(left) > 0 {
			f.t.Fatalf("hg_safe partition %s is not the arbiter's SafeParts by content: %+v", state.PartitionID, content)
		}
		for _, p := range parts {
			names[state.PartitionID] = append(names[state.PartitionID], p.Name)
		}
	}
	return names
}

func (f *rebuildFixture) journal() string {
	f.t.Helper()
	b, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(f.cfg.StateDir, "state.json"))
	if err != nil {
		f.t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return string(b)
}

// writeConn records every statement that is not a read.
type writeConn struct {
	clickhouse.Conn
	mu     sync.Mutex
	writes []string
}

func (c *writeConn) Exec(ctx context.Context, query string, args ...any) error {
	c.mu.Lock()
	c.writes = append(c.writes, query)
	c.mu.Unlock()
	return c.Conn.Exec(ctx, query, args...)
}

func TestFenceRefusesAnActiveReplica(t *testing.T) {
	a, b := requireRebuildCH(t)
	s, shard := suffixOf(t)
	p := ddl.Pinned{UnsafeDB: "hg_unsafe_f" + s, SafeDB: "hg_safe_f" + s, PromoteDB: "hg_promote_f" + s, NodeID: "snode-f-" + s, KeeperShardID: shard}
	dropDatabasesAtEnd(t, b, p.UnsafeDB, p.SafeDB, p.PromoteDB)
	sch := rebuildSchema(s)
	if err := ddl.EnsureTable(context.Background(), b, p, sch, 0, ddl.ModeCreateAndVerify); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	res, err := Fence(context.Background(), a, p, []string{sch.TableID})

	if !errors.Is(err, ErrFenceReplicaActive) || !strings.HasPrefix(err.Error(), "fence: replica "+p.NodeID+" of "+sch.TableID+" is active at ") ||
		!strings.HasSuffix(err.Error(), "; the old ClickHouse is not fenced") || strings.Contains(err.Error(), "an unknown host") {
		t.Fatalf("err = %v", err)
	}
	if len(res) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("results = %+v", res)
	}
	replicas, err := ddl.KeeperReplicas(context.Background(), a, p, sch.TableID)
	if err != nil || !slices.Equal(replicas, []string{p.NodeID}) {
		t.Fatalf("the active replica must stay: %v, %v", replicas, err)
	}
}

func TestFenceDropsTheStaleReplicaOfEveryOwnedTable(t *testing.T) {
	a, b := requireRebuildCH(t)
	ctx := context.Background()
	s, shard := suffixOf(t)
	old := ddl.Pinned{UnsafeDB: "hg_unsafe_f" + s, SafeDB: "hg_safe_f" + s, PromoteDB: "hg_promote_f" + s, NodeID: "snode-f-" + s, KeeperShardID: shard}
	pool := old
	pool.UnsafeDB, pool.SafeDB, pool.PromoteDB, pool.NodeID = "hg_unsafe_g"+s, "hg_safe_g"+s, "hg_promote_g"+s, "verifier-f-"+s
	dropDatabasesAtEnd(t, b, old.UnsafeDB, old.SafeDB, old.PromoteDB, pool.UnsafeDB, pool.SafeDB, pool.PromoteDB)
	var ids []string
	for i, owned := range []bool{true, true, false} {
		sch := rebuildSchema(fmt.Sprintf("%s_%d", s, i))
		ids = append(ids, sch.TableID)
		if err := ddl.EnsureTable(ctx, b, pool, sch, 0, ddl.ModeCreateAndVerify); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if owned {
			if err := ddl.EnsureTable(ctx, b, old, sch, 0, ddl.ModeCreateAndVerify); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			mustExec(t, b, fmt.Sprintf("DETACH TABLE `%s`.`%s`", old.UnsafeDB, ddl.CHTableName(sch.TableID)))
		}
	}

	res, err := Fence(ctx, a, old, ids)

	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	want := []FenceResult{
		{TableID: ids[0], Path: ddl.ZooKeeperPath(old, ids[0]), Present: true, Dropped: true},
		{TableID: ids[1], Path: ddl.ZooKeeperPath(old, ids[1]), Present: true, Dropped: true},
		{TableID: ids[2], Path: ddl.ZooKeeperPath(old, ids[2])},
	}
	if !slices.Equal(res, want) {
		t.Fatalf("results = %+v, want %+v", res, want)
	}
	for _, id := range ids {
		replicas, err := ddl.KeeperReplicas(ctx, a, old, id)
		if err != nil || !slices.Equal(replicas, []string{pool.NodeID}) {
			t.Fatalf("%s replicas = %v, %v; want only the pool's", id, replicas, err)
		}
	}
}

func TestFenceRefusesAScopedReplicaOfThisNode(t *testing.T) {
	a, b := requireRebuildCH(t)
	ctx := context.Background()
	s, shard := suffixOf(t)
	p := ddl.Pinned{UnsafeDB: "hg_unsafe_f" + s, SafeDB: "hg_safe_f" + s, PromoteDB: "hg_promote_f" + s, NodeID: "snode-f-" + s, KeeperShardID: shard}
	scoped := "hg_scoped_f" + s
	dropDatabasesAtEnd(t, b, p.UnsafeDB, p.SafeDB, p.PromoteDB, scoped)
	sch := rebuildSchema(s)
	if err := ddl.EnsureTable(ctx, b, p, sch, 0, ddl.ModeCreateAndVerify); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	mustExec(t, b, fmt.Sprintf("DETACH TABLE `%s`.`%s`", p.UnsafeDB, ddl.CHTableName(sch.TableID)))
	mustExec(t, b, "CREATE DATABASE `"+scoped+"`")
	mustExec(t, b, fmt.Sprintf("CREATE TABLE `%s`.t (v UInt64) ENGINE = ReplicatedMergeTree('/sentio/%d/unsafe_inc/rb__t__i3', '%s') ORDER BY v", scoped, shard, p.NodeID))

	res, err := Fence(ctx, a, p, []string{sch.TableID})

	want := fmt.Sprintf("fence: /sentio/%d/unsafe_inc has children [rb__t__i3]; the scoped root must be empty before the purge switch", shard)
	if !errors.Is(err, ErrFenceScopedReplica) || err.Error() != want || res != nil {
		t.Fatalf("Fence = %+v, %v; want %q", res, err, want)
	}
	if replicas, err := ddl.KeeperReplicas(ctx, a, p, sch.TableID); err != nil || !slices.Equal(replicas, []string{p.NodeID}) {
		t.Fatalf("nothing may be dropped: %v, %v", replicas, err)
	}
}

func TestRebuildRestoresHgSafeToTheArbitersSafeParts(t *testing.T) {
	f := newRebuildFixture(t)
	f.cleanUnsafePart("p_p1", 0)
	f.lose()

	report, err := Rebuild(context.Background(), f.cfg, f.a, f.inputs(), f.store)

	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	names := f.wantSafeParts()
	var acknowledged []string
	for _, e := range f.states.Partitions[0].SafeParts {
		acknowledged = append(acknowledged, e.PartName)
	}
	t.Logf("p_p0: rebuilt under %v, acknowledged under %v", names["p_p0"], acknowledged)
	if slices.Equal(slices.Sorted(slices.Values(acknowledged)), slices.Sorted(slices.Values(names["p_p0"]))) {
		t.Fatal("the fixture must give the rebuilt p_p0 other names than the acknowledged ones")
	}
	wantFence := []FenceResult{{TableID: f.schema.TableID, Path: ddl.ZooKeeperPath(f.cfg.Pinned, f.schema.TableID), Present: true, Dropped: true}}
	if !slices.Equal(report.Fence, wantFence) || report.AlreadyRebuilt || report.DryRun || len(report.Partitions) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("report = %+v", report)
	}
	for _, p := range report.Partitions {
		if p.Parts != len(f.store.parts[p.PartitionID]) || p.FromOwnUnsafe+p.FromObjectStore != p.Parts || len(p.Missing) != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("partition report %+v", p)
		}
	}
	journal := f.journal()
	for partitionID, partNames := range names {
		for _, name := range partNames {
			if !strings.Contains(journal, `"safe_part_name":"`+name+`"`) {
				t.Fatalf("the journal does not record %s of %s: %s", name, partitionID, journal)
			}
		}
	}
	if strings.Count(journal, `"rebuilt":true`) != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("the journal must mark both partitions rebuilt: %s", journal)
	}
	if active, err := ddl.ReplicaIsActive(context.Background(), f.a, f.cfg.Pinned, f.schema.TableID, f.cfg.Pinned.NodeID); err != nil || !active {
		t.Fatalf("the new hg_unsafe replica is not active: %v, %v", active, err)
	}
	if left, err := scratchTables(f.a, f.cfg.Pinned.PromoteDB); err != nil || len(left) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("scratch tables left: %v, %v", left, err)
	}
}

func scratchTables(conn clickhouse.Conn, db string) ([]string, error) {
	rows, err := conn.Query(context.Background(), "SELECT name FROM system.tables WHERE database = ? AND position(name, '__rebuild_') > 0", db)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()
	var out []string
	for rows.Next() {
		var n string
		if err := rows.Scan(&n); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		out = append(out, n)
	}
	return out, rows.Err()
}

func TestRebuildPrefersTheOwnUnsafeReplicaThenTheObjectStore(t *testing.T) {
	f := newRebuildFixture(t)
	f.cleanUnsafePart("p_p0", 1)
	f.lose()

	report, err := Rebuild(context.Background(), f.cfg, f.a, f.inputs(), f.store)

	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	f.wantSafeParts()
	got := map[string][2]int{}
	for _, p := range report.Partitions {
		got[p.PartitionID] = [2]int{p.FromOwnUnsafe, p.FromObjectStore}
	}
	if want := map[string][2]int{"p_p0": {1, 1}, "p_p1": {1, 0}}; fmt.Sprint(got) != fmt.Sprint(want) {
		t.Fatalf("sources (own_unsafe, object_store) = %v, want %v", got, want)
	}
	if !slices.Equal(f.store.restored, []string{"p_p0"}) {
		t.Fatalf("the object store restored %v, want only p_p0", f.store.restored)
	}
}

func TestRebuildDryRunWritesNothingAndReportsCoverage(t *testing.T) {
	f := newRebuildFixture(t)
	f.cleanUnsafePart("p_p0", 1)
	live := f.cfg
	live.Pinned = f.old
	live.DryRun = true
	before := f.journal()
	w := &writeConn{Conn: f.a}

	report, err := Rebuild(context.Background(), live, w, f.inputs(), f.store)

	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if len(w.writes) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("the dry run ran %v", w.writes)
	}
	if f.journal() != before {
		t.Fatal("the dry run changed the journal")
	}
	if !report.DryRun || report.Fence != nil || len(report.Partitions) != 2 ||
		report.Partitions[0].FromOwnUnsafe != 1 || report.Partitions[0].FromObjectStore != 1 || report.Partitions[1].FromOwnUnsafe != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("report = %+v", report)
	}
	for _, line := range report.JSONLines() {
		if !strings.HasPrefix(line, `{"phase":"plan"`) && !strings.HasPrefix(line, `{"phase":"done"`) {
			t.Fatalf("dry-run line %s", line)
		}
	}
	empty := &diskStore{parts: map[string][]BackupPart{}}
	report, err = Rebuild(context.Background(), live, w, f.inputs(), empty)
	missing := f.states.Partitions[0].SafeParts[1]
	if !errors.Is(err, ErrRebuildSourceMissing) || !strings.HasPrefix(err.Error(), "rebuild: no source holds part "+missing.PartName+" (row hash ") ||
		!strings.HasSuffix(err.Error(), ", hash_of_all_files "+missing.PartPhysHash+") of "+f.schema.TableID+" partition p_p0") {
		t.Fatalf("err = %v", err)
	}
	if len(report.Partitions) != 2 || !slices.Equal(report.Partitions[0].Missing, []string{missing.PartName}) || len(w.writes) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("report = %+v, writes %v", report, w.writes)
	}
}

func TestRebuildRefusesAPhysHashMismatch(t *testing.T) {
	f := newRebuildFixture(t)
	s, _ := suffixOf(t)
	table := ddl.CHTableName(f.schema.TableID)
	// The same rows of p1 in wide parts: equal row LtHash, other files.
	evil := "hg_evil_" + s
	mustExec(t, f.a, "CREATE DATABASE `"+evil+"`")
	mustExec(t, f.a, fmt.Sprintf("CREATE TABLE `%s`.`%s` AS `%s`.`%s`", evil, table, f.old.SafeDB, table))
	mustExec(t, f.a, fmt.Sprintf("ALTER TABLE `%s`.`%s` MODIFY SETTING min_bytes_for_wide_part = 0, min_rows_for_wide_part = 0", evil, table))
	mustExec(t, f.a, fmt.Sprintf("INSERT INTO `%s`.`%s` SELECT * FROM `%s`.`%s` WHERE p = 'p1' SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 1", evil, table, f.old.SafeDB, table))
	evilBackup := f.store.backup + "_evil"
	mustExec(t, f.a, fmt.Sprintf("BACKUP TABLE `%s`.`%s` TO Disk('backups', '%s')", evil, table, evilBackup))
	f.store.backup, f.store.sourceDB = evilBackup, evil
	f.cleanUnsafePart("p_p1", 0)
	f.lose()

	_, err := Rebuild(context.Background(), f.cfg, f.a, f.inputs(), f.store)

	recorded := f.states.Partitions[1].SafeParts[0].PartPhysHash
	if !errors.Is(err, ErrRebuildPhysHashMismatch) || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), " of "+f.schema.TableID+" partition p_p1 came back with hash_of_all_files ") ||
		!strings.HasSuffix(err.Error(), "; the arbiter records "+recorded) {
		t.Fatalf("err = %v", err)
	}
	if parts, _ := f.content(f.a, f.cfg.Pinned.SafeDB, "p_p1"); len(parts) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("a mismatching part reached hg_safe: %+v", parts)
	}
	if strings.Contains(f.journal(), `"rebuilt":true`) {
		t.Fatal("a refused rebuild must not write the journal")
	}
}

func TestRebuildIsIdempotent(t *testing.T) {
	f := newRebuildFixture(t)
	f.cleanUnsafePart("p_p0", 0)
	f.lose()
	if _, err := Rebuild(context.Background(), f.cfg, f.a, f.inputs(), f.store); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	names := f.wantSafeParts()
	journal := f.journal()
	w := &writeConn{Conn: f.a}

	report, err := Rebuild(context.Background(), f.cfg, w, f.inputs(), f.store)

	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !report.AlreadyRebuilt || report.Fence != nil || len(report.Partitions) != 2 || len(w.writes) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("second run: report %+v, writes %v", report, w.writes)
	}
	if fmt.Sprint(f.wantSafeParts()) != fmt.Sprint(names) || f.journal() != journal {
		t.Fatal("the second run changed hg_safe or the journal")
	}
	lines := report.JSONLines()
	if !strings.Contains(lines[len(lines)-1], `"already_rebuilt":true`) {
		t.Fatalf("done line %s", lines[len(lines)-1])
	}
}

func TestRebuildRefusesForeignSafeParts(t *testing.T) {
	f := newRebuildFixture(t)
	f.lose()
	if _, err := Rebuild(context.Background(), f.cfg, f.a, f.inputs(), f.store); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	table := ddl.CHTableName(f.schema.TableID)
	insertRows(t, f.a, f.cfg.Pinned.SafeDB, table, "p0", 5000, 1)
	before, _ := f.content(f.a, f.cfg.Pinned.SafeDB, "p_p0")
	journal := f.journal()

	_, err := Rebuild(context.Background(), f.cfg, f.a, f.inputs(), f.store)

	want := "rebuild: hg_safe." + table + " partition p_p0 holds parts outside the arbiter's SafeParts; only an empty or already rebuilt table is rebuilt"
	if !errors.Is(err, ErrRebuildForeignSafeParts) || err.Error() != want {
		t.Fatalf("err = %v, want %q", err, want)
	}
	if after, _ := f.content(f.a, f.cfg.Pinned.SafeDB, "p_p0"); !slices.Equal(after, before) || f.journal() != journal {
		t.Fatal("the refused rebuild changed hg_safe or the journal")
	}
	scans, err := chexec.ScanAllParts(context.Background(), f.a, f.cfg.Pinned.SafeDB+"."+table, f.schema)
	if err != nil || len(scans) != 4 {
		t.Fatalf("hg_safe holds %d parts (%v), want the three rebuilt and the foreign one", len(scans), err)
	}
}
```

```go
// Package rebuild is the same-identity owner rebuild of a lost source
// ClickHouse (housegate spec 2026-10-14 §16 P4; plan S3-D contract §34,
// clarifications K52 and K54). The host keeps its identity, its signer key
// and its volume, so the SNode journal survives; only the ClickHouse (pod,
// PVC, PV) is new. Rebuild fences the lost server's Keeper replicas, creates
// the owned tables (the new hg_unsafe replica clones from the pool
// verifiers), restores every hg_safe partition to the arbiter's SafeParts
// through the restore gate (member/gate) from the own hg_unsafe replica and
// then the object store, and records the restored inventories in the journal
// (snode.RecordRebuiltSafeInventories). It refuses a live track and a track
// with issued, unacknowledged promotions before it touches anything.
package rebuild

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"slices"
	"strings"
	"time"

	clickhouse "github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-go/v2"

	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay/chexec"
	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay/payloadexec"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/dataplane/chparts"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/dataplane/ddl"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/member/gate"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/snode"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire"
)

// DefaultUnsafeSyncTimeout is Config.UnsafeSyncTimeout's default.
const DefaultUnsafeSyncTimeout = 30 * time.Minute

// Config is one rebuild: the network, the indexer whose source ClickHouse is
// rebuilt, its protocol DDL inputs (Pinned.NodeID is its SNode's node id, the
// replica name the fence drops and the new tables take), its SNode state
// directory, its genesis table schemas, how long the new hg_unsafe replicas
// may take to catch up with the pool (0: DefaultUnsafeSyncTimeout), and
// whether only to plan.
type Config struct {
	NetworkID         string
	IndexerID         uint64
	Pinned            ddl.Pinned
	StateDir          string
	GenesisTables     []payloadexec.TableSchema
	UnsafeSyncTimeout time.Duration
	DryRun            bool
}

// Inputs are the arbiter's answers the rebuild works from: the table
// registry, one PartitionStates per owned table (Client.GetPartitionStates)
// and the outcomes with Acked false of every owned table
// (Client.GetPromotionOutcomes, paged by NextAfterPromotionSeq).
type Inputs struct {
	Registry wire.TableRegistrySnapshot
	States   []wire.PartitionStates
	Unacked  []wire.PromotionOutcome
}

// Phase names a stage of the rebuild in its report and its errors.
type Phase string

const (
	PhaseFence   Phase = "fence"
	PhaseTables  Phase = "tables"
	PhaseRestore Phase = "restore"
	PhaseJournal Phase = "journal"
	PhasePlan    Phase = "plan"
	PhaseDone    Phase = "done"
)

// Source is where a restored part came from.
type Source string

const (
	// SourceOwnUnsafe: a promoted part whose cleanup has not run, still in
	// the re-cloned hg_unsafe replica, found by hash_of_all_files.
	SourceOwnUnsafe Source = "own_unsafe"
	// SourceObjectStore: the backup the rebuild names.
	SourceObjectStore Source = "object_store"
)

// The rebuild's refusals. Each sentinel's text is the format of the message
// of the refusal it matches (errors.Is), so the verbatim message lives once.
var (
	ErrRebuildNotQuarantined   = errors.New("rebuild: indexer %d is not quarantined; a live track's hg_safe is never rebuilt")
	ErrRebuildUnacked          = errors.New("rebuild: indexer %d has issued, unacknowledged promotions %v; settle them first (arbiter-admin indexer settle)")
	ErrRebuildForeignSafeParts = errors.New("rebuild: hg_safe.%s partition %s holds parts outside the arbiter's SafeParts; only an empty or already rebuilt table is rebuilt")
	ErrRebuildSourceMissing    = errors.New("rebuild: no source holds part %s (row hash %s, hash_of_all_files %s) of %s partition %s")
	ErrRebuildPhysHashMismatch = errors.New("rebuild: part %s of %s partition %s came back with hash_of_all_files %s; the arbiter records %s")
	ErrRebuildClosure          = errors.New("rebuild: %s partition %s does not close: local %s plus kept %s is not the base root %s")
	ErrFenceReplicaActive      = errors.New("fence: replica %s of %s is active at %s; the old ClickHouse is not fenced")
	ErrFenceScopedReplica      = errors.New("fence: %s has children %v; the scoped root must be empty before the purge switch")
)

// refusal is one of the refusals above: its message is the sentinel's text
// formatted with the refusal's values, and it unwraps to the sentinel.
type refusal struct {
	kind error
	msg  string
}

func (e *refusal) Error() string { return e.msg }
func (e *refusal) Unwrap() error { return e.kind }

func refuse(kind error, args ...any) error {
	return &refusal{kind: kind, msg: fmt.Sprintf(kind.Error(), args...)}
}

// ownedTable is one table the indexer owns: its registry key, its schema, the
// incarnation marker ddl.EnsureTable takes (0 for a genesis table) and its
// physical name.
type ownedTable struct {
	TableID  string
	Schema   payloadexec.TableSchema
	Marker   uint64
	Physical string
}

// ownedPartition is one partition the arbiter acknowledged safe parts of.
type ownedPartition struct {
	table ownedTable
	state wire.PartitionState
}

// partContent is a part's identity across names: its row LtHash and its
// hash_of_all_files.
type partContent struct{ Row, Phys string }

// planned is one partition's restore plan: the safe parts it still needs,
// each with the source that holds it.
type planned struct {
	part    ownedPartition
	local   []string // row LtHashes of the parts hg_safe holds already
	need    []arbiter.SafePartMapping
	sources []Source
	report  PartitionReport
}

// Rebuild rebuilds cfg.IndexerID's source ClickHouse on conn (see the package
// comment). A dry run plans every owned partition and writes nothing. A real
// run returns AlreadyRebuilt without writing when hg_safe and the journal
// already equal the arbiter's state, so a second run changes nothing.
func Rebuild(ctx context.Context, cfg Config, conn clickhouse.Conn, in Inputs, store ObjectStore) (Report, error) {
	if err := cfg.check(); err != nil {
		return Report{}, err
	}
	if !slices.Contains(in.Registry.QuarantinedIndexers, cfg.IndexerID) {
		return Report{}, refuse(ErrRebuildNotQuarantined, cfg.IndexerID)
	}
	var unacked []uint64
	for _, o := range in.Unacked {
		if !o.Acked {
			unacked = append(unacked, o.PromotionSeq)
		}
	}
	if len(unacked) > 0 {
		slices.Sort(unacked)
		return Report{}, refuse(ErrRebuildUnacked, cfg.IndexerID, unacked)
	}
	tables, err := ownedTables(cfg, in.Registry)
	if err != nil {
		return Report{}, err
	}
	partitions := ownedPartitions(tables, in.States)
	inventories := make([]snode.RebuiltSafeInventory, 0, len(partitions))
	for _, p := range partitions {
		inventories = append(inventories, snode.RebuiltSafeInventory{TableID: p.table.TableID, PartitionID: p.state.PartitionID, PublishSeq: p.state.PublishSeq})
	}
	journaled, err := snode.CheckRebuildJournal(cfg.StateDir, inventories)
	if err != nil {
		return Report{}, err
	}
	if cfg.DryRun {
		return dryRun(ctx, cfg, conn, partitions, store)
	}
	if done, report, err := alreadyRebuilt(ctx, cfg, conn, tables, partitions, journaled); err != nil || done {
		return report, err
	}
	report := Report{}
	local, err := locallyHeld(ctx, conn, cfg.Pinned, tables)
	if err != nil {
		return report, err
	}
	var toFence []string
	for _, t := range tables {
		// A table this server already holds was fenced by an earlier,
		// interrupted run (its replica is created only after the fence),
		// and its replica is this server's own.
		if !local[t.TableID] {
			toFence = append(toFence, t.TableID)
		}
	}
	if report.Fence, err = Fence(ctx, conn, cfg.Pinned, toFence); err != nil {
		return report, err
	}
	for _, t := range tables {
		if err := ddl.EnsureTable(ctx, conn, cfg.Pinned, t.Schema, t.Marker, ddl.ModeCreateAndVerify); err != nil {
			return report, fmt.Errorf("rebuild %s: %w", PhaseTables, err)
		}
	}
	if err := waitUnsafeSynced(ctx, conn, cfg.Pinned.UnsafeDB, tables, cfg.unsafeSyncTimeout()); err != nil {
		return report, err
	}
	if err := dropScratches(ctx, conn, cfg.Pinned.PromoteDB); err != nil {
		return report, err
	}
	plans := make([]planned, 0, len(partitions))
	for _, p := range partitions {
		pl, err := planPartition(ctx, cfg, conn, p, store, false)
		if err != nil {
			return report, err
		}
		plans = append(plans, pl)
	}
	for _, pl := range plans {
		if len(pl.report.Missing) > 0 {
			return report, missingRefusal(pl)
		}
	}
	scratch := 0
	for _, pl := range plans {
		if err := restorePartition(ctx, cfg, conn, pl, store, &scratch); err != nil {
			return report, err
		}
		report.Partitions = append(report.Partitions, pl.report)
	}
	for _, t := range tables {
		if err := checkPartitionSet(ctx, cfg, conn, t, partitions); err != nil {
			return report, err
		}
	}
	if err := dropScratches(ctx, conn, cfg.Pinned.PromoteDB); err != nil {
		return report, err
	}
	for i, p := range partitions {
		parts, err := readBack(ctx, cfg, conn, p)
		if err != nil {
			return report, err
		}
		inventories[i].Parts = parts
	}
	if err := snode.RecordRebuiltSafeInventories(cfg.StateDir, inventories); err != nil {
		return report, fmt.Errorf("rebuild %s: %w", PhaseJournal, err)
	}
	return report, nil
}

func (cfg Config) check() error {
	p := cfg.Pinned
	if cfg.NetworkID == "" || cfg.StateDir == "" || p.UnsafeDB == "" || p.SafeDB == "" || p.PromoteDB == "" || p.NodeID == "" {
		return errors.New("rebuild: Config needs NetworkID, StateDir and Pinned's three databases and node id")
	}
	return nil
}

func (cfg Config) unsafeSyncTimeout() time.Duration {
	if cfg.UnsafeSyncTimeout > 0 {
		return cfg.UnsafeSyncTimeout
	}
	return DefaultUnsafeSyncTimeout
}

// ownedTables are the registry keys whose live incarnation the indexer owns
// and that hold tables (Pending, Active, Retiring), sorted by key: a genesis
// incarnation takes its schema from cfg.GenesisTables and marker 0, a chain
// incarnation its registry schema and its seq. A schema whose hash is not the
// registry's is refused: tables built from it would not take the backup's
// parts.
func ownedTables(cfg Config, reg wire.TableRegistrySnapshot) ([]ownedTable, error) {
	genesis := map[string]payloadexec.TableSchema{}
	for _, s := range cfg.GenesisTables {
		genesis[s.TableID] = s
	}
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	var out []ownedTable
	for _, inc := range reg.Incarnations {
		key := inc.Key()
		if seen[key] {
			continue
		}
		seen[key] = true
		live := reg.Live(key)
		if live == nil || reg.Owner(*live) != cfg.IndexerID {
			continue
		}
		switch live.Status {
		case wire.TableStatusPending, wire.TableStatusActive, wire.TableStatusRetiring:
		default:
			continue
		}
		t := ownedTable{TableID: key, Physical: ddl.CHTableName(key)}
		if live.Origin == wire.TableOriginGenesis {
			s, ok := genesis[key]
			if !ok {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("rebuild: genesis table %s is not in the configured genesis tables", key)
			}
			t.Schema = s
		} else {
			s, err := live.Schema()
			if err != nil {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("rebuild: %w", err)
			}
			t.Schema, t.Marker = s, live.Seq
		}
		if h := payloadexec.TableSchemaHash(cfg.NetworkID, t.Schema); live.SchemaHash != "" && live.SchemaHash != h {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("rebuild: table %s has schema hash %s here, the registry has %s", key, h, live.SchemaHash)
		}
		out = append(out, t)
	}
	slices.SortFunc(out, func(a, b ownedTable) int { return strings.Compare(a.TableID, b.TableID) })
	return out, nil
}

// ownedPartitions are the partitions with safe parts the arbiter answered for
// the owned tables, by table then partition.
func ownedPartitions(tables []ownedTable, states []wire.PartitionStates) []ownedPartition {
	byTable := map[string]ownedTable{}
	for _, t := range tables {
		byTable[t.TableID] = t
	}
	var out []ownedPartition
	for _, s := range states {
		for _, p := range s.Partitions {
			t, ok := byTable[p.TableID]
			if !ok || len(p.SafeParts) == 0 {
				continue
			}
			out = append(out, ownedPartition{table: t, state: p})
		}
	}
	slices.SortFunc(out, func(a, b ownedPartition) int {
		if c := strings.Compare(a.table.TableID, b.table.TableID); c != 0 {
			return c
		}
		return strings.Compare(a.state.PartitionID, b.state.PartitionID)
	})
	return slices.CompactFunc(out, func(a, b ownedPartition) bool {
		return a.table.TableID == b.table.TableID && a.state.PartitionID == b.state.PartitionID
	})
}

// manifest is a partition's SafeParts as mappings: what the restore must
// produce, by content.
func manifest(p ownedPartition) []arbiter.SafePartMapping {
	out := make([]arbiter.SafePartMapping, 0, len(p.state.SafeParts))
	for _, e := range p.state.SafeParts {
		out = append(out, arbiter.SafePartMapping{PartRowLtHash: e.PartRowLtHash, SafePartName: e.PartName, PartPhysHash: e.PartPhysHash})
	}
	return out
}

func rowHashes(parts []arbiter.SafePartMapping) []string {
	out := make([]string, 0, len(parts))
	for _, p := range parts {
		out = append(out, p.PartRowLtHash)
	}
	return out
}

// localContent scans db.table's partition: each active part with its row
// LtHash and hash_of_all_files. A table that does not exist holds nothing.
func localContent(ctx context.Context, conn clickhouse.Conn, db, table string, sch payloadexec.TableSchema, partitionID string) ([]chparts.Part, []partContent, error) {
	parts, err := chparts.ActiveParts(ctx, conn, db, table)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	parts = chparts.PartsInLogicalPartition(parts, sch, partitionID)
	if len(parts) == 0 {
		return nil, nil, nil
	}
	_, scanned, err := chparts.PartitionContentScan(ctx, conn, db, table, sch, partitionID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	rows := map[string]string{}
	for _, s := range scanned {
		rows[s.Name] = s.RowLtHash
	}
	out := make([]partContent, 0, len(parts))
	for _, p := range parts {
		out = append(out, partContent{Row: rows[p.Name], Phys: p.PhysHash})
	}
	return parts, out, nil
}

// subtract removes have from want by content and reports whether every
// element of have was in want: what is left is still needed.
func subtract(want []arbiter.SafePartMapping, have []partContent) ([]arbiter.SafePartMapping, bool) {
	left := slices.Clone(want)
	for _, h := range have {
		i := slices.IndexFunc(left, func(m arbiter.SafePartMapping) bool { return m.PartRowLtHash == h.Row && m.PartPhysHash == h.Phys })
		if i < 0 {
			return nil, false
		}
		left = slices.Delete(left, i, i+1)
	}
	return left, true
}

// planPartition finds a source for each safe part the partition needs, by
// hash_of_all_files: the own hg_unsafe replica first, then the object store.
// A dry run plans every part of SafeParts (the local hg_safe is the one the
// rebuild will lose); a real run plans what hg_safe does not hold yet and
// refuses a partition that holds anything else.
func planPartition(ctx context.Context, cfg Config, conn clickhouse.Conn, p ownedPartition, store ObjectStore, dry bool) (planned, error) {
	t := p.table
	m := manifest(p)
	pl := planned{part: p, report: PartitionReport{TableID: t.TableID, PartitionID: p.state.PartitionID,
		PublishSeq: p.state.PublishSeq, Parts: len(m), Root: p.state.BasePartitionRoot}}
	need := m
	if !dry {
		_, have, err := localContent(ctx, conn, cfg.Pinned.SafeDB, t.Physical, t.Schema, p.state.PartitionID)
		if err != nil {
			return pl, fmt.Errorf("rebuild %s: hg_safe.%s partition %s: %w", PhaseRestore, t.Physical, p.state.PartitionID, err)
		}
		var ok bool
		if need, ok = subtract(m, have); !ok {
			return pl, refuse(ErrRebuildForeignSafeParts, t.Physical, p.state.PartitionID)
		}
		for _, h := range have {
			pl.local = append(pl.local, h.Row)
		}
		plan, err := gate.PlanPartition(rowHashes(m), p.state.BasePartitionRoot, pl.local)
		if err != nil {
			return pl, fmt.Errorf("rebuild %s: %s partition %s: %w", PhaseRestore, t.TableID, p.state.PartitionID, err)
		}
		if plan.Diverged {
			return pl, refuse(ErrRebuildForeignSafeParts, t.Physical, p.state.PartitionID)
		}
	}
	unsafe, err := chparts.ActiveParts(ctx, conn, cfg.Pinned.UnsafeDB, t.Physical)
	if err != nil {
		return pl, fmt.Errorf("rebuild %s: hg_unsafe.%s: %w", PhaseRestore, t.Physical, err)
	}
	unsafePhys := map[string]int{}
	for _, u := range chparts.PartsInLogicalPartition(unsafe, t.Schema, p.state.PartitionID) {
		unsafePhys[u.PhysHash]++
	}
	storePhys := map[string]int{}
	if store != nil {
		for _, b := range store.Parts(t.TableID, p.state.PartitionID) {
			storePhys[b.HashOfAllFiles]++
		}
	}
	for _, part := range need {
		switch {
		case unsafePhys[part.PartPhysHash] > 0:
			unsafePhys[part.PartPhysHash]--
			pl.need, pl.sources = append(pl.need, part), append(pl.sources, SourceOwnUnsafe)
			pl.report.FromOwnUnsafe++
		case storePhys[part.PartPhysHash] > 0:
			storePhys[part.PartPhysHash]--
			pl.need, pl.sources = append(pl.need, part), append(pl.sources, SourceObjectStore)
			pl.report.FromObjectStore++
		default:
			pl.report.Missing = append(pl.report.Missing, part.SafePartName)
		}
	}
	return pl, nil
}

func missingRefusal(pl planned) error {
	for _, part := range manifest(pl.part) {
		if slices.Contains(pl.report.Missing, part.SafePartName) {
			return refuse(ErrRebuildSourceMissing, part.SafePartName, abbreviate(part.PartRowLtHash), part.PartPhysHash, pl.part.table.TableID, pl.part.state.PartitionID)
		}
	}
	return refuse(ErrRebuildSourceMissing, pl.report.Missing[0], "?", "?", pl.part.table.TableID, pl.part.state.PartitionID)
}

func dryRun(ctx context.Context, cfg Config, conn clickhouse.Conn, partitions []ownedPartition, store ObjectStore) (Report, error) {
	report := Report{DryRun: true}
	var first *planned
	for _, p := range partitions {
		pl, err := planPartition(ctx, cfg, conn, p, store, true)
		if err != nil {
			return report, err
		}
		report.Partitions = append(report.Partitions, pl.report)
		if len(pl.report.Missing) > 0 && first == nil {
			first = &pl
		}
	}
	if first != nil {
		return report, missingRefusal(*first)
	}
	return report, nil
}

// alreadyRebuilt reports whether a run would change nothing: every owned
// table's hg_safe exists and equals the arbiter's SafeParts by content in
// every partition, holds no other partition, and the journal records every
// partition rebuilt at its PublishSeq. Then the report lists the partitions
// with nothing fetched, and nothing is written, the fence included (the
// server holds the replicas itself).
func alreadyRebuilt(ctx context.Context, cfg Config, conn clickhouse.Conn, tables []ownedTable, partitions []ownedPartition, journaled []bool) (bool, Report, error) {
	if slices.Contains(journaled, false) {
		return false, Report{}, nil
	}
	for _, t := range tables {
		exists, err := tableExists(ctx, conn, cfg.Pinned.SafeDB, t.Physical)
		if err != nil || !exists {
			return false, Report{}, err
		}
		if err := checkPartitionSet(ctx, cfg, conn, t, partitions); err != nil {
			return false, Report{}, nil
		}
	}
	report := Report{AlreadyRebuilt: true}
	for _, p := range partitions {
		_, have, err := localContent(ctx, conn, cfg.Pinned.SafeDB, p.table.Physical, p.table.Schema, p.state.PartitionID)
		if err != nil {
			return false, Report{}, err
		}
		if left, ok := subtract(manifest(p), have); !ok || len(left) > 0 {
			return false, Report{}, nil
		}
		report.Partitions = append(report.Partitions, PartitionReport{TableID: p.table.TableID, PartitionID: p.state.PartitionID,
			PublishSeq: p.state.PublishSeq, Parts: len(p.state.SafeParts), Root: p.state.BasePartitionRoot})
	}
	return true, report, nil
}

func tableExists(ctx context.Context, conn clickhouse.Conn, db, table string) (bool, error) {
	var n uint64
	if err := conn.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT count() FROM system.tables WHERE database = ? AND name = ?`, db, table).Scan(&n); err != nil {
		return false, fmt.Errorf("rebuild: look up %s.%s: %w", db, table, err)
	}
	return n > 0, nil
}

// locallyHeld reports, per owned table, whether this server already holds
// its hg_unsafe replica (system.replicas at its Keeper path with p.NodeID).
func locallyHeld(ctx context.Context, conn clickhouse.Conn, p ddl.Pinned, tables []ownedTable) (map[string]bool, error) {
	out := map[string]bool{}
	for _, t := range tables {
		var n uint64
		if err := conn.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT count() FROM system.replicas WHERE database = ? AND table = ? AND zookeeper_path = ? AND replica_name = ?`,
			p.UnsafeDB, t.Physical, ddl.ZooKeeperPath(p, t.TableID), p.NodeID).Scan(&n); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("rebuild %s: look up the local replica of %s: %w", PhaseFence, t.TableID, err)
		}
		out[t.TableID] = n > 0
	}
	return out, nil
}

// waitUnsafeSynced waits until every new hg_unsafe replica has worked off its
// replication queue (system.replicas queue_size 0), or until timeout passes;
// then the plan takes what the replicas hold, and the object store covers the
// rest. A new replica's CREATE copies the source replica's queue before it
// returns, so a queue of 0 is never read before the clone started.
func waitUnsafeSynced(ctx context.Context, conn clickhouse.Conn, db string, tables []ownedTable, timeout time.Duration) error {
	deadline := time.Now().Add(timeout)
	for _, t := range tables {
		for {
			var queue uint32
			err := conn.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT queue_size FROM system.replicas WHERE database = ? AND table = ?`, db, t.Physical).Scan(&queue)
			if err != nil {
				return fmt.Errorf("rebuild %s: replication queue of %s.%s: %w", PhaseTables, db, t.Physical, err)
			}
			if queue == 0 || !time.Now().Before(deadline) {
				break
			}
			select {
			case <-ctx.Done():
				return ctx.Err()
			case <-time.After(time.Second):
			}
		}
	}
	return nil
}

const scratchMarker = "__rebuild_"

// dropScratches drops every rebuild scratch table in db.
func dropScratches(ctx context.Context, conn clickhouse.Conn, db string) error {
	rows, err := conn.Query(ctx, `SELECT name FROM system.tables WHERE database = ? AND position(name, ?) > 0`, db, scratchMarker)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("rebuild %s: list scratch tables: %w", PhaseRestore, err)
	}
	var names []string
	for rows.Next() {
		var n string
		if err := rows.Scan(&n); err != nil {
			rows.Close()
			return err
		}
		names = append(names, n)
	}
	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
		rows.Close()
		return fmt.Errorf("rebuild %s: list scratch tables: %w", PhaseRestore, err)
	}
	rows.Close()
	for _, n := range names {
		if err := conn.Exec(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `%s`.`%s` SYNC", db, n)); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("rebuild %s: drop scratch %s.%s: %w", PhaseRestore, db, n, err)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// restorePartition fetches the plan's parts, own hg_unsafe first and then the
// object store, each source into a fresh scratch hg_promote.<t>__rebuild_<n>
// whose parts the gate classifies; it keeps exactly the needed parts, checks
// each kept part's hash_of_all_files against SafeParts, attaches them to
// hg_safe with ATTACH PARTITION FROM and checks the closure.
func restorePartition(ctx context.Context, cfg Config, conn clickhouse.Conn, pl planned, store ObjectStore, scratch *int) error {
	if len(pl.need) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	t, partitionID := pl.part.table, pl.part.state.PartitionID
	quoted, err := chparts.QuotePartition(t.Schema, partitionID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	safe := fmt.Sprintf("`%s`.`%s`", cfg.Pinned.SafeDB, t.Physical)
	var kept []string
	for _, source := range []Source{SourceOwnUnsafe, SourceObjectStore} {
		var group []arbiter.SafePartMapping
		for i, part := range pl.need {
			if pl.sources[i] == source {
				group = append(group, part)
			}
		}
		if len(group) == 0 {
			continue
		}
		*scratch++
		name := fmt.Sprintf("%s%s%d", t.Physical, scratchMarker, *scratch)
		qualified := fmt.Sprintf("`%s`.`%s`", cfg.Pinned.PromoteDB, name)
		switch source {
		case SourceOwnUnsafe:
			if err := conn.Exec(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("CREATE TABLE %s AS %s", qualified, safe)); err != nil {
				return fmt.Errorf("rebuild %s: create scratch %s: %w", PhaseRestore, qualified, err)
			}
			if err := conn.Exec(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("ALTER TABLE %s ATTACH PARTITION %s FROM `%s`.`%s`", qualified, quoted, cfg.Pinned.UnsafeDB, t.Physical)); err != nil {
				return fmt.Errorf("rebuild %s: attach %s partition %s from hg_unsafe: %w", PhaseRestore, t.TableID, partitionID, err)
			}
		case SourceObjectStore:
			if err := store.RestorePartitions(ctx, conn, t.TableID, []string{partitionID}, name); err != nil {
				return fmt.Errorf("rebuild %s: %w", PhaseRestore, err)
			}
		}
		groupKept, err := gateScratch(ctx, conn, cfg.Pinned.PromoteDB, name, qualified, t, partitionID, group)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := conn.Exec(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("ALTER TABLE %s ATTACH PARTITION %s FROM %s", safe, quoted, qualified)); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("rebuild %s: attach %s partition %s to hg_safe: %w", PhaseRestore, t.TableID, partitionID, err)
		}
		if err := conn.Exec(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS %s SYNC", qualified)); err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("rebuild %s: drop scratch %s: %w", PhaseRestore, qualified, err)
		}
		kept = append(kept, groupKept...)
	}
	if err := gate.Closure(pl.part.state.BasePartitionRoot, pl.local, kept); err != nil {
		localSum, _ := payloadexec.SumPartRowLtHashes(pl.local)
		keptSum, _ := payloadexec.SumPartRowLtHashes(kept)
		return refuse(ErrRebuildClosure, t.TableID, partitionID, abbreviate(localSum), abbreviate(keptSum), abbreviate(pl.part.state.BasePartitionRoot))
	}
	_, have, err := localContent(ctx, conn, cfg.Pinned.SafeDB, t.Physical, t.Schema, partitionID)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("rebuild %s: hg_safe.%s partition %s: %w", PhaseRestore, t.Physical, partitionID, err)
	}
	if left, ok := subtract(manifest(pl.part), have); !ok || len(left) > 0 {
		return refuse(ErrRebuildForeignSafeParts, t.Physical, partitionID)
	}
	return nil
}

// gateScratch classifies the scratch's parts with the restore gate in restore
// mode (keep each needed row LtHash once, drop the rest), drops the others,
// and requires each kept part's hash_of_all_files to be the one SafeParts
// records for its row LtHash. It returns the kept row LtHashes.
func gateScratch(ctx context.Context, conn clickhouse.Conn, db, name, qualified string, t ownedTable, partitionID string, group []arbiter.SafePartMapping) ([]string, error) {
	scans, err := chexec.ScanAllParts(ctx, conn, db+"."+name, t.Schema)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("rebuild %s: scan %s: %w", PhaseRestore, qualified, err)
	}
	parts, err := chparts.ActiveParts(ctx, conn, db, name)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("rebuild %s: parts of %s: %w", PhaseRestore, qualified, err)
	}
	phys := map[string]string{}
	for _, p := range parts {
		phys[p.Name] = p.PhysHash
	}
	want := map[string]string{} // row LtHash -> hash_of_all_files SafeParts records
	for _, g := range group {
		want[g.PartRowLtHash] = g.PartPhysHash
	}
	scratchParts := make([]gate.ScratchPart, 0, len(scans))
	for _, s := range scans {
		scratchParts = append(scratchParts, gate.ScratchPart{Name: s.PartName, RowLtHash: s.RowLtHash, Rows: s.RowCount})
	}
	// Offer the gate the parts whose files match SafeParts first, so of two
	// parts with one row LtHash it keeps the one the arbiter recorded.
	slices.SortStableFunc(scratchParts, func(a, b gate.ScratchPart) int {
		am, bm := phys[a.Name] == want[a.RowLtHash], phys[b.Name] == want[b.RowLtHash]
		switch {
		case am && !bm:
			return -1
		case bm && !am:
			return 1
		}
		return 0
	})
	c, err := gate.Classify(gate.Fetch{Need: rowHashes(group)}, scratchParts)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("rebuild %s: classify %s: %w", PhaseRestore, qualified, err)
	}
	for _, drop := range c.Drop {
		if err := conn.Exec(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("ALTER TABLE %s DROP PART '%s'", qualified, chparts.EscapeSQLString(drop))); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("rebuild %s: drop part %s of %s: %w", PhaseRestore, drop, qualified, err)
		}
	}
	byName := map[string]string{}
	for _, s := range scans {
		byName[s.PartName] = s.RowLtHash
	}
	for _, keep := range c.Keep {
		if got, recorded := phys[keep], want[byName[keep]]; got != recorded {
			return nil, refuse(ErrRebuildPhysHashMismatch, keep, t.TableID, partitionID, got, recorded)
		}
	}
	return c.Kept, nil
}

// checkPartitionSet requires hg_safe's partitions of t to be exactly the
// arbiter's partitions with safe parts.
func checkPartitionSet(ctx context.Context, cfg Config, conn clickhouse.Conn, t ownedTable, partitions []ownedPartition) error {
	var manifestIDs []string
	for _, p := range partitions {
		if p.table.TableID == t.TableID {
			manifestIDs = append(manifestIDs, p.state.PartitionID)
		}
	}
	parts, err := chparts.ActiveParts(ctx, conn, cfg.Pinned.SafeDB, t.Physical)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("rebuild %s: hg_safe.%s: %w", PhaseRestore, t.Physical, err)
	}
	var local []string
	for _, p := range parts {
		local = append(local, chparts.LogicalPartitionID(t.Schema, p))
	}
	if err := gate.PartitionSet(manifestIDs, local); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("rebuild %s: hg_safe.%s: %w", PhaseRestore, t.Physical, err)
	}
	return nil
}

// readBack is the partition's rebuilt inventory: each SafeParts entry with
// the name its content has in hg_safe now.
func readBack(ctx context.Context, cfg Config, conn clickhouse.Conn, p ownedPartition) ([]arbiter.SafePartMapping, error) {
	parts, have, err := localContent(ctx, conn, cfg.Pinned.SafeDB, p.table.Physical, p.table.Schema, p.state.PartitionID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("rebuild %s: hg_safe.%s partition %s: %w", PhaseJournal, p.table.Physical, p.state.PartitionID, err)
	}
	out := make([]arbiter.SafePartMapping, 0, len(parts))
	for i, part := range parts {
		out = append(out, arbiter.SafePartMapping{PartRowLtHash: have[i].Row, SafePartName: part.Name, PartPhysHash: have[i].Phys})
	}
	if left, ok := subtract(manifest(p), have); !ok || len(left) > 0 {
		return nil, refuse(ErrRebuildForeignSafeParts, p.table.Physical, p.state.PartitionID)
	}
	return out, nil
}

// abbreviate shortens a 4098-character accumulator for a message.
func abbreviate(h string) string {
	if len(h) <= 26 {
		return h
	}
	return h[:18] + "…" + h[len(h)-8:]
}
```

Create `snode/rebuild/fence.go`:

```go
package rebuild

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"slices"
	"strings"

	clickhouse "github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-go/v2"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/dataplane/ddl"
)

// FenceResult is the fence's outcome for one owned table: its Keeper path,
// whether this node's replica was registered there, and whether the fence
// dropped it.
type FenceResult struct {
	TableID, Path    string
	Present, Dropped bool
}

// Fence is the Keeper fence of a same-identity owner rebuild (housegate spec
// 2026-10-14 §16 P4; plan S3-D clarification K54), run before the new
// ClickHouse creates any replica: the scoped root /sentio/<shard>/unsafe_inc
// must have no child (every incarnation is on the unscoped path before the
// purge switch, spec §8.8), and then, per table, p.NodeID's replica is either
// absent, or present and inactive and dropped with SYSTEM DROP REPLICA ...
// FROM ZKPATH. A present replica that is still active refuses the fence
// (ErrFenceReplicaActive): the old ClickHouse is not dead, and nothing of a
// later table is dropped. Tables are fenced in the order given.
func Fence(ctx context.Context, conn clickhouse.Conn, p ddl.Pinned, tableIDs []string) ([]FenceResult, error) {
	root := fmt.Sprintf("/sentio/%d/unsafe_inc", p.KeeperShardID)
	children, err := ddl.ScopedUnsafeRootChildren(ctx, conn, p)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("rebuild %s: %w", PhaseFence, err)
	}
	if len(children) > 0 {
		return nil, refuse(ErrFenceScopedReplica, root, children)
	}
	out := make([]FenceResult, 0, len(tableIDs))
	for _, tableID := range tableIDs {
		res := FenceResult{TableID: tableID, Path: ddl.ZooKeeperPath(p, tableID)}
		replicas, err := ddl.KeeperReplicas(ctx, conn, p, tableID)
		if err != nil {
			return out, fmt.Errorf("rebuild %s: %w", PhaseFence, err)
		}
		if !slices.Contains(replicas, p.NodeID) {
			out = append(out, res)
			continue
		}
		res.Present = true
		active, err := ddl.ReplicaIsActive(ctx, conn, p, tableID, p.NodeID)
		if err != nil {
			return out, fmt.Errorf("rebuild %s: %w", PhaseFence, err)
		}
		if active {
			return out, refuse(ErrFenceReplicaActive, p.NodeID, tableID, replicaHost(ctx, conn, res.Path, p.NodeID))
		}
		if err := ddl.DropReplica(ctx, conn, p, tableID, p.NodeID); err != nil {
			if ddl.ReplicaActive(err) {
				// The old server came back between the check and the drop.
				return out, refuse(ErrFenceReplicaActive, p.NodeID, tableID, replicaHost(ctx, conn, res.Path, p.NodeID))
			}
			return out, fmt.Errorf("rebuild %s: %w", PhaseFence, err)
		}
		res.Dropped = true
		out = append(out, res)
	}
	return out, nil
}

// replicaHost is the host a replica registered under path (the host line of
// <path>/replicas/<replica>/host), for the operator; "an unknown host" when it
// cannot be read.
func replicaHost(ctx context.Context, conn clickhouse.Conn, path, replica string) string {
	var value string
	err := conn.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT value FROM system.zookeeper WHERE path = ? AND name = 'host'`, path+"/replicas/"+replica).Scan(&value)
	if err != nil {
		return "an unknown host"
	}
	for _, line := range strings.Split(value, "\n") {
		if host, ok := strings.CutPrefix(line, "host: "); ok && host != "" {
			return host
		}
	}
	return "an unknown host"
}
```

Create `snode/rebuild/objectstore.go`:

```go
package rebuild

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"strings"

	clickhouse "github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-go/v2"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/dataplane/chparts"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/dataplane/ddl"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/dataplane/objstore"
)

// ObjectStore is the rebuild's second source: one backup of the owner's
// hg_safe. Parts lists what the backup holds of one logical partition;
// RestorePartitions restores those partitions of one table into the fresh
// scratch table hg_promote.<scratch>, which it creates.
type ObjectStore interface {
	Parts(tableID, partitionID string) []BackupPart
	RestorePartitions(ctx context.Context, conn clickhouse.Conn, tableID string, partitionIDs []string, scratch string) error
}

// BackupPart is one part a backup holds: its name in the backed-up table, its
// hash_of_all_files and its row count.
type BackupPart struct {
	Name, HashOfAllFiles string
	Rows                 uint64
}

// promoteDatabase is the database of NewObjectStore's restore scratch: the
// SNode's promote database, where si_snode may create and drop tables.
const promoteDatabase = "hg_promote"

// NewObjectStore is the ObjectStore of one backup taken by Plan S3-C1's
// backup job (dataplane/objstore): it reads the backup's index through
// objstore.ReadIndexes and restores with objstore.RestoreSQL into
// hg_promote, the SNode's promote database. ref.Name names the backup; the
// index of that name must exist.
func NewObjectStore(ctx context.Context, conn clickhouse.Conn, ref objstore.BackupRef) (ObjectStore, error) {
	indexes, err := objstore.ReadIndexes(ctx, conn, ref.Bucket, ref.Owner, ref.Credentials)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("rebuild: read the backup indexes of indexer %d: %w", ref.Owner, err)
	}
	for _, idx := range indexes {
		if idx.Name == ref.Name {
			return newIndexStore(ref, idx), nil
		}
	}
	return nil, fmt.Errorf("rebuild: indexer %d has no backup %s under %s", ref.Owner, ref.Name, ref.Bucket.IndexGlob(ref.Owner))
}

// indexStore is NewObjectStore's ObjectStore: the parts of one backup index,
// keyed by physical table and logical partition.
type indexStore struct {
	ref   objstore.BackupRef
	parts map[string]map[string][]BackupPart
}

func newIndexStore(ref objstore.BackupRef, idx objstore.BackupIndex) *indexStore {
	s := &indexStore{ref: ref, parts: map[string]map[string][]BackupPart{}}
	for _, table := range idx.Tables {
		byPartition := s.parts[table.PhysicalTable]
		if byPartition == nil {
			byPartition = map[string][]BackupPart{}
			s.parts[table.PhysicalTable] = byPartition
		}
		for _, p := range table.Parts {
			byPartition[p.PartitionID] = append(byPartition[p.PartitionID], BackupPart{Name: p.Name, HashOfAllFiles: p.PhysHash, Rows: p.Rows})
		}
	}
	return s
}

func (s *indexStore) Parts(tableID, partitionID string) []BackupPart {
	return s.parts[ddl.CHTableName(tableID)][partitionID]
}

// RestorePartitions runs objstore.RestoreSQL synchronously: si_snode may not
// read system.backups, so the ASYNC form Plan S3-C1's jobs poll is not
// available to it, and a rebuild restores one partition per statement. The
// statement carries the key, so a failure names the backup, the table and
// the partitions, and ClickHouse's answer only with the secret redacted.
func (s *indexStore) RestorePartitions(ctx context.Context, conn clickhouse.Conn, tableID string, partitionIDs []string, scratch string) error {
	clause, err := partitionsClause(partitionIDs)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	physical := ddl.CHTableName(tableID)
	sql := objstore.RestoreSQL(s.ref.Bucket, s.ref.Owner, s.ref.Name, physical, clause, objstore.Scratch{Database: promoteDatabase, Table: scratch}, s.ref.Credentials)
	if err := conn.Exec(ctx, sql); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("rebuild: restore %s partitions %v of backup %s into %s.%s: %s",
			tableID, partitionIDs, s.ref.Name, promoteDatabase, scratch, redactSecret(err.Error(), s.ref.Credentials))
	}
	return nil
}

// redactSecret replaces c's secret, SQL-escaped and raw, in text: a server
// error may echo a fragment of the statement that carried it.
func redactSecret(text string, c objstore.Credentials) string {
	if c.SecretAccessKey == "" {
		return text
	}
	if escaped := chparts.EscapeSQLString(c.SecretAccessKey); escaped != c.SecretAccessKey {
		text = strings.ReplaceAll(text, escaped, "[redacted]")
	}
	return strings.ReplaceAll(text, c.SecretAccessKey, "[redacted]")
}

// partitionsClause is objstore.PartitionClause for a list of logical
// partition ids, which carry the partitioning (all, or p_<value>), so it needs
// no schema (the ObjectStore interface passes none): nothing for an
// unpartitioned table, else PARTITIONS with each quoted value. For one id it
// is PartitionClause's text.
func partitionsClause(partitionIDs []string) (string, error) {
	if len(partitionIDs) == 1 && partitionIDs[0] == "all" {
		return "", nil
	}
	values := make([]string, 0, len(partitionIDs))
	for _, id := range partitionIDs {
		value, ok := strings.CutPrefix(id, "p_")
		if !ok || value == "" {
			return "", fmt.Errorf("rebuild: partition id %s does not use p_<value> form", id)
		}
		values = append(values, "'"+chparts.EscapeSQLString(value)+"'")
	}
	if len(values) == 0 {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("rebuild: no partition to restore")
	}
	return "PARTITIONS " + strings.Join(values, ", "), nil
}
```

Create `snode/rebuild/report.go`:

```go
package rebuild

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"slices"
)

// PartitionReport is the rebuild's account of one owned partition: the
// arbiter's PublishSeq, the parts of its SafeParts, how many of them were
// fetched from each source (a dry run: would be; both 0 for a partition that
// already held them), the parts no source holds (a dry run only; a real run
// refuses instead), and the base root they close over.
type PartitionReport struct {
	TableID, PartitionID                  string
	PublishSeq                            uint64
	Parts, FromOwnUnsafe, FromObjectStore int
	Missing                               []string
	Root                                  string
}

// Report is a rebuild's outcome: the fence, one entry per owned partition
// with safe parts, whether hg_safe and the journal were already rebuilt (then
// nothing was written) and whether it was a dry run.
type Report struct {
	Fence          []FenceResult
	Partitions     []PartitionReport
	AlreadyRebuilt bool
	DryRun         bool
}

type fenceLine struct {
	Phase   Phase  `json:"phase"`
	TableID string `json:"table_id"`
	Path    string `json:"path"`
	Present bool   `json:"present"`
	Dropped bool   `json:"dropped"`
}

type partitionLine struct {
	Phase           Phase    `json:"phase"`
	TableID         string   `json:"table_id"`
	PartitionID     string   `json:"partition_id"`
	PublishSeq      uint64   `json:"publish_seq"`
	Parts           int      `json:"parts"`
	FromOwnUnsafe   int      `json:"from_own_unsafe"`
	FromObjectStore int      `json:"from_object_store"`
	Missing         []string `json:"missing"`
	Root            string   `json:"root"`
}

type doneLine struct {
	Phase           Phase `json:"phase"`
	DryRun          bool  `json:"dry_run"`
	AlreadyRebuilt  bool  `json:"already_rebuilt"`
	Tables          int   `json:"tables"`
	Partitions      int   `json:"partitions"`
	Parts           int   `json:"parts"`
	FromOwnUnsafe   int   `json:"from_own_unsafe"`
	FromObjectStore int   `json:"from_object_store"`
	Missing         int   `json:"missing"`
}

// JSONLines renders r as one JSON object per line, each with a "phase": one
// "fence" line per fence result, one "plan" (dry run) or "restore" line per
// partition, and a final "done" line with the totals. The lines carry no key
// or password.
func (r Report) JSONLines() []string {
	var out []string
	add := func(v any) {
		b, err := json.Marshal(v)
		if err != nil {
			panic(err) // the line types marshal without error
		}
		out = append(out, string(b))
	}
	for _, f := range r.Fence {
		add(fenceLine{Phase: PhaseFence, TableID: f.TableID, Path: f.Path, Present: f.Present, Dropped: f.Dropped})
	}
	phase := PhaseRestore
	if r.DryRun {
		phase = PhasePlan
	}
	done := doneLine{Phase: PhaseDone, DryRun: r.DryRun, AlreadyRebuilt: r.AlreadyRebuilt}
	var tables []string
	for _, p := range r.Partitions {
		missing := p.Missing
		if missing == nil {
			missing = []string{}
		}
		add(partitionLine{Phase: phase, TableID: p.TableID, PartitionID: p.PartitionID, PublishSeq: p.PublishSeq, Parts: p.Parts,
			FromOwnUnsafe: p.FromOwnUnsafe, FromObjectStore: p.FromObjectStore, Missing: missing, Root: p.Root})
		if !slices.Contains(tables, p.TableID) {
			tables = append(tables, p.TableID)
		}
		done.Partitions++
		done.Parts += p.Parts
		done.FromOwnUnsafe += p.FromOwnUnsafe
		done.FromObjectStore += p.FromObjectStore
		done.Missing += len(p.Missing)
	}
	done.Tables = len(tables)
	add(done)
	return out
}
```

```go
package chmechanics

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"slices"
	"testing"
	"time"

	clickhouse "github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-go/v2"

	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay/chexec"
	"github.com/housegate/housegate/pkg/replay/payloadexec"
)

// partHashes is every active part of db.table as (row LtHash, hash_of_all_files),
// sorted: the identity the restore gate and the arbiter compare, whatever the
// part names. Row LtHashes come from chexec.ScanAllParts, the rebuild's scan.
func partHashes(t *testing.T, conn clickhouse.Conn, db, table string, sch payloadexec.TableSchema) []string {
	t.Helper()
	scans, err := chexec.ScanAllParts(context.Background(), conn, db+"."+table, sch)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("scan %s.%s: %v", db, table, err)
	}
	phys := map[string]string{}
	for _, part := range partsOf(t, conn, db, table) {
		if part.Active {
			phys[part.Name] = part.PhysHash
		}
	}
	out := make([]string, 0, len(scans))
	for _, s := range scans {
		out = append(out, s.RowLtHash+"/"+phys[s.PartName])
	}
	slices.Sort(out)
	return out
}

// TestMechanics_RestoreAndAttachIntoAFreshTableKeepsEveryPartHash (M15) pins
// the restore path of the same-identity owner rebuild (housegate spec
// 2026-10-14 §16 P4; plan S3-D clarification K52): an hg_safe table with parts
// in two partitions, one of them after a REPLACE PARTITION, is backed up to a
// disk as in M5, restored with RESTORE ... AS <scratch> PARTITIONS, and
// attached with ATTACH PARTITION ... FROM the scratch into a fresh table of
// the same definition. Every part keeps its row LtHash and hash_of_all_files,
// which is what the arbiter's SafeParts and the owner audit's rebuilt rule
// compare; the names the fresh table gives the parts are logged, not
// asserted, because the rebuild never relies on them.
func TestMechanics_RestoreAndAttachIntoAFreshTableKeepsEveryPartHash(t *testing.T) {
	env := requireMechanics(t)
	p := mechanicsPinned(t)
	sch := mechanicsSchema(t)
	_, safe, promote := protocolTables(t, env.A, env.AAddr, p, sch)
	mustInsert(t, env.A, p.SafeDB, safe.Table, "p0", 0, 1_000, nil)
	mustInsert(t, env.A, p.SafeDB, safe.Table, "p0", 1_000, 1_000, nil)
	mustInsert(t, env.A, p.SafeDB, safe.Table, "p1", 0, 10, nil)
	// A promotion of p0: its shadow holds the base parts and one candidate,
	// and REPLACE PARTITION publishes them under new names.
	source, shadow := qualified(p.SafeDB, safe.Table), qualified(p.PromoteDB, promote.Table)
	mustExec(t, env.A, fmt.Sprintf("ALTER TABLE %s ATTACH PARTITION 'p0' FROM %s", shadow, source))
	mustInsert(t, env.A, p.PromoteDB, promote.Table, "p0", 2_000, 500, nil)
	mustExec(t, env.A, fmt.Sprintf("ALTER TABLE %s REPLACE PARTITION 'p0' FROM %s", source, shadow))
	mustExec(t, env.A, fmt.Sprintf("ALTER TABLE %s DROP PARTITION 'p0'", shadow))
	want := partHashes(t, env.A, p.SafeDB, safe.Table, sch)
	if len(want) != 4 {
		t.Fatalf("the source holds %d parts, want 4 (three in p0 after the REPLACE, one in p1)", len(want))
	}
	disk := fmt.Sprintf("Disk('backups', %s)", literal(fmt.Sprintf("mech_%s_%d_rebuild", suffix(t), time.Now().UnixNano())))
	runBackup(t, env.A, fmt.Sprintf("BACKUP TABLE %s TO %s", source, disk), "BACKUP_CREATED")

	restoreDB, freshDB := "hg_promote_r"+suffix(t), "hg_safe_r"+suffix(t)
	dropDatabasesAt(t, env.AAddr, restoreDB, freshDB)
	mustExec(t, env.A, "CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS "+ident(restoreDB))
	mustExec(t, env.A, "CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS "+ident(freshDB))
	scratch := qualified(restoreDB, safe.Table+"__rebuild_1")
	fresh := qualified(freshDB, safe.Table)
	runBackup(t, env.A, fmt.Sprintf("RESTORE TABLE %s AS %s PARTITIONS 'p0', 'p1' FROM %s", source, scratch, disk), "RESTORED")
	mustExec(t, env.A, fmt.Sprintf("CREATE TABLE %s AS %s", fresh, source))
	for _, partition := range []string{"p0", "p1"} {
		mustExec(t, env.A, fmt.Sprintf("ALTER TABLE %s ATTACH PARTITION %s FROM %s", fresh, literal(partition), scratch))
	}

	got := partHashes(t, env.A, freshDB, safe.Table, sch)
	if !slices.Equal(got, want) {
		t.Fatalf("after RESTORE and ATTACH PARTITION FROM the fresh table holds (row LtHash/hash_of_all_files)\n%v\nthe source held\n%v", got, want)
	}
	t.Logf("part names: source %v, fresh table %v", names(activeParts(t, env.A, p.SafeDB, safe.Table, "p0")), names(activeParts(t, env.A, freshDB, safe.Table, "p0")))
}
```

Create `dataplane/chmechanics/interserver_test.go`:

```go
package chmechanics

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	clickhouse "github.com/ClickHouse/clickhouse-go/v2"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/dataplane/chtest"
)

// The interserver mechanics (M16; plan S3-D clarification K56) run on a
// second pair that scripts/ci/clickhouse-mechanics.sh starts beside the
// first: ch-iscred has interserver_http_credentials (user si_interserver,
// the CI-only password of scripts/ci/clickhouse-mechanics-interserver.xml,
// allow_empty true), ch-isplain has none, and both use node A's Keeper.
const (
	envInterserver  = "ARBITER_CH_INTERSERVER"
	envIsCredAddr   = "CH_ISCRED_ADDR"
	envIsPlainAddr  = "CH_ISPLAIN_ADDR"
	interserverWait = 60 * time.Second
)

// interserverRefusals are the interserver handler's answers (HTTP 401) to a
// fetcher that sends credentials to a server that has none: the text plan
// S3-D clarification K56 quotes, and the one upstream 25.8 to 26.7 answer
// (measured while drafting plan S3-D on 25.8.28.1, 26.2, 26.3.51.7 and
// 26.7.5.10: the uncredentialed server checks the fetcher's user against an
// empty credential set).
var interserverRefusals = []string{
	"Client requires HTTP Basic authentication, but server doesn't provide it",
	"Incorrect user or password in HTTP basic authentication: si_interserver",
}

type interserverEnv struct {
	Cred, Plain         clickhouse.Conn
	CredAddr, PlainAddr string
}

// requireInterserver is a second opt-in, ARBITER_CH_INTERSERVER=1, after the
// suite's; once set, a missing address fails.
func requireInterserver(t *testing.T) interserverEnv {
	t.Helper()
	requireMechanics(t)
	if os.Getenv(envInterserver) != "1" {
		t.Skip("set ARBITER_CH_INTERSERVER=1, CH_ISCRED_ADDR and CH_ISPLAIN_ADDR (scripts/ci/clickhouse-mechanics.sh starts the pair) to run the interserver mechanics")
	}
	var missing []string
	for _, name := range []string{envIsCredAddr, envIsPlainAddr} {
		if os.Getenv(name) == "" {
			missing = append(missing, name)
		}
	}
	if len(missing) > 0 {
		t.Fatalf("ARBITER_CH_INTERSERVER=1 requires %s", strings.Join(missing, ", "))
	}
	env := interserverEnv{CredAddr: os.Getenv(envIsCredAddr), PlainAddr: os.Getenv(envIsPlainAddr)}
	env.Cred, env.Plain = chtest.Open(t, env.CredAddr), chtest.Open(t, env.PlainAddr)
	requireKeeper(t, envIsCredAddr, env.Cred)
	requireKeeper(t, envIsPlainAddr, env.Plain)
	return env
}

// interserverTable creates one ReplicatedMergeTree table, under a Keeper path
// of the test's own, on both servers (replicas iscred and isplain) and returns
// its database.
func interserverTable(t *testing.T, env interserverEnv) string {
	t.Helper()
	db := "mech_is_" + suffix(t)
	path := "/mechanics/interserver/" + suffix(t)
	for _, s := range []struct {
		conn          clickhouse.Conn
		addr, replica string
	}{{env.Cred, env.CredAddr, "iscred"}, {env.Plain, env.PlainAddr, "isplain"}} {
		dropDatabasesAt(t, s.addr, db)
		mustExec(t, s.conn, "CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS "+ident(db))
		mustExec(t, s.conn, fmt.Sprintf("CREATE TABLE %s (v UInt64) ENGINE = ReplicatedMergeTree(%s, %s) ORDER BY v",
			qualified(db, "t"), literal(path), literal(s.replica)))
	}
	return db
}

// TestMechanics_InterserverAllowEmptyAcceptsAnUncredentialedFetcher (M16): a
// part inserted on the credentialed server reaches the uncredentialed one:
// with allow_empty a credentialed server serves a fetcher that sends no
// credentials, so in interserver step 1 every source may be credentialed
// before its fetchers are (K56), and the fetched part keeps its
// hash_of_all_files.
func TestMechanics_InterserverAllowEmptyAcceptsAnUncredentialedFetcher(t *testing.T) {
	env := requireInterserver(t)
	db := interserverTable(t, env)
	mustExec(t, env.Cred, fmt.Sprintf("INSERT INTO %s SELECT number FROM numbers(10)", qualified(db, "t")))
	eventually(t, interserverWait, "ch-isplain fetching the part inserted on ch-iscred", func() (bool, string) {
		n, err := countRows(env.Plain, qualified(db, "t"))
		return err == nil && n == 10, fmt.Sprintf("ch-isplain holds %d rows (%v)", n, err)
	})
	if got, want := physHashes(activeParts(t, env.Plain, db, "t", "tuple()")), physHashes(activeParts(t, env.Cred, db, "t", "tuple()")); strings.Join(got, ",") != strings.Join(want, ",") {
		t.Fatalf("the fetched part's hash_of_all_files %v, the source's %v", got, want)
	}
}

// TestMechanics_InterserverUncredentialedServerRefusesACredentialedFetcher
// (M16): a part inserted on the uncredentialed server does not reach the
// credentialed one within 60 s, whose replication queue records the
// interserver handler's refusal: a fetcher that sends credentials is refused
// by a server that has none, which is why interserver step 1 credentials the
// sources before the fetchers (K56).
func TestMechanics_InterserverUncredentialedServerRefusesACredentialedFetcher(t *testing.T) {
	env := requireInterserver(t)
	db := interserverTable(t, env)
	start := time.Now()
	mustExec(t, env.Plain, fmt.Sprintf("INSERT INTO %s SELECT number FROM numbers(10)", qualified(db, "t")))
	var refusal string
	eventually(t, interserverWait, "ch-iscred's replication queue recording the refused fetch", func() (bool, string) {
		var exception string
		err := env.Cred.QueryRow(context.Background(),
			"SELECT any(last_exception) FROM system.replication_queue WHERE database = ? AND table = 't' AND last_exception != ''", db).Scan(&exception)
		for _, r := range interserverRefusals {
			if err == nil && strings.Contains(exception, "HTTP status code: 401") && strings.Contains(exception, r) {
				refusal = r
				return true, ""
			}
		}
		first, _, _ := strings.Cut(exception, "Stack trace")
		return false, fmt.Sprintf("last_exception %q (%v)", first, err)
	})
	t.Logf("M16 interserver refusal: %s", refusal)
	for time.Since(start) < interserverWait {
		if n := mustCountRows(t, env.Cred, qualified(db, "t")); n != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("ch-iscred holds %d rows %s after the insert: an uncredentialed server served a credentialed fetcher", n, time.Since(start).Round(time.Second))
		}
		time.Sleep(time.Second)
	}
}
```
