```go
// TestSettleTrackRefusesASecondSettleOfOneIndexer: one active settle per
// indexer; once it ended, a new one may begin and replaces the record.
func TestSettleTrackRefusesASecondSettleOfOneIndexer(t *testing.T) {
	rec := settleServerFixture(t)
	admin := settleAdmin(rec, rec.f, 5*time.Minute, true)
	ctx := context.Background()
	first, err := admin.SettleTrack(ctx, settleRequest(t, rec.f, serverTestAuthority, 1, 1, 1))
	if err != nil || first.GetState() != pb.TrackSettleState_TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_ACTIVE {
		t.Fatalf("first settle = %v, %v", first, err)
	}
	_, err = admin.SettleTrack(ctx, settleRequest(t, rec.f, serverTestAuthority, 1, 1, 1))
	if status.Code(err) != codes.FailedPrecondition || status.Convert(err).Message() != "a track settle of indexer 1 is already active" {
		t.Fatalf("second settle = %v", err)
	}
	admin.s.settles.EndSettle(1, pb.TrackSettleState_TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_EXPIRED)
	again, err := admin.SettleTrack(ctx, settleRequest(t, rec.f, serverTestAuthority, 1, 1, 1))
	if err != nil || again.GetState() != pb.TrackSettleState_TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_ACTIVE || again.GetSends() != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("a settle after the first ended = %v, %v", again, err)
	}
}

// TestSettleTrackAuthority: the request's order is EvictNode's and the
// quarantine RPCs': updates enabled, the tracks activation, shape,
// leadership, then the authority: a non-authority key, a token of another
// purpose or over another list, a token of another epoch and a token older
// than max_token_age are each PermissionDenied, and nothing is recorded.
func TestSettleTrackAuthority(t *testing.T) {
	rec := settleServerFixture(t)
	ctx := context.Background()
	follower := &recordingNode{fakeNode: &fakeNode{f: rec.f}}
	if _, err := settleAdmin(follower, rec.f, 5*time.Minute, true).SettleTrack(ctx, settleRequest(t, rec.f, serverTestAuthority, 1, 1, 1)); !isNotLeader(err) {
		t.Fatalf("a follower's settle = %v, want NotLeader", err)
	}
	admin := settleAdmin(rec, rec.f, 5*time.Minute, true)
	quarantineToken := quarantineRequest(t, rec.f, serverTestAuthority, 1, 1, "stuck").GetAuthorityJws()
	otherList := settleRequest(t, rec.f, serverTestAuthority, 1, 1, 1, 2)
	nextEpoch := serverAuthorityContext(t, rec.f)
	nextEpoch.AuthorityEpoch++
	epochToken, err := serverTestAuthority.SignSettleTrackWithContext(arbiter.SettleTrackCommand{IndexerID: 1, ExpectedGeneration: 1, PromotionSeqs: []uint64{1}}, nextEpoch)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for name, req := range map[string]*pb.SettleTrackRequest{
		"a non-authority key":   settleRequest(t, rec.f, authoritytest.MustSigner(t, authoritytest.IndexerKeyHex1), 1, 1, 1),
		"a quarantine token":    {IndexerId: 1, ExpectedGeneration: 1, PromotionSeqs: []uint64{1}, AuthorityJws: quarantineToken},
		"a token of [1 2]":      {IndexerId: 1, ExpectedGeneration: 1, PromotionSeqs: []uint64{1}, AuthorityJws: otherList.GetAuthorityJws()},
		"a token of epoch + 1":  {IndexerId: 1, ExpectedGeneration: 1, PromotionSeqs: []uint64{1}, AuthorityJws: epochToken},
		"a token of another id": {IndexerId: 1, ExpectedGeneration: 1, PromotionSeqs: []uint64{1}, AuthorityJws: settleRequest(t, rec.f, serverTestAuthority, 2, 1, 1).GetAuthorityJws()},
	} {
		_, err := admin.SettleTrack(ctx, req)
		if status.Code(err) != codes.PermissionDenied || !strings.HasPrefix(status.Convert(err).Message(), "track settle authority: ") {
			t.Fatalf("%s: %v", name, err)
		}
	}
	if _, err := settleAdmin(rec, rec.f, 0, true).SettleTrack(ctx, settleRequest(t, rec.f, serverTestAuthority, 1, 1, 1)); status.Code(err) != codes.PermissionDenied {
		t.Fatalf("a zero max_token_age must fail closed: %v", err)
	}
	if _, ok := admin.s.settles.Get(1); ok {
		t.Fatal("a refused settle left a record")
	}
	got, err := admin.SettleTrack(ctx, settleRequest(t, rec.f, serverTestAuthority, 1, 1, 1))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("the authority's settle = %v", err)
	}
	want := &pb.TrackSettle{IndexerId: 1, Quarantined: true, QuarantineGeneration: 1, UnackedPromotionSeqs: []uint64{1},
		State: pb.TrackSettleState_TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_ACTIVE, PromotionSeqs: []uint64{1}, ExpiresUnixMs: got.GetExpiresUnixMs(),
		SnodeNodeId: "s1", SnodeSettleCapable: true}
	if !proto.Equal(got, want) || got.GetExpiresUnixMs() == 0 {
		t.Fatalf("the authority's settle = %v, want %v", got, want)
	}
}

// TestGetTrackSettlePreviewsTheWithheldPromotions: without a settle the read
// is the preview arbiter-admin signs (state UNSPECIFIED, every settle field
// zero); with one it describes it. It crosses one leader barrier, refuses an
// indexer without a track with NotFound, and a follower answers NotLeader.
func TestGetTrackSettlePreviewsTheWithheldPromotions(t *testing.T) {
	rec := settleServerFixture(t)
	var barriers atomic.Int32
	rec.barrier = func(time.Duration) error { barriers.Add(1); return nil }
	admin := settleAdmin(rec, rec.f, 5*time.Minute, true)
	ctx := context.Background()
	preview, err := admin.GetTrackSettle(ctx, &pb.TrackSettleRef{IndexerId: 1})
	if err != nil || !proto.Equal(preview, &pb.TrackSettle{IndexerId: 1, Quarantined: true, QuarantineGeneration: 1, UnackedPromotionSeqs: []uint64{1}}) || barriers.Load() != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("preview = %v, %v (barriers %d)", preview, err, barriers.Load())
	}
	if _, err := admin.GetTrackSettle(ctx, &pb.TrackSettleRef{IndexerId: 7}); status.Code(err) != codes.NotFound || status.Convert(err).Message() != "indexer 7 is not enrolled" {
		t.Fatalf("GetTrackSettle(7) = %v", err)
	}
	if _, err := admin.SettleTrack(ctx, settleRequest(t, rec.f, serverTestAuthority, 1, 1, 1)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	admin.s.settles.CountSend(1)
	got, err := admin.GetTrackSettle(ctx, &pb.TrackSettleRef{IndexerId: 1})
	if err != nil || got.GetState() != pb.TrackSettleState_TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_ACTIVE || !slices.Equal(got.GetPromotionSeqs(), []uint64{1}) ||
		got.GetSnodeNodeId() != "s1" || !got.GetSnodeSettleCapable() || got.GetSends() != 1 || !slices.Equal(got.GetUnackedPromotionSeqs(), []uint64{1}) {
		t.Fatalf("GetTrackSettle during the settle = %v, %v", got, err)
	}
	admin.s.snodes.registerHello(&pb.SNodeHello{NodeId: "s1"})
	if got, _ := admin.GetTrackSettle(ctx, &pb.TrackSettleRef{IndexerId: 1}); got.GetSnodeSettleCapable() {
		t.Fatalf("snode_settle_capable after s1 reconnected without settle = %v", got)
	}
	follower := settleAdmin(&recordingNode{fakeNode: &fakeNode{f: rec.f}}, rec.f, 5*time.Minute, true)
	if _, err := follower.GetTrackSettle(ctx, &pb.TrackSettleRef{IndexerId: 1}); !isNotLeader(err) {
		t.Fatalf("a follower's GetTrackSettle = %v, want NotLeader", err)
	}
	if rec.proposals() != 0 {
		t.Fatal("a settle read was proposed")
	}
}

// TestTrackSettleExpiresAfterItsTimeout: timeout_ms bounds a settle, 0
// selects consensus_admin.max_track_settle and a larger value is capped to
// it; an expired settle is EXPIRED, no longer active, and counts once.
func TestTrackSettleExpiresAfterItsTimeout(t *testing.T) {
	rec := settleServerFixture(t)
	clock := &settleClock{t: time.Unix(1_800_000_000, 0)}
	metrics := &recordingSettleMetrics{}
	admin := &consensusAdminService{s: New(Deps{Node: rec, FSM: rec.f, TrackSettleMetrics: metrics, Cfg: Config{NodeID: "arb-0", ApplyTimeout: time.Second,
		ConsensusUpdatesEnabled: true, ConsensusAdminMaxTokenAge: 5 * time.Minute, ConsensusMaxTrackSettle: time.Minute}})}
	admin.s.settles.now = clock.now
	admin.s.snodes.registerHello(&pb.SNodeHello{NodeId: "s1", Settle: true})
	ctx := context.Background()
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		timeoutMs uint64
		want      time.Duration
	}{{0, time.Minute}, {3_600_000, time.Minute}, {1 << 63, time.Minute}, {1000, time.Second}} {
		req := settleRequest(t, rec.f, serverTestAuthority, 1, 1, 1)
		req.TimeoutMs = tc.timeoutMs
		got, err := admin.SettleTrack(ctx, req)
		if err != nil || got.GetExpiresUnixMs() != uint64(clock.now().Add(tc.want).UnixMilli()) {
			t.Fatalf("timeout_ms %d: %v, %v; want expiry in %s", tc.timeoutMs, got, err, tc.want)
		}
		if tc.timeoutMs != 1000 {
			admin.s.settles.EndSettle(1, pb.TrackSettleState_TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_SETTLED)
		}
	}
	clock.advance(999 * time.Millisecond)
	if active := admin.s.settles.ActiveSettles(); len(active) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("active settles before the deadline = %+v", active)
	}
	clock.advance(time.Millisecond)
	if active := admin.s.settles.ActiveSettles(); len(active) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("active settles at the deadline = %+v", active)
	}
	got, err := admin.GetTrackSettle(ctx, &pb.TrackSettleRef{IndexerId: 1})
	if err != nil || got.GetState() != pb.TrackSettleState_TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_EXPIRED {
		t.Fatalf("GetTrackSettle after the deadline = %v, %v", got, err)
	}
	admin.s.settles.CountSend(1)
	metrics.mu.Lock()
	defer metrics.mu.Unlock()
	if !slices.Equal(metrics.ended, []string{"settled", "settled", "settled", "expired"}) || metrics.active[1] || metrics.sent != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("metrics = ended %v, active %v, sent %d", metrics.ended, metrics.active, metrics.sent)
	}
}

// TestTrackSettleClearsOnLeadershipLoss: a settle is leader-local. Losing
// leadership ends it LEADERSHIP_LOST, and so does a Raft term that moved
// under it (a leader that lost and regained leadership in between) and a
// step-down within the term between the leader check and Begin, which the
// second leader check after Begin sees.
func TestTrackSettleClearsOnLeadershipLoss(t *testing.T) {
	rec := settleServerFixture(t)
	node := &termNode{recordingNode: rec}
	node.term.Store(4)
	metrics := &recordingSettleMetrics{}
	admin := &consensusAdminService{s: New(Deps{Node: node, FSM: rec.f, TrackSettleMetrics: metrics, Cfg: Config{NodeID: "arb-0", ApplyTimeout: time.Second,
		ConsensusUpdatesEnabled: true, ConsensusAdminMaxTokenAge: 5 * time.Minute}})}
	admin.s.snodes.registerHello(&pb.SNodeHello{NodeId: "s1", Settle: true})
	ctx := context.Background()
	got, err := admin.SettleTrack(ctx, settleRequest(t, rec.f, serverTestAuthority, 1, 1, 1))
	if err != nil || got.GetRaftTerm() != 4 {
		t.Fatalf("settle in term 4 = %v, %v", got, err)
	}
	admin.s.OnLeadershipLost()
	if rec, ok := admin.s.settles.Get(1); !ok || rec.State != pb.TrackSettleState_TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_LEADERSHIP_LOST || len(admin.s.settles.ActiveSettles()) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("after OnLeadershipLost: %+v, %v", rec, ok)
	}
	admin.s.snodes.registerHello(&pb.SNodeHello{NodeId: "s1", Settle: true})
	if _, err := admin.SettleTrack(ctx, settleRequest(t, rec.f, serverTestAuthority, 1, 1, 1)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	node.term.Store(5)
	got, err = admin.GetTrackSettle(ctx, &pb.TrackSettleRef{IndexerId: 1})
	if err != nil || got.GetState() != pb.TrackSettleState_TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_LEADERSHIP_LOST || got.GetRaftTerm() != 4 {
		t.Fatalf("a settle of term 4 read in term 5 = %v, %v", got, err)
	}
	var checks atomic.Int32
	rec.verify = func() error {
		if checks.Add(1) > 1 {
			return raft.ErrNotLeader
		}
		return nil
	}
	if _, err := admin.SettleTrack(ctx, settleRequest(t, rec.f, serverTestAuthority, 1, 1, 1)); !isNotLeader(err) {
		t.Fatalf("a settle whose leader stepped down before Begin returned = %v, want NotLeader", err)
	}
	if stale, ok := admin.s.settles.Get(1); !ok || stale.State != pb.TrackSettleState_TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_LEADERSHIP_LOST || stale.Term != 5 || checks.Load() != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("after a step-down before Begin: %+v, %v (leader checks %d)", stale, ok, checks.Load())
	}
	metrics.mu.Lock()
	defer metrics.mu.Unlock()
	if !slices.Equal(metrics.ended, []string{"leadership_lost", "leadership_lost", "leadership_lost"}) || metrics.active[1] {
		t.Fatalf("metrics = ended %v, active %v", metrics.ended, metrics.active)
	}
}

// TestSettleTrackWritesNothingToTheLog: a settle and its reads are
// leader-local: no proposal, no change to replicated state, and SettleTrack
// takes no barrier.
func TestSettleTrackWritesNothingToTheLog(t *testing.T) {
	rec := settleServerFixture(t)
	var barriers atomic.Int32
	rec.barrier = func(time.Duration) error { barriers.Add(1); return nil }
	before := serverSnapshotBytes(t, rec.f)
	admin := settleAdmin(rec, rec.f, 5*time.Minute, true)
	if _, err := admin.SettleTrack(context.Background(), settleRequest(t, rec.f, serverTestAuthority, 1, 1, 1)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if barriers.Load() != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("SettleTrack took %d barriers", barriers.Load())
	}
	if _, err := admin.GetTrackSettle(context.Background(), &pb.TrackSettleRef{IndexerId: 1}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	admin.s.settles.EndSettle(1, pb.TrackSettleState_TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_SETTLED)
	if rec.proposals() != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("the settle proposed %d commands", rec.proposals())
	}
	if !bytes.Equal(before, serverSnapshotBytes(t, rec.f)) {
		t.Fatal("the settle changed replicated state")
	}
}

// serverSnapshotBytes is f's persisted snapshot container.
func serverSnapshotBytes(t *testing.T, f *fsm.FSM) []byte {
	t.Helper()
	snap, err := f.Snapshot()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer snap.Release()
	sink := &blockSnapshotSink{}
	if err := snap.Persist(sink); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return sink.Bytes()
}

// TestTrackSettleAttemptFencesReplacementExpiryAndTerm exercises the actual
// registry behind the loop's conditional operations without scheduling races.
func TestTrackSettleAttemptFencesReplacementExpiryAndTerm(t *testing.T) {
	clock := &settleClock{t: time.Unix(1_800_000_000, 0)}
	reg := NewTrackSettles(time.Minute, clock.now)
	term := uint64(4)
	reg.term = func() uint64 { return term }
	work := TrackSettleRecord{}.Work
	work.IndexerID, work.Generation, work.PromotionSeqs = 1, 1, []uint64{1}
	first, err := reg.Begin(term, work, "s1", time.Second)
	if err != nil || first.Work.Attempt == 0 {
		t.Fatalf("begin: %+v, %v", first, err)
	}
	stale := reg.ActiveSettles()[0]
	clock.advance(time.Second)
	work.Generation = 2
	second, err := reg.Begin(term, work, "s1", time.Second)
	if err != nil || second.Work.Attempt <= stale.Attempt {
		t.Fatalf("replacement: %+v, %v", second, err)
	}
	reg.EndSettleAttempt(stale, pb.TrackSettleState_TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_RELEASED)
	calls := 0
	if err := reg.SendSettleAttempt(stale, func() error { calls++; return nil }); !errors.Is(err, ErrTrackSettleInactive) {
		t.Fatalf("stale send: %v", err)
	}
	current, _ := reg.Get(1)
	if calls != 0 || current.State != pb.TrackSettleState_TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_ACTIVE || current.Sends != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("stale work changed replacement: %+v calls=%d", current, calls)
	}
	failed := errors.New("enqueue failed")
	if err := reg.SendSettleAttempt(second.Work, func() error { return failed }); !errors.Is(err, failed) {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	current, _ = reg.Get(1)
	if current.Sends != 0 {
		t.Fatal("failed enqueue counted")
	}
	if err := reg.SendSettleAttempt(second.Work, func() error { calls++; return nil }); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	current, _ = reg.Get(1)
	if calls != 1 || current.Sends != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("current send: calls=%d record=%+v", calls, current)
	}
	clock.advance(time.Second)
	if err := reg.SendSettleAttempt(second.Work, func() error { calls++; return nil }); !errors.Is(err, ErrTrackSettleInactive) {
		t.Fatalf("expired send: %v", err)
	}
	reg.EndSettleAttempt(second.Work, pb.TrackSettleState_TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_SETTLED)
	current, _ = reg.Get(1)
	if current.State != pb.TrackSettleState_TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_EXPIRED || calls != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expiry overwritten: %+v calls=%d", current, calls)
	}
	third, err := reg.Begin(term, work, "s1", time.Second)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	term++
	if err := reg.SendSettleAttempt(third.Work, func() error { calls++; return nil }); !errors.Is(err, ErrTrackSettleInactive) {
		t.Fatalf("old term send: %v", err)
	}
	current, _ = reg.Get(1)
	if current.State != pb.TrackSettleState_TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_LEADERSHIP_LOST || calls != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("term changed: %+v calls=%d", current, calls)
	}
}

func TestTrackSettleLegacyOperationsRespectExpiry(t *testing.T) {
	for _, operation := range []string{"count", "end"} {
		t.Run(operation, func(t *testing.T) {
			clock := &settleClock{t: time.Unix(1_800_000_000, 0)}
			reg := NewTrackSettles(time.Second, clock.now)
			work := TrackSettleRecord{}.Work
			work.IndexerID, work.Generation, work.PromotionSeqs = 1, 1, []uint64{1}
			if _, err := reg.Begin(0, work, "s1", time.Second); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			clock.advance(time.Second)
			if operation == "count" {
				reg.CountSend(1)
			} else {
				reg.EndSettle(1, pb.TrackSettleState_TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_SETTLED)
			}
			rec, _ := reg.Get(1)
			if rec.State != pb.TrackSettleState_TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_EXPIRED || rec.Sends != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("expired %s changed record: %+v", operation, rec)
			}
		})
	}
}
```

Create `server/track_settle.go`:

```go
package server

import (
	"errors"
	"math"
	"slices"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"time"

	pb "github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-proto/gen/pb"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/codes"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/status"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter/orchestrator"
)

// defaultConsensusMaxTrackSettle is consensus_admin.max_track_settle's
// default: the longest a settle runs, and the timeout a request without one
// gets.
const defaultConsensusMaxTrackSettle = 10 * time.Minute

// TrackSettleMetrics receives the leader's settle activity (plan S3-D
// contract §35.3); nil disables it.
type TrackSettleMetrics interface {
	// TrackSettleActive is 1 while indexerID has an active settle.
	TrackSettleActive(indexerID uint64, active bool)
	// TrackSettleEnded counts a settle that ended in state (settled,
	// released, expired or leadership_lost).
	TrackSettleEnded(state string)
	// TrackSettleSent counts one settle command an SNode stream accepted.
	TrackSettleSent()
}

// TrackSettleRecord is one indexer's current or last settle on this leader.
type TrackSettleRecord struct {
	Work        orchestrator.SettleWork
	Term        uint64
	Expires     time.Time
	SNodeNodeID string
	State       pb.TrackSettleState
	Sends       uint64
}

// TrackSettles is the leader-local settle registry (housegate spec
// 2026-10-14 §14, plan S3-D K53): at most one active settle per indexer,
// whose listed promotions the orchestrator streams until each is
// acknowledged. Nothing in it is replicated. A settle ends SETTLED or
// RELEASED by the orchestrator, EXPIRED at its deadline and LEADERSHIP_LOST
// when this node stops leading or its Raft term moves; the last record of
// every indexer stays readable until the next Begin.
type TrackSettles struct {
	maxDuration time.Duration
	now         func() time.Time
	// term reads the current Raft term; nil (test fakes without one) records
	// term 0 throughout.
	term    func() uint64
	metrics TrackSettleMetrics

	mu          sync.Mutex
	records     map[uint64]*TrackSettleRecord
	nextAttempt uint64
}

// NewTrackSettles returns an empty registry whose settles run at most
// maxDuration (the default when not positive), timed by now (time.Now when
// nil).
func NewTrackSettles(maxDuration time.Duration, now func() time.Time) *TrackSettles {
	if maxDuration <= 0 {
		maxDuration = defaultConsensusMaxTrackSettle
	}
	if now == nil {
		now = time.Now
	}
	return &TrackSettles{maxDuration: maxDuration, now: now, records: map[uint64]*TrackSettleRecord{}}
}

// Begin starts the settle of work.IndexerID in Raft term term towards the
// SNode snodeNodeID. timeout 0 selects the maximum and a larger one is capped
// to it. It refuses while the indexer already has an active settle.
func (t *TrackSettles) Begin(term uint64, work orchestrator.SettleWork, snodeNodeID string, timeout time.Duration) (TrackSettleRecord, error) {
	t.mu.Lock()
	defer t.mu.Unlock()
	if rec := t.records[work.IndexerID]; rec != nil {
		t.refreshLocked(rec)
		if rec.State == pb.TrackSettleState_TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_ACTIVE {
			return TrackSettleRecord{}, status.Errorf(codes.FailedPrecondition, "a track settle of indexer %d is already active", work.IndexerID)
		}
	}
	if timeout <= 0 || timeout > t.maxDuration {
		timeout = t.maxDuration
	}
	if t.nextAttempt == math.MaxUint64 {
		return TrackSettleRecord{}, status.Error(codes.ResourceExhausted, "track settle attempt identity exhausted")
	}
	t.nextAttempt++
	rec := &TrackSettleRecord{
		Work:        orchestrator.SettleWork{Attempt: t.nextAttempt, IndexerID: work.IndexerID, Generation: work.Generation, PromotionSeqs: slices.Clone(work.PromotionSeqs)},
		Term:        term,
		Expires:     t.now().Add(timeout),
		SNodeNodeID: snodeNodeID,
		State:       pb.TrackSettleState_TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_ACTIVE,
	}
	t.records[work.IndexerID] = rec
	if t.metrics != nil {
		t.metrics.TrackSettleActive(work.IndexerID, true)
	}
	return cloneTrackSettleRecord(rec), nil
}

// Get is indexerID's current or last settle record, with its expiry and term
// checked first.
func (t *TrackSettles) Get(indexerID uint64) (TrackSettleRecord, bool) {
	t.mu.Lock()
	defer t.mu.Unlock()
	rec := t.records[indexerID]
	if rec == nil {
		return TrackSettleRecord{}, false
	}
	t.refreshLocked(rec)
	return cloneTrackSettleRecord(rec), true
}

// ActiveSettles lists the active settles' works, by indexer id
// (orchestrator.SettleSource).
func (t *TrackSettles) ActiveSettles() []orchestrator.SettleWork {
	t.mu.Lock()
	defer t.mu.Unlock()
	ids := make([]uint64, 0, len(t.records))
	for id, rec := range t.records {
		t.refreshLocked(rec)
		if rec.State == pb.TrackSettleState_TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_ACTIVE {
			ids = append(ids, id)
		}
	}
	slices.Sort(ids)
	out := make([]orchestrator.SettleWork, 0, len(ids))
	for _, id := range ids {
		w := t.records[id].Work
		out = append(out, orchestrator.SettleWork{Attempt: w.Attempt, IndexerID: w.IndexerID, Generation: w.Generation, PromotionSeqs: slices.Clone(w.PromotionSeqs)})
	}
	return out
}

// EndSettle ends indexerID's active settle in state; a settle already ended
// keeps its state (orchestrator.SettleSource).
func (t *TrackSettles) EndSettle(indexerID uint64, state pb.TrackSettleState) {
	t.mu.Lock()
	defer t.mu.Unlock()
	if rec := t.records[indexerID]; rec != nil {
		t.refreshLocked(rec)
		t.endLocked(rec, state)
	}
}

// CountSend counts one settle command sent for indexerID's active settle
// (orchestrator.SettleSource).
func (t *TrackSettles) CountSend(indexerID uint64) {
	t.mu.Lock()
	defer t.mu.Unlock()
	rec := t.records[indexerID]
	if rec == nil {
		return
	}
	t.refreshLocked(rec)
	if rec.State != pb.TrackSettleState_TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_ACTIVE {
		return
	}
	rec.Sends++
	if t.metrics != nil {
		t.metrics.TrackSettleSent()
	}
}

// OnLeadershipLost ends every active settle LEADERSHIP_LOST: a settle is
// leader-local and a new leader starts without one.
func (t *TrackSettles) OnLeadershipLost() {
	t.mu.Lock()
	defer t.mu.Unlock()
	for _, rec := range t.records {
		t.endLocked(rec, pb.TrackSettleState_TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_LEADERSHIP_LOST)
	}
}

// refreshLocked ends an active settle whose term is no longer the current
// one (LEADERSHIP_LOST) or whose deadline passed (EXPIRED).
func (t *TrackSettles) refreshLocked(rec *TrackSettleRecord) {
	if rec.State != pb.TrackSettleState_TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_ACTIVE {
		return
	}
	switch {
	case t.currentTerm() != rec.Term:
		t.endLocked(rec, pb.TrackSettleState_TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_LEADERSHIP_LOST)
	case !t.now().Before(rec.Expires):
		t.endLocked(rec, pb.TrackSettleState_TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_EXPIRED)
	}
}

func (t *TrackSettles) endLocked(rec *TrackSettleRecord, state pb.TrackSettleState) {
	if rec.State != pb.TrackSettleState_TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_ACTIVE {
		return
	}
	rec.State = state
	if t.metrics != nil {
		t.metrics.TrackSettleActive(rec.Work.IndexerID, false)
		t.metrics.TrackSettleEnded(trackSettleStateName(state))
	}
}

func (t *TrackSettles) currentTerm() uint64 {
	if t.term == nil {
		return 0
	}
	return t.term()
}

// trackSettleStateName is the metric label of a final state: settled,
// released, expired or leadership_lost.
func trackSettleStateName(state pb.TrackSettleState) string {
	return strings.ToLower(strings.TrimPrefix(state.String(), "TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_"))
}

func cloneTrackSettleRecord(rec *TrackSettleRecord) TrackSettleRecord {
	out := *rec
	out.Work.PromotionSeqs = slices.Clone(rec.Work.PromotionSeqs)
	return out
}

// ErrTrackSettleInactive means a captured loop work no longer names an active
// attempt. No send callback ran and nothing was counted.
var ErrTrackSettleInactive = errors.New("track settle attempt is no longer active")

// EndSettleAttempt ends only the exact active attempt captured by the loop.
func (t *TrackSettles) EndSettleAttempt(work orchestrator.SettleWork, state pb.TrackSettleState) {
	t.mu.Lock()
	defer t.mu.Unlock()
	rec := t.records[work.IndexerID]
	if rec == nil {
		return
	}
	t.refreshLocked(rec)
	if rec.State == pb.TrackSettleState_TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_ACTIVE && rec.Work.Attempt == work.Attempt {
		t.endLocked(rec, state)
	}
}

// SendSettleAttempt checks the captured identity, term and deadline, then
// sends and counts under the same registry lock. A Begin/expiry/step-down
// cannot replace the record between validation and successful accounting.
// send must perform only the bounded, nonblocking stream enqueue;
// it must not call this registry or retain the callback.
func (t *TrackSettles) SendSettleAttempt(work orchestrator.SettleWork, send func() error) error {
	t.mu.Lock()
	defer t.mu.Unlock()
	rec := t.records[work.IndexerID]
	if rec == nil {
		return ErrTrackSettleInactive
	}
	t.refreshLocked(rec)
	if rec.State != pb.TrackSettleState_TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_ACTIVE || rec.Work.Attempt != work.Attempt {
		return ErrTrackSettleInactive
	}
	if err := send(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	rec.Sends++
	if t.metrics != nil {
		t.metrics.TrackSettleSent()
	}
	return nil
}
```

Create `server/track_settle_rpc.go`:

```go
package server

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	"math"
	"slices"
	"strings"
	"time"

	pb "github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-proto/gen/pb"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/codes"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/status"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter/fsm"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter/orchestrator"
)

// trackSettleBeforeTracksMessage refuses both settle RPCs before the tracks
// activation: no track is quarantined and no promotion is withheld before it.
const trackSettleBeforeTracksMessage = "track settle requires the tracks activation"

// SettleTrack starts a leader-local settle of a quarantined track (housegate
// spec 2026-10-14 §14, plan S3-D K53, contract §35.2): the orchestrator then
// streams the listed promotions, marked settle, to their expected source on
// every pass until each is acknowledged. Nothing on this path writes to the
// log: leadership is verified rather than barriered, the token age is
// decided here, and the request is checked against this leader's applied
// state, which the orchestrator re-reads on every pass. The refusals, in
// order, are the contract's.
func (svc *consensusAdminService) SettleTrack(ctx context.Context, req *pb.SettleTrackRequest) (*pb.TrackSettle, error) {
	s := svc.s
	if !s.d.Cfg.ConsensusUpdatesEnabled {
		return nil, status.Error(codes.FailedPrecondition, consensusUpdatesDisabledMessage)
	}
	if !s.d.FSM.TracksActive() {
		return nil, status.Error(codes.FailedPrecondition, trackSettleBeforeTracksMessage)
	}
	cmd := wire.SettleTrackFromRequest(req)
	switch {
	case len(cmd.PromotionSeqs) == 0 || !strictlyAscending(cmd.PromotionSeqs):
		return nil, status.Error(codes.InvalidArgument, "promotion_seqs must be non-empty and strictly ascending")
	case len(strings.Split(cmd.AuthorityJWS, ".")) != 3:
		// A token that is not a JWS is a malformed request, not a failed
		// authorization.
		return nil, status.Error(codes.InvalidArgument, "authority_jws must be a JWS compact serialization with 3 dot-separated parts")
	}
	consensus, validator, err := svc.quarantineAuthority(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if _, err := validator.AuthorizeSettleTrack(cmd.Canonical(), cmd.AuthorityJWS, consensus); err != nil {
		// The validator names the recovered address or the failed check and
		// never the token itself; keep it that way.
		return nil, status.Errorf(codes.PermissionDenied, "track settle authority: %v", err)
	}
	view := s.d.FSM.TrackSettleWork(cmd.IndexerID)
	unacked := settleUnackedSeqs(view)
	switch {
	case !view.Enrolled:
		return nil, status.Errorf(codes.FailedPrecondition, "indexer %d is not enrolled", cmd.IndexerID)
	case !view.Quarantined:
		return nil, status.Errorf(codes.FailedPrecondition, "indexer %d is not quarantined: its promotions are streamed without a settle", cmd.IndexerID)
	case view.QuarantineGeneration != cmd.ExpectedGeneration:
		return nil, status.Errorf(codes.FailedPrecondition, "indexer %d has quarantine generation %d, not %d", cmd.IndexerID, view.QuarantineGeneration, cmd.ExpectedGeneration)
	case !slices.Equal(cmd.PromotionSeqs, unacked):
		return nil, status.Errorf(codes.FailedPrecondition, "promotion_seqs %v are not indexer %d's issued, unacknowledged promotions %v", cmd.PromotionSeqs, cmd.IndexerID, unacked)
	}
	if rec, ok := s.settles.Get(cmd.IndexerID); ok && rec.State == pb.TrackSettleState_TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_ACTIVE {
		return nil, status.Errorf(codes.FailedPrecondition, "a track settle of indexer %d is already active", cmd.IndexerID)
	}
	node, routed, err := s.d.FSM.PromotionSource(cmd.PromotionSeqs[0])
	if err == nil && !routed {
		err = errors.New("promotions are not routed to one source")
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, status.Errorf(codes.FailedPrecondition, "promotion %d of indexer %d has no expected source: %v", cmd.PromotionSeqs[0], cmd.IndexerID, err)
	}
	if !s.snodes.SettleCapable(node) {
		return nil, status.Errorf(codes.FailedPrecondition, "the SNode %s of indexer %d is not connected with settle support; run a release that answers settles", node, cmd.IndexerID)
	}
	work := orchestrator.SettleWork{IndexerID: cmd.IndexerID, Generation: cmd.ExpectedGeneration, PromotionSeqs: cmd.PromotionSeqs}
	rec, err := s.settles.Begin(s.raftTerm(), work, node, settleTimeout(cmd.TimeoutMS))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	// A step-down within the term between the leader check and Begin (its
	// OnLeadershipLost ran before the settle existed) would leave the settle
	// on a follower: confirm leadership now that it is recorded, as
	// PrepareConsensusUpdate does for a hold. Any other failure of the check
	// leaves the settle running; the caller reads it with GetTrackSettle.
	if err := s.consensusLeaderCheck(ctx); err != nil {
		if carriesNotLeader(err) {
			s.settles.EndSettleAttempt(rec.Work, pb.TrackSettleState_TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_LEADERSHIP_LOST)
		}
		return nil, err
	}
	return trackSettleToPB(view, &rec, true), nil
}

// settleTimeout is timeout_ms as a duration; a value no duration holds is 0,
// which Begin, like any value above consensus_admin.max_track_settle, turns
// into that maximum.
func settleTimeout(ms uint64) time.Duration {
	if ms > uint64(math.MaxInt64/int64(time.Millisecond)) {
		return 0
	}
	return time.Duration(ms) * time.Millisecond
}

// GetTrackSettle reads indexerID's settle on this leader behind one leader
// read barrier and never mutates: the current or last settle, or, with state
// UNSPECIFIED and every settle field zero, the indexer's quarantine and its
// issued, unacknowledged promotions, which arbiter-admin signs.
func (svc *consensusAdminService) GetTrackSettle(ctx context.Context, req *pb.TrackSettleRef) (*pb.TrackSettle, error) {
	s := svc.s
	if !s.d.FSM.TracksActive() {
		return nil, status.Error(codes.FailedPrecondition, trackSettleBeforeTracksMessage)
	}
	if err := s.consensusReadBarrier(ctx); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	view := s.d.FSM.TrackSettleWork(req.GetIndexerId())
	if !view.Enrolled {
		return nil, status.Errorf(codes.NotFound, "indexer %d is not enrolled", req.GetIndexerId())
	}
	rec, ok := s.settles.Get(req.GetIndexerId())
	if !ok {
		return trackSettleToPB(view, nil, false), nil
	}
	return trackSettleToPB(view, &rec, s.snodes.SettleCapable(rec.SNodeNodeID)), nil
}

// TrackSettles is this leader's settle registry, the orchestrator's settle
// source (cmd/arbiter wires it).
func (s *Server) TrackSettles() *TrackSettles { return s.settles }

// settleUnackedSeqs lists a settle view's unacknowledged promotion seqs,
// ascending as TrackSettleWork returns them; nil when there is none.
func settleUnackedSeqs(view fsm.TrackSettleWorkView) []uint64 {
	var out []uint64
	for _, p := range view.Unacked {
		out = append(out, p.Promote.PromotionSeq)
	}
	return out
}

// trackSettleToPB is the TrackSettle reply: the track's state from view and,
// when rec is not nil, the settle it describes; capable is whether the
// settle's SNode currently advertises settle.
func trackSettleToPB(view fsm.TrackSettleWorkView, rec *TrackSettleRecord, capable bool) *pb.TrackSettle {
	out := &pb.TrackSettle{
		IndexerId:            view.IndexerID,
		Quarantined:          view.Quarantined,
		QuarantineGeneration: view.QuarantineGeneration,
		UnackedPromotionSeqs: settleUnackedSeqs(view),
	}
	if rec == nil {
		return out
	}
	out.State = rec.State
	out.PromotionSeqs = slices.Clone(rec.Work.PromotionSeqs)
	out.RaftTerm = rec.Term
	out.ExpiresUnixMs = uint64(rec.Expires.UnixMilli())
	out.SnodeNodeId = rec.SNodeNodeID
	out.SnodeSettleCapable = capable
	out.Sends = rec.Sends
	return out
}
```

```go
// TestLoadConsensusAdminMaxTrackSettle: plan S3-D contract §35.3.
// consensus_admin.max_track_settle defaults to 10m, takes a configured
// positive value and refuses zero and a negative value with its name.
func TestLoadConsensusAdminMaxTrackSettle(t *testing.T) {
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		name, block, wantErr string
		want                 time.Duration
	}{
		{name: "absent", want: 10 * time.Minute},
		{name: "empty block", block: "consensus_admin: {}\n", want: 10 * time.Minute},
		{name: "configured", block: "consensus_admin:\n  max_track_settle: 90s\n", want: 90 * time.Second},
		{name: "zero", block: "consensus_admin:\n  max_track_settle: 0s\n", wantErr: "consensus_admin.max_track_settle must be positive"},
		{name: "negative", block: "consensus_admin:\n  max_track_settle: -1m\n", wantErr: "consensus_admin.max_track_settle must be positive"},
	} {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			cfg, err := Load(writeConfig(t, minimal+tc.block))
			if tc.wantErr != "" {
				if err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), tc.wantErr) {
					t.Fatalf("got %v, want %q", err, tc.wantErr)
				}
				return
			}
			if err != nil || cfg.ConsensusAdmin.MaxTrackSettle.Duration != tc.want {
				t.Fatalf("max_track_settle = %+v, %v; want %s", cfg.ConsensusAdmin.MaxTrackSettle, err, tc.want)
			}
		})
	}
}
```

```go
package metrics

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/prometheus/client_golang/prometheus/testutil"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter/fsm"
)

// TestTrackSettleMetrics: plan S3-D contract §35.3. The four end states are
// exported at 0 from the start; a settle sets its indexer's gauge to 1 and
// back to 0 when it ends, counting its final state and every send.
func TestTrackSettleMetrics(t *testing.T) {
	m := New(laneSnapshot{fsm.MetricsSnapshot{}})
	want := `
# HELP arbiter_track_settles_total Track settles this node ended while leading, by final state (settled, released, expired, leadership_lost).
# TYPE arbiter_track_settles_total counter
arbiter_track_settles_total{state="expired"} 0
arbiter_track_settles_total{state="leadership_lost"} 0
arbiter_track_settles_total{state="released"} 0
arbiter_track_settles_total{state="settled"} 0
`
	if err := testutil.GatherAndCompare(m.registry, strings.NewReader(want), "arbiter_track_settles_total"); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if n, err := testutil.GatherAndCount(m.registry, "arbiter_track_settle_active"); err != nil || n != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("arbiter_track_settle_active before any settle: %d series, %v", n, err)
	}
	m.TrackSettleActive(2, true)
	m.TrackSettleSent()
	m.TrackSettleSent()
	m.TrackSettleActive(2, false)
	m.TrackSettleEnded("settled")
	m.TrackSettleActive(0, true)
	want = `
# HELP arbiter_track_settle_active 1 while this leader runs a track settle for the SI indexer (plan S3-D: its quarantined track's issued, unacknowledged promotions are streamed marked settle), 0 once it ended; indexer_id is an enrolled SI indexer, a governed, bounded set.
# TYPE arbiter_track_settle_active gauge
arbiter_track_settle_active{indexer_id="0"} 1
arbiter_track_settle_active{indexer_id="2"} 0
# HELP arbiter_track_settle_sends_total Settle-marked promotion commands this leader handed to an SNode stream.
# TYPE arbiter_track_settle_sends_total counter
arbiter_track_settle_sends_total 2
# HELP arbiter_track_settles_total Track settles this node ended while leading, by final state (settled, released, expired, leadership_lost).
# TYPE arbiter_track_settles_total counter
arbiter_track_settles_total{state="expired"} 0
arbiter_track_settles_total{state="leadership_lost"} 0
arbiter_track_settles_total{state="released"} 0
```

Create `cmd/arbiter-admin/settle_test.go`:

```go
package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"slices"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/authority"
	pb "github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-proto/gen/pb"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/codes"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/status"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/encoding/protojson"
	"google.golang.org/protobuf/proto"
)

// settleLeader is fakeAdmin serving the settle RPCs: GetTrackSettle answers
// preview on its first read and then the reads in order (the last one
// repeating), SettleTrack records its requests and answers started or err.
type settleLeader struct {
	*fakeAdmin
	mu       sync.Mutex
	preview  *pb.TrackSettle
	reads    []*pb.TrackSettle
	readN    int
	started  *pb.TrackSettle
	err      error
	requests []*pb.SettleTrackRequest
}

func (f *settleLeader) GetTrackSettle(_ context.Context, ref *pb.TrackSettleRef) (*pb.TrackSettle, error) {
	f.mu.Lock()
	defer f.mu.Unlock()
	f.readN++
	if f.readN == 1 || len(f.reads) == 0 {
		return f.preview, nil
	}
	i := min(f.readN-2, len(f.reads)-1)
	return f.reads[i], nil
}

func (f *settleLeader) SettleTrack(_ context.Context, req *pb.SettleTrackRequest) (*pb.TrackSettle, error) {
	f.mu.Lock()
	defer f.mu.Unlock()
	f.requests = append(f.requests, req)
	if f.err != nil {
		return nil, f.err
	}
	return f.started, nil
}

func (f *settleLeader) settleRequests() []*pb.SettleTrackRequest {
	f.mu.Lock()
	defer f.mu.Unlock()
	return slices.Clone(f.requests)
}

// newSettleLeader is a leader whose indexer 2 is quarantined at generation 3
// with promotions 41 and 42 withheld; its settle starts ACTIVE and ends in
// final after one more ACTIVE read.
func newSettleLeader(final pb.TrackSettleState) *settleLeader {
	active := &pb.TrackSettle{IndexerId: 2, Quarantined: true, QuarantineGeneration: 3, UnackedPromotionSeqs: []uint64{41, 42},
		State: pb.TrackSettleState_TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_ACTIVE, PromotionSeqs: []uint64{41, 42}, RaftTerm: 9, ExpiresUnixMs: 1_800_000_090_000,
		SnodeNodeId: "snode-3", SnodeSettleCapable: true, Sends: 1}
	ended := proto.Clone(active).(*pb.TrackSettle)
	ended.State, ended.Sends = final, 4
	if final == pb.TrackSettleState_TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_SETTLED {
		ended.UnackedPromotionSeqs = nil
	}
	return &settleLeader{
		fakeAdmin: &fakeAdmin{nodeID: "arb-0", state: testConsensusState()},
		preview:   &pb.TrackSettle{IndexerId: 2, Quarantined: true, QuarantineGeneration: 3, UnackedPromotionSeqs: []uint64{41, 42}},
		started:   active,
		reads:     []*pb.TrackSettle{active, ended},
	}
}

func settleArgs(addr string, extra ...string) []string {
	return append([]string{"indexer", "settle", "--address", addr, "--indexer", "2", "--expected-generation", "3"}, extra...)
}

// fastSettlePolls shortens the settle poll for one test.
func fastSettlePolls(t *testing.T) {
	t.Helper()
	old := settlePollInterval
	settlePollInterval = time.Millisecond
	t.Cleanup(func() { settlePollInterval = old })
}

type settleResultJSON struct {
	IndexerID            string   `json:"indexer_id"`
	ExpectedGeneration   string   `json:"expected_generation"`
	PromotionSeqs        []string `json:"promotion_seqs"`
	State                string   `json:"state"`
	UnackedPromotionSeqs []string `json:"unacked_promotion_seqs"`
	Sends                string   `json:"sends"`
}

// TestIndexerSettleSignsTheLeadersPreview: plan S3-D contract §35.4. The CLI
// signs exactly the preview's withheld promotions for the given generation
// under the leader's consensus context, requests --settle-timeout, polls
// until the settle ends and prints one JSON object; neither the key nor the
// token appears in the output.
func TestIndexerSettleSignsTheLeadersPreview(t *testing.T) {
	adminKey(t)
	fastSettlePolls(t)
	leader := newSettleLeader(pb.TrackSettleState_TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_SETTLED)
	addr := serveAdminImpl(t, leader)
	var out bytes.Buffer
	if err := run(context.Background(), settleArgs(addr, "--settle-timeout", "90s"), &out); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	requests := leader.settleRequests()
	if len(requests) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("sent %d settle requests", len(requests))
	}
	req := requests[0]
	if req.GetIndexerId() != 2 || req.GetExpectedGeneration() != 3 || !slices.Equal(req.GetPromotionSeqs(), []uint64{41, 42}) || req.GetTimeoutMs() != 90_000 {
		t.Fatalf("request = %v", req)
	}
	hash, err := authority.SettleTrackHash(arbiter.SettleTrackCommand{IndexerID: 2, ExpectedGeneration: 3, PromotionSeqs: []uint64{41, 42}})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	payload := decodeJWSPayload(t, req.GetAuthorityJws())
	if payload.Purpose != authority.SettleTrackPurpose || payload.CmdHash != hash || payload.NetworkID != "testnet" ||
		payload.GenesisSnapshotID != "genesis-committed" || payload.AuthorityEpoch == nil || *payload.AuthorityEpoch != 7 {
		t.Fatalf("token payload = %+v", payload)
	}
	var result settleResultJSON
	if err := json.Unmarshal(out.Bytes(), &result); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("output %q: %v", out.String(), err)
	}
	want := settleResultJSON{IndexerID: "2", ExpectedGeneration: "3", PromotionSeqs: []string{"41", "42"}, State: "TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_SETTLED",
		UnackedPromotionSeqs: []string{}, Sends: "4"}
	if !reflectEqualJSON(result, want) {
		t.Fatalf("output = %s", out.String())
	}
	if strings.Contains(out.String(), os.Getenv(authorityPrivateKeyEnv)) || strings.Contains(out.String(), req.GetAuthorityJws()) {
		t.Fatal("output exposes the signing key or the token")
	}
	leader.mu.Lock()
	reads := leader.readN
	leader.mu.Unlock()
	if reads != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("read the settle %d times, want the preview and two polls", reads)
	}
}

// reflectEqualJSON compares two results field by field, an empty list equal
// to an empty list only.
func reflectEqualJSON(a, b settleResultJSON) bool {
	return a.IndexerID == b.IndexerID && a.ExpectedGeneration == b.ExpectedGeneration && slices.Equal(a.PromotionSeqs, b.PromotionSeqs) &&
		a.State == b.State && slices.Equal(a.UnackedPromotionSeqs, b.UnackedPromotionSeqs) && (a.UnackedPromotionSeqs == nil) == (b.UnackedPromotionSeqs == nil) &&
		a.Sends == b.Sends
}

// TestIndexerSettleRefusesAnOlderLeader: a leader without the settle RPCs
// answers Unimplemented, and both commands say so before anything is
// signed or sent.
func TestIndexerSettleRefusesAnOlderLeader(t *testing.T) {
	adminKey(t)
	addr := serveAdminImpl(t, &fakeAdmin{nodeID: "arb-0", state: testConsensusState()})
	for _, args := range [][]string{settleArgs(addr), {"indexer", "settle-status", "--address", addr, "--indexer", "2"}} {
		var out bytes.Buffer
		err := run(context.Background(), args, &out)
		if err == nil || err.Error() != "leader does not support track settle (arbiter older than this arbiter-admin); upgrade the leader" || out.Len() != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("%s against an older leader: %v (output %q)", args[1], err, out.String())
		}
	}
}

// TestIndexerSettleExitsNonZeroUnlessSettled: every final state but SETTLED
// prints the outcome and fails; a preview with nothing to settle, and a
// leader refusal, fail before or at the request; settle-status prints the
// read as protojson; the flags and the key are checked locally.
func TestIndexerSettleExitsNonZeroUnlessSettled(t *testing.T) {
	adminKey(t)
	fastSettlePolls(t)
	for _, final := range []pb.TrackSettleState{pb.TrackSettleState_TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_EXPIRED, pb.TrackSettleState_TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_RELEASED,
		pb.TrackSettleState_TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_LEADERSHIP_LOST, pb.TrackSettleState_TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_UNSPECIFIED} {
		leader := newSettleLeader(final)
		var out bytes.Buffer
		err := run(context.Background(), settleArgs(serveAdminImpl(t, leader)), &out)
		if err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "track settle of indexer 2 ended "+final.String()+", not TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_SETTLED") {
			t.Fatalf("%s: err = %v", final, err)
		}
		var result settleResultJSON
		if jerr := json.Unmarshal(out.Bytes(), &result); jerr != nil || result.State != final.String() || !slices.Equal(result.UnackedPromotionSeqs, []string{"41", "42"}) {
			t.Fatalf("%s: output %q (%v)", final, out.String(), jerr)
		}
	}

	for name, tc := range map[string]struct {
		preview *pb.TrackSettle
		want    string
	}{
		"not quarantined":  {&pb.TrackSettle{IndexerId: 2, QuarantineGeneration: 4}, "indexer 2 is not quarantined: nothing to settle"},
		"nothing withheld": {&pb.TrackSettle{IndexerId: 2, Quarantined: true, QuarantineGeneration: 3}, "indexer 2 has no issued, unacknowledged promotion: nothing to settle"},
	} {
		leader := newSettleLeader(pb.TrackSettleState_TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_SETTLED)
		leader.preview = tc.preview
		if err := run(context.Background(), settleArgs(serveAdminImpl(t, leader)), &bytes.Buffer{}); err == nil || err.Error() != tc.want {
			t.Fatalf("%s: err = %v, want %q", name, err, tc.want)
		}
		if len(leader.settleRequests()) != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("%s: a settle was requested", name)
		}
	}

	refused := newSettleLeader(pb.TrackSettleState_TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_SETTLED)
	refused.err = status.Error(codes.FailedPrecondition, "the SNode snode-3 of indexer 2 is not connected with settle support; run a release that answers settles")
	err := run(context.Background(), settleArgs(serveAdminImpl(t, refused)), &bytes.Buffer{})
	if status.Code(err) != codes.FailedPrecondition || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "not connected with settle support") || strings.Contains(err.Error(), "settle-status") {
		t.Fatalf("a leader refusal must pass through: %v", err)
	}
	unknown := newSettleLeader(pb.TrackSettleState_TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_SETTLED)
	unknown.err = status.Error(codes.Unavailable, "transport is closing")
	err = run(context.Background(), settleArgs(serveAdminImpl(t, unknown)), &bytes.Buffer{})
	if status.Code(err) != codes.Unavailable || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "the settle may be active on the leader: read it with indexer settle-status before retrying") {
		t.Fatalf("an unknown outcome must say how to read the settle: %v", err)
	}

	statusLeader := newSettleLeader(pb.TrackSettleState_TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_SETTLED)
	var out bytes.Buffer
	if err := run(context.Background(), []string{"indexer", "settle-status", "--address", serveAdminImpl(t, statusLeader), "--indexer", "2"}, &out); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var printed pb.TrackSettle
	if err := protojson.Unmarshal(out.Bytes(), &printed); err != nil || !proto.Equal(&printed, statusLeader.preview) {
		t.Fatalf("settle-status printed %s (%v)", out.String(), err)
	}

	addr := serveAdminImpl(t, newSettleLeader(pb.TrackSettleState_TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_SETTLED))
	for name, tc := range map[string]struct {
		args []string
		want string
	}{
		"no generation":        {[]string{"indexer", "settle", "--address", addr, "--indexer", "2"}, "--expected-generation is required"},
		"no indexer":           {[]string{"indexer", "settle-status", "--address", addr}, "--indexer is required"},
		"zero settle timeout":  {settleArgs(addr, "--settle-timeout", "0s"), "--settle-timeout must be positive"},
		"generation on status": {[]string{"indexer", "settle-status", "--address", addr, "--indexer", "2", "--expected-generation", "3"}, "flag provided but not defined: -expected-generation"},
		"address without port": {settleArgs("localhost"), "--address must be a direct node host:port"},
		"positional argument":  {settleArgs(addr, "extra"), "unexpected positional arguments"},
	} {
		if err := run(context.Background(), tc.args, &bytes.Buffer{}); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), tc.want) {
			t.Fatalf("%s: err = %v, want %q", name, err, tc.want)
		}
	}
	t.Setenv(authorityPrivateKeyEnv, "")
	if err := run(context.Background(), settleArgs(addr), &bytes.Buffer{}); err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), authorityPrivateKeyEnv+" is required") {
		t.Fatalf("settle without the key: %v", err)
	}
}

// TestIndexerSettleRefusesAnUnrepresentableTimeout prevents a positive
// duration from truncating to wire zero, which means the server maximum.
func TestIndexerSettleRefusesAnUnrepresentableTimeout(t *testing.T) {
	adminKey(t)
	fastSettlePolls(t)
	leader := newSettleLeader(pb.TrackSettleState_TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_SETTLED)
	err := run(context.Background(), settleArgs(serveAdminImpl(t, leader), "--settle-timeout", "1ns"), &bytes.Buffer{})
	if err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "--settle-timeout must be at least 1ms") || len(leader.settleRequests()) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("sub-millisecond timeout: err=%v, requests=%d", err, len(leader.settleRequests()))
	}
}

// TestIndexerSettleRefusesAReplacedRecord covers a second Begin between CLI
// polls. SETTLED belongs to that later attempt, not the signed request.
func TestIndexerSettleRefusesAReplacedRecord(t *testing.T) {
	adminKey(t)
	fastSettlePolls(t)
	for _, field := range []string{"term", "expiry", "promotions", "indexer", "source", "generation"} {
		t.Run(field, func(t *testing.T) {
			leader := newSettleLeader(pb.TrackSettleState_TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_SETTLED)
			final := proto.Clone(leader.reads[1]).(*pb.TrackSettle)
			switch field {
			case "term":
				final.RaftTerm++
			case "expiry":
				final.ExpiresUnixMs++
			case "promotions":
				final.PromotionSeqs = []uint64{42}
			case "indexer":
				final.IndexerId++
			case "source":
				final.SnodeNodeId = "other-source"
			case "generation":
				final.QuarantineGeneration++
			}
			leader.reads = []*pb.TrackSettle{final}
			var out bytes.Buffer
			err := run(context.Background(), settleArgs(serveAdminImpl(t, leader)), &out)
			if err == nil || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "track settle record changed") || out.Len() != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("replaced settle: err=%v, output=%q", err, out.String())
			}
		})
	}
}
```

with:

```go
// trackSettleUnsupportedMessage is the refusal of indexer settle and
// settle-status against a leader that predates the settle RPCs.
const trackSettleUnsupportedMessage = "leader does not support track settle (arbiter older than this arbiter-admin); upgrade the leader"

// settlePollInterval is how often indexer settle reads the settle back; a
// variable so tests can shorten it.
var settlePollInterval = 2 * time.Second

// runIndexerSettle is `indexer settle` and `indexer settle-status` (housegate
// spec 2026-10-14 §14, plan S3-D K53, contract §35.4). settle reads the
// leader's barriered preview, signs exactly the promotions it lists with the
// key in ARBITER_AUTHORITY_PRIVATE_KEY_HEX under the leader's consensus
// context, starts the settle and polls it until it is no longer active;
// nothing it does reaches the Raft log. settle-status prints the read.
func runIndexerSettle(ctx context.Context, operation string, args []string, out io.Writer) error {
	fs := flag.NewFlagSet("indexer "+operation, flag.ContinueOnError)
	fs.SetOutput(io.Discard)
	address := fs.String("address", "", "leader gRPC host:port")
	indexer := fs.Uint64("indexer", 0, "required SI indexer id")
	required := []string{"address", "indexer"}
	var expected *uint64
	var settleTimeout *time.Duration
	timeoutDefault := 10 * time.Second
	if operation == "settle" {
		expected = fs.Uint64("expected-generation", 0, "required: the indexer's current quarantine_generation (consensus tracks prints it)")
		settleTimeout = fs.Duration("settle-timeout", 10*time.Minute, "how long the leader keeps the settle (capped by its consensus_admin.max_track_settle)")
		required = append(required, "expected-generation")
		timeoutDefault = 15 * time.Minute
	}
	timeout := fs.Duration("timeout", timeoutDefault, "timeout for the entire operation")
	if err := fs.Parse(args); err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, flag.ErrHelp) {
			if _, err := fmt.Fprintln(out, usage); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			fs.SetOutput(out)
			fs.PrintDefaults()
			return nil
		}
		return err
	}
	if fs.NArg() != 0 {
		return errors.New("unexpected positional arguments")
	}
	present := map[string]bool{}
	fs.Visit(func(f *flag.Flag) { present[f.Name] = true })
	for _, name := range required {
		if !present[name] {
			return fmt.Errorf("--%s is required", name)
		}
	}
	if host, port, err := net.SplitHostPort(*address); err != nil || host == "" || port == "" {
		return errors.New("--address must be a direct node host:port")
	}
	if *timeout <= 0 {
		return errors.New("--timeout must be positive")
	}
	var signer *authority.Signer
	if operation == "settle" {
		if *settleTimeout <= 0 {
			return errors.New("--settle-timeout must be positive")
		}
		if *settleTimeout < time.Millisecond {
			return errors.New("--settle-timeout must be at least 1ms")
		}
		keyHex := os.Getenv(authorityPrivateKeyEnv)
		if keyHex == "" {
			return fmt.Errorf("%s is required", authorityPrivateKeyEnv)
		}
		var err error
		if signer, err = authority.NewSignerFromHex(keyHex); err != nil {
			// Do not copy key material or parser fragments into operator logs.
			return fmt.Errorf("%s is invalid: expected a 32-byte secp256k1 private key in hex", authorityPrivateKeyEnv)
		}
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, *timeout)
	defer cancel()
	client, closeFn, err := dialAdmin(*address)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("connect to %s: %w", *address, err)
	}
	defer closeFn()
	ref := &pb.TrackSettleRef{IndexerId: *indexer}
	if operation == "settle-status" {
		view, err := client.GetTrackSettle(ctx, ref)
		if err != nil {
			return settleRPCError("read track settle", *address, err)
		}
		return writeProtoJSON(out, view)
	}
	// The authority context comes from the leader's barriered view: the
	// leader refuses a token bound to any other network, genesis or epoch.
	state, err := client.GetConsensusParams(ctx, &emptypb.Empty{})
	if err != nil {
		return rpcError("read consensus parameters", *address, err)
	}
	if state.GetProtocolVersion() != arbiter.ConsensusAdminProtocolVersion {
		return fmt.Errorf("unsupported consensus admin protocol %d (this CLI supports %d)", state.GetProtocolVersion(), arbiter.ConsensusAdminProtocolVersion)
	}
	preview, err := client.GetTrackSettle(ctx, ref)
	if err != nil {
		return settleRPCError("read track settle", *address, err)
	}
	if !preview.GetQuarantined() {
		return fmt.Errorf("indexer %d is not quarantined: nothing to settle", *indexer)
	}
	if len(preview.GetUnackedPromotionSeqs()) == 0 {
		return fmt.Errorf("indexer %d has no issued, unacknowledged promotion: nothing to settle", *indexer)
	}
	settle := wire.SettleTrack{IndexerID: *indexer, ExpectedGeneration: *expected, PromotionSeqs: slices.Clone(preview.GetUnackedPromotionSeqs()),
		TimeoutMS: uint64(settleTimeout.Milliseconds())}
	consensus := authority.ConsensusContext{NetworkID: state.GetNetworkId(), GenesisSnapshotID: state.GetGenesisSnapshotId(), AuthorityEpoch: state.GetEpoch()}
	if settle.AuthorityJWS, err = signer.SignSettleTrackWithContext(settle.Canonical(), consensus); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("sign track settle: %w", err)
	}
	started, err := client.SettleTrack(ctx, wire.SettleTrackToRequest(settle))
	if err != nil {
		wrapped := settleRPCError("settle track", *address, err)
		switch status.Code(err) {
		case codes.DeadlineExceeded, codes.Canceled, codes.Unavailable, codes.Unknown, codes.Internal:
			return fmt.Errorf("%w; the settle may be active on the leader: read it with indexer settle-status before retrying", wrapped)
		}
		return wrapped
	}
	fmt.Fprintf(stderr, "track settle of indexer %d started: promotions %v towards SNode %s, expires %s\n", *indexer, started.GetPromotionSeqs(),
		started.GetSnodeNodeId(), time.UnixMilli(int64(started.GetExpiresUnixMs())).UTC().Format(time.RFC3339))
	final := started
	for final.GetState() == pb.TrackSettleState_TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_ACTIVE {
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return fmt.Errorf("track settle of indexer %d still active when --timeout ended: read it with indexer settle-status", *indexer)
		case <-time.After(settlePollInterval):
		}
		if final, err = client.GetTrackSettle(ctx, ref); err != nil {
			return settleRPCError("read track settle", *address, err)
		}
		// A later Begin replaces the leader-local record. Never report that
		// other attempt's terminal state as success for this request.
		// Current quarantine generation is mutable even on an old RELEASED
		// record, so preserve non-success outcomes; a SETTLED success is
		// refused if it no longer belongs to the signed generation.
		if final.GetState() == pb.TrackSettleState_TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_SETTLED && final.GetQuarantineGeneration() != *expected {
			return fmt.Errorf("track settle record changed for indexer %d: read it with indexer settle-status before retrying", *indexer)
		}
		if final.GetIndexerId() != started.GetIndexerId() || final.GetRaftTerm() != started.GetRaftTerm() ||
			final.GetExpiresUnixMs() != started.GetExpiresUnixMs() || final.GetSnodeNodeId() != started.GetSnodeNodeId() ||
			!slices.Equal(final.GetPromotionSeqs(), started.GetPromotionSeqs()) {
			return fmt.Errorf("track settle record changed for indexer %d: read it with indexer settle-status before retrying", *indexer)
		}
	}
	seqs := func(list []uint64) []string {
		out := make([]string, 0, len(list))
		for _, seq := range list {
			out = append(out, strconv.FormatUint(seq, 10))
		}
		return out
	}
	result := struct {
		IndexerID            string   `json:"indexer_id"`
		ExpectedGeneration   string   `json:"expected_generation"`
		PromotionSeqs        []string `json:"promotion_seqs"`
		State                string   `json:"state"`
		UnackedPromotionSeqs []string `json:"unacked_promotion_seqs"`
		Sends                string   `json:"sends"`
	}{strconv.FormatUint(*indexer, 10), strconv.FormatUint(*expected, 10), seqs(settle.PromotionSeqs), final.GetState().String(),
		seqs(final.GetUnackedPromotionSeqs()), strconv.FormatUint(final.GetSends(), 10)}
	encoder := json.NewEncoder(out)
	encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
	if err := encoder.Encode(result); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if final.GetState() != pb.TrackSettleState_TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_SETTLED {
		return fmt.Errorf("track settle of indexer %d ended %s, not TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_SETTLED", *indexer, final.GetState())
	}
	return nil
}

// settleRPCError is rpcError, naming an older leader's Unimplemented.
func settleRPCError(operation, address string, err error) error {
	if status.Code(err) == codes.Unimplemented {
		return errors.New(trackSettleUnsupportedMessage)
	}
	return rpcError(operation, address, err)
}
```

The harness's signing SNode gains the settle side of arbiter-core's SNode (contract §34): it subscribes advertising settle once restarted on a settle-capable release, applies each promotion once and answers a resend from its journal, can lose an acknowledgement on the way, and answers a settle from the journal only.

```go
func (s *signingSNode) ackPromotion(ctx context.Context, promote *pb.PromoteSafePartition, epoch uint64) error {
	parts := make([]*pb.SafePartMapping, 0, len(promote.GetCandidateParts()))
	for _, part := range promote.GetCandidateParts() {
		hash := part.GetPartRowLthash()
		parts = append(parts, &pb.SafePartMapping{
			PartRowLthash: hash,
			SafePartName:  "safe_" + strings.TrimPrefix(hash, "0x")[:8],
			PartPhysHash:  replay.DigestString("safe:" + hash),
		})
	}
	postRoot, err := postCommitment(promote.GetBasePartitionRoot(), promote.GetCandidateParts())
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	ack := &pb.PromotionAck{
		NodeId: s.id, PromotionSeq: promote.GetPromotionSeq(), TableId: promote.GetTableId(), PartitionId: promote.GetPartitionId(),
		PostPartitionCommitment: postRoot, Parts: parts, Applied: true,
		SafePartitionParts: s.safeInventory(promote.GetTableId(), promote.GetPartitionId(), parts),
	}
	jws, err := s.signer.SignSNodeMessage(authority.SNodeMessagePromotionAck, s.msgCtx, wire.RecordPromotionAckFromRequest(ack).Ack)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	ack.SourceJws = jws
	if err := s.cl.withLeaderRetry(ctx, func(ctx context.Context, conn *grpc.ClientConn) error {
		_, err := pb.NewPromotionGatewayClient(conn).AckPromotion(ctx, ack)
		return err
	}); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	s.mu.Lock()
	s.ackedEpochs[promote.GetPromotionSeq()] = append(s.ackedEpochs[promote.GetPromotionSeq()], epoch)
	s.mu.Unlock()
	s.promotionAcks.Add(1)
	return nil
}
```

with:

```go
func (s *signingSNode) ackPromotion(ctx context.Context, promote *pb.PromoteSafePartition, epoch uint64) error {
	seq := promote.GetPromotionSeq()
	s.mu.Lock()
	ack := s.journal[seq]
	s.mu.Unlock()
	if ack == nil {
		var err error
		if ack, err = s.applyPromotion(promote); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	// A resend is answered from the journal, as a real SNode does: the
	// promotion is applied once.
	if s.loseAcks.Load() {
		return nil
	}
	if err := s.sendAck(ctx, ack); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	s.mu.Lock()
	s.ackedEpochs[seq] = append(s.ackedEpochs[seq], epoch)
	s.mu.Unlock()
	s.promotionAcks.Add(1)
	return nil
}

// applyPromotion applies promote to the SNode's safe inventory and journals
// its signed acknowledgement.
func (s *signingSNode) applyPromotion(promote *pb.PromoteSafePartition) (*pb.PromotionAck, error) {
	parts := make([]*pb.SafePartMapping, 0, len(promote.GetCandidateParts()))
	for _, part := range promote.GetCandidateParts() {
		hash := part.GetPartRowLthash()
		parts = append(parts, &pb.SafePartMapping{
			PartRowLthash: hash,
			SafePartName:  "safe_" + strings.TrimPrefix(hash, "0x")[:8],
			PartPhysHash:  replay.DigestString("safe:" + hash),
		})
	}
	postRoot, err := postCommitment(promote.GetBasePartitionRoot(), promote.GetCandidateParts())
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	ack := &pb.PromotionAck{
		NodeId: s.id, PromotionSeq: promote.GetPromotionSeq(), TableId: promote.GetTableId(), PartitionId: promote.GetPartitionId(),
		PostPartitionCommitment: postRoot, Parts: parts, Applied: true,
		SafePartitionParts: s.safeInventory(promote.GetTableId(), promote.GetPartitionId(), parts),
	}
	jws, err := s.signer.SignSNodeMessage(authority.SNodeMessagePromotionAck, s.msgCtx, wire.RecordPromotionAckFromRequest(ack).Ack)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	ack.SourceJws = jws
	s.mu.Lock()
	s.journal[promote.GetPromotionSeq()] = ack
	s.applied[promote.GetPromotionSeq()]++
	s.mu.Unlock()
	return ack, nil
}

func (s *signingSNode) sendAck(ctx context.Context, ack *pb.PromotionAck) error {
	return s.cl.withLeaderRetry(ctx, func(ctx context.Context, conn *grpc.ClientConn) error {
		_, err := pb.NewPromotionGatewayClient(conn).AckPromotion(ctx, ack)
		return err
	})
}

// answerSettle answers a settle-marked promotion from the journal only, as
// arbiter-core's SNode does (plan S3-D contract §34): the journaled
// acknowledgement is sent again (journaled); a promotion it never applied is
// answered Applied:false with the settle detail, which is journaled too
// (not_applied). It never applies the promotion.
func (s *signingSNode) answerSettle(ctx context.Context, promote *pb.PromoteSafePartition) error {
	seq := promote.GetPromotionSeq()
	s.mu.Lock()
	ack, journaled := s.journal[seq]
	s.mu.Unlock()
	outcome := "journaled"
	if !journaled {
		outcome = "not_applied"
		ack = &pb.PromotionAck{NodeId: s.id, PromotionSeq: seq, TableId: promote.GetTableId(), PartitionId: promote.GetPartitionId(),
			Detail: fmt.Sprintf("settle: promotion %d was not applied on this SNode", seq)}
		jws, err := s.signer.SignSNodeMessage(authority.SNodeMessagePromotionAck, s.msgCtx, wire.RecordPromotionAckFromRequest(ack).Ack)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		ack.SourceJws = jws
		s.mu.Lock()
		s.journal[seq] = ack
		s.mu.Unlock()
	}
	if err := s.sendAck(ctx, ack); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	s.mu.Lock()
	s.settleAnswers[outcome]++
	s.mu.Unlock()
	return nil
}

// restartWithSettle stops the SNode and subscribes again advertising settle,
// as a host restarted on a release that answers settles.
func (s *signingSNode) restartWithSettle(t *testing.T) {
	t.Helper()
	s.stop()
	s.settle.Store(true)
	s.start(t)
}

// journaledApplied reports whether the SNode applied promotion seq.
func (s *signingSNode) journaledApplied(seq uint64) bool {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	return s.applied[seq] > 0
}

// appliedCount is how often the SNode applied promotion seq.
func (s *signingSNode) appliedCount(seq uint64) int {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	return s.applied[seq]
}

// settleAnswerCount is how many settles the SNode answered with outcome.
func (s *signingSNode) settleAnswerCount(outcome string) int {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	return s.settleAnswers[outcome]
}

// safeInventoryLen is how many safe parts the SNode holds for
// table/partition.
func (s *signingSNode) safeInventoryLen(table, partition string) int {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	return len(s.safeParts[partitionKey(table, partition)])
}
```

Create `integration/stage3_p4_test.go`:

```go
package integration

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"slices"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	pb "github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-proto/gen/pb"
	"google.golang.org/grpc"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/codes"
	"google.golang.org/grpc/status"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core"
	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter-core/wire"

	"github.com/sentioxyz/arbiter/fsm"
)

// trackSettle is the leader's barriered GetTrackSettle answer for indexer.
func (tc *tracksCluster) trackSettle(t *testing.T, indexer uint64) *pb.TrackSettle {
	t.Helper()
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	var view *pb.TrackSettle
	if err := tc.withLeaderRetry(ctx, func(ctx context.Context, conn *grpc.ClientConn) error {
		var err error
		view, err = pb.NewConsensusAdminClient(conn).GetTrackSettle(ctx, &pb.TrackSettleRef{IndexerId: indexer})
		return err
	}); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("GetTrackSettle(%d): %v", indexer, err)
	}
	return view
}

// settleRequest signs one SettleTrack for the current epoch.
func (tc *tracksCluster) settleRequest(t *testing.T, indexer, generation uint64, seqs []uint64) *pb.SettleTrackRequest {
	t.Helper()
	cmd := arbiter.SettleTrackCommand{IndexerID: indexer, ExpectedGeneration: generation, PromotionSeqs: seqs}
	token, err := tc.authoritySigner.SignSettleTrackWithContext(cmd, tc.authorityContext(t))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	return wire.SettleTrackToRequest(wire.SettleTrack{IndexerID: indexer, ExpectedGeneration: generation, PromotionSeqs: seqs, AuthorityJWS: token})
}

// sendSettle sends req to the leader once: a settle refusal is a
// FailedPrecondition, which withLeaderRetry would take for a redirect.
func (tc *tracksCluster) sendSettle(t *testing.T, req *pb.SettleTrackRequest) (*pb.TrackSettle, error) {
	t.Helper()
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	_, conn, err := tc.leaderConn(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("leader: %v", err)
	}
	return pb.NewConsensusAdminClient(conn).SettleTrack(ctx, req)
}

// waitSettleEnded polls GetTrackSettle until indexer's settle is no longer
// active and returns that read.
func (tc *tracksCluster) waitSettleEnded(t *testing.T, indexer uint64) *pb.TrackSettle {
	t.Helper()
	var last *pb.TrackSettle
	poll(t, fmt.Sprintf("the settle of indexer %d ended", indexer), 30*time.Second, 100*time.Millisecond, func() bool {
		tc.failOnBackground(t)
		last = tc.trackSettle(t, indexer)
		return last.GetState() != pb.TrackSettleState_TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_ACTIVE
	})
	return last
}

// statementStatus is flat's status on the leader.
func (tc *tracksCluster) statementStatus(t *testing.T, flat string) fsm.StatementStatusInfo {
	t.Helper()
	info, ok := tc.leaderState(t).StatementStatusView(flat)
	if !ok {
		t.Fatalf("statement %s is unknown", flat)
	}
	return info
}

// settleTrackOne starts the settle of indexer 1's withheld promotions at
// generation and waits until it ends SETTLED.
func (tc *tracksCluster) settleTrackOne(t *testing.T, generation uint64, seqs []uint64) *pb.TrackSettle {
	t.Helper()
	started, err := tc.sendSettle(t, tc.settleRequest(t, 1, generation, seqs))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("settle indexer 1: %v", err)
	}
	if started.GetState() != pb.TrackSettleState_TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_ACTIVE || !slices.Equal(started.GetPromotionSeqs(), seqs) ||
		started.GetSnodeNodeId() != tc.sn2.id || !started.GetSnodeSettleCapable() {
		t.Fatalf("the settle started as %v", started)
	}
	ended := tc.waitSettleEnded(t, 1)
	if ended.GetState() != pb.TrackSettleState_TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_SETTLED || ended.GetSends() == 0 || len(ended.GetUnackedPromotionSeqs()) != 0 ||
		!ended.GetQuarantined() || ended.GetQuarantineGeneration() != generation {
		t.Fatalf("the settle ended as %v, want SETTLED with every listed promotion acknowledged and the track still quarantined", ended)
	}
	return ended
}

// TestTrackSettleRecordsALostAcknowledgementFromTheJournal is housegate spec
// 2026-10-14 §14 ("Exits from the release refusals") over the wire. snode-2
// applies indexer 1's promotion but its acknowledgement is lost, and the
// track is quarantined, so the promotion is never streamed again
// (clarification C8). While snode-2 runs a release without settles the
// leader refuses the settle up front; once it subscribes advertising
// settle, the leader streams the listed promotion marked settle, snode-2
// answers with its journaled acknowledgement without applying the promotion
// again, the settle ends SETTLED while the track stays quarantined, and the
// statement is safe. The release then lets the track publish.
func TestTrackSettleRecordsALostAcknowledgementFromTheJournal(t *testing.T) {
	tc := startTracksCluster(t)
	key1, account1 := newAccount(t)
	tc.sn2.loseAcks.Store(true)
	flat := tc.submit(t, tc.sn2, key1, account1, 1, testTable1)
	block := tc.blockOf(t, flat)
	seq := tc.waitIssuedUnacked(t, testTable1)
	waitFor(t, "snode-2 applied the promotion and lost its acknowledgement", 30*time.Second, func() bool {
		tc.failOnBackground(t)
		return tc.sn2.journaledApplied(seq)
	})
	if err := tc.sendQuarantine(t, tc.quarantineRequest(t, 1, 0, "integration: snode-2 lost an acknowledgement")); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("quarantine indexer 1: %v", err)
	}
	preview := tc.trackSettle(t, 1)
	if !preview.GetQuarantined() || preview.GetQuarantineGeneration() != 1 || !slices.Equal(preview.GetUnackedPromotionSeqs(), []uint64{seq}) ||
		preview.GetState() != pb.TrackSettleState_TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_UNSPECIFIED {
		t.Fatalf("preview = %v", preview)
	}
	_, err := tc.sendSettle(t, tc.settleRequest(t, 1, 1, []uint64{seq}))
	if status.Code(err) != codes.FailedPrecondition ||
		status.Convert(err).Message() != "the SNode snode-2 of indexer 1 is not connected with settle support; run a release that answers settles" {
		t.Fatalf("a settle towards an SNode without settle support = %v", err)
	}

	tc.sn2.restartWithSettle(t)
	tc.settleTrackOne(t, 1, []uint64{seq})
	if got := tc.sn2.settleAnswerCount("journaled"); got == 0 || tc.sn2.settleAnswerCount("not_applied") != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("snode-2 settle answers: journaled %d, not_applied %d", got, tc.sn2.settleAnswerCount("not_applied"))
	}
	if n := tc.sn2.appliedCount(seq); n != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("snode-2 applied promotion %d %d times, want once (a settle never applies)", seq, n)
	}
	if st := tc.statementStatus(t, flat); st.Status != fsm.StatusSafe {
		t.Fatalf("statement %s after the settle = %v, want Safe", flat, st.Status)
	}
	if tr := indexerTrack(t, tc.trackState(t), 1); !tr.GetQuarantined() || tr.GetQuarantineGeneration() != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("indexer 1 after the settle = %v, want still quarantined at generation 1", tr)
	}

	tc.sn2.loseAcks.Store(false)
	if err := tc.sendRelease(t, tc.releaseRequest(t, 1, 1, nil)); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("release indexer 1: %v", err)
	}
	tc.waitPublished(t, 1, block)
}

// TestTrackSettleConsumesANeverAppliedPromotionWithoutPromotingIt: snode-2
// never receives (or never applies) indexer 1's promotion before the
// quarantine. The settle reaches it marked settle; it answers Applied:false
// with the settle detail and builds nothing, which consumes the promotion:
// the statement stays Promotable, nothing is promoted or issued while the
// track is quarantined, and after the release the orchestrator issues a new
// promotion that snode-2 applies.
func TestTrackSettleConsumesANeverAppliedPromotionWithoutPromotingIt(t *testing.T) {
	tc := startTracksCluster(t)
	key1, account1 := newAccount(t)
	tc.sn2.holdPromotions.Store(true)
	flat := tc.submit(t, tc.sn2, key1, account1, 1, testTable1)
	block := tc.blockOf(t, flat)
	seq := tc.waitIssuedUnacked(t, testTable1)
	if err := tc.sendQuarantine(t, tc.quarantineRequest(t, 1, 0, "integration: snode-2 never applied the promotion")); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("quarantine indexer 1: %v", err)
	}
	tc.sn2.restartWithSettle(t)
	tc.settleTrackOne(t, 1, []uint64{seq})
	// A duplicate settle resends its journaled Applied:false acknowledgement.
	// Exercise that supported retry deterministically rather than depending
	// on whether the leader tick raced the first acknowledgement.
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
	err := tc.sn2.answerSettle(ctx, &pb.PromoteSafePartition{PromotionSeq: seq})
	cancel()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("repeat the same never-applied settle: %v", err)
	}
	if got := tc.sn2.settleAnswerCount("not_applied"); got == 0 || tc.sn2.settleAnswerCount("journaled") == 0 {
		t.Fatalf("snode-2 settle answers: not_applied %d, journaled %d", got, tc.sn2.settleAnswerCount("journaled"))
	}
	// Journaled is permitted only for this same signed never-applied record;
	// it must never conceal an Applied:true or unrelated promotion.
	tc.sn2.mu.Lock()
	onlyNeverApplied := len(tc.sn2.journal) == 1
	for journalSeq, ack := range tc.sn2.journal {
		onlyNeverApplied = onlyNeverApplied && journalSeq == seq && ack.GetPromotionSeq() == seq &&
			ack.GetNodeId() == tc.sn2.id && !ack.GetApplied() && ack.GetTableId() == testTable1 &&
			ack.GetPartitionId() == testPartition && ack.GetSourceJws() != "" &&
			ack.GetDetail() == fmt.Sprintf("settle: promotion %d was not applied on this SNode", seq)
	}
	tc.sn2.mu.Unlock()
	if !onlyNeverApplied {
		t.Fatal("the repeated settle must resend only the same signed Applied:false record")
	}
	if tc.sn2.appliedCount(seq) != 0 || tc.sn2.safeInventoryLen(testTable1, testPartition) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("snode-2 applied a promotion it answered by a settle")
	}
	if st := tc.statementStatus(t, flat); st.Status != fsm.StatusPromotable {
		t.Fatalf("statement %s after the settle = %v, want Promotable", flat, st.Status)
	}
	promotionSeq := tc.leaderState(t).PromotionSeqView()
	time.Sleep(time.Second)
	if got := tc.leaderState(t).PromotionSeqView(); got != promotionSeq {
		t.Fatalf("promotion_seq moved %d -> %d while indexer 1 is quarantined", promotionSeq, got)
	}

	tc.sn2.holdPromotions.Store(false)
	if err := tc.sendRelease(t, tc.releaseRequest(t, 1, 1, nil)); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("release indexer 1: %v", err)
	}
	tc.waitPublished(t, 1, block)
	if st := tc.statementStatus(t, flat); st.Status != fsm.StatusSafe {
		t.Fatalf("statement %s after the release = %v, want Safe", flat, st.Status)
	}
	if tc.sn2.appliedCount(seq) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("snode-2 applied the consumed promotion %d after the release", seq)
	}
}

// TestTrackSettleLetsARejectedBlockReleaseThatALostPromotionCovered is the
// release refusal (iii) of ruling R27 cleared by a settle. Indexer 1's
// promotion is issued but never applied when its block is challenged and
// rejected, which quarantines the track: the release acknowledging the block
// is refused because the rejected statement is covered by the unacknowledged
// promotion, and nothing would ever stream it again. The settle consumes it
// with snode-2's Applied:false answer; the same release then goes through
// and the rejected part is cleaned on snode-2.
func TestTrackSettleLetsARejectedBlockReleaseThatALostPromotionCovered(t *testing.T) {
	tc := startTracksCluster(t)
	key1, account1 := newAccount(t)
	tc.sn2.holdPromotions.Store(true)
	flat := tc.submit(t, tc.sn2, key1, account1, 1, testTable1)
	block := tc.blockOf(t, flat)
	seq := tc.waitIssuedUnacked(t, testTable1)
	// proposeRegistry proposes any command on the leader exactly as the
	// orchestrator does; here it opens and resolves the challenge.
	tc.proposeRegistry(t, wire.Command{OpenChallenge: &wire.OpenChallenge{BlockSeq: block, Reason: "integration: settle scenario", OpenedBy: "verifier-1"}})
	tc.proposeRegistry(t, wire.Command{ResolveChallenge: &wire.ResolveChallenge{BlockSeq: block, Verdict: wire.ChallengeVerdictRejected}})
	view := tc.waitTrack(t, "the automatic quarantine of indexer 1", 30*time.Second, func(v *pb.TrackStateView) bool {
		tr := indexerTrackOf(v, 1)
		return tr != nil && tr.GetQuarantined()
	})
	if tr := indexerTrack(t, view, 1); !slices.Equal(tr.GetRejectedBlocks(), []uint64{block}) || tr.GetQuarantineGeneration() != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("indexer 1 after the rejection = %v", tr)
	}
	stmt := tc.statementStatus(t, flat)
	if stmt.Status != fsm.StatusRejected {
		t.Fatalf("statement %s = %v, want Rejected", flat, stmt.Status)
	}
	covered := fmt.Sprintf("release of indexer 1 refused: rejected statement %d of block %d is covered by unacknowledged promotion %d", stmt.Seq, block, seq)
	if err := tc.sendRelease(t, tc.releaseRequest(t, 1, 1, []uint64{block})); status.Code(err) != codes.FailedPrecondition || status.Convert(err).Message() != covered {
		t.Fatalf("the release before the settle = %v, want FailedPrecondition %q", err, covered)
	}

	tc.sn2.restartWithSettle(t)
	tc.settleTrackOne(t, 1, []uint64{seq})
	if tc.sn2.settleAnswerCount("not_applied") == 0 || tc.sn2.appliedCount(seq) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("snode-2 answered not_applied %d times and applied promotion %d %d times", tc.sn2.settleAnswerCount("not_applied"), seq, tc.sn2.appliedCount(seq))
	}
	if err := tc.sendRelease(t, tc.releaseRequest(t, 1, 1, []uint64{block})); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("the release after the settle: %v", err)
	}
	waitFor(t, "snode-2 acknowledged the rejected-part cleanup", 30*time.Second, func() bool {
		tc.failOnBackground(t)
		return tc.sn2.rejectedCleanupAcks(block) > 0
	})
	view = tc.waitTrack(t, "track 1 past the rejected block", 45*time.Second, func(v *pb.TrackStateView) bool {
		tr := indexerTrackOf(v, 1)
		return tr != nil && tr.GetPublished().GetSafeBlockSeq() >= block
	})
	if tr := indexerTrack(t, view, 1); tr.GetQuarantined() || !slices.Equal(tr.GetAcknowledgedRejectedBlocks(), []uint64{block}) {
		t.Fatalf("indexer 1 after the release = %v", tr)
	}
	if strings.Contains(fmt.Sprint(tc.trackSettle(t, 1).GetUnackedPromotionSeqs()), fmt.Sprint(seq)) {
		t.Fatalf("promotion %d is still unacknowledged after the release", seq)
	}
}
```
