              operator: In
              values: [storage-integrity-si-v2, storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-b, storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-c]

        - ports:

    - fromEndpoints:

def cluster_pod_template(chi, cluster):
    """The pod template one cluster of a CHI runs: its own templates.podTemplate, else the defaults'."""
    spec = chi["spec"]
    (entry,) = [item for item in spec["configuration"]["clusters"] if item["name"] == cluster]
    name = (entry.get("templates") or {}).get("podTemplate") or spec["defaults"]["templates"]["podTemplate"]
    (pod,) = [pod for pod in spec["templates"]["podTemplates"] if pod["name"] == name]
    return pod


def d39_conflicts(placement, eligible):
    """The verifier ClickHouses that break decision D39 in a placement
    ((installation, cluster) -> node): one on a source's node, or two on one
    node while devnet2 has at least six eligible nodes."""
    sources = {node for (installation, cluster), node in placement.items() if cluster == "source"}
    verifiers = {key: node for key, node in placement.items() if key[1] != "source"}
    shared = len(eligible) >= 6
    return {
        key for key, node in verifiers.items()
        if node in sources or (shared and list(verifiers.values()).count(node) > 1)
    }
```

The canonical `render-inertness.sh` invokes Helmfile and is not run in this review. Write `$P/local-render.py` with this audited direct-Helm equivalent (local only). It preserves the exact chart, release, namespace, ordered values and set-file inputs, byte/object comparisons, new-release checks, protected-path archive exclusions and fail-closed grammar; it performs no live tail or wrapper invocation.

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Local direct-Helm rendering only; deployment context/order options are not used."""
import argparse,hashlib,json,os,re,subprocess,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
import yaml
class UniqueLoader(yaml.SafeLoader):
    pass
def unique_mapping(loader,node,deep=False):
    result={}
    for key_node,value_node in node.value:
        key=loader.construct_object(key_node,deep=deep)
        if key in result:raise ValueError('duplicate YAML key')
        result[key]=loader.construct_object(value_node,deep=deep)
    return result
UniqueLoader.add_constructor(yaml.resolver.BaseResolver.DEFAULT_MAPPING_TAG,unique_mapping)
FORBIDDEN={'k8s-sea/clickhouse/clickhouse.yaml','k8s-sea/clickhouse/clickhouse-extra.yaml'}
def require(ok):
    if not ok: raise ValueError('unsupported or unsafe local render input; details withheld')
def plain(x):
    if isinstance(x,str):require('{{' not in x and '}}' not in x and '\x00' not in x)
    elif isinstance(x,dict):
        for k,v in x.items():plain(k);plain(v)
    elif isinstance(x,list):
        for v in x:plain(v)
    else:require(x is None or isinstance(x,(int,float,bool)))
def checked(root,parent,value,folder=False):
    require(isinstance(value,str) and not Path(value).is_absolute());plain(value)
    p=(parent/value).resolve(); require(p.is_relative_to(root));require(str(p.relative_to(root)) not in FORBIDDEN)
    require(p.is_dir() if folder else p.is_file());return p
def load(root,file,name):
    root=Path(root).resolve();path=checked(root,root,file)
    raw=path.read_text();plain(raw);doc=yaml.load(raw,Loader=UniqueLoader)
    require(isinstance(doc,dict) and not set(doc)-{'helmDefaults','releases'})
    defaults=doc.get('helmDefaults',{});require(isinstance(defaults,dict) and not set(defaults)-{'kubeContext','createNamespace'})
    require(defaults.get('kubeContext','sentio-sea')=='sentio-sea' and defaults.get('createNamespace',False) is False)
    require(isinstance(doc.get('releases'),list));rows=[r for r in doc['releases'] if isinstance(r,dict) and r.get('name')==name]
    if not rows:return None
    require(len(rows)==1);row=rows[0];require(not set(row)-{'name','namespace','chart','needs','set','values','wait','timeout'})
    require(re.fullmatch('[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*',name) is not None);require(isinstance(row.get('namespace'),str));plain(row)
    require(isinstance(row.get('needs',[]),list) and all(isinstance(s,str) for s in row.get('needs',[])))
    require(isinstance(row.get('wait',False),bool));require(type(row.get('timeout',1)) is int)
    chart=checked(root,path.parent,row['chart'],True)
    require(str(chart.relative_to(root)) in {'charts/storage-integrity','charts/sentio-node'})
    require(isinstance(row.get('values',[]),list) and isinstance(row.get('set',[]),list))
    vals=[]
    for v in row.get('values',[]):
        if isinstance(v,str):vals.append(('file',checked(root,path.parent,v)))
        else:
            require(isinstance(v,dict) and set(v)=={'nodeSelector'} and isinstance(v['nodeSelector'],dict))
            require(all(isinstance(k,str) and isinstance(s,str) for k,s in v['nodeSelector'].items())); vals.append(('inline',v))
    sets=[]
    for v in row.get('set',[]):
        require(isinstance(v,dict) and set(v)=={'name','file'} and v['name']=='service.chainsConfig')
        sets.append((v['name'],checked(root,path.parent,v['file'])))
    require(len(sets)<=1)
    return root,path,row,chart,vals,sets

def render(tree,file,release,output):
    data=load(tree,file,release)
    if data is None:raise LookupError('selected release absent')
    root,path,row,chart,vals,sets=data
    out=Path(output);out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='direct-helm-inline-') as td:
        args=['helm','template',release,str(chart),'--namespace',row['namespace']]
        for i,(kind,value) in enumerate(vals):
            if kind=='inline':
                value_path=Path(td)/f'inline-{i}.yaml';value_path.write_text(yaml.safe_dump(value));value_path.chmod(0o600)
            else:value_path=value
            args+=['-f',str(value_path)]
        for name,p in sets:args+=['--set-file',name+'='+str(p)]
        run=subprocess.run(args,cwd=path.parent,capture_output=True,timeout=120)
        require(run.returncode==0 and bool(run.stdout.strip()))
        objects=list(yaml.safe_load_all(run.stdout));require(objects and all(isinstance(x,dict) and x.get('apiVersion') and x.get('kind') and isinstance(x.get('metadata'),dict) and x['metadata'].get('name') for x in objects))
        keys=[(x['apiVersion'],x['kind'],x['metadata'].get('namespace',''),x['metadata']['name']) for x in objects];require(len(keys)==len(set(keys)))
        out.write_bytes(run.stdout);out.chmod(0o600)
        meta={'release':release,'namespace':row['namespace'],'helmfile':file,'chart':str(chart.relative_to(root)),'ordered_values':[str(v.relative_to(root)) if k=='file' else {'inline_keys':sorted(v)} for k,v in vals], 'set_file_names':[k for k,v in sets], 'ignored_operational_fields':sorted(set(row)&{'needs','wait','timeout'}),'ignored_defaults':sorted(load_defaults(path)), 'sha256':hashlib.sha256(run.stdout).hexdigest(),'objects':len(keys),'object_keys_sha256':hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(sorted(keys)).encode()).hexdigest()}
        out.with_suffix(out.suffix+'.meta.json').write_text(json.dumps(meta,indent=2)+'\n')
        return meta

def load_defaults(path):return yaml.load(path.read_text(),Loader=UniqueLoader).get('helmDefaults',{})

def compare(base_tree,head_tree,entries,new_releases,output_dir):
    """Compare exact bytes and resource identities; permit only genuinely new named releases."""
    names=[n for f,n in entries];require(len(names)==len(set(names)))
    require(len(new_releases)==len(set(new_releases)) and set(new_releases)<=set(names))
    results=[]
    for file,name in entries:
        require(load(head_tree,file,name)is not None)
        head=render(head_tree,file,name,Path(output_dir)/('head-'+name+'.yaml'))
        absent=load(base_tree,file,name)is None
        if absent:
            require(name in new_releases);results.append({'release':name,'status':'new','head':head});continue
        require(name not in new_releases)
        base=render(base_tree,file,name,Path(output_dir)/('base-'+name+'.yaml'))
        require(base['sha256']==head['sha256'] and base['object_keys_sha256']==head['object_keys_sha256'])
        results.append({'release':name,'status':'identical','base':base,'head':head})
    return results

ENTRIES=[
 ("k8s-sea/sentio-network-devnet2/storage-integrity-si-v2.helmfile.yaml","storage-integrity-si-v2"),
 ("k8s-sea/sentio-network-devnet2/storage-integrity-si-v2.helmfile.yaml","sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-a"),
 ("k8s-sea/sentio-network-devnet2/storage-integrity-si-v2.helmfile.yaml","sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-b"),
 ("k8s-sea/sentio-network-devnet2/helmfile.yaml","sentio-node-devnet2-observer"),
 ("k8s-sea/sentio-network-testnet-v2/helmfile.yaml","sentio-node-testnet-v2-indexer-a"),
 ("k8s-sea/sentio-network-testnet-v2/helmfile.yaml","sentio-node-testnet-v2-indexer-b"),
 ("k8s-sea/sentio-network-testnet-v2/helmfile.yaml","sentio-node-observer"),
 ("k8s-sea/sentio-network-devnet2/storage-integrity-si-v2.helmfile.yaml","sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-c"),
]
def export_base(tree,ref,destination):
    import tarfile
    tree=Path(tree).resolve()
    # Ref and filename metadata are validated before archive reads any content.
    require(isinstance(ref,str) and bool(ref) and not ref.startswith("-") and "\x00" not in ref)
    sha=subprocess.check_output(["git","-C",str(tree),"rev-parse","--verify",ref+"^{commit}"],text=True).strip()
    require(re.fullmatch("[0-9a-f]{40}",sha)is not None)
    names=subprocess.check_output(["git","-C",str(tree),"ls-tree","-rz","--name-only",sha],text=True).split("\x00")
    # The two credential-bearing files are excluded at the archive argument layer.
    args=["git","-C",str(tree),"archive",sha,"--",".",*[(":(exclude)"+n) for n in sorted(FORBIDDEN)]]
    process=subprocess.Popen(args,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
    try:
        with tarfile.open(fileobj=process.stdout,mode="r|") as archive:
            for member in archive:
                require(member.name not in FORBIDDEN)
                p=(Path(destination)/member.name).resolve();require(p.is_relative_to(Path(destination).resolve()))
                # Deployment inputs must be regular files; never follow source symlinks.
                if member.isdir() or member.isfile():archive.extract(member,destination)
                else:require(member.issym())
        require(process.wait(timeout=30)==0)
    except Exception:
        process.kill();process.wait();raise
    require(all(not(Path(destination)/n).exists() for n in FORBIDDEN))
    return sha

def main():
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser();parser.add_argument("action",choices=["compare","diff"])
    parser.add_argument("--tree",required=True);parser.add_argument("--base-ref",required=True);parser.add_argument("--release")
    args=parser.parse_args()
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="si-p4-direct-render-") as td:
        base=Path(td)/"base";base.mkdir();export_base(args.tree,args.base_ref,base)
        out=Path(td)/"renders"
        if args.action=="compare":
            require(args.release is None)
            results=compare(base,args.tree,ENTRIES,[],out)
            for result in results:print(result["release"]+" identical")
        else:
            entries=[(file,name)for file,name in ENTRIES if name==args.release];require(len(entries)==1)
            file,name=entries[0];a=out/"base.yaml";b=out/"head.yaml"
            render(base,file,name,a);render(args.tree,file,name,b)
            def objects(p):
                return {(x["kind"],x["metadata"]["name"]):x for x in yaml.safe_load_all(p.read_text())}
            before,after=objects(a),objects(b)
            for key in sorted(set(before)|set(after)):
                if before.get(key)!=after.get(key):print("changed "+"/".join(key))
if __name__=="__main__":
    try:main()
    except Exception:raise SystemExit("direct-render: unsupported grammar, missing input or local render failure; details withheld; stop")

```python
P4_STAGING_HEADER = """\
# The interserver staging pair of the stage-3 P4 hardening (housegate spec
# 2026-10-14 §14; Plan S3-D K56; docs/storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p4-hardening.md
# §3). Generated by charts/storage-integrity/tests/test_render.py
# p4_staging_document() from indexer-b's installation
# (storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-b-source.yaml) and the staging hashes of
# Plan S3-B's logins script (make-clickhouse-logins.sh staging), and checked
# against both by test_p4_interserver_staging_chis_mirror_indexer_b; never edit
# it by hand. Each CHI is indexer-b's as Plans S3-B and S3-C1 left it (Plan
# S3-C3's server bundle, engine grants and si_member removed: its 100 GiB
# keep_free_space_bytes would refuse every insert on these 1Gi volumes, and its
# named collections name live installations), renamed, on the Keeper root
# /storage-integrity/devnet2/p4-interserver-staging (created by runbook §3.1,
# refusing a non-empty one, removed in §3.4), with 1Gi volumes, in posture C
# with the network's user set and the staging hashes, and without P4's own
# settings: the runbook adds each staging step's
# interserver_http_credentials, from storage-integrity-si-v2-interserver.
# Deleted at the end of runbook §3.
"""


def p4_staging_base(indexer_b, name, hashes):
    """indexer-b's CHI as the interserver staging pair takes it (P4_STAGING_HEADER)."""
    spec = p4_neutral(without_p2_chi(indexer_b)["spec"])
    configuration = spec["configuration"]
    configuration["zookeeper"]["root"] = P4_STAGING_KEEPER_ROOT
    configuration["users"] = si_clickhouse_users("network", "C", hashes)
    configuration["files"] = si_clickhouse_files(unlocked_files(configuration["files"]), "C")
    for claim in spec["templates"]["volumeClaimTemplates"]:
        claim["spec"]["resources"]["requests"]["storage"] = "1Gi"
    return {
        "apiVersion": indexer_b["apiVersion"], "kind": indexer_b["kind"],
        "metadata": {"name": name, "namespace": LEGACY_NAMESPACE}, "spec": spec,
    }


class _BlockStringDumper(yaml.SafeDumper):
    """yaml.SafeDumper that writes a multi-line string (a CHI file) as a block scalar."""


_BlockStringDumper.add_representer(str, lambda dumper, value: dumper.represent_scalar(
    "tag:yaml.org,2002:str", value, style="|" if "\n" in value else None,
))


def p4_staging_document(indexer_b, hashes):
    """The text of P4_STAGING_CHI, generated from indexer-b's CHI and the staging hashes."""
    return P4_STAGING_HEADER + yaml.dump_all(
        [p4_staging_base(indexer_b, name, hashes) for name in P4_STAGING_NAMES],
        Dumper=_BlockStringDumper, sort_keys=False, explicit_start=True,
    )


def p4_staging_hashes():
    """The staging hashes P4_STAGING_CHI carries (user -> SHA-256), the same in both CHIs."""
    found = []
    for document in yaml.safe_load_all(P4_STAGING_CHI.read_text()):
        if document:
            users = document["spec"]["configuration"]["users"]
            found.append({key.split("/", 1)[0]: value for key, value in users.items() if key.endswith("/password_sha256_hex")})
    if len(found) != len(P4_STAGING_NAMES) or any(hashes != found[0] for hashes in found):
        raise AssertionError(f"{P4_STAGING_CHI.name}: the staging CHIs must carry the same staging hashes")
    return found[0]
```

class InterserverSecretScriptTest(unittest.TestCase):
    """scripts/storage-integrity/make-interserver-secret.sh, run against the stand-in kubectl of ClickHouseLoginsScriptTest."""

    def run_script(self, directory, *arguments, existing=(), get_failure=False):
        bin_dir, state, home, scratch = (directory / name for name in ("bin", "state", "home", "tmp"))
        for path in (bin_dir, state, home, scratch):
            path.mkdir()
        stub = bin_dir / "kubectl"
        stub.write_text(ClickHouseLoginsScriptTest.STUB_KUBECTL.replace(
            'verb = args[4:]', 'verb = args[4:]' + ('\nif verb[:2] == ["get", "secret"]: sys.exit(17)' if get_failure else '')))
        stub.chmod(0o755)
        env = {
            "PATH": f"{bin_dir}{os.pathsep}{os.environ['PATH']}",
            "HOME": str(home),
            "TMPDIR": str(scratch),
            "PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE": "1",
            "KUBECTL_STUB_STATE": str(state),
            "KUBECTL_STUB_EXISTING": " ".join(existing),
        }
        result = subprocess.run(["bash", str(MAKE_INTERSERVER_SECRET), *arguments], env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, check=False)
        calls_file, secrets_file = state / "calls.jsonl", state / "secrets.json"
        calls = [json.loads(line) for line in calls_file.read_text().splitlines()] if calls_file.exists() else []
        secrets = json.loads(secrets_file.read_text()) if secrets_file.exists() else {}
        return result, calls, secrets

    def test_interserver_secret_script_creates_one_secret_and_never_prints_it(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as name:
            directory = Path(name)
            result, calls, secrets = self.run_script(directory)
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
            self.assertEqual(list(secrets), [SI_INTERSERVER_SECRET])
            self.assertEqual(list(secrets[SI_INTERSERVER_SECRET]), ["password"])
            password = secrets[SI_INTERSERVER_SECRET]["password"]["value"]
            self.assertRegex(password, r"^[0-9a-f]{48}$")
            # Never on the terminal or a kubectl command line, and no file left behind.
            self.assertNotIn(password, result.stdout + result.stderr)
            self.assertNotIn(password, json.dumps(calls))
            self.assertIn(f"created Secret {SI_INTERSERVER_SECRET} (key password)", result.stdout)
            self.assertTrue(all(call[:4] == ["--context", "sentio-sea", "--namespace", "sentio-network-devnet2"] for call in calls))
            self.assertEqual([call[4:8] for call in calls if call[4] == "create"], [["create", "secret", "generic", SI_INTERSERVER_SECRET]])
            self.assertFalse(Path(secrets[SI_INTERSERVER_SECRET]["password"]["path"]).exists())
            self.assertEqual(list((directory / "tmp").iterdir()), [])

    def test_interserver_secret_script_refuses_to_overwrite_or_guess(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as name:
            result, calls, secrets = self.run_script(Path(name), existing=[SI_INTERSERVER_SECRET])
            self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 1)
            self.assertIn(f"Secret {SI_INTERSERVER_SECRET} exists; it is never overwritten", result.stderr)
            self.assertEqual(secrets, {})
            self.assertNotIn("create", [call[4] for call in calls])
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as name:
            result, calls, secrets = self.run_script(Path(name), get_failure=True)
            self.assertNotEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stdout)
            self.assertEqual(secrets, {})
            self.assertNotIn("create", [call[4] for call in calls])
        for arguments in (("--staging",), (SI_INTERSERVER_SECRET,)):
            with self.subTest(arguments=arguments), tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as name:
                result, calls, _ = self.run_script(Path(name), *arguments)
                self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 2, result.stderr)
                self.assertIn("usage: bash scripts/storage-integrity/make-interserver-secret.sh", result.stderr)
                self.assertEqual(calls, [])
```

Create `scripts/storage-integrity/make-interserver-secret.sh` (Step 23 makes it mode 755):

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Creates the interserver HTTP credential of the devnet2-si-v2 SI ClickHouses
# (housegate spec 2026-10-14 §14; Plan S3-D K56;
# docs/storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p4-hardening.md §4). Run it in your own
# terminal (from fish too):
#
#   bash scripts/storage-integrity/make-interserver-secret.sh
#
# It creates Secret storage-integrity-si-v2-interserver, with the one key
# password, in namespace sentio-network-devnet2 of context sentio-sea: the one
# credential every SI installation and the runbook's staging pair name
# (clickhouse.interserver.secret, and the CHI manifests'
# interserver_http_credentials/password valueFrom). The password is 24 random
# bytes in hex (openssl rand -hex 24), written only to a file of a mode-700
# temporary directory that is removed on exit and handed to kubectl as that
# file: it is never printed, logged or put on a command line. An existing
# Secret is never overwritten: a rotation is a successor credential (a
# follow-up of Plan S3-D), never a change in place.
set -euo pipefail
umask 077

readonly context=sentio-sea
readonly namespace=sentio-network-devnet2
readonly secret=storage-integrity-si-v2-interserver

if [ "$#" -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "usage: bash scripts/storage-integrity/make-interserver-secret.sh" >&2
  exit 2
fi

kube() {
  kubectl --context "$context" --namespace "$namespace" "$@"
}

for tool in kubectl openssl; do
  command -v "$tool" >/dev/null || { echo "make-interserver-secret: $tool is required" >&2; exit 1; }
done
if ! existing=$(kube get secret "$secret" --ignore-not-found -o name); then
  echo "make-interserver-secret: cannot establish Secret absence; stop" >&2
  exit 1
fi
if [ -n "$existing" ]; then
  echo "make-interserver-secret: Secret $secret exists; it is never overwritten" >&2
  exit 1
fi

dir=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$dir"' EXIT
chmod 700 "$dir"
openssl rand -hex 24 | tr -d '\n' > "$dir/password"
if [ "$(wc -c < "$dir/password" | tr -d ' ')" -ne 48 ]; then
  echo "make-interserver-secret: openssl rand did not return 24 bytes" >&2
  exit 1
fi
kube create secret generic "$secret" --from-file=password="$dir/password" >/dev/null
echo "make-interserver-secret: created Secret $secret (key password) in $namespace"
```

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Plan S3-D Task 53 Step 24: replay the first live commits of Tasks 55 and 56
in a scratch export and judge each with the whole render suite (local tool,
never committed; it changes only the export it is given).

usage: rollout-check.py EXPORT

EXPORT is a protected-path-excluded scratch copy of the branch, carrying the `.s3d-task53-scratch` ownership sentinel. Each scenario edits the
copy the way the hardening and owner-rebuild runbooks' commits do (the three
interserver_http_credentials keys as the first entries of a CHI manifest's
settings, the kubernetes.io/hostname pin after its nodeSelector entries, the
network overlay's interserver flags and nodePins that Step 18 put there, GRANT
READ ON S3 after si_snode's last grant) together with the rollout mirrors, runs
charts/storage-integrity/tests/test_render.py, and prints one line per
scenario. Exit 0 only when every in-order scenario passes and the out-of-order
one fails.
"""
import ast
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

export = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
if not (export / ".s3d-task53-scratch").is_file() or export == Path.cwd().resolve():
    sys.exit("rollout-check: require a disposable owned export and run outside it; stop")
TESTS = export / "charts/storage-integrity/tests/test_render.py"
sys.path.insert(0, str(TESTS.parent))
import test_render as t  # noqa: E402

B, C, NET = "storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-b", "storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-c", "storage-integrity-si-v2"
OVERLAY = t.DEVNET2 / "storage-integrity-si-v2.yaml"
PREFIX = "interserver_http_credentials/"


def fail(message):
    sys.exit(f"rollout-check: {message}")


def sub(path, old, new):
    text = path.read_text()
    if text.count(old) != 1:
        fail(f"{path.name}: expected {old!r} once, found it {text.count(old)} times")
    path.write_text(text.replace(old, new))


def set_entry(name, key, value):
    """Set one entry of a dict constant of test_render.py (or the constant itself when key is None)."""
    source = TESTS.read_text()
    (node,) = [n for n in ast.parse(source).body if isinstance(n, ast.Assign) and getattr(n.targets[0], "id", None) == name]
    target = node.value
    if key is not None:
        (target,) = [v for k, v in zip(node.value.keys, node.value.values) if ast.literal_eval(k) == key]
    lines = source.splitlines(keepends=True)
    start = sum(map(len, lines[:target.lineno - 1])) + target.col_offset
    end = sum(map(len, lines[:target.end_lineno - 1])) + target.end_col_offset
    TESTS.write_text(source[:start] + repr(value).replace("'", '"') + source[end:])


def chi_step1(path):
    block = "".join(f"      {line}\n" for line in (
        f"{PREFIX}user: {t.SI_INTERSERVER_USER}",
        f"{PREFIX}password:",
        "  valueFrom:",
        "    secretKeyRef:",
        f"      name: {t.SI_INTERSERVER_SECRET}",
        "      key: password",
        f'{PREFIX}allow_empty: "true"',
    ))
    sub(path, "    settings:\n", "    settings:\n" + block)


def chi_pin(path, node):
    sub(path, '          nodeSelector:\n            sentio.xyz/general: "true"\n',
        f'          nodeSelector:\n            sentio.xyz/general: "true"\n            kubernetes.io/hostname: "{node}"\n')


def network_values(step, pins):
    """The network overlay's clickhouse.interserver flags and clickhouse.nodePins
    as hardening runbook §5.0, §5.3 and §6.3 set them: each flips a value
    Step 18 put there."""
    text = OVERLAY.read_text()
    flags = re.compile(r"(?m)^  interserver:\n    enabled: (?:true|false)\n    allowEmpty: (?:true|false)\n")
    if len(flags.findall(text)) != 1:
        fail("the overlay's clickhouse.interserver is not the block Step 18 wrote")
    text = flags.sub(lambda _: f"  interserver:\n    enabled: {'true' if step else 'false'}\n"
                               f"    allowEmpty: {'false' if step == 2 else 'true'}\n", text)
    block = re.compile(r"(?m)^  nodePins:(?: \{\}\n|\n(?:    .*\n)+)")
    if len(block.findall(text)) != 1:
        fail("the overlay's clickhouse.nodePins is not the block Step 18 wrote")
    body = "  nodePins:\n" + "".join(f'    {cluster}: "{node}"\n' for cluster, node in pins.items()) if pins else "  nodePins: {}\n"
    OVERLAY.write_text(block.sub(lambda _: body, text))


def restore_grant(path):
    """GRANT READ ON S3 after si_snode's last grant, at that list's own indent."""
    lines = path.read_text().split("\n")
    key = lines.index("      si_snode/grants/query:")
    indent = re.match(r"( *)- ", lines[key + 1]).group(1)
    end = key + 1
    while lines[end].startswith(indent + "- "):
        end += 1
    lines.insert(end, indent + "- GRANT READ ON S3")
    path.write_text("\n".join(lines))


def run(label, expect_ok):
    result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-B", str(TESTS)], capture_output=True, text=True)
    tail = [line for line in result.stderr.splitlines() if line.startswith(("Ran ", "OK", "FAILED"))]
    errors = sorted({line[:200] for line in result.stderr.splitlines() if line.startswith("AssertionError")})
    ok = result.returncode == 0
    print(f"{'pass' if ok == expect_ok else 'UNEXPECTED'} {label}: {'OK' if ok else 'FAILED'} ({' '.join(tail)})")
    for line in errors[:6]:
        print(f"    {line}")
    return ok == expect_ok


# The read placement and the §5.0 moves it implies (decision D39).
read = dict(t.DEVNET2_CLICKHOUSE_NODES)
eligible = sorted(t.DEVNET2_SI_ELIGIBLE_NODES)
sources = {node for (name, cluster), node in read.items() if cluster == "source"}
placement, moves = dict(read), {}
for n in (1, 2, 3):
    key = (NET, f"verifier-{n}")
    others = [placement[(NET, f"verifier-{m}")] for m in (1, 2, 3) if m < n]
    if placement[key] in sources or (len(eligible) >= 6 and placement[key] in others):
        free = [node for node in eligible if node not in set(placement.values())]
        if not free:
            fail(f"no eligible node holds no SI ClickHouse for verifier-{n}")
        placement[key] = moves[f"verifier-{n}"] = free[0]

pristine = export.parent / (export.name + ".pristine")
if pristine.exists():
    fail("pristine path already exists; stop")
shutil.copytree(export, pristine, symlinks=True)
good = True
# Out of order first: the network CHI's step 1 before indexer-b and indexer-c (K56).
network_values(1, {cluster: placement[(NET, cluster)] for cluster in ("source", "verifier-1", "verifier-2", "verifier-3")})
set_entry("DEVNET2_INTERSERVER_STEP", NET, 1)
for cluster in ("source", "verifier-1", "verifier-2", "verifier-3"):
    set_entry("DEVNET2_NODE_PINS", (NET, cluster), placement[(NET, cluster)])
good &= run("out of order: the network CHI at step 1 first", False)
shutil.rmtree(export)
shutil.copytree(pristine, export, symlinks=True)
# In order: the §5.0 moves, indexer-b and indexer-c at step 1, the network CHI at
# step 1 with every pin, then indexer-b's restore grant (owner-rebuild runbook §4.1).
pins = {}
for cluster, node in moves.items():
    pins[cluster] = node
    network_values(0, pins)
    set_entry("DEVNET2_NODE_PINS", (NET, cluster), node)
    good &= run(f"hardening §5.0: {cluster} moved to {node}", True)
chi_step1(t.INDEXER_B_CHI)
chi_pin(t.INDEXER_B_CHI, read[(B, "source")])
set_entry("DEVNET2_INTERSERVER_STEP", B, 1)
set_entry("DEVNET2_NODE_PINS", (B, "source"), read[(B, "source")])
good &= run("hardening §5.1: indexer-b at step 1, pinned to its volume's node", True)
chi_step1(t.INDEXER_C_CHI)
set_entry("DEVNET2_INTERSERVER_STEP", C, 1)
good &= run("hardening §5.2: indexer-c at step 1", True)
network_values(1, {cluster: placement[(NET, cluster)] for cluster in ("source", "verifier-1", "verifier-2", "verifier-3")})
set_entry("DEVNET2_INTERSERVER_STEP", NET, 1)
for cluster in ("source", "verifier-1", "verifier-2", "verifier-3"):
    if (NET, cluster) not in [(NET, moved) for moved in moves]:
        set_entry("DEVNET2_NODE_PINS", (NET, cluster), placement[(NET, cluster)])
good &= run("hardening §5.3: the network CHI at step 1 with every pin", True)
restore_grant(t.INDEXER_B_CHI)
set_entry("DEVNET2_SNODE_RESTORE_GRANT", B, True)
good &= run("owner rebuild §4.1: si_snode's restore grant on indexer-b", True)
shutil.rmtree(pristine)
print("rollout check passed" if good else "rollout check FAILED")
sys.exit(0 if good else 1)
```

Notes (drafting decisions, Appendix B):
- **Inert on merge.** This task changes three documents. With Task 53's commits the PR adds values that are unset, policy documents nothing applies and an example nothing applies (no GitOps on sea, validation-only workflows), and every release renders byte-identically to `origin/main` (Step 7 runs the audited direct-Helm equivalent; the canonical Helmfile wrapper is not executed). The live steps are Tasks 55 and 56, each confirmed in chat.
- **The admin context.** The operators' `editor` role (`k8s-common/_roles/editor-clusterrole.yaml`, bound per namespace) grants no `pods/ephemeralcontainers`, nothing cluster-scoped such as a PersistentVolume, and nothing in `kube-system`, while the cluster-wide `viewer` role reads pods, nodes and PersistentVolumes everywhere. The probe containers, the PV patches and labels, Hubble and every CiliumNetworkPolicy apply therefore go through `si_kadmin` (`sentio-sea-admin`, the context production's `cilium-ops` skill names), and each runbook's §1.2 checks `auth can-i` for them and stops on a `no`.
- **Census by the documents.** `si_p4_py` evaluates the CiliumNetworkPolicy documents itself (Cilium's rules for `fromEndpoints`, the policy-namespace default, `fromEntities`, `toPorts`, `ingressDeny`), so the census judges the merged observe documents and each enforce commit's document, never a summary of `SI_NETWORK_FLOWS`, whose Python shape is Task 53's. A `query_log` client is attributed only by its source address when the current non-hostNetwork pod holding that address was already running at the client's first query. Client-provided hostname is descriptive and cannot authorize a source; a historical, reused or unbound address stops the census as unattributed. The interserver fetchers come from Keeper's `replicas/<replica>/host` (every replica of a table fetches from every other); the scrapers from vmagent's targets (`vmagent-vm.monitoring.svc:8429`); the Keeper clients from `flwc cons` sampled daily; short-lived Keeper clients only show in §8.3's watch. A census client the documents do not admit joins its installation's enforce commit (contract §36.3's "every further census client in the enforce commit"), with its `SI_NETWORK_FLOWS` or `KEEPER_INGRESS_CLIENTS` entry and an open probe row, so the render tests and the probes judge it before it is enforced.
- **Observe-mode probes.** In observe mode nothing is denied, so a `refused` row towards a target whose policy does not enforce yet is recorded as `unjudged`; every row is judged once its target's policy enforces, and the exit probe judges all. The backup CronJob's pods exist only during a backup, so its rows run from a throwaway pod with the CronJob's pod labels (no Service selects them: the host Services select `app.kubernetes.io/component: node`). The matrix has rows from the production `clickhouse-extra` and `clickhouse-keeper-extra` pods, so the probes add terminated ephemeral containers to those pods as well; the runbook says so before each probe block.
- **The interserver Secret comes first.** The staging pair names the one interserver Secret (Task 53 D53-8: the committed example has no interserver setting, and each staging state adds the three `interserver_http_credentials/*` keys from `SI_INTERSERVER_SECRET`), and only the user's script makes that Secret. The runbook keeps contract §36.6's numbering (§3 staging proof, §4 the user's Secret) and says in both places that §4 runs before §3.1; §3.1 refuses while the Secret is missing, and nothing reads it before §5 (Task 55 runs §4 as its Step 6, before §3 as its Step 7).
- **Restart windows and acceptance writes.** Every ClickHouse restart of §5 and §6 is one restart window of the P2 runbook (Plan S3-C3 contract §27.5, which binds every SI ClickHouse restart since P2): quiet point (for the network CHI on every owner), render tests, push, apply or sync, every pod of the installation replaced once and Ready, the engine-fence probe, then the owner's acceptance write, which here also proves the mixed interserver state live (the uncredentialed verifiers fetch the owner's new part from the now credentialed source, `si_p4_downloads`). The runbook makes 18 acceptance writes (3 more per §5.0 move), 14 of them the `devuser1` owner's in the user's terminal.
- **Acceptance tables and values.** The hardening runbook creates indexer-b's own `devuser1.s3_p4` (§1.3, one table-set transition) rather than write into a table an earlier runbook may still keep or drop, and the owner-rebuild runbook drops it (§6); indexer-c's writes go to its existing `<db>.s3e_e2e` (the indexer-c runbook's §8), which is also the table of Task 56's acceptance `4001`. Values: hardening `4201`–`4207` per owner table plus `429<n>` per §5.0 move and `428<k>` per revert window, owner rebuild `4001`–`4005` (`4001` the drill's acceptance, the RTO's end), disjoint from the earlier runbooks' (`3001`–`3004`, `3101`–`3102`, `s3e_e2e` rows `1`–`3` and the P3 runbook's row `4`, `4101`–`4104`, `5101`–`5104`, `5201`–`5299`, the P3 runbook's `5301`). The hardening makes 18 promotions and needs a half-budget of at least 18; the owner rebuild makes 5. Contract issue for Task 55 (drafted against an earlier two-table shape of this runbook): its Step 4 creates `s3_p4` in the indexer-c acceptance database as well (two table-set transitions, expecting `<db>.s3_p4 on indexer-c: active`) and its gates name `s3_p4` for indexer-c's rows; the runbook creates only `devuser1.s3_p4` (one transition; §1.3 expects `<db>.s3e_e2e on indexer-c: active`) and writes indexer-c's rows into `<db>.s3e_e2e`, so Task 55 follows the runbook.
- **The dry run's object store.** `rebuild-safe` reads `storage_integrity.backup` (`rebuild-safe requires storage_integrity.backup: …`), which a host's config carries only while `rebuildSafe` is on (Task 53 D53-2). §5.3 therefore runs the dry run in the running host with a temporary config: `/config/standalone.yaml` plus `storage_integrity.backup.bucket_url` (from indexer-c's backup ConfigMap) and `owner_indexer_id`, written to the pod's `/tmp` and removed afterwards; the restore key goes from its Secret into the container's stdin (Task 52's note "Dry run on a running host").
- **The backup schedule.** indexer-c's CronJob runs daily (`17 4 * * *` UTC, Plan S3-C1); a scheduled backup during the drill would read the lost or half-rebuilt ClickHouse, so §5.4 refuses unless the next run is at least 8 hours away.
- **The fence evidence and the lost databases.** `keeper-before.txt` is the replica list of every table `snode-3` held, taken after the old server's Keeper session expired (`snode-3` inactive, the verifiers active); `si_rebuild_py check-report` requires the fence lines' dropped paths to be exactly those tables. `pv-fenced.txt` shows the three old volumes `Retain`, `Released` and labelled `storage-integrity.sentio.xyz/fenced: "true"`. §1.2 records every non-protocol database of indexer-c's ClickHouse with its engine (`databases-c.tsv`, the indexer-c runbook's `devnet2` among them) and refuses any table outside the protocol and member databases; §5.6 creates those databases again on the new ClickHouse, since `rebuild-safe` creates only the protocol databases and the si-member its own.
- **The D39 verdict.** `si_p4_py placement` moves every verifier ClickHouse that sits on a source's node and, when devnet2 has at least six eligible nodes, every verifier but the first on a node another verifier holds, to distinct eligible nodes that hold no source (preferring, and with six eligible nodes requiring, one no SI ClickHouse holds or an earlier move takes), reports `SHARE` lines when fewer than six eligible nodes leave two verifiers on one node, and stops on two sources on one node, every eligible node holding a source, fewer than four eligible nodes, a pin that disagrees with its pod, or a pod off its volume's node.
- **The earlier runbooks' helpers.** The P0 runbook's `partstates` tool is copied into each runbook's `$si_backup/tools` (§1.1), and the owner-rebuild runbook puts it back into the voters after replacing them (§2.4). The P2 and P3 runbooks' helpers are called only with the arguments and outputs their contracts fix (Plan S3-C3 §27.2, S3-C4 §32.4). The P1 runbook's `si_p1_pin` and `si_p1_image` and the P0 runbook's `si_stage3_image` read positional pins under `$si_backup`, so the hardening runbook redefines them to refuse instead of reading its pins file as theirs. The P2 runbook's own `si_owner_id` (Plan S3-C3 Task 39) reads indexer-c's id from line 8 of its `$si_backup/pins`; the hardening runbook's `si_owner_id` takes the same argument and prints the same id from this runbook's pins, and, defined later in the chain, replaces it, so `si_quiet_point`, which calls it, reads the right pin.
- **Placeholders.** The runbook texts hold PR-time values in angle brackets (`<SN_COMMIT_P3>`, `<SN_DIGEST_P3>`, `<ARBITER_TAG>`, `<ARBITER_DIGEST>`, `<INDEXER_C_ID>`, `<INDEXER_C_CHI_NODE>`, `<INDEXER_C_HOST_NODE>`, `<P4_MECHANICS>`, `<ARBITER_TAG_P4>`, `<ARBITER_DIGEST_P4>`, `<CORE_TAG_P4>`, `<PROTO_TAG_P4>`, `<SN_COMMIT_P4>`, `<SN_DIGEST_P4>`, `<HG_TAG_P3>`, `<UNSAFE_INC_ROOT>`, `<P1_END>`); Step 6 fills them from the ledger and proves none is left. Runtime values (`'<n>'`, `'<target>'`, `'<installation>'`, `'<1|2>'`, `'<policy>'`, `'<indexer id>'`, `/path/to/devuser1-owner.key`, `/path/to/arbiter`) stay: every block that needs one refuses its placeholder.
- **Review source and bounded verification (2026-10-18).** The current input is final Task53's independently verified 1769-regular-file source (manifest SHA256 `a6536dbced760e4eab0ecd5ccf31e2d7b8ffe5bc990350ce24a93cd5ec7482ee`), preserving fresh C3 metadata/SHOW COLUMNS, C4 serving and chart guards, the actual source placement and user capacity settings. """Validate exact ledger rows before literal substitution; never evaluates ledger text."""
import datetime,json,re,shlex,sys
from pathlib import Path
KEYS='SN_COMMIT_P3 SN_DIGEST_P3 ARBITER_TAG ARBITER_DIGEST INDEXER_C_ID INDEXER_C_CHI_NODE INDEXER_C_HOST_NODE P4_MECHANICS ARBITER_TAG_P4 ARBITER_DIGEST_P4 CORE_TAG_P4 PROTO_TAG_P4 SN_COMMIT_P4 SN_DIGEST_P4 HG_TAG_P3 UNSAFE_INC_ROOT P1_END'.split()
def read(path):
 d={}
 for line in Path(path).read_text().splitlines():
  k,sep,v=line.partition('=')
  if not sep or k not in KEYS or k in d or not v:raise SystemExit('unexpected/duplicate/empty ledger row')
  d[k]=v
 if set(d)!=set(KEYS):raise SystemExit('incomplete ledger rows')
 for k,v in d.items():
  if k.startswith('SN_COMMIT'):pat='[0-9a-f]{40}'
  elif 'DIGEST' in k:pat='sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}'
  elif '_TAG' in k:pat=r'v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(?:-[0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?'
  elif k=='INDEXER_C_ID':
   pat='0|[1-9][0-9]*'
   if not re.fullmatch(pat,v) or not 1 < int(v) <= 18446744073709551615:raise SystemExit('invalid enrolled indexer-c id')
  elif k.endswith('_NODE'):pat=r'[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9.-]*[a-z0-9])?'
  elif k in ('P4_MECHANICS','P1_END'):
   pat=r'[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}'
   try:datetime.date.fromisoformat(v)
   except ValueError:raise SystemExit('invalid ledger date')
  elif k=='UNSAFE_INC_ROOT':pat=r'/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+(?:/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)*'
  else:raise SystemExit('unhandled ledger key')
  if re.fullmatch(pat,v) is None:raise SystemExit('invalid ledger value '+k)
 return d
values=read(sys.argv[1])
if len(sys.argv)==2:
 for k in KEYS:print(k+'='+shlex.quote(values[k]))
else:
 for name in sys.argv[2:]:
  p=Path(name);s=p.read_text()
  for k in KEYS:s=s.replace('<'+k+'>',values[k])
  if any('<'+k+'>' in s for k in KEYS):raise SystemExit('unfilled PR-time placeholder')
  p.write_text(s)
 print('Both runbooks filled from validated exact ledger rows; no value evaluated')
```

```python
"""Conventions check of the two stage-3 P4 runbooks (Plan S3-D Task 54; local, never committed).

usage: python3 -I check_runbooks.py <out-dir> <hardening.md> <owner-rebuild.md>

It asserts the section lists of Plan S3-D contract §36.6, exactly one bash block in each §0 and that it is
§0's first block, the line `Confirm before running.` in front of every block that writes and only there, no
hard-wrapped prose, `bash -n` on every bash block, `fish --no-execute` on every fish block and a compile of
every embedded Python program, and writes every block into <out-dir> for shellcheck and the self-test.
"""
import os
import py_compile
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys

SECTIONS = {
    "storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p4-hardening.md": [
        "## 0. Session helpers", "## 1. Preparation", "### 1.1 Pins and identities", "### 1.2 Preconditions and baseline", "### 1.3 Promotion budget",
        "## 2. Census", "### 2.1 ClickHouse clients", "### 2.2 Interserver fetches", "### 2.3 Keeper clients", "### 2.4 Placement",
        "## 3. Staging proof", "### 3.1 Staging pair", "### 3.2 Mixed-state fetches", "### 3.3 Step 2", "### 3.4 Staging cleanup",
        "## 4. Interserver secret (user action)",
        "## 5. Interserver step 1 and node pins", "### 5.0 Moving a verifier ClickHouse, only when §2.4 finds a conflict", "### 5.1 indexer-b", "### 5.2 indexer-c", "### 5.3 network",
        "## 6. Interserver step 2", "### 6.1 indexer-b", "### 6.2 indexer-c", "### 6.3 network",
        "## 7. SI ClickHouse policies", "### 7.1 Observe", "### 7.2 Probes", "### 7.3 Enforce",
        "## 8. Keeper ingress allowlist", "### 8.1 Observe", "### 8.2 Probes", "### 8.3 Enforce",
        "## 9. Failure domains", "## 10. Exit probe", "## 11. End",
        "## 12. Rollback", "### 12.1 Interserver", "### 12.2 Node pins", "### 12.3 Policies", "### 12.4 Keeper allowlist",
        "## 13. Operating rules",
    ],
    "storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p4-owner-rebuild.md": [
        "## 0. Session helpers", "## 1. Preparation", "### 1.1 Pins and identities", "### 1.2 Preconditions", "### 1.3 Promotion budget",
        "## 2. Settle rollout", "### 2.1 Offline replay check", "### 2.2 Verifiers", "### 2.3 Hosts", "### 2.4 Voters",
        "## 3. Settle", "### 3.1 Read the track", "### 3.2 Settle", "### 3.3 Release after a settle",
        "## 4. Rebuild preparation", "### 4.1 Restore grant", "### 4.2 RTO marks",
        "## 5. Rebuild drill", "### 5.1 Quarantine", "### 5.2 Settle", "### 5.3 Backup and dry run", "### 5.4 Loss", "### 5.5 Isolate the old volume",
        "### 5.6 Re-create the ClickHouse", "### 5.7 Rebuild", "### 5.8 Audit", "### 5.9 Rebuild values off", "### 5.10 Release", "### 5.11 Acceptance",
        "## 6. End", "## 7. Rollback", "## 8. Operating rules",
    ],
}
# A block writes when it pushes, opens or merges a PR, syncs, applies, deletes, patches, labels, scales, creates,
# runs or debugs a resource, writes Keeper, writes data or runs DDL, submits a quarantine, settle or release,
# writes into a pod, or calls one of the mutating helpers of the two §0 blocks.
WRITES = re.compile(
    r"git push|git revert|gh pr (create|merge)|helmfile [^\n]* sync"
    r"|\b(si_kubectl|si_kadmin|kubectl)\b[^\n|;]*?\s(apply|delete|patch|label|scale|create|run|debug)\s"
    r"|\bsi_(cnp_apply|p4_roll|p4_enforce|net_probe|p4_accept|agent_start|partstates_put|replace_voter|revert_stage3)\b"
    r"|si_keeper \"(touch|create|rmr|rm|set) "
    r"|arbiter-admin indexer (quarantine|release|settle) "
    r"|INSERT INTO|CREATE TABLE|DROP TABLE|CREATE DATABASE|SYSTEM SYNC REPLICA"
    r"|rebuild-safe --config-path"
)
HELPERS = "## 0. Session helpers"


def blocks_of(lines):
    """(start index, language, body, confirmed, section) of every fenced block."""
    out, i, section = [], 0, ""
    while i < len(lines):
        if re.match(r"#{2,3} ", lines[i]):
            section = lines[i]
        m = re.match(r"^```(\w+)\s*$", lines[i])
        if not m:
            i += 1
            continue
        j = i + 1
        while lines[j] != "```":
            j += 1
        prev = [x for x in lines[:i] if x.strip()]
        confirmed = bool(prev) and prev[-1].strip() == "Confirm before running."
        out.append((i, m.group(1), "\n".join(lines[i + 1:j]) + "\n", confirmed, section))
        i = j + 1
    return out


def check(path, out):
    name = os.path.basename(path)
    text = open(path).read()
    lines = text.splitlines()
    want = SECTIONS[name]
    got = [l for l in lines if re.match(r"#{2,3} ", l)]
    assert got == want, f"{name}: sections differ: missing {[w for w in want if w not in got]}, extra {[g for g in got if g not in want]}"
    blocks = blocks_of(lines)
    in_helpers = [b for b in blocks if b[4] == HELPERS]
    assert len(in_helpers) == 1 and in_helpers[0][1] == "bash", f"{name}: §0 must hold exactly one block, a bash block"
    assert blocks[0] is in_helpers[0], f"{name}: the §0 block must be the runbook's first block"
    missing, needless = [], []
    for pos, lang, body, ok, sec in blocks:
        if lang != "bash" or sec == HELPERS:
            continue
        hits = [l for l in body.splitlines() if WRITES.search(l.replace("--dry-run=server", "")) and not l.lstrip().startswith("#")]
        if hits and not ok:
            missing.append(f"{pos + 1}: {hits[0].strip()[:90]}")
        if ok and not hits:
            needless.append(str(pos + 1))
    assert not missing, f"{name}: writing blocks without 'Confirm before running.': " + " | ".join(missing)
    assert not needless, f"{name}: 'Confirm before running.' before a block that writes nothing: lines " + ", ".join(needless)
    in_fence, wrapped = False, []
    prose = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z`(\[*\"']")
    for n, l in enumerate(lines):
        if l.startswith("```"):
            in_fence = not in_fence
            continue
        if in_fence or n == 0:
            continue
        if prose.match(l) and prose.match(lines[n - 1]):
            wrapped.append(n + 1)
    assert not wrapped, f"{name}: hard-wrapped prose at lines {wrapped[:10]}"
    stem = name[: -len(".md")]
    bad, snippets = [], 0
    for n, (pos, lang, body, ok, sec) in enumerate(blocks):
        kind = "helpers" if sec == HELPERS else ("c" if ok else "r")
        f = os.path.join(out, f"{stem}-{n:03d}-{kind}.{lang}")
        open(f, "w").write(body)
        if lang == "bash":
            r = subprocess.run(["bash", "-n", f], capture_output=True, text=True)
            if r.returncode:
                bad.append((f, r.stderr.strip()[:300]))
            for k, py in enumerate(re.findall(r"python3 -I(?: -B)? - [^\n]*<<'(EOF|PY)'[^\n]*\n(.*?)\n\1\n", body, re.S)):
                snippets += 1
                p = os.path.join(out, "py", f"{stem}-{n:03d}-{k}.py")
                open(p, "w").write(py[1] + "\n")
                py_compile.compile(p, doraise=True)
            for k, py in enumerate(re.findall(r"python3 -I(?: -B)? -c '([^']*)'", body)):
                snippets += 1
                p = os.path.join(out, "py", f"{stem}-{n:03d}-c{k}.py")
                open(p, "w").write(py + "\n")
                py_compile.compile(p, doraise=True)
        elif lang == "fish":
            r = subprocess.run(["fish", "--no-execute", f], capture_output=True, text=True)
            if r.returncode:
                bad.append((f, r.stderr.strip()[:300]))
    assert not bad, f"{name}: syntax: {bad}"
    bash = [b for b in blocks if b[1] == "bash"]
    print(f"{name}: sections as contract §36.6 lists them; one helper block, §0's first; {len(bash)} bash blocks ({sum(1 for b in bash if b[3])} confirmed, every write confirmed), {sum(1 for b in blocks if b[1] == 'fish')} fish blocks; no hard-wrapped prose; bash -n and fish --no-execute pass; {snippets} python programs compile")


out = sys.argv[1]
shutil.rmtree(out, ignore_errors=True)
os.makedirs(os.path.join(out, "py"))
for p in sys.argv[2:]:
    check(p, out)
print(f"blocks in {out}")
```

# Storage integrity devnet2: stage 3 P4, network hardening

This runbook hardens the network around devnet2-si-v2's six SI ClickHouses (the network installation `storage-integrity-si-v2` with indexer-a's source and `verifier-1..3`, and the sources of indexer-b and indexer-c, `storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-b` and `storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-c`, all in `sentio-network-devnet2`) and the shared Keeper ensemble `clickhouse-keeper-extra` (namespace `clickhouse`): interserver credentials in two rolling steps, node pins that put the sources on pairwise distinct nodes and no verifier ClickHouse on a source's node, ingress-only Cilium policies on every SI ClickHouse, an ingress allowlist on the Keeper ensemble, each probed from every pod first, and the failure-domain record that P5 and P6 consume. Design: housegate `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-14-multi-source-si-stage3-database-groups-design.md`, §14 "Network hardening (P4, before k is raised)", §9.3 "Failure independence", §16 row P4 and §18, as clarified by Plan S3-D (housegate `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-15-multi-source-si-s3d-p4-settle-rebuild-hardening.md`, clarifications K55 to K57 and decision D39). It continues [storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p3-replica-reads.md](storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p3-replica-reads.md) (reads from members, done); the settle rollout and the owner rebuild of indexer-c follow in [storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p4-owner-rebuild.md](storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p4-owner-rebuild.md), after this runbook's §11.

| Stage | Change | Way back |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | PR (P4): chart values `clickhouse.interserver`, `clickhouse.nodePins`, `clickhouse.access.snodeRestoreGrant` and `storageIntegrity.snode.rebuildSafe`, all unset; the SI ingress policies and `clickhouse-keeper-extra-ingress` in observe mode, applied by nothing; the probe matrix; the interserver staging pair; `make-interserver-secret.sh`; render tests; this runbook and the owner-rebuild runbook; inert on merge | Revert the PR |
| 1 | Census of every client of the six SI ClickHouses and of the Keeper ensemble, 7 days, read-only; placement judged by D39 (§2) | None needed |
| 2 | Staging proof of the mixed state on two throwaway CHIs (§3) | Delete the pair (§3.4) |
| 3 | The interserver Secret, the user's action (§4) | The user deletes it while no installation names it |
| 4 | Interserver step 1 (`allow_empty` true) with the node pins: indexer-b, indexer-c, then the network CHI, one restart window each; a verifier ClickHouse on a source's node moves first (§5) | §12.1, §12.2 |
| 5 | Interserver step 2 (`allow_empty` false), same order (§6) | §12.1 |
| 6 | SI ClickHouse policies: observe, probes from every pod, enforce one installation per window (§7) | §12.3 |
| 7 | Keeper ingress allowlist: observe, probes, enforce through its own PR with an abort criterion (§8) | §12.4 |
| 8 | Failure domains, exit probe, end (§9 to §11) | None needed |

Every value a later block needs is written under `$si_backup`, so a block also runs in a new session once §0 is defined. Never run two stages in one window. From §5 until §11, freeze every other change to the three installations, the three host releases and `clickhouse-keeper-extra`: no other sync or apply, no pod deletion and no consensus update outside this runbook.

Every block that pushes to production `main`, opens or merges a PR, syncs a release, applies, patches or deletes a resource, adds an ephemeral container, runs a throwaway pod, writes Keeper or writes data needs explicit user confirmation in chat before it runs; each such block is preceded by the line `Confirm before running.`.
