````markdown
trailer="Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>";seen=set()
for c in commits:
 if not isinstance(c,dict)or not isinstance(c.get("sha"),str)or re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}",c["sha"])is None or c["sha"]in seen:sys.exit("malformed or duplicate PR commit; stop")
 seen.add(c["sha"]);a=c["commit"]["author"];message=c["commit"]["message"]
 if not isinstance(message,str)or(a["name"],a["email"])!=("poetry","chen@sentio.xyz"):sys.exit("unexpected primary author; stop")
 coauthors=re.findall(r"(?im)^[ \t]*co-authored-by[ \t]*:.*$",message)
 parsed=subprocess.run(["git","interpret-trailers","--parse"],input=message,text=True,check=True,capture_output=True).stdout.splitlines()
 if coauthors not in ([],[trailer])or parsed.count(trailer)!=len(coauthors):sys.exit("unexpected or duplicated coauthor trailer; stop")
if commits[-1]["sha"]!=head:sys.exit("REST listing head differs from the checked head; stop")
print("PR commit identities and pinned head verified")
' "$3" < "$file" || { rm -f "$file"; return 1; }
  rm -f "$file"
  remote="$(gh pr view "$2" --repo "$1" --json headRefOid --jq .headRefOid)" || return 1
  [ "$remote" = "$3" ] || { echo "PR head changed during validation; repeat review" >&2; return 1; }
}
si_pin() { # $1 a name of this runbook's pins file (§1.1): its value; fails when it is not recorded
  local v
  v="$(sed -n "s/^$1=//p" "$si_backup/pins" 2>/dev/null)"
  [ -n "$v" ] || { echo "$1 is not recorded in $si_backup/pins (§1.1)" >&2; return 1; }
  printf '%s\n' "$v"
}
si_indexer_c_id() { si_pin INDEXER_C_ID; } # the indexer-c runbook's helper, over this runbook's pins
si_stage3_image() { echo "si_stage3_image reads the stage-3 P0 pins; the P4 runbooks read theirs with si_pin" >&2; return 1; }
si_p1_pin() { echo "si_p1_pin reads the P1 pins; the P4 runbooks read theirs with si_pin" >&2; return 1; }
si_p1_image() { echo "si_p1_image reads the P1 pins; the P4 runbooks read theirs with si_pin" >&2; return 1; }
si_chi_of() { # $1 installation network|indexer-b|indexer-c: its CHI
  case "$1" in
    network) echo storage-integrity-si-v2 ;;
    indexer-b) echo storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-b ;;
    indexer-c) echo storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-c ;;
    *) echo "unknown installation $1 (network|indexer-b|indexer-c)" >&2; return 2 ;;
  esac
}
si_hosts_of() { # $1 installation: its ClickHouse hosts as si_ch_pod names them, one per line
  case "$1" in
    network) printf '%s\n' a v1 v2 v3 ;;
    indexer-b) echo b ;;
    indexer-c) echo c ;;
    *) echo "unknown installation $1 (network|indexer-b|indexer-c)" >&2; return 2 ;;
  esac
}
si_owner_of() { # $1 installation: the SI indexer (a|b|c) whose source it holds
  case "$1" in network) echo a ;; indexer-b) echo b ;; indexer-c) echo c ;; *) echo "unknown installation $1" >&2; return 2 ;; esac
}
si_owner_id() { # $1 a|b|c: its SI indexer id (replaces the P2 runbook's helper, which reads the P2 pins)
  case "$1" in a) echo 0 ;; b) echo 1 ;; c) si_indexer_c_id ;; *) echo "unknown indexer $1 (a|b|c)" >&2; return 2 ;; esac
}
si_keeper_pod() { # $1 0|1|2: that clickhouse-keeper-extra replica's pod
  local p
  case "$1" in 0|1|2) ;; *) echo "Keeper ordinal must be 0, 1 or 2" >&2; return 2 ;; esac
  p="$(kubectl --context sentio-sea -n clickhouse get pods -l clickhouse-keeper.altinity.com/chk=clickhouse-keeper-extra -o name | sed 's|^pod/||' | LC_ALL=C sort | sed -n "$(( $1 + 1 ))p")"
  [ -n "$p" ] || { echo "no clickhouse-keeper-extra replica $1" >&2; return 1; }
  echo "$p"
}
si_keeper_at() { # $1 0|1|2, $2 keeper-client query: on that replica, read-only use only
  local pod
  pod="$(si_keeper_pod "$1")" || return 1
  kubectl --context sentio-sea -n clickhouse exec "$pod" -- clickhouse-keeper-client -h localhost -p 2181 -q "$2"
}
si_p4_keeper_exists() { # $1 exact absolute Keeper path: only the literal response 0 or 1 is valid
  local answer
  case "$1" in /*) ;; *) echo "absolute Keeper path required" >&2; return 2 ;; esac
  answer="$(si_keeper "exists '$1'")" || return 1
  case "$answer" in 0|1) printf '%s\n' "$answer" ;; *) echo "Keeper exists did not return literal 0 or 1" >&2; return 1 ;; esac
}
si_p4_staging_count() { # $1 a|b, $2 exact expected row count: the read itself must succeed
  local count
  count="$(si_staging_pair "$1" "SELECT count() FROM default.p4_interserver")" || return 1
  [ "$count" = "$2" ] || { echo "staging $1 count differs from $2; stop" >&2; return 1; }
  printf 'staging %s count %s\n' "$1" "$count"
}
si_p4_staging_auth() { # $1 a|b: at least one failed GET_PART with a measured authentication refusal
  local work
  work="$(mktemp)" || return 1
  si_staging_pair "$1" "SELECT type, num_tries, last_exception FROM system.replication_queue WHERE table = 'p4_interserver' FORMAT JSONEachRow" > "$work" || { rm -f "$work"; return 1; }
  si_p4_py staging-auth "$work" || { rm -f "$work"; return 1; }
  rm -f "$work"
}
si_net_alias() { # $1 an alias of the probe matrix: "<namespace> <pod> <pod IP>"
  local ns pod="" sel="" ip
  case "$1" in
    host-a|host-b|host-c) ns=sentio-network-devnet2; pod="sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-${1#host-}-0" ;;
    member-a|member-b|member-c) ns=sentio-network-devnet2; pod="sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-${1#member-}-si-member-0" ;;
    verifier-1|verifier-2|verifier-3) ns=sentio-network-devnet2; pod="storage-integrity-si-v2-verifier-$(( ${1#verifier-} - 1 ))" ;;
    ch-network-source) ns=sentio-network-devnet2; pod=storage-integrity-si-v2-source-0-0-0 ;;
    ch-verifier-1|ch-verifier-2|ch-verifier-3) ns=sentio-network-devnet2; pod="storage-integrity-si-v2-verifier-${1#ch-verifier-}-0-0-0" ;;
    ch-b) ns=sentio-network-devnet2; pod=storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-b-source-0-0-0 ;;
    ch-c) ns=sentio-network-devnet2; pod=storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-c-source-0-0-0 ;;
    keeper-0|keeper-1|keeper-2) ns=clickhouse; pod="$(si_keeper_pod "${1#keeper-}")" || return 1 ;;
    extra-ch) ns=clickhouse; sel=clickhouse.altinity.com/chi=clickhouse-extra ;;
    dind) ns=sentio-network-devnet2; sel=app.kubernetes.io/instance=sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-a,app.kubernetes.io/component=dind ;;
    observer) ns=sentio-network-devnet2; pod=sentio-node-devnet2-observer-0 ;;
    toolbox) ns=default; sel=app=toolbox ;;
    *) echo "unknown alias $1 (backup-a|b|c have no standing pod)" >&2; return 2 ;;
  esac
  if [ -n "$sel" ]; then
    pod="$(kubectl --context sentio-sea -n "$ns" get pods -l "$sel" -o name | sed 's|^pod/||' | LC_ALL=C sort | head -n 1)"
  fi
  [ -n "$pod" ] || { echo "no pod for alias $1" >&2; return 1; }
  ip="$(kubectl --context sentio-sea -n "$ns" get pod "$pod" -o jsonpath='{.status.podIP}')" || return 1
  [ -n "$ip" ] || { echo "pod $ns/$pod has no IP" >&2; return 1; }
  printf '%s %s %s\n' "$ns" "$pod" "$ip"
}
si_net_census() { # $1 installation, $2 optional UTC start 'YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss' (default 7 days ago): every client its ClickHouse pods logged since then, attributed to a pod; TSV host, port, user, address, client, namespace, pod, queries, first, last, how
  local since="now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY" hosts h work
  [ -z "${2:-}" ] || since="toDateTime('$2', 'UTC')"
  hosts="$(si_hosts_of "$1")" || return 2
  work="$(mktemp -d)"
  kubectl --context sentio-sea get pods -A -o json > "$work/pods.json" || return 1
  cp "$work/pods.json" "$si_backup/pods-census-$1.json"
  printf 'host\tport\tuser\taddress\tclient\tnamespace\tpod\tqueries\tfirst\tlast\thow\n'
  for h in $hosts; do
    si_ch_admin "$h" "SELECT IPv6NumToString(address) AS address, user, client_hostname, http_user_agent, interface, count() AS queries, toString(min(event_time), 'UTC') AS first, toString(max(event_time), 'UTC') AS last FROM system.query_log WHERE event_time >= $since AND type != 'QueryStart' AND query_kind != 'AsyncInsertFlush' GROUP BY address, user, client_hostname, http_user_agent, interface ORDER BY address, user, client_hostname, interface FORMAT JSONEachRow" > "$work/$h.jsonl" || return 1
    si_p4_py attribute "$h" "$work/$h.jsonl" "$work/pods.json" || return 1
  done
  rm -rf "$work"
}
si_net_scrapes() { # every vmagent scrape target on an SI ClickHouse or clickhouse-keeper-extra pod; TSV namespace, pod, port, scrape pool, health, scrapers
  local work
  work="$(mktemp -d)"
  si_arbiter 0 wget -qO- http://vmagent-vm.monitoring.svc:8429/api/v1/targets > "$work/targets.json" || { echo "vmagent does not answer from arbiter-0" >&2; return 1; }
  kubectl --context sentio-sea get pods -A -o json > "$work/pods.json" || return 1
  cp "$work/pods.json" "$si_backup/pods-census-scrape.json"
  printf 'namespace\tpod\tport\tpool\thealth\tscrapers\n'
  si_p4_py scrapes "$work/targets.json" "$work/pods.json" || return 1
  rm -rf "$work"
}
# shellcheck disable=SC2016 # the in-pod script is single-quoted on purpose: it expands inside the Keeper pod
si_net_replicas() { # every replica Keeper records under the network root's unscoped unsafe paths: TSV table, replica, interserver host, port, active
  local p
  p="$(si_keeper_pod 0)" || return 1
  kubectl --context sentio-sea -n clickhouse exec "$p" -- sh -c '
    r=/storage-integrity/devnet2/devnet2-si-v2/sentio/0/unsafe
    q() { clickhouse-keeper-client -h localhost -p 2181 -q "$1"; }
    exists() {
      answer="$(q "exists '\''$1'\''")" || return 1
      case "$answer" in 0|1) printf "%s\n" "$answer" ;; *) echo "Keeper exists returned neither literal 0 nor 1" >&2; return 1 ;; esac
    }
    children() {
      [ "$(exists "$1")" = 1 ] || { echo "required Keeper census node is missing or unreadable" >&2; return 1; }
      answer="$(q "ls '\''$1'\''")" || return 1
      for child in $answer; do
        case "$child" in ""|*[!A-Za-z0-9_.-]*) echo "malformed Keeper child name" >&2; return 1 ;; esac
      done
      printf "%s\n" "$answer"
    }
    tables="$(children "$r")" || exit 1
    [ -n "$tables" ] || { echo "unsafe census has no tables" >&2; exit 1; }
    for t in $tables; do
      replicas="$(children "$r/$t/replicas")" || exit 1
      [ -n "$replicas" ] || { echo "unsafe table has no replicas" >&2; exit 1; }
      for n in $replicas; do
        [ "$(exists "$r/$t/replicas/$n/host")" = 1 ] || exit 1
        h="$(q "get '\''$r/$t/replicas/$n/host'\''")" || exit 1
        host="$(printf "%s\n" "$h" | sed -n "s/^host: //p")"
        port="$(printf "%s\n" "$h" | sed -n "s/^port: //p")"
        case "$host" in ""|*[!A-Za-z0-9_.-]*) echo "malformed replica host" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac
        case "$port" in ""|*[!0-9]*) echo "malformed replica port" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac
        active="$(exists "$r/$t/replicas/$n/is_active")" || exit 1
        a=no; [ "$active" = 0 ] || a=yes
        printf "%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n" "$t" "$n" "$host" "$port" "$a"
      done
    done'
}
si_keeper_cons() { # one sample of the client sessions of every clickhouse-keeper-extra replica (flwc cons), attributed to pods of any namespace or to nodes; TSV keeper, client address, client port, namespace, pod
  local work n pod
  work="$(mktemp -d)"
  kubectl --context sentio-sea get pods -A -o json > "$work/pods.json" || return 1
  kubectl --context sentio-sea get nodes -o json > "$work/nodes.json" || return 1
  cp "$work/pods.json" "$si_backup/pods-census-keeper-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ).json"
  printf 'keeper\tclient\tport\tnamespace\tpod\n'
  for n in 0 1 2; do
    pod="$(si_keeper_pod "$n")" || return 1
    si_keeper_at "$n" 'flwc cons' > "$work/cons-$n.txt" || return 1
    si_p4_py cons "$pod" "$work/cons-$n.txt" "$work/pods.json" "$work/nodes.json" || return 1
  done
  rm -rf "$work"
}
si_keeper_state() { # one line per clickhouse-keeper-extra replica: server state, followers, alive connections, outstanding requests (flwc mntr)
  local n sample state
  for n in 0 1 2; do
    sample="$(si_keeper_at "$n" 'flwc mntr')" || return 1
    state="$(printf '%s\n' "$sample" | awk '$1 ~ /^zk_(server_state|synced_followers|num_alive_connections|outstanding_requests)$/ {if (seen[$1]++) exit 1; printf "%s=%s ", $1, $2} END {if (!seen["zk_server_state"] || !seen["zk_num_alive_connections"] || !seen["zk_outstanding_requests"]) exit 1}')" || { echo "incomplete or duplicate Keeper monitor fields" >&2; return 1; }
    printf 'keeper-%s %s\n' "$n" "$state"
  done
}
si_keeper_client_errors() { # $1 RFC 3339 UTC start: every Keeper client ClickHouse pod (the clickhouse-extra pods and the six SI ClickHouses) whose log shows Keeper session errors since then, with their count; fails, naming what it could not read on stderr, when a pod list cannot be read or is empty or a pod's log cannot be read or searched, so §8.3's watch aborts instead of reading silence as health
  local ns sel pods p n log err
  log="$(mktemp)"
  err="$(mktemp)"
  for ns in clickhouse sentio-network-devnet2; do
    sel=clickhouse.altinity.com/chi=clickhouse-extra
    [ "$ns" = clickhouse ] || sel='clickhouse.altinity.com/chi in (storage-integrity-si-v2,storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-b,storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-c)'
    pods="$(kubectl --context sentio-sea -n "$ns" get pods -l "$sel" -o name 2> "$err")" || { echo "cannot list the Keeper client pods of $ns: $(head -n 1 "$err")" >&2; rm -f "$log" "$err"; return 1; }
    [ -n "$pods" ] || { echo "no Keeper client pod in $ns matches $sel" >&2; rm -f "$log" "$err"; return 1; }
    for p in $pods; do
      kubectl --context sentio-sea -n "$ns" logs "$p" --all-containers=true --since-time="$1" > "$log" 2> "$err" || { echo "cannot read the log of $ns/${p#pod/}: $(head -n 1 "$err")" >&2; rm -f "$log" "$err"; return 1; }
      # grep -c prints 0 and exits 1 when nothing matches: only that status, after a log read that succeeded, is a clean log
      n="$(grep -cE 'ZSESSIONEXPIRED|Session expired|ZCONNECTIONLOSS|Connection loss' "$log")" || [ "$?" = 1 ] || { echo "cannot search the log of $ns/${p#pod/}" >&2; rm -f "$log" "$err"; return 1; }
      [ "$n" = 0 ] || printf '%s/%s %s\n' "$ns" "${p#pod/}" "$n"
    done
  done
  rm -f "$log" "$err"
}
si_placement() { # $1 optional file name under $si_backup (default placement.tsv): writes the placement of the six SI ClickHouses (installation, cluster, role, pod, node, data volume's node, pin) and prints the D39 verdict lines; fails on a stop
  local work out="$si_backup/${1:-placement.tsv}" sel='clickhouse.altinity.com/chi in (storage-integrity-si-v2,storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-b,storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-c)'
  work="$(mktemp -d)"
  si_kubectl get pods -l "$sel" -o json > "$work/pods.json" || return 1
  si_kubectl get pvc -l "$sel" -o json > "$work/pvcs.json" || return 1
  kubectl --context sentio-sea get pv -o json > "$work/pvs.json" || return 1
  kubectl --context sentio-sea get nodes -l sentio.xyz/general=true --no-headers -o custom-columns=NAME:.metadata.name > "$work/eligible.txt" || return 1
  si_p4_py placement "$work/pods.json" "$work/pvcs.json" "$work/pvs.json" "$work/eligible.txt" "$out"
}
si_cnp_ns() { # $1 policy: its namespace
  case "$1" in
    clickhouse-keeper-extra-ingress) echo clickhouse ;;
    storage-integrity-si-v2-clickhouse-ingress|storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-b-clickhouse-ingress|storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-c-clickhouse-ingress) echo sentio-network-devnet2 ;;
    *) echo "unknown policy $1" >&2; return 2 ;;
  esac
}
si_cnp_mode() { # $1 policy: "<policy> absent", or its live mode (observe when enableDefaultDeny.ingress is false, else enforce) and Cilium's Valid condition
  local ns j
  ns="$(si_cnp_ns "$1")" || return 2
  j="$(si_kadmin -n "$ns" get ciliumnetworkpolicies.cilium.io "$1" -o json --ignore-not-found)" || return 1
  if [ -z "$j" ]; then echo "$1 absent"; return 0; fi
  printf '%s\n' "$j" | jq -er --arg p "$1" --arg ns "$ns" '
    if .apiVersion != "cilium.io/v2" or .kind != "CiliumNetworkPolicy" or .metadata.name != $p or .metadata.namespace != $ns or (.spec.enableDefaultDeny.ingress | type) != "boolean" then error("malformed live policy identity or mode")
    else [.status.conditions[]? | select(.type == "Valid") | .status] as $valid |
      if ($valid | length) != 1 or ($valid[0] != "True" and $valid[0] != "False" and $valid[0] != "Unknown") then error("missing or duplicate Valid condition")
      else "\($p) \(if .spec.enableDefaultDeny.ingress == false then "observe" else "enforce" end) valid=\($valid[0])" end end'
}
si_cnp_modes() { # si_cnp_mode of the four P4 policies
  local p
  for p in storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-b-clickhouse-ingress storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-c-clickhouse-ingress storage-integrity-si-v2-clickhouse-ingress clickhouse-keeper-extra-ingress; do
    si_cnp_mode "$p" || return 1
  done
}
si_policy_of() { # $1 installation: its SI ClickHouse policy
  case "$1" in
    network) echo storage-integrity-si-v2-clickhouse-ingress ;;
    indexer-b) echo storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-b-clickhouse-ingress ;;
    indexer-c) echo storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-c-clickhouse-ingress ;;
    *) echo "unknown installation $1 (network|indexer-b|indexer-c)" >&2; return 2 ;;
  esac
}
si_cnp_apply() { # $1 policy, $2 observe|enforce: a write, only in a confirmed block. Applies that one document of its file at HEAD (server-side dry run first), then requires the same spec/identity and Valid condition; traffic probes remain mandatory
  local ns doc live v=""
  ns="$(si_cnp_ns "$1")" || return 2
  doc="$(mktemp)" || return 1
  live="$(mktemp)" || { rm -f "$doc"; return 1; }
  si_p4_py doc "$1" "$2" "$doc" || return 1
  si_kadmin -n "$ns" apply --dry-run=server -f "$doc" > /dev/null || return 1
  si_kadmin -n "$ns" apply -f "$doc" || return 1
  for _ in $(seq 1 30); do
    if si_kadmin -n "$ns" get ciliumnetworkpolicies.cilium.io "$1" -o json > "$live"; then
      v="$(si_p4_py policy-live "$1" "$live" "$doc")" || v=""
      case "$v" in "$1 $2 valid=True uid="*) echo "$v $(si_stamp)"; rm -f "$doc" "$live"; return 0 ;; esac
    fi
    sleep 2
  done
  echo "$1 did not become valid with the exact applied spec in mode $2 within a minute: ${v:-unreadable}" >&2
  rm -f "$doc" "$live"
  return 1
}
si_p4_observe_apply() { # $1 policy, $2 retained exact observe document: emergency rollback, called only in confirmed blocks
  local ns live result
  ns="$(si_cnp_ns "$1")" || return 1
  live="$(mktemp)" || return 1
  si_kadmin -n "$ns" apply -f "$2" || { rm -f "$live"; return 1; }
  for _ in $(seq 1 30); do
    if si_kadmin -n "$ns" get ciliumnetworkpolicies.cilium.io "$1" -o json > "$live"; then
      result="$(si_p4_py policy-live "$1" "$live" "$2")" || result=""
      case "$result" in "$1 observe valid=True uid="*) printf '%s\n' "$result"; rm -f "$live"; return 0 ;; esac
    fi
    sleep 2
  done
  rm -f "$live"
  echo "emergency observe apply is not verified; stop and reconcile its exact live spec" >&2
  return 1
}
si_cnp_drops() { # $1 RFC 3339 UTC start: every flow Hubble dropped by policy since then towards an SI ClickHouse or clickhouse-keeper-extra pod, from the Cilium agent of each node that runs one; TSV time, source, destination, port, reason; fails when either pod list cannot be read or names no node, or an agent cannot be read
  local node agent work
  work="$(mktemp -d)"
  si_kubectl get pods -l 'clickhouse.altinity.com/chi in (storage-integrity-si-v2,storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-b,storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-c)' -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.spec.nodeName}{"\n"}{end}' > "$work/nodes-si" || return 1
  kubectl --context sentio-sea -n clickhouse get pods -l clickhouse-keeper.altinity.com/chk=clickhouse-keeper-extra -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.spec.nodeName}{"\n"}{end}' > "$work/nodes-keeper" || return 1
  grep -q . "$work/nodes-si" || { echo "no node runs an SI ClickHouse pod: no Cilium agent to read" >&2; return 1; }
  grep -q . "$work/nodes-keeper" || { echo "no node runs a clickhouse-keeper-extra pod: no Cilium agent to read" >&2; return 1; }
  cat "$work/nodes-si" "$work/nodes-keeper" | sed '/^$/d' | LC_ALL=C sort -u > "$work/nodes"
  printf 'time\tsource\tdestination\tport\treason\n'
  while read -r node; do
    agent="$(si_kadmin -n kube-system get pods -l k8s-app=cilium --field-selector "spec.nodeName=$node" -o name | head -n 1)" || return 1
    [ -n "$agent" ] || { echo "no Cilium agent on $node" >&2; return 1; }
    si_kadmin -n kube-system exec "$agent" -c cilium-agent -- hubble observe --since "$1" --verdict DROPPED -o jsonpb > "$work/flows" 2> "$work/err" || { cat "$work/err" >&2; return 1; }
    si_p4_py drops "$work/flows" || return 1
  done < "$work/nodes"
  rm -rf "$work"
}
si_net_probe_pod() { # $1 namespace, $2 pod, $3 probe script: a write (an ephemeral container stays in the pod's spec, terminated, until the pod is replaced). Runs the script in a new busybox:1.36.1 ephemeral container that shares the pod's network identity and prints its output
  local c n code=""
  c="si-probe-$(date +%s)-$RANDOM"
  si_kadmin -n "$1" debug "pod/$2" --image=busybox:1.36.1 --profile=general --container="$c" -- sh -c "$(cat "$3")" > /dev/null || return 1
  for _ in $(seq 1 300); do
    code="$(si_kadmin -n "$1" get pod "$2" -o json | jq -r --arg c "$c" '.status.ephemeralContainerStatuses[]? | select(.name == $c) | .state.terminated.exitCode // empty')" || code=""
    [ -n "$code" ] && break
    sleep 2
  done
  [ -n "$code" ] || { echo "probe container $c in $1/$2 did not end within 10 minutes" >&2; return 1; }
  [ "$code" = 0 ] || { echo "probe container $c exited $code; its rows cannot establish admission" >&2; return 1; }
  si_kadmin -n "$1" logs "$2" -c "$c"
}
si_net_probe_backup() { # $1 a|b|c, $2 probe script: a write. The backup CronJob's pods exist only while a backup runs, so this runs the script in a throwaway busybox:1.36.1 pod carrying that CronJob's pod labels (and storage-integrity.sentio.xyz/probe=true), prints its output and deletes it
  local labels pod n phase=""
  labels="$(si_kubectl get cronjob "sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-$1-si-backup" -o json | jq -c '.spec.jobTemplate.spec.template.metadata.labels // {}')" || return 1
  printf '%s\n' "$labels" | jq -e '."app.kubernetes.io/component" == "si-backup" and (."app.kubernetes.io/instance" | type) == "string"' > /dev/null || { echo "the backup CronJob of indexer-$1 carries no si-backup pod labels: $labels" >&2; return 1; }
  pod="si-probe-backup-$1-$(date +%s)"
  si_kubectl run "$pod" --restart=Never --image=busybox:1.36.1 \
    --labels="$(printf '%s\n' "$labels" | jq -r 'to_entries | map("\(.key)=\(.value)") + ["storage-integrity.sentio.xyz/probe=true"] | join(",")')" \
    --command -- sh -c "$(cat "$2")" > /dev/null || return 1
  for _ in $(seq 1 300); do
    phase="$(si_kubectl get pod "$pod" -o jsonpath='{.status.phase}')" || phase=""
    case "$phase" in Succeeded|Failed) break ;; esac
    sleep 2
  done
  si_kubectl logs "pod/$pod" || phase=unreadable
  si_kubectl delete pod "$pod" > /dev/null || { echo "could not delete owned probe pod $pod: reconcile cleanup before continuing" >&2; return 1; }
  [ "$phase" = Succeeded ] || { echo "probe pod $pod ended ${phase:-unknown}" >&2; return 1; }
}
si_net_probe() { # $1 probe matrix TSV, $2 optional from-alias: a write (ephemeral containers, throwaway pods), so every call sits in a confirmed block. Runs every row (or that alias's rows) from its source's network identity with nc -zv -w 3 and prints one TSV line per row with the live mode of its target's policy; fails on any row whose outcome differs from what that mode expects
  local tsv="$1" only="${2:-}" work al r f from ns pod rest
  [ -s "$tsv" ] || { echo "no probe matrix $tsv" >&2; return 2; }
  work="$(mktemp -d)"
  si_p4_py probe-aliases "$tsv" "$only" > "$work/aliases" || return 2
  : > "$work/resolved"
  while read -r al; do
    case "$al" in
      backup-a|backup-b|backup-c) echo "$al - - -" >> "$work/resolved" ;;
      *) r="$(si_net_alias "$al")" || return 1; echo "$al $r" >> "$work/resolved" ;;
    esac
  done < "$work/aliases"
  si_cnp_modes > "$work/modes" || return 1
  si_p4_py probe-plan "$tsv" "$work/resolved" "$work" "$only" || return 2
  : > "$work/results"
  for f in "$work"/from-*.sh; do
    [ -e "$f" ] || continue
    from="${f##*/from-}"; from="${from%.sh}"
    case "$from" in
      backup-a|backup-b|backup-c) si_net_probe_backup "${from#backup-}" "$f" >> "$work/results" || return 1 ;;
      *) read -r ns pod rest <<< "$(sed -n "s/^$from //p" "$work/resolved")"
         si_net_probe_pod "$ns" "$pod" "$f" >> "$work/results" || return 1 ;;
    esac
  done
  si_p4_py probe-judge "$tsv" "$work/results" "$work/modes" "$only"
}
# Runs inside a ClickHouse container: the interserver credentials of the running server's preprocessed config, as "user=<u> allow_empty=<v> password=<set|empty>" or "credentials=absent"; never the password.
# shellcheck disable=SC2016 # an awk program
si_interserver_awk='
/<interserver_http_credentials>/ {inb = 1}
inb && /<user>/ {u = $0; sub(/.*<user>/, "", u); sub(/<\/user>.*/, "", u)}
inb && /<allow_empty>/ {a = $0; sub(/.*<allow_empty>/, "", a); sub(/<\/allow_empty>.*/, "", a)}
inb && /<password/ {p = $0; if (p ~ /<password[^>]*\/>/) pw = "empty"; else {sub(/.*<password[^>]*>/, "", p); sub(/<\/password>.*/, "", p); pw = (length(p) > 0) ? "set" : "empty"}; p = ""}
/<\/interserver_http_credentials>/ {inb = 0; found = 1}
END {if (!found) print "credentials=absent"; else printf "user=%s allow_empty=%s password=%s\n", u, (a == "" ? "unset" : a), pw}'
si_interserver_state() { # $1 installation: per ClickHouse pod, the interserver credentials its running server loaded
  local hosts h pod s
  hosts="$(si_hosts_of "$1")" || return 2
  for h in $hosts; do
    pod="$(si_ch_pod "$h")" || return 2
    s="$(si_kubectl exec "$pod" -c clickhouse -- awk "$si_interserver_awk" /var/lib/clickhouse/preprocessed_configs/config.xml)" || return 1
    printf '%s %s\n' "$pod" "$s"
  done
}
si_fetch_errors() { # $1 installation, $2 optional UTC start 'YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss' (default 1 hour ago): replication fetch failures on its ClickHouse pods; TSV host, kind, database, table, part, tries or error code, time, first 200 characters of the message
  local hosts h since="now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR"
  [ -z "${2:-}" ] || since="toDateTime('$2', 'UTC')"
  hosts="$(si_hosts_of "$1")" || return 2
  printf 'host\tkind\tdatabase\ttable\tpart\ttries\ttime\tmessage\n'
  for h in $hosts; do
    si_ch_admin "$h" "SELECT '$h', 'queue', database, table, new_part_name, toString(num_tries), toString(last_exception_time, 'UTC'), replaceRegexpAll(substring(last_exception, 1, 200), '[\\t\\n]', ' ') FROM system.replication_queue WHERE last_exception != '' AND last_exception_time >= $since FORMAT TSV" || return 1
    si_ch_admin "$h" "SELECT '$h', 'part_log', database, table, part_name, toString(error), toString(event_time, 'UTC'), replaceRegexpAll(substring(exception, 1, 200), '[\\t\\n]', ' ') FROM system.part_log WHERE event_type = 'DownloadPart' AND error != 0 AND event_time >= $since FORMAT TSV" || return 1
  done
}
si_staging_pair() { # $1 a|b, $2 query: as default over loopback on that staging ClickHouse, the password of S3-B's staging logins piped into kubectl exec stdin
  case "$1" in a|b) ;; *) echo "usage: si_staging_pair a|b <query>" >&2; return 2 ;; esac
  si_kubectl get secret storage-integrity-si-v2-lockdown-staging-logins -o 'jsonpath={.data.default}' | base64 -d |
    si_kubectl exec -i "storage-integrity-si-v2-p4-staging-$1-source-0-0-0" -c clickhouse -- sh -c "$si_inpod_client" sh raw default "$2"
}
si_p4_manifest() { # $1 installation: the file its CHI lives in (indexer-b, indexer-c) or the overlay its chart values live in (network)
  case "$1" in
    network) echo k8s-sea/sentio-network-devnet2/storage-integrity-si-v2.yaml ;;
    indexer-b) echo k8s-sea/sentio-network-devnet2/storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-b-source.yaml ;;
    indexer-c) echo k8s-sea/sentio-network-devnet2/storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-c-source.yaml ;;
    *) echo "unknown installation $1" >&2; return 2 ;;
  esac
}
si_p4_roll() { # $1 installation, $2 evidence name under $si_backup: a write, only in a confirmed block. One restart window of the P2 runbook (§5 and §14.3 there) for HEAD, which must change exactly the installation's file and test_render.py: quiet point, render tests, push, apply (kubectl for indexer-b and indexer-c, the one-release sync for network), every ClickHouse pod of the installation replaced once and Ready, the engine-grant probe of the P2 window; writes <evidence> (HEAD), <evidence>.window and <evidence>.uids
  local inst="$1" ev="$si_backup/$2" chi file hosts h pod n src out ok u
  chi="$(si_chi_of "$inst")" || return 2
  file="$(si_p4_manifest "$inst")" || return 2
  hosts="$(si_hosts_of "$inst")" || return 2
  [ ! -e "$ev" ] || { echo "$ev exists: this window ran; never re-run it" >&2; return 1; }
  if [ "$inst" = network ]; then
    for h in a b c; do si_quiet_point "$h" || return 1; done # the network CHI holds every track's verifiers
  else
    si_quiet_point "$(si_owner_of "$inst")" || return 1
  fi
  si_head_is "$file" charts/storage-integrity/tests/test_render.py || return 1
  python3 -B charts/storage-integrity/tests/test_render.py > "$ev.render" 2>&1 || { tail -n 20 "$ev.render" >&2; return 1; }
  if [ "$inst" = network ]; then
    si_render_diff storage-integrity-si-v2 > "$ev.render-diff" || return 1
    if [ "$(cat "$ev.render-diff")" != "changed ClickHouseInstallation/storage-integrity-si-v2" ]; then
      cat "$ev.render-diff" >&2; echo "the release renders more than the CHI differently" >&2; return 1
    fi
  else
    si_kubectl apply --dry-run=server -f "$file" > /dev/null || return 1
  fi
  for h in $hosts; do
    pod="$(si_ch_pod "$h")" || return 2
    u="$(si_kubectl get pod "$pod" -o jsonpath='{.metadata.uid}')" || return 1
    [ -n "$u" ] || { echo "initial ClickHouse pod UID is empty; stop before pushing" >&2; return 1; }
    printf '%s %s\n' "$pod" "$u" || return 1
  done > "$ev.uids" || return 1
  git rev-parse HEAD > "$ev" || return 1
  echo "start $(si_stamp)" > "$ev.window"
  si_p4_commit_gate || return 1
  git push origin HEAD:main || return 1
  if [ "$inst" = network ]; then
    helmfile -f k8s-sea/sentio-network-devnet2/storage-integrity-si-v2.helmfile.yaml sync --selector name=storage-integrity-si-v2 || return 1
  else
    si_kubectl apply -f "$file" || return 1
  fi
  for n in $(seq 1 270); do
    ok=1
    while read -r pod uid; do
      # replaced means a pod of that name with another uid: an absent pod (between the old one's deletion and the
      # new one's creation) and an unreadable one are not replaced yet
      u="$(si_kubectl get pod "$pod" --ignore-not-found -o jsonpath='{.metadata.uid}')" || u=""
      case "$u" in "" | "$uid") ok="" ;; esac
    done < "$ev.uids"
    [ -n "$ok" ] && break
    sleep 10
  done
  [ -n "$ok" ] || { echo "not every ClickHouse pod of $inst was replaced within 45 minutes: read the CHI's status and the operator's log before anything else" >&2; return 1; }
  while read -r pod uid; do si_kubectl wait --for=condition=Ready "pod/$pod" --timeout=15m || return 1; done < "$ev.uids"
  si_wait_chi "$chi" || return 1
  src="$(si_owner_of "$inst")"
  if out="$(si_ch_exec "$src" si_gateway "CREATE TABLE devnet2.p2_restart_probe (x UInt8) ENGINE = ReplicatedMergeTree('/p2-restart-probe/{uuid}', 'r') ORDER BY x" 2>&1)"; then
    echo "as si_gateway the restart probe table was CREATED on $src: the engine fence is off; drop devnet2.p2_restart_probe as admin (P2 runbook §14.2) and stop" >&2
    return 1
  fi
  if ! printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q 'Code: 497' || ! printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q 'TABLE ENGINE ON ReplicatedMergeTree'; then
    printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -n 2 >&2; echo "not the 497 of the engine fence" >&2; return 1
  fi
  echo "end $(si_stamp)" >> "$ev.window"
  echo "window $2 done: $(tr '\n' ' ' < "$ev.window")"
}
si_p4_window_check() { # $1 installation, $2 evidence name of its window, $3 file name under $si_backup for its fetch failures: read-only checks after si_p4_roll; the fetch failures since the window's start (si_fetch_errors) go into that file and to stdout
  local inst="$1" ev="$si_backup/$2" fe="$si_backup/${3:?usage: si_p4_window_check <installation> <window> <fetch-errors file>}" hosts h start pod uid current uptime audit
  hosts="$(si_hosts_of "$inst")" || return 2
  [ -s "$ev.window" ] && [ -s "$ev.uids" ] || { echo "no complete window record" >&2; return 1; }
  start="$(sed -n 's/^start //p' "$ev.window")" || return 1
  [ -n "$start" ] || return 1
  while read -r pod uid; do
    current="$(si_kubectl get pod "$pod" -o jsonpath='{.metadata.uid}')" || return 1
    [ -n "$current" ] && [ -n "$uid" ] && [ "$current" != "$uid" ] || { echo "window pod was not replaced" >&2; return 1; }
    printf '%s uid %s (was %s)\n' "$pod" "$current" "$uid"
  done < "$ev.uids"
  for h in $hosts; do
    uptime="$(si_uptime "$h")" || return 1
    [ -n "$uptime" ] || return 1
    printf '%s uptime %s s; ' "$h" "$uptime"
    si_p2_stage_check "$h" member || return 1
  done
  si_interserver_state "$inst" || return 1
  audit="$(si_audit "$(si_owner_of "$inst")")" || return 1
  printf '%s\n' "$audit" | grep -E 'unclean_tables|runs_total\{trigger="clickhouse_restart"\}' || return 1
  si_fetch_errors "$inst" "$start" | tee "$fe" || return 1
  si_cnp_modes || return 1
  si_tracks | jq -ce '[.indexers[] | {id: .indexer_id, published: .published.safe_block_seq, quarantined}]' || return 1
  si_global || return 1
}
si_p4_enforce() { # $1 installation: a write, only in a confirmed block. HEAD must be its enforce commit (that one policy document in enforce mode, the two others as they are live; the policy file and test_render.py, and the probe matrix when it adds rows): render tests, push, apply, then the whole probe matrix from every pod; writes cnp-<policy>-enforce-commit (HEAD, the enforce time in RFC 3339 and in UTC, the applied state) and probe-enforce-<installation>.tsv
  local inst="$1" p q ev pf=k8s-sea/sentio-network-devnet2/storage-integrity-si-v2-network-policy.yaml tr=charts/storage-integrity/tests/test_render.py pm=charts/storage-integrity/tests/si_network_probe.tsv
  p="$(si_policy_of "$inst")" || return 2
  ev="$si_backup/cnp-$p-enforce-commit"
  [ ! -e "$ev" ] || { echo "$p was enforced already ($ev); never re-run it" >&2; return 1; }
  [ "$(si_cnp_mode "$p")" = "$p observe valid=True" ] || { echo "$p is not live in observe mode" >&2; return 1; }
  if [ -n "$(git diff --name-only HEAD~1 HEAD -- "$pm")" ]; then si_head_is "$pf" "$tr" "$pm" || return 1; else si_head_is "$pf" "$tr" || return 1; fi
  [ "$(si_p4_py mode "$p")" = "$p enforce" ] || { echo "HEAD does not enforce $p" >&2; return 1; }
  for q in storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-b-clickhouse-ingress storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-c-clickhouse-ingress storage-integrity-si-v2-clickhouse-ingress; do
    [ "$q" = "$p" ] && continue
    [ "$(si_p4_py mode "$q")" = "$(si_cnp_mode "$q" | cut -d' ' -f1,2)" ] || { echo "HEAD changes the mode of $q as well" >&2; return 1; }
  done
  python3 -B "$tr" > "$ev.render" 2>&1 || { tail -n 20 "$ev.render" >&2; return 1; }
  { git rev-parse HEAD || return 1; date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ; si_stamp; } > "$ev" || return 1
  si_p4_commit_gate || return 1
  git push origin HEAD:main || return 1
  si_cnp_apply "$p" enforce | tee -a "$ev" || return 1
  si_net_probe "$pm" > "$si_backup/probe-enforce-$inst.tsv"
}
si_p4_table() { # $1 b|c: the "<database> <table>" that owner's acceptance writes go to (indexer-b: devuser1.s3_p4 of §1.3; indexer-c: the indexer-c runbook's <db>.s3e_e2e)
  case "$1" in
    b) echo "devuser1 s3_p4" ;;
    c) printf '%s s3e_e2e\n' "$(cat "$HOME/si-devnet2-stage3-indexer-c/acceptance-db")" ;;
    *) echo "si_p4_table: the owner is b or c, not '$1'" >&2; return 2 ;;
  esac
}
si_p4_accept() { # $1 key file of devuser1's owner (- for indexer-a), $2 a|b|c, $3 value (a) or row id (b, c), $4 section tag: a write, only in a confirmed block. indexer-a: si_accept_a_track; indexer-b and indexer-c: one row (id, "p4-<tag>-<id>") into si_p4_table through devuser1's own agent (in the user's terminal), then waits for that owner's track and reads the row back in safe mode
  local db t id base n
  [[ "$3" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || { echo "usage: si_p4_accept <key-file|-> a|b|c <n> <tag>" >&2; return 2; }
  case "$2" in
    a) si_accept_a_track "$3"; return ;;
    b|c) read -r db t <<< "$(si_p4_table "$2")"; [ -n "$t" ] || return 1 ;;
    *) echo "usage: si_p4_accept <key-file|-> a|b|c <n> <tag>" >&2; return 2 ;;
  esac
  id="$(si_owner_id "$2")" || return 1
  base="$(si_track_published "$id")"
  [ -n "$base" ] || { echo "indexer $id has no track" >&2; return 1; }
  si_agent_start "$1" || return 1
  if ! printf '%s,p4-%s-%s\n' "$3" "$4" "$3" | si_agent_ch --database "$db" --query "INSERT INTO $t FORMAT CSV"; then si_agent_stop; return 1; fi
  si_wait_track "$id" "$base" || { si_agent_stop; return 1; }
  n="$(si_agent_ch --database "$db" --query "SELECT count() FROM $t WHERE id = $3 SETTINGS SQL_x_read_mode='safe'")"
  si_agent_stop
  echo "indexer-$2 row $3 in $db.$t: safe count $n"
  [ "$n" = 1 ]
}
si_p4_downloads() { # $1 b|c, $2 evidence name of a window: per verifier, how many parts of that owner's acceptance table its ClickHouse fetched (system.part_log DownloadPart without error) since the window started
  local db t start n
  read -r db t <<< "$(si_p4_table "$1")"; [ -n "$t" ] || return 2
  start="$(sed -n 's/^start //p' "$si_backup/$2.window")"
  [ -n "$start" ] || { echo "no window record $si_backup/$2.window" >&2; return 1; }
  for n in 1 2 3; do
    echo "verifier-$n downloaded $(si_verifier_ch "$n" "SELECT count() FROM system.part_log WHERE database = 'hg_unsafe' AND table = '${db}__$t' AND event_type = 'DownloadPart' AND error = 0 AND event_time >= toDateTime('$start', 'UTC')") parts of ${db}__$t since the window"
  done
}
si_p4_py() { # the census, placement, policy, probe and staging checks; imports this checkout's test_render.py
  python3 -I -B - "$@" <<'PY'
import json
import ipaddress
import os
import re
import sys

POLICY_FILE = "k8s-sea/sentio-network-devnet2/storage-integrity-si-v2-network-policy.yaml"
KEEPER_FILE = "k8s-sea/clickhouse/network-policy.yaml"
POLICIES = {
    "storage-integrity-si-v2-clickhouse-ingress": (POLICY_FILE, "sentio-network-devnet2", "storage-integrity-si-v2"),
    "storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-b-clickhouse-ingress": (POLICY_FILE, "sentio-network-devnet2", "storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-b"),
    "storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-c-clickhouse-ingress": (POLICY_FILE, "sentio-network-devnet2", "storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-c"),
    "clickhouse-keeper-extra-ingress": (KEEPER_FILE, "clickhouse", None),
}
HOST_POLICY = {"a": "storage-integrity-si-v2-clickhouse-ingress", "v1": "storage-integrity-si-v2-clickhouse-ingress", "v2": "storage-integrity-si-v2-clickhouse-ingress", "v3": "storage-integrity-si-v2-clickhouse-ingress", "b": "storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-b-clickhouse-ingress", "c": "storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-c-clickhouse-ingress"}
HOST_POD = {"a": "storage-integrity-si-v2-source-0-0-0", "v1": "storage-integrity-si-v2-verifier-1-0-0-0", "v2": "storage-integrity-si-v2-verifier-2-0-0-0", "v3": "storage-integrity-si-v2-verifier-3-0-0-0", "b": "storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-b-source-0-0-0", "c": "storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-c-source-0-0-0"}
TARGET_POLICY = {"ch-network-source": "storage-integrity-si-v2-clickhouse-ingress", "ch-verifier-1": "storage-integrity-si-v2-clickhouse-ingress", "ch-verifier-2": "storage-integrity-si-v2-clickhouse-ingress", "ch-verifier-3": "storage-integrity-si-v2-clickhouse-ingress", "ch-b": "storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-b-clickhouse-ingress", "ch-c": "storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-c-clickhouse-ingress", "keeper-0": "clickhouse-keeper-extra-ingress", "keeper-1": "clickhouse-keeper-extra-ingress", "keeper-2": "clickhouse-keeper-extra-ingress"}
PORTS = {1: "9000", 2: "8123"}
SI_CHIS = ("storage-integrity-si-v2", "storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-b", "storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-c")
STAGING = ("storage-integrity-si-v2-p4-staging-a", "storage-integrity-si-v2-p4-staging-b")
STAGING_FILE = "docs/examples/storage-integrity-p4-interserver-staging-chi.yaml"
STAGING_ROOT = "/storage-integrity/devnet2/p4-interserver-staging"
ISKEYS = ("interserver_http_credentials/user", "interserver_http_credentials/password", "interserver_http_credentials/allow_empty")


def die(msg):
    print(msg, file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)


def render():
    sys.path.insert(0, os.path.abspath("charts/storage-integrity/tests"))
    import test_render
    return test_render


def yaml_docs(path):
    import yaml
    with open(path) as f:
        return [d for d in yaml.safe_load_all(f) if d]


def policy_doc(name):
    if name not in POLICIES:
        die(f"unknown policy {name}")
    path, ns, _ = POLICIES[name]
    docs = [d for d in yaml_docs(path) if d.get("kind") == "CiliumNetworkPolicy" and d.get("metadata", {}).get("name") == name]
    if len(docs) != 1:
        die(f"{path} holds {len(docs)} CiliumNetworkPolicy documents named {name}, not one")
    doc = docs[0]
    if doc["metadata"].get("namespace") != ns:
        die(f"{name} is in namespace {doc['metadata'].get('namespace')}, not {ns}")
    return doc


def doc_mode(doc):
    dd = doc.get("spec", {}).get("enableDefaultDeny") or {}
    if type(dd.get("ingress")) is not bool:
        die("policy enableDefaultDeny.ingress must be an explicit boolean")
    return "observe" if dd["ingress"] is False else "enforce"


def check_ingress_only(name, doc):
    spec = doc.get("spec", {})
    if spec.get("egress") or spec.get("egressDeny"):
        die(f"{name} has egress rules: the P4 policies are ingress-only (K57)")
    if (spec.get("enableDefaultDeny") or {}).get("egress") is not False:
        die(f"{name} does not set enableDefaultDeny.egress: false (K57)")


def cmd_doc(args):
    name, mode, out = args
    import yaml
    doc = policy_doc(name)
    check_ingress_only(name, doc)
    if doc_mode(doc) != mode:
        die(f"{name} is in mode {doc_mode(doc)} at HEAD, not {mode}")
    with open(out, "w") as f:
        yaml.safe_dump(doc, f, sort_keys=False)
    print(f"{name} {mode} at HEAD")


def cmd_mode(args):
    doc = policy_doc(args[0])
    print(f"{args[0]} {doc_mode(doc)}")


def cmd_keeper_health(args):
    states = {}
    for line in open(args[0]):
        words = line.split()
        if not words:
            continue
        if words[0] not in ("keeper-0", "keeper-1", "keeper-2") or words[0] in states:
            die("Keeper state has an unexpected or duplicate replica")
        fields = {}
        for word in words[1:]:
            k, sep, value = word.partition("=")
            if not sep or k in fields:
                die("malformed or duplicate Keeper state field")
            fields[k] = value
        for key in ("zk_num_alive_connections", "zk_outstanding_requests"):
            if re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]+", fields.get(key, "")) is None:
                die("Keeper monitor lacks a numeric health field")
        states[words[0]] = fields
    if len(states) != 3:
        die("Keeper state does not describe all three replicas")
    leaders = [v for v in states.values() if v.get("zk_server_state") == "leader"]
    followers = [v for v in states.values() if v.get("zk_server_state") == "follower"]
    if len(leaders) != 1 or len(followers) != 2 or leaders[0].get("zk_synced_followers") != "2":
        die("Keeper ensemble lacks exactly one leader, two followers and two synced followers")
    print("Keeper quorum healthy: one leader and two synced followers")


def cmd_staging_auth(args):
    rows = [json.loads(line) for line in open(args[0]) if line.strip()]
    def measured(row):
        tries = row.get("num_tries")
        if isinstance(tries, str) and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]+", tries):
            tries = int(tries)
        message = row.get("last_exception")
        if row.get("type") != "GET_PART" or type(tries) is not int or tries <= 0 or not isinstance(message, str):
            return False
        return "Client requires HTTP Basic authentication" in message or (re.search(r"\b401\b", message) is not None and "http basic authentication" in message.lower())
    if not any(measured(row) for row in rows):
        die("no failed GET_PART contains a measured authentication refusal")
    print("staging authentication refusal verified")


def cmd_policy_live(args):
    name, path, expected_path = args
    with open(path) as f:
        live = json.load(f)
    expected = yaml_docs(expected_path)
    if len(expected) != 1:
        die("expected exactly one retained policy document")
    want = expected[0]
    md = live.get("metadata") or {}
    if live.get("apiVersion") != "cilium.io/v2" or live.get("kind") != "CiliumNetworkPolicy" or md.get("name") != name or md.get("namespace") != POLICIES[name][1]:
        die("live policy identity differs from the applied document")
    if not md.get("uid") or not md.get("resourceVersion") or type(md.get("generation")) is not int or md["generation"] < 1:
        die("live policy lacks API-server identity/version custody")
    if live.get("spec") != want.get("spec") or live.get("specs"):
        die("live policy spec differs from the exact applied policy")
    conditions = (live.get("status") or {}).get("conditions") or []
    valid = [c for c in conditions if c.get("type") == "Valid"]
    if len(valid) != 1 or valid[0].get("status") != "True":
        die("live policy has no unique Valid=True condition")
    print(f"{name} {doc_mode(live)} valid=True uid={md['uid']} generation={md['generation']} resourceVersion={md['resourceVersion']}")


def norm_key(k):
    for p in ("k8s:", "any:"):
        if k.startswith(p):
            return k[len(p):]
    return k


def selector_matches(sel, labels, ns, policy_ns):
    if not isinstance(sel, dict) or set(sel) - {"matchLabels", "matchExpressions"}:
        die("unsupported endpoint selector grammar")
    full = dict(labels or {})
    full["io.kubernetes.pod.namespace"] = ns
    named_ns = False
    for k, v in (sel.get("matchLabels") or {}).items():
        k = norm_key(k)
        named_ns = named_ns or k == "io.kubernetes.pod.namespace"
        if full.get(k) != str(v):
            return False
    for e in sel.get("matchExpressions") or []:
        k = norm_key(e["key"])
        named_ns = named_ns or k == "io.kubernetes.pod.namespace"
        vals = [str(x) for x in e.get("values") or []]
        op = e["operator"]
        if op not in ("In", "NotIn", "Exists", "DoesNotExist"):
            die(f"unsupported endpoint selector operator {op!r}")
        if op == "In" and full.get(k) not in vals:
            return False
        if op == "NotIn" and full.get(k) in vals:
            return False
        if op == "Exists" and k not in full:
            return False
        if op == "DoesNotExist" and k in full:
            return False
    return named_ns or ns == policy_ns


def port_matches(rule, port):
    tps = rule.get("toPorts")
    if not tps:
        return True
    for tp in tps:
        for p in tp.get("ports") or []:
            if str(p.get("port")) == str(port) and str(p.get("protocol", "ANY")).upper() in ("TCP", "ANY"):
                return True
    return False


def rule_matches(rule, source, port, policy_ns):
    kind, ns, labels = source
    if set(rule) - {"fromEndpoints", "fromEntities", "toPorts"}:
        die("unsupported ingress restrictions; inspect the policy rather than assuming admission")
    if any(set(tp) - {"ports"} for tp in rule.get("toPorts") or []):
        die("unsupported L7 or listener restrictions in ingress rule")
    if not port_matches(rule, port):
        return False
    ents = set(rule.get("fromEntities") or [])
    if "all" in ents:
        return True
    if kind == "pod":
        if "cluster" in ents:
            return True
        return any(selector_matches(sel, labels, ns, policy_ns) for sel in rule.get("fromEndpoints") or [])
    if kind == "node":
        # This census tuple has no source-to-destination node-locality proof.
        # Never widen host or remote-node into every node. Kubelet probes are
        # checked by target pod readiness separately.
        return "cluster" in ents
    return "world" in ents


def admits(name, source, port):
    doc = policy_doc(name)
    ns = POLICIES[name][1]
    spec = doc.get("spec", {})
    if any(rule_matches(r, source, port, ns) for r in spec.get("ingressDeny") or []):
        return False
    return any(rule_matches(r, source, port, ns) for r in spec.get("ingress") or [])


def load_pods(path):
    with open(path) as f:
        items = json.load(f)["items"]
    pods, by_ip = {}, {}
    for p in items:
        md, st = p["metadata"], p.get("status", {})
        key = (md["namespace"], md["name"])
        if key in pods:
            die(f"duplicate pod {key}")
        pods[key] = p
        if not p.get("spec", {}).get("hostNetwork") and st.get("podIP"):
            if st["podIP"] in by_ip:
                die(f"duplicate pod IP {st['podIP']}")
            by_ip[st["podIP"]] = key
    return pods, by_ip


def plain_ip(addr):
    return addr[7:] if addr.startswith("::ffff:") else addr


def cmd_attribute(args):
    host, rows_path, pods_path = args
    pods, by_ip = load_pods(pods_path)
    by_name = {}
    for (ns, name) in pods:
        by_name.setdefault(name, []).append(ns)
    port_of = lambda i: PORTS.get(int(i), f"iface{i}")
    with open(rows_path) as f:
        for line in f:
            if not line.strip():
                continue
            r = json.loads(line)
            ip = plain_ip(r["address"])
            client = r.get("client_hostname") or r.get("http_user_agent") or ""
            ns = pod = "-"
            if ip in ("::1", "127.0.0.1"):
                how = "loopback"
            elif ip in by_ip:
                ns, pod = by_ip[ip]
                started = pods[(ns, pod)].get("status", {}).get("startTime", "")
                first = r["first"].replace(" ", "T") + "Z"
                how = "address" if started and started <= first else "unattributed"
                if how == "unattributed":
                    ns = pod = "-"
            else:
                how = "unattributed"
            print("\t".join([host, port_of(r["interface"]), r["user"], ip, client.replace("\t", " "), ns, pod, str(r["queries"]), r["first"], r["last"], how]))


def cmd_cons(args):
    keeper, cons_path, pods_path, nodes_path = args
    pods, by_ip = load_pods(pods_path)
    with open(nodes_path) as f:
        nodes = {a["address"]: n["metadata"]["name"] for n in json.load(f)["items"] for a in n.get("status", {}).get("addresses", []) if a.get("type") == "InternalIP"}
    pat = re.compile(r"^\s*/?\[?([0-9A-Fa-f:.]+?)\]?:([0-9]+)\(")
    count = 0
    for line in open(cons_path):
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        m = pat.match(line)
        if not m:
            die("Keeper cons returned an unrecognized nonempty line; retain evidence and stop")
        count += 1
        ip = plain_ip(m.group(1))
        if ip in by_ip:
            ns, pod = by_ip[ip]
        elif ip in nodes:
            ns, pod = "node", nodes[ip]
        elif ip in ("127.0.0.1", "::1"):
            ns, pod = "loopback", keeper
        else:
            ns, pod = "-", "-"
        print("\t".join([keeper, ip, m.group(2), ns, pod]))
    if not count:
        die("Keeper cons returned no client rows; stop rather than claiming an empty healthy census")


def cmd_scrapes(args):
    targets_path, pods_path = args
    pods, by_ip = load_pods(pods_path)
    with open(targets_path) as f:
        active = json.load(f)["data"]["activeTargets"]
    scrapers = sorted(f"{ns}/{name}" for (ns, name), p in pods.items() if ns == "monitoring" and (p["metadata"].get("labels") or {}).get("app.kubernetes.io/name") == "vmagent")
    for t in active:
        addr = (t.get("discoveredLabels") or {}).get("__address__") or (t.get("labels") or {}).get("instance", "")
        ip, _, port = addr.rpartition(":")
        key = by_ip.get(ip.strip("[]"))
        if not key:
            continue
        ns, pod = key
        labels = pods[key]["metadata"].get("labels") or {}
        if not (labels.get("clickhouse.altinity.com/chi") in SI_CHIS or labels.get("clickhouse-keeper.altinity.com/chk") == "clickhouse-keeper-extra"):
            continue
        print("\t".join([ns, pod, port, t.get("scrapePool", "-"), t.get("health", "-"), ",".join(scrapers) or "-"]))


def replica_pod(host):
    host = host.split(".")[0]
    m = re.fullmatch(r"(.+)-replica-0", host)
    return f"{m.group(1)}-0-0-0" if m else None


def pod_host(pod):
    for h, p in HOST_POD.items():
        if p == pod:
            return h
    return None


def cmd_split_interserver(args):
    all_path, out_dir = args
    rows = [l.rstrip("\n").split("\t") for l in open(all_path) if l.strip()]
    inst_of = {"a": "network", "v1": "network", "v2": "network", "v3": "network", "b": "indexer-b", "c": "indexer-c"}
    outs = {i: open(os.path.join(out_dir, f"census-interserver-{i}.tsv"), "w") for i in ("network", "indexer-b", "indexer-c")}
    for o in outs.values():
        o.write("table\treplica\thost\tport\tactive\n")
    for r in rows:
        if len(r) != 5:
            die(f"malformed replica row {r}")
        h = pod_host(replica_pod(r[2]) or "")
        if h is None:
            die(f"replica {r[1]} of {r[0]} advertises host {r[2]}, which is no SI ClickHouse")
        outs[inst_of[h]].write("\t".join(r) + "\n")
    for o in outs.values():
        o.close()


def tsv(path):
    lines = [l.rstrip("\n").split("\t") for l in open(path) if l.strip()]
    return lines[0], lines[1:]


def cmd_census_check(args):
    target = None
    if args[:1] == ["--policy"]:
        if len(args) < 3 or args[1] not in POLICIES:
            die("census --policy requires an exact reviewed policy name and source files")
        target, args = args[1], args[2:]
    out, bad = [], 0
    pods = {}
    for path in args:
        base = os.path.basename(path)
        if base.startswith("pods-census-"):
            pods.update(load_pods(path)[0])
    def source_of(ns, pod):
        if ns == "node":
            return ("node", None, {})
        p = pods.get((ns, pod))
        return ("pod", ns, (p["metadata"].get("labels") or {}) if p else None)
    interserver = []
    for path in args:
        base = os.path.basename(path)
        if base.startswith("pods-census-"):
            continue
        if base.startswith("census-clickhouse-"):
            head, rows = tsv(path)
            for r in rows:
                host, port, user, ip, client, ns, pod, _, _, last, how = r
                if target and HOST_POLICY[host] != target:
                    continue
                flow = f"{ns}/{pod} ({user}, {client or ip}) -> {HOST_POD[host]}:{port}"
                if how == "loopback":
                    out.append(f"loopback {flow}")
                    continue
                if how == "unattributed":
                    out.append(f"unattributed {ip} ({user}, {client or '-'}) -> {HOST_POD[host]}:{port}, last {last}")
                    bad += 1
                    continue
                src = source_of(ns, pod)
                if src[2] is None:
                    out.append(f"unattributed {flow}: the pod is gone from the snapshot")
                    bad += 1
                    continue
                ok = admits(HOST_POLICY[host], src, port)
                out.append(("admitted " if ok else "UNCOVERED ") + flow)
                bad += 0 if ok else 1
        elif base.startswith("census-interserver-"):
            interserver += tsv(path)[1]
        elif base.startswith("census-scrape"):
            for r in tsv(path)[1]:
                ns, pod, port, pool, _, scrapers = r
                target_host = pod_host(pod)
                policy = HOST_POLICY[target_host] if target_host else "clickhouse-keeper-extra-ingress"
                if target and policy != target:
                    continue
                for s in scrapers.split(","):
                    sns, spod = s.split("/", 1)
                    src = source_of(sns, spod)
                    if src[2] is None:
                        out.append(f"unattributed scraper {s} of {ns}/{pod}:{port}")
                        bad += 1
                        continue
                    ok = admits(policy, src, port)
                    out.append(("admitted " if ok else "UNCOVERED ") + f"{s} (scrape {pool}) -> {pod}:{port}")
                    bad += 0 if ok else 1
        elif base.startswith("census-keeper-"):
            if target and target != "clickhouse-keeper-extra-ingress":
                continue
            for r in tsv(path)[1]:
                keeper, ip, _, ns, pod = r
                if ns == "loopback":
                    continue
                if ns == "-":
                    out.append(f"unattributed {ip} -> {keeper}:2181 ({base})")
                    bad += 1
                    continue
                src = source_of(ns, pod)
                if src[2] is None:
                    out.append(f"unattributed {ns}/{pod} -> {keeper}:2181 ({base}): the pod is gone from the snapshot")
                    bad += 1
                    continue
                ok = admits("clickhouse-keeper-extra-ingress", src, "2181")
                out.append(("admitted " if ok else "UNCOVERED ") + f"{ns}/{pod} -> {keeper}:2181")
                bad += 0 if ok else 1
        else:
            die(f"unknown census file {path}")
    by_table = {}
    for r in interserver:
        by_table.setdefault(r[0], []).append(r)
    for table, reps in sorted(by_table.items()):
        for fetcher in reps:
            for server in reps:
                if fetcher is server:
                    continue
                fpod, spod = replica_pod(fetcher[2]), replica_pod(server[2])
                if target and HOST_POLICY[pod_host(spod)] != target:
                    continue
                src = source_of("sentio-network-devnet2", fpod)
                if src[2] is None:
                    out.append(f"unattributed fetcher {fetcher[1]} ({fpod}) of {table}")
                    bad += 1
                    continue
                ok = admits(HOST_POLICY[pod_host(spod)], src, server[3])
                out.append(("admitted " if ok else "UNCOVERED ") + f"{fpod} (replica {fetcher[1]}) -> {spod}:{server[3]} ({table})")
                bad += 0 if ok else 1
    if target and not out:
        die("targeted census has no observed flows; reconcile evidence instead of certifying silence")
    for line in sorted(set(out)):
        print(line)
    print(f"census: {sum(1 for l in set(out) if l.startswith('admitted'))} admitted, {bad} uncovered or unattributed")
    sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)


def node_of_pv(pv):
    for term in (((pv.get("spec") or {}).get("nodeAffinity") or {}).get("required") or {}).get("nodeSelectorTerms") or []:
        for e in term.get("matchExpressions") or []:
            if e.get("key") == "kubernetes.io/hostname" and e.get("values"):
                return e["values"][0]
    return "-"


def cmd_placement(args):
    pods_path, pvcs_path, pvs_path, eligible_path, out_path = args
    t = render()
    eligible = sorted(l.strip() for l in open(eligible_path) if l.strip())
    with open(pvcs_path) as f:
        claims = {c["metadata"]["name"]: c["spec"].get("volumeName") for c in json.load(f)["items"]}
    with open(pvs_path) as f:
        pv_node = {p["metadata"]["name"]: node_of_pv(p) for p in json.load(f)["items"]}
    rows = []
    with open(pods_path) as f:
        for p in json.load(f)["items"]:
            labels = p["metadata"].get("labels") or {}
            chi, cluster = labels.get("clickhouse.altinity.com/chi"), labels.get("clickhouse.altinity.com/cluster")
            if chi not in SI_CHIS:
                continue
            name = p["metadata"]["name"]
            role = "source" if cluster == "source" else "verifier"
            vol = pv_node.get(claims.get(f"data-volume-claim-{name}"), "-")
            pin = t.DEVNET2_NODE_PINS.get((chi, cluster))
            rows.append((chi, cluster, role, name, p["spec"].get("nodeName") or "-", vol, pin or "-"))
    rows.sort()
    with open(out_path, "w") as f:
        f.write("installation\tcluster\trole\tpod\tnode\tpv_node\tpin\n")
        for r in rows:
            f.write("\t".join(r) + "\n")
    verdict = []
    stop = False
    want = sorted(t.DEVNET2_SI_ELIGIBLE_NODES)
    print(f"verdict eligible {len(eligible)}: {' '.join(eligible)}")
    if eligible != want:
        verdict.append(f"STOP eligible nodes differ from DEVNET2_SI_ELIGIBLE_NODES ({' '.join(want)})")
        stop = True
    if len(rows) != 6:
        verdict.append(f"STOP {len(rows)} SI ClickHouse pods, not six")
        stop = True
    for r in rows:
        if r[4] != r[5]:
            verdict.append(f"STOP {r[3]} runs on {r[4]} but its data volume is on {r[5]}")
            stop = True
        if r[4] not in eligible:
            verdict.append(f"STOP {r[3]} runs on {r[4]}, which is not an eligible node")
            stop = True
        recorded = t.DEVNET2_CLICKHOUSE_NODES.get((r[0], r[1]))
        if recorded != r[4] and r[6] != r[4]:
            verdict.append(f"drift {r[0]}/{r[1]} runs on {r[4]}; DEVNET2_CLICKHOUSE_NODES records {recorded} and no pin names {r[4]}")
        if r[6] != "-" and r[6] != r[4]:
            verdict.append(f"STOP {r[0]}/{r[1]} is pinned to {r[6]} but runs on {r[4]}")
            stop = True
    if len(eligible) < 4:
        verdict.append("STOP devnet2 has fewer than four eligible nodes: no placement keeps every verifier off every source (D39); stop")
        stop = True
    sources = [r for r in rows if r[2] == "source"]
    verifiers = sorted((r for r in rows if r[2] == "verifier"), key=lambda r: r[1])
    source_nodes = {r[4] for r in sources}
    if len(source_nodes) != len(sources):
        verdict.append(f"STOP two sources share a node: {' '.join(f'{r[0]}={r[4]}' for r in sources)}")
        stop = True
    if not [n for n in eligible if n not in source_nodes]:
        verdict.append("STOP every eligible node holds a source")
        stop = True
    distinct = len(eligible) >= 6
    # The verifiers that move (D39): every one on a source's node; with at least six eligible nodes also every
    # one but the first on a node another verifier holds.
    moving, staying = [], {}
    for v in verifiers:
        if v[4] in source_nodes:
            moving.append((v, f"{v[4]} holds a source"))
        elif distinct and v[4] in staying:
            moving.append((v, f"{v[4]} holds {staying[v[4]]} too"))
        else:
            staying.setdefault(v[4], v[1])
    held = {r[4] for r in rows}
    final = [v[4] for v in verifiers if v[4] in staying and staying[v[4]] == v[1] or (not distinct and v[4] not in source_nodes)]
    for v, why in moving:
        # an eligible node without a source; with six eligible nodes or more one that no SI ClickHouse holds
        # and no earlier move takes, else preferring such a node
        busy = held | set(final)
        cands = sorted((n for n in eligible if n not in source_nodes and (not distinct or n not in busy)), key=lambda n: (n in busy, n))
        if not cands:
            verdict.append(f"STOP no eligible node can take {v[1]} (D39)")
            stop = True
            continue
        verdict.append(f"MOVE {v[1]} from {v[4]} ({why}) to {cands[0]} (candidates {' '.join(cands)})")
        final.append(cands[0])
    for node in sorted(set(final)):
        if final.count(node) > 1:
            verdict.append(f"SHARE {final.count(node)} verifier ClickHouses on {node} (D39: devnet2 has {len(eligible)} eligible nodes, fewer than six)")
    for v in verdict:
        print(f"verdict {v}")
    print("verdict placement " + ("STOP" if stop else "needs §5.0" if moving else "ok"))
    sys.exit(1 if stop else 0)


def cmd_domains(args):
    placement, c_id = args
    head, rows = tsv(placement)
    owner = {"storage-integrity-si-v2": 0, "storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-b": 1, "storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-c": int(c_id)}
    doms = sorted((owner[r[0]], r[4]) for r in rows if r[2] == "source")
    if [d[0] for d in doms] != sorted(owner.values()):
        die(f"placement.tsv does not hold one source per SI indexer: {doms}")
    print("DEVNET2_FAILURE_DOMAINS=" + ",".join(f"{i}=node:{n}" for i, n in doms))


def matrix(path):
    rows = []
    seen = set()
    for n, line in enumerate(l for l in open(path) if l.strip() and not l.startswith("#")):
        cols = line.rstrip("\n").split("\t")
        if cols[:4] == ["from", "to", "port", "expect"]:
            continue
        if len(cols) != 4 or cols[3] not in ("open", "refused") or any(re.fullmatch(r"[a-z][a-z0-9-]*", v) is None for v in cols[:2]) or re.fullmatch(r"[1-9][0-9]*", cols[2]) is None or not 1 <= int(cols[2]) <= 65535:
            die("malformed probe row or unsafe alias/port")
        if tuple(cols[:3]) in seen:
            die("duplicate probe flow")
        seen.add(tuple(cols[:3]))
        rows.append((len(rows) + 1, cols[0], cols[1], cols[2], cols[3]))
    if not rows:
        die(f"{path} has no rows")
    return rows


def cmd_probe_aliases(args):
    path, only = args[0], (args[1] if len(args) > 1 else "")
    names = set()
    for _, frm, to, _, _ in matrix(path):
        if only and frm != only:
            continue
        names.add(frm)
        names.add(to)
    for a in sorted(names):
        print(a)


def cmd_probe_plan(args):
    path, resolved, work = args[0], args[1], args[2]
    only = args[3] if len(args) > 3 else ""
    ip = {}
    for line in open(resolved):
        alias, ns, pod, addr = line.split()
        ip[alias] = addr
    scripts = {}
    for n, frm, to, port, _ in matrix(path):
        if only and frm != only:
            continue
        if to.startswith("backup-"):
            die(f"row {n}: {to} cannot be a probe target")
        try:
            address = ipaddress.ip_address(ip.get(to, ""))
        except ValueError:
            die(f"row {n}: target {to} has no valid pod IP")
        if address.version != 4:
            die("this reviewed probe command requires an IPv4 pod address; reconcile an IPv6 transition explicitly")
        scripts.setdefault(frm, []).append(f"r {n} {ip[to]} {port}")
    for frm, lines in scripts.items():
        with open(os.path.join(work, f"from-{frm}.sh"), "w") as f:
            f.write('r() { if nc -zv -w 3 "$2" "$3" > /dev/null 2>&1; then echo "$1 open"; else echo "$1 refused"; fi; }\n')
            f.write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")


def cmd_probe_judge(args):
    path, results, modes = args[0], args[1], args[2]
    only = args[3] if len(args) > 3 else ""
    got = {}
    for line in open(results):
        parts = line.split()
        if not parts:
            continue
        if len(parts) != 2 or not parts[0].isdigit() or parts[1] not in ("open", "refused") or int(parts[0]) in got:
            die("malformed or duplicate probe result")
        got[int(parts[0])] = parts[1]
    mode = {}
    for line in open(modes):
        parts = line.split()
        if len(parts) < 2 or parts[0] not in POLICIES or parts[0] in mode or parts[1] not in ("observe", "enforce", "absent"):
            die("malformed, unknown or duplicate policy mode")
        if (parts[1] == "absent" and len(parts) != 2) or (parts[1] != "absent" and (len(parts) != 3 or parts[2] != "valid=True")):
            die("probe target policy is not uniquely valid; stop before judging admission")
        mode[parts[0]] = parts[1]
    print("row\tfrom\tto\tport\texpect\tgot\tmode\tverdict")
    bad = n_rows = 0
    expected_rows = {n for n, frm, _, _, _ in matrix(path) if not only or frm == only}
    if set(got) != expected_rows:
        die("probe result roster differs from the requested matrix rows")
    for n, frm, to, port, expect in matrix(path):
        if only and frm != only:
            continue
        n_rows += 1
        pol = TARGET_POLICY.get(to)
        m = "none" if pol is None else mode.get(pol, "absent")
        g = got.get(n, "missing")
        if g not in ("open", "refused"):
            verdict = "FAIL"
        elif m in ("enforce", "none"):
            verdict = "ok" if g == expect else "FAIL"
        elif expect == "open":
            verdict = "ok" if g == "open" else "FAIL"
        else:
            verdict = "unjudged"
        bad += verdict == "FAIL"
        print("\t".join([str(n), frm, to, port, expect, g, m, verdict]))
    print(f"probe: {n_rows} rows, {bad} failed", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)


def staging_chis():
    docs = yaml_docs(STAGING_FILE)
    chis = {d["metadata"]["name"]: d for d in docs if d.get("kind") == "ClickHouseInstallation"}
    if sorted(chis) != sorted(STAGING):
        die(f"{STAGING_FILE} holds {sorted(chis)}, not {list(STAGING)}")
    return chis


def staging_ref(chis, t):
    refs = []
    for name in STAGING:
        v = (chis[name]["spec"]["configuration"].get("settings") or {}).get(ISKEYS[1])
        if isinstance(v, dict) and isinstance(v.get("valueFrom"), dict):
            refs.append(v["valueFrom"].get("secretKeyRef"))
    if any(r != refs[0] for r in refs) or (refs and not (isinstance(refs[0], dict) and refs[0].get("name") and refs[0].get("key"))):
        die(f"{STAGING_FILE} names more than one or a malformed interserver password Secret: {refs}")
    return dict(refs[0]) if refs else {"name": t.SI_INTERSERVER_SECRET, "key": "password"}


def cmd_staging_secret(args):
    ref = staging_ref(staging_chis(), render())
    print(ref["name"], ref["key"])


def cmd_staging(args):
    a_mode, b_mode, out = args
    import yaml
    t = render()
    chis = staging_chis()
    ref = staging_ref(chis, t)
    for name, mode in zip(STAGING, (a_mode, b_mode)):
        conf = chis[name]["spec"]["configuration"]
        if conf.get("zookeeper", {}).get("root") != STAGING_ROOT:
            die(f"{name} does not use the Keeper root {STAGING_ROOT}")
        settings = conf.setdefault("settings", {})
        for k in ISKEYS:
            settings.pop(k, None)
        if mode == "none":
            continue
        if mode not in ("empty", "strict"):
            die(f"unknown staging mode {mode} (none|empty|strict)")
        settings[ISKEYS[0]] = t.SI_INTERSERVER_USER
        settings[ISKEYS[1]] = {"valueFrom": {"secretKeyRef": dict(ref)}}
        settings[ISKEYS[2]] = "true" if mode == "empty" else "false"
    with open(out, "w") as f:
        yaml.safe_dump_all([chis[n] for n in STAGING], f, sort_keys=False)
    print(f"{out}: {STAGING[0]} {a_mode}, {STAGING[1]} {b_mode}; password from Secret {ref['name']} key {ref['key']}")


def cmd_drops(args):
    for line in open(args[0]):
        line = line.strip()
        if not line:
            continue
        if not line.startswith("{"):
            die("unrecognized non-JSON Hubble output; observation is not healthy silence")
        message = json.loads(line)
        flow = message.get("flow") if isinstance(message, dict) else None
        if not isinstance(flow, dict) or not isinstance(flow.get("verdict"), str):
            die("Hubble returned a non-flow or incomplete observation, including a possible lost-event notice")
        if flow.get("verdict") != "DROPPED" or flow.get("drop_reason_desc") != "POLICY_DENIED":
            continue
        dst, src = flow.get("destination") or {}, flow.get("source") or {}
        dpod, dns = dst.get("pod_name", ""), dst.get("namespace", "")
        if not ((dns == "sentio-network-devnet2" and dpod.startswith("storage-integrity-si-v2-")) or (dns == "clickhouse" and dpod.startswith("clickhouse-keeper-extra-"))):
            continue
        l4 = flow.get("l4") or {}
        port = (l4.get("TCP") or l4.get("UDP") or {}).get("destination_port", "-")
        source = f"{src.get('namespace')}/{src.get('pod_name')}" if src.get("pod_name") else (flow.get("IP") or {}).get("source", "-")
        print("\t".join([flow.get("time", "-"), source, f"{dns}/{dpod}", str(port), flow.get("drop_reason_desc", "-")]))


COMMANDS = {"keeper-health": cmd_keeper_health, "staging-auth": cmd_staging_auth, "policy-live": cmd_policy_live, "staging-secret": cmd_staging_secret, "doc": cmd_doc, "mode": cmd_mode, "attribute": cmd_attribute, "cons": cmd_cons, "scrapes": cmd_scrapes, "split-interserver": cmd_split_interserver, "census-check": cmd_census_check, "placement": cmd_placement, "domains": cmd_domains, "probe-aliases": cmd_probe_aliases, "probe-plan": cmd_probe_plan, "probe-judge": cmd_probe_judge, "staging": cmd_staging, "drops": cmd_drops}
if len(sys.argv) < 2 or sys.argv[1] not in COMMANDS:
    die("usage: si_p4_py " + "|".join(COMMANDS) + " ...")
COMMANDS[sys.argv[1]](sys.argv[2:])
PY
}
```

`si_p4_py` evaluates a CiliumNetworkPolicy itself, so every check reads the document the checkout holds, never a summary of it: a flow is admitted when an `ingress` rule's `toPorts` lists its port (TCP or ANY, or no `toPorts`) and one of its `fromEndpoints` selectors matches the source pod's labels and namespace (`k8s:io.kubernetes.pod.namespace`; without it, the policy's own namespace), or its `fromEntities` holds `all`, `cluster` (any pod) ; `host` and `remote-node` are not inferred from an arbitrary node address without source-to-destination locality proof (the separate kubelet-probe gate is pod readiness); an `ingressDeny` rule that matches refuses it. A live policy is in observe mode when `enableDefaultDeny.ingress` is `false` and in enforce mode otherwise (Cilium's default for a policy with ingress rules); `si_p4_py doc` refuses a document with egress rules or without `enableDefaultDeny.egress: false` (K57: ingress-only). The census attributes a `query_log` client only by its source IP, when the current non-hostNetwork pod holding that IP was already running at the client's first query. A client-supplied hostname is descriptive and never grants an identity; anything else is `unattributed`, as is a pod gone from the snapshot. A probe row is judged by the live mode of its target's policy: with the target in enforce mode, or with no P4 policy on the target, the row must match its `expect` column; in observe mode (or before the policy exists) an `open` row must be open and a `refused` row is recorded as `unjudged`, because nothing is denied yet. `si_net_probe` runs each source pod's rows in one ephemeral container (`kubectl debug`, `busybox:1.36.1`, `nc -zv -w 3` against the target pod's IP), which shares the pod's network namespace and therefore its Cilium identity; the backup CronJob's pods exist only while a backup runs, so its rows run from a throwaway pod with that CronJob's pod labels, which no Service selects (the host Services select `app.kubernetes.io/component: node`). `si_cnp_drops` reads the flows the Cilium agent of every node that runs an SI ClickHouse or a Keeper replica dropped with `POLICY_DENIED`; each agent's Hubble ring holds only the latest flows of its node, so it proves a recent drop, never the absence of an old one. `si_p4_roll` is one restart window: it refuses a second run of the same window (its evidence file exists), checks the quiet point (`si_quiet_point` of the installation's owner; for the network CHI that covers every track), that HEAD is one commit on `origin/main` changing exactly the installation's file and `test_render.py`, the render tests, the render difference (only the network CHI for `network`) or a server-side dry run, then pushes, applies, waits until every ClickHouse pod of the installation was replaced and is Ready and the CHI is `Completed`, and runs the P2 window's engine-fence probe (as `si_gateway`, a `ReplicatedMergeTree` refused with 497 naming `TABLE ENGINE ON ReplicatedMergeTree`).

SN_COMMIT_P3='<SN_COMMIT_P3>'; SN_DIGEST_P3='<SN_DIGEST_P3>'; ARBITER_TAG='<ARBITER_TAG>'; ARBITER_DIGEST='<ARBITER_DIGEST>'

### 1.3 Promotion budget

The P2 runbook's budget (Plan S3-B's P0 runbook §13.4 as fixed in housegate#237): the leader's newest finished snapshot is copied and checked against its metadata, its state length and `promotion_seq` are read from the container, and the live sequence is read afterwards and subtracted. Read-only:

```bash

Expected: one budget line whose `a drill spends at most <n>` is at least 18 (this runbook's writes, every one a single-partition promotion; §5.0 checks its own 3 per move again). Less: stop; the hardening waits until the state can carry it. This output authorizes no later operation after the seven-day census or a pause: it describes only the captured snapshot/live-sequence pair. Task 55 adds a fresh capture after the census and before every acceptance batch, preserving each finished Size/CRC-checked archive and live sequence separately and checking the complete remaining obligation (18 plus three per pending MOVE, minus only strictly completed cost receipts). Do not reuse this initial line, reduce the obligation to one batch, or infer completion from an ambiguous attempt; stop for reconciliation instead. The estimator and L/4 threshold remain unchanged.
````
