```bash
if not placement or placement[0] != "installation\tcluster\trole\tpod\tnode\tpv_node\tpin":
    sys.exit("placement has no exact seven-field header: stop")
rows = [r.split("\t") for r in placement[1:] if r.strip()]
expected = {(chis[0], "source"), (chis[1], "source"), (chis[c_id], "source")} | {(chis[0], f"verifier-{i}") for i in (1, 2, 3)}
if len(rows) != 6 or any(len(r) != 7 for r in rows) or {(r[0], r[1]) for r in rows} != expected:
    sys.exit("placement must hold exactly the six distinct SI ClickHouses: stop")
if len({r[3] for r in rows}) != 6 or any(not r[3] or r[3] == "-" for r in rows):
    sys.exit("placement has missing or duplicate pod identities: stop")
eligible = [l.strip() for l in open(eligible_file) if l.strip()]
if not eligible or len(eligible) != len(set(eligible)) or set(eligible) != set(t.DEVNET2_SI_ELIGIBLE_NODES):
    sys.exit("eligible-node inventory differs from the reviewed constants: stop")
for r in rows:
    if r[2] != ("source" if r[1] == "source" else "verifier") or r[4] not in eligible or r[5] != r[4]:
        bad.append(f"invalid role, ineligible node or PV-node mismatch for {r[3]}")
sources = [r[4] for r in rows if r[2] == "source"]
verifiers = [r[4] for r in rows if r[2] == "verifier"]
if len(set(sources)) != 3 or set(sources) & set(verifiers) or (len(eligible) >= 6 and len(set(verifiers)) != 3):
    bad.append("placement violates D39 source/verifier failure domains")
for l in lines:
    if not l.startswith("verdict "):
        continue
    words = l.split()
    if words[1] in ("STOP", "MOVE"):
        bad.append(l)
    elif words[1] == "drift":
        bad.append(f"{l} (every SI ClickHouse is pinned by now, and a pod on its pin prints no drift line)")
    elif words[1] == "SHARE" and len(eligible) >= 6:
        bad.append(f"{l} (devnet2 has {len(eligible)} eligible nodes)")
if "verdict placement ok" not in lines:
    bad.append("no 'verdict placement ok' line")
for r in rows:
    if t.DEVNET2_NODE_PINS.get((r[0], r[1])) != r[4] or r[6] != r[4]:
        bad.append(f"{r[3]} runs on {r[4]} with pin {r[6]}; DEVNET2_NODE_PINS says {t.DEVNET2_NODE_PINS.get((r[0], r[1]))}")
print("\n".join(bad) or f"failure domains {value}: the source pins at HEAD, every SI ClickHouse on its pin, D39 verdict ok")
sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
PY
}
p4_end_check() { # $1 hardening-end.txt of runbook §11: read-only; one well-formed line per produced ledger name
  python3 -I - "$1" "$(si_indexer_c_id)" <<'PY'
import re
import sys
import datetime

text = open(sys.argv[1]).read().split("\n")
forms = {
    "INTERSERVER_STEP1_END": r"20[0-9]{2}-[01][0-9]-[0-3][0-9]",
    "INTERSERVER_STEP2_END": r"20[0-9]{2}-[01][0-9]-[0-3][0-9]",
    "DEVNET2_FAILURE_DOMAINS": r"0=node:sea-[a-z]+-[0-9]+,1=node:sea-[a-z]+-[0-9]+,%s=node:sea-[a-z]+-[0-9]+" % sys.argv[2],
    "HARDENING_END": r"20[0-9]{2}-[01][0-9]-[0-3][0-9]",
}
bad, values = [], {}
for name, form in forms.items():
    found = [l.split("=", 1)[1] for l in text if l.startswith(name + "=")]
    if len(found) != 1 or not re.fullmatch(form, found[0]):
        bad.append(f"{name}: {found or 'missing'}")
    else:
        values[name] = found[0]
        if name.endswith("_END"):
            try: datetime.date.fromisoformat(found[0])
            except ValueError: bad.append(f"{name}: invalid calendar date {found[0]}")
if not bad and not values["INTERSERVER_STEP1_END"] <= values["INTERSERVER_STEP2_END"] <= values["HARDENING_END"]:
    bad.append("the dates are not in the order step 1, step 2, end")
if not any(re.fullmatch(r"exit probe rows ok: [1-9][0-9]*", l) for l in text):
    bad.append("no exit probe count")
print("\n".join(bad) or "hardening-end.txt: " + ", ".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in values.items()))
sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
PY
}
p4_record_gate() { # local evidence only: do not turn missing staging/watch/exit/completion into success prose
  local work f remaining head dirty
  cd "$P" || return 1
  head="$(git -C "$P" rev-parse HEAD)" || return 1
  dirty="$(git -C "$P" status --porcelain)" || return 1
  [ -z "$dirty" ] || return 1
  python3 -I -B "$p4_tools/p4-budget.py" verify-end "$si_backup" "$head" || return 1
  remaining="$(python3 -I -B "$p4_tools/p4-budget.py" required "$si_backup" complete)" || return 1
  [ "$remaining" = 0 ] || { echo "not every planned acceptance block has a complete cost receipt: stop"; return 1; }
  work="$(mktemp -d "$si_backup/record-check.XXXXXX")" || return 1
  p4_census_window > "$work/census-window.txt" || return 1
  p4_census_gate census-check.txt > "$work/census.txt" || return 1
  for f in indexer-b indexer-c network; do
    p4_census_gate "census-check-enforce-$f.txt" > "$work/census-$f.txt" || return 1
  done
  p4_census_gate keeper-census-enforce.txt > "$work/census-keeper.txt" || return 1
  p4_domains_check "$si_backup/failure-domains.txt" "$si_backup/placement-final.tsv" > "$work/domains.txt" || return 1
  p4_end_check "$si_backup/hardening-end.txt" > "$work/end.txt" || return 1
  python3 -I -B - "$si_backup" "$work" <<'PYRECORD'
import datetime,json,re,sys
from pathlib import Path
base,work=map(Path,sys.argv[1:])
def fail(message):sys.exit("p4_record_gate: "+message+"; nothing recorded")
def read(name):
    p=base/name
    if not p.is_file()or p.is_symlink()or not p.stat().st_size:fail("missing/unsafe/empty evidence "+name)
    return p.read_text()
required=["staging-pair.txt","staging-mixed.txt","staging-step2.txt","keeper-watch.txt","probe-exit.tsv","exit-state.txt","budget-start.txt","budget-end.txt","keeper-enforce-pr"]
for inst in ("indexer-b","indexer-c","network"):
    required += [f"probe-enforce-{inst}.tsv",f"cnp-drops-{inst}.tsv"]
    for step in (1,2):
        required += [f"window-{inst}-step{step}.txt",f"interserver-step{step}-{inst}-commit",f"interserver-step{step}-{inst}-commit.window",f"interserver-step{step}-{inst}-commit.uids"]
for name in required:read(name)
for phase,want in [("mixed",[("b","1"),("a","1")]),("step2",[("a","2"),("b","2"),("a","4"),("b","4"),("a","5"),("b","4")])]:
    text=read(f"staging-{phase}.txt")
    got=re.findall(r"^staging ([ab]) count ([0-9]+)$",text,re.M)
    if got!=want or text.splitlines().count("staging authentication refusal verified")!=1:
        fail("staging count/authentication proof differs from the frozen producer "+phase)
pr=read("keeper-enforce-pr").splitlines()
if len([s for s in pr if re.fullmatch(r"https://github.com/sentioxyz/production/pull/[1-9][0-9]*",s)])!=1 or len([s for s in pr if re.fullmatch(r"MERGED [0-9a-f]{40}",s)])!=1:
    fail("Keeper PR/merge identity is incomplete")
for inst in ("indexer-b","indexer-c","network"):
    names=[f"interserver-step{k}-{inst}-commit"for k in(1,2)]
    policy="storage-integrity-si-v2"+("" if inst=="network" else "-"+inst)+"-clickhouse-ingress"
    names.append("cnp-"+policy+"-enforce-commit")
    for name in names:
        if re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}",read(name).splitlines()[0])is None:fail("invalid commit receipt "+name)
watch=read("keeper-watch.txt").splitlines()
if not watch or watch[-1]!="keeper enforce held for 30 minutes"or any("ABORT"in s for s in watch):fail("Keeper watch did not complete cleanly")
starts=[s for s in watch if s.startswith("apply ")]
if len(starts)!=1:fail("Keeper watch has no unique start")
try:start=datetime.datetime.strptime(starts[0],"apply %Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
except ValueError:fail("invalid Keeper watch start")
if not any(re.fullmatch(r"clickhouse-keeper-extra-ingress enforce valid=True uid=\S+ generation=[1-9][0-9]* resourceVersion=\S+ [0-9-]+ [0-9:]+",s)for s in watch):fail("Keeper watch lacks exact applied-policy identity custody")
minutes=[]
for line in watch:
    if " minute "not in line:continue
    m=re.fullmatch(r"([0-9-]+ [0-9:]+) minute ([0-9]+): errors \[\] drops \[\] (.+)",line)
    if m is None:fail("Keeper watch minute has errors/drops or malformed state")
    try:stamp=datetime.datetime.strptime(m[1],"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
    except ValueError:fail("invalid Keeper minute timestamp")
    minutes.append((int(m[2]),stamp))
    states=[s.strip()for s in re.split(r"(?=\bkeeper-[012] )",m[3])if s.strip()]
    (work/f"keeper-minute-{int(m[2]):02}.txt").write_text("\n".join(states)+"\n")
if [n for n,_ in minutes]!=list(range(1,31))or any(b[1]<a[1]for a,b in zip(minutes,minutes[1:]))or minutes[0][1]<start or (minutes[-1][1]-start).total_seconds()<1800:
    fail("Keeper watch lacks all30 ordered minutes spanning30 minutes")
exit_state=read("exit-state.txt").splitlines()
policies=["storage-integrity-si-v2"+suffix+"-clickhouse-ingress"for suffix in("-indexer-b","-indexer-c","")]+["clickhouse-keeper-extra-ingress"]
mode=[]
for p in policies:
    if exit_state.count(p+" enforce valid=True")!=1:fail("exit state lacks one enforced valid policy "+p)
    mode.append(p+" enforce valid=True")
(work/"probe-modes.txt").write_text("\n".join(mode)+"\n")
(work/"keeper-exit.txt").write_text("\n".join(s for s in exit_state if re.match(r"^keeper-[012] ",s))+"\n")
probe=read("probe-exit.tsv").splitlines();head="row\tfrom\tto\tport\texpect\tgot\tmode\tverdict"
if probe.count(head)!=1:fail("exit probe has no unique complete header")
rows=[s.split("\t")for s in probe if re.match(r"^[0-9]+\t",s)]
if not rows or any(len(r)!=8 or r[7]!="ok"for r in rows):fail("exit probe is empty, malformed, failed or unjudged")
summary=f"probe: {len(rows)} rows, 0 failed"
if probe.count(summary)!=1:fail("exit probe summary does not match its complete row count")
(work/"probe-results.txt").write_text("".join(r[0]+" "+r[5]+"\n"for r in rows))
(work/"exit-rows.tsv").write_text(head+"\n"+"\n".join("\t".join(r)for r in rows)+"\n")
end=read("hardening-end.txt")
if re.findall(r"^exit probe rows ok: ([0-9]+)$",end,re.M)!=[str(len(rows))]:fail("end record exit count differs from actual complete probe rows")
print("staging, commit, watch and exit evidence present; recheck frozen local producer oracles next")
PYRECORD
  for f in "$work"/keeper-minute-*.txt "$work/keeper-exit.txt"; do
    si_p4_py keeper-health "$f" >> "$work/keeper-health.txt" || return 1
  done
  si_p4_py probe-judge "$P/charts/storage-integrity/tests/si_network_probe.tsv" "$work/probe-results.txt" "$work/probe-modes.txt" > "$work/exit-rejudged.tsv" 2> "$work/exit-rejudged.err" || return 1
  cmp "$work/exit-rows.tsv" "$work/exit-rejudged.tsv" || { echo "exit rows differ from the frozen producer's full-matrix rejudgement: stop"; return 1; }
  si_budget > "$work/budget-end-rechecked.txt" 2>&1 || return 1
  cmp "$si_backup/budget-end.txt" "$work/budget-end-rechecked.txt" || { echo "end budget does not match its retained CRC/current-live inputs: stop"; return 1; }
}

p4_record_text() { # writes this task's run record only after complete local evidence gates
  p4_record_gate || return 1
  python3 -I - "$si_backup" "$1" <<'PY'
import glob
import os
import re
import sys

base, out = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]


def read(name):
    with open(os.path.join(base, name)) as f:
        return f.read()


def first(name):
    return read(name).split("\n")[0].strip()


end = dict(line.split("=", 1) for line in read("hardening-end.txt").split("\n") if re.match(r"^[A-Z0-9_]+=", line))
census = [line for line in read("census-check.txt").split("\n") if line.startswith("census: ")][-1]
samples = len(glob.glob(os.path.join(base, "census-keeper-*.txt")))
moves = sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(base, "move-verifier-*.txt")))
moves = [m for m in moves if re.search(r"move-verifier-[123]\.txt$", m)]
share = [line[len("verdict "):] for line in read("failure-domains.txt").split("\n") if line.startswith("verdict SHARE ")]
keeper_pr = re.search(r"/pull/([0-9]+)", read("keeper-enforce-pr"))
merged = [line for line in read("keeper-enforce-pr").split("\n") if line.startswith("MERGED ")]
exit_ok = [line for line in read("hardening-end.txt").split("\n") if line.startswith("exit probe rows ok: ")]
commits = []
for name in ("interserver-step1-indexer-b-commit", "interserver-step1-indexer-c-commit", "interserver-step1-network-commit",
             "interserver-step2-indexer-b-commit", "interserver-step2-indexer-c-commit", "interserver-step2-network-commit",
             "cnp-storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-b-clickhouse-ingress-enforce-commit",
             "cnp-storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-c-clickhouse-ingress-enforce-commit",
             "cnp-storage-integrity-si-v2-clickhouse-ingress-enforce-commit"):
    commits.append(f"{name.replace('-commit', '')} {first(name)[:9]}")
for m in moves:
    line = [l for l in open(m).read().split("\n") if l.startswith("start ")][0]
    commits.insert(0, f"{os.path.basename(m)[:-4]} {line.split(' commit ')[1][:9]}")
paragraph = (
    f"Hardening runbook docs/storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p4-hardening.md run on devnet2-si-v2 from the census start "
    f"{first('census-start')} UTC to HARDENING_END {end['HARDENING_END']}: a census of at least 7 days with {samples} Keeper samples "
    f"({census}); the staging pair showed K56's mixed state (staging-mixed.txt) and step 2 (staging-step2.txt); interserver step 1 on "
    f"indexer-b, indexer-c and the network CHI ended {end['INTERSERVER_STEP1_END']} and step 2 in the same order ended "
    f"{end['INTERSERVER_STEP2_END']}, each one restart window with its owners' acceptance writes reaching safe; {len(moves)} verifier "
    f"move(s) of §5.0; the three SI ClickHouse policies enforced indexer-b, indexer-c, then the network, each probed from every pod; "
    f"clickhouse-keeper-extra-ingress enforced through production PR #{keeper_pr.group(1) if keeper_pr else '?'} "
    f"({merged[-1] if merged else 'not merged'}) and held its 30-minute abort watch; exit probe {exit_ok[-1][len('exit probe rows ok: '):] if exit_ok else '?'} "
    f"rows ok and 0 failed; failure domains {end['DEVNET2_FAILURE_DOMAINS']}."
)
items = [
    "commits on production main: " + ", ".join(commits),
    "D39 sharing: " + ("; ".join(share) if share else "none, the six SI ClickHouses run on pairwise distinct nodes"),
    "budget at the start: " + read("budget-start.txt").strip().split("\n")[-1],
    "budget at the end: " + read("budget-end.txt").strip().split("\n")[-1],
]
if "?" in paragraph or "not merged" in paragraph:
    sys.exit("p4_record_text: the evidence is incomplete (Keeper PR or exit probe); nothing written")
with open(out, "w") as f:
    f.write(paragraph + "\n" + "".join(f"- {item}\n" for item in items))
print(f"{out}: one paragraph and {len(items)} sub-items")
PY
}
```

`p4-user-block.sh`, which runs one of the devuser1 owner's runbook blocks in the user's own terminal:

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# Run one devuser1 block of docs/storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p4-hardening.md in the user's own terminal (Plan S3-D Task 55).
#
#   bash ~/.cache/s3d-task55/p4-user-block.sh <block> <key file of devuser1's owner> [<n>]
#
# From fish this is an ordinary command. <block> names one confirmed block of the live checkout's
# runbook whose first line checks the user's own terminal and second line names the key: tables (§1.3), accept-move
# (§5.0, with <n> the moved verifier), accept-b-step1 (§5.1), accept-c-step1 (§5.2), accept-step1
# (§5.3), accept-b-step2 (§6.1), accept-c-step2 (§6.2), accept-step2 (§6.3),
# accept-enforce-indexer-b, accept-enforce-indexer-c, accept-enforce-network (§7.3) and
# keeper-enforce-accept (§8.3). Preserve the complete confirmed body and terminal guard,
# replacing only its second key assignment (and accept-move n). Source it directly on the
# user's terminal: its own tee remains, and no outer tee invalidates the TTY guard.
# si_agent_start reads the key into HOUSEGATE_AGENT_KEY: it never reaches argv, this terminal or
# the chat. The block as run is kept as $si_backup/user-<block>.sh and its output as
# $si_backup/user-<block>.out, aggregated from its own evidence after success; the receipt
# records source/execution hashes. An aggregate is not an independent live proof. Any retained
# script or receipt refuses a retry, including a failed or ambiguous write.
# shellcheck disable=SC2154  # si_backup and P come from helpers.sh
set -eo pipefail
usage="usage: bash ~/.cache/s3d-task55/p4-user-block.sh tables|accept-move|accept-b-step1|accept-c-step1|accept-step1|accept-b-step2|accept-c-step2|accept-step2|accept-enforce-indexer-b|accept-enforce-indexer-c|accept-enforce-network|keeper-enforce-accept <key file> [<n> for accept-move]"
[ "$#" = 2 ] || [ "$#" = 3 ] || { echo "$usage"; exit 2; }
# shellcheck disable=SC1091
source "$HOME/.cache/s3d-task55/helpers.sh"
si_p3_user_terminal || exit 1
umask 077
name=$1
n=""
case "$name" in
  accept-move)
    [ "$#" = 3 ] && [[ "$3" =~ ^[123]$ ]] || { echo "accept-move needs the moved verifier's number 1, 2 or 3"; exit 2; }
    n=$3; name="accept-move-$n" ;;
  tables|accept-b-step1|accept-c-step1|accept-step1|accept-b-step2|accept-c-step2|accept-step2|accept-enforce-indexer-b|accept-enforce-indexer-c|accept-enforce-network|keeper-enforce-accept)
    [ "$#" = 2 ] || { echo "$usage"; exit 2; } ;;
  *) echo "$1 is not one of the runbook's devuser1 blocks"; echo "$usage"; exit 2 ;;
esac
[ -d "$si_backup" ] || { echo "$si_backup does not exist: runbook §1.1 has not run"; exit 1; }
[ ! -e "$si_backup/user-$name.sh" ] || { echo "$si_backup/user-$name.sh exists: that block ran already; never re-run it (read $si_backup/user-$name.out instead)"; exit 1; }
[ ! -e "$si_backup/user-$name.receipt.json" ] && [ ! -e "$si_backup/user-$name.out" ] || { echo "retained user evidence exists: stop; never repeat the write"; exit 1; }
[ -f "$2" ] && [ -r "$2" ] || { echo "$2 is not a readable key file"; exit 1; }
key="$(cd "$(dirname "$2")" && pwd)/$(basename "$2")"
block="$si_backup/user-$name.sh"
python3 -I - "$P/docs/storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p4-hardening.md" "$1" "$key" "$block" "$n" "$si_backup/user-$name.receipt.json" <<'PY'
import re
import shlex
import sys
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

runbook, name, key, out, n, receipt = sys.argv[1:]
where = {
    "tables": ("### 1.3 ", "CREATE TABLE s3_p4"),
    "accept-move": ("### 5.0 ", 'si_p4_accept - a "429$n"'),
    "accept-b-step1": ("### 5.1 ", 'si_p4_accept "$key_file" b 4201 step1'),
    "accept-c-step1": ("### 5.2 ", 'si_p4_accept "$key_file" c 4201 step1'),
    "accept-step1": ("### 5.3 ", "si_p4_accept - a 4201"),
    "accept-b-step2": ("### 6.1 ", 'si_p4_accept "$key_file" b 4203 step2'),
    "accept-c-step2": ("### 6.2 ", 'si_p4_accept "$key_file" c 4203 step2'),
    "accept-step2": ("### 6.3 ", "si_p4_accept - a 4202"),
    "accept-enforce-indexer-b": ("### 7.3 ", 'si_p4_accept "$key_file" b 4205 enforce'),
    "accept-enforce-indexer-c": ("### 7.3 ", 'si_p4_accept "$key_file" c 4205 enforce'),
    "accept-enforce-network": ("### 7.3 ", "si_p4_accept - a 4203"),
    "keeper-enforce-accept": ("### 8.3 ", "si_p4_accept - a 4204"),
}
heading, marker = where[name]
first = "si_p3_user_terminal || exit 1"
key_line = "key_file=/path/to/devuser1-owner.key"
# The bash blocks of that subsection, found by their fences line by line (decision D24), as
# p4-helpers.py does; a heading counts only outside a block, and so does the line before a block.
found, current, previous, fence, body, confirmed = [], None, "", None, None, False
for line in open(runbook).read().split("\n"):
    if fence is None:
        opening = re.match(r"(`{3,})([^`\s]*)\s*$", line)
        if opening:
            fence = opening.group(1)
            body = [] if opening.group(2) == "bash" and current is not None and current.startswith(heading) else None
            confirmed = previous == "Confirm before running."
            continue
        if re.match(r"#{2,3} ", line):
            current = line
        if line.strip():
            previous = line.strip()
    elif re.fullmatch(re.escape(fence) + r"`*\s*", line):
        if body and len(body) >= 2 and body[:2] == [first, key_line] and any(marker in text for text in body):
            found.append((confirmed, body))
        fence, body, previous = None, None, line.strip()
    elif body is not None:
        body.append(line)
if len(found) != 1:
    sys.exit(f"p4-user-block: expected one devuser1 block of {heading.strip()} with {marker!r}, found {len(found)}")
confirmed, lines = found[0]
if not confirmed:
    sys.exit(f"p4-user-block: the {name} block is not a confirmed block of the runbook")
original = "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
rest = lines[2:]
if name == "accept-move":
    hits = [i for i, text in enumerate(rest) if text == "n='<n>'"]
    if len(hits) != 1:
        sys.exit("p4-user-block: the accept-move block has no line n='<n>'")
    rest[hits[0]] = f"n={n}"
native = {
    "tables": ["tables.txt"],
    "accept-move": [f"accept-move-{n}.txt"],
    "accept-b-step1": ["accept-b-step1.txt"], "accept-c-step1": ["accept-c-step1.txt"],
    "accept-step1": ["accept-step1.txt", "interserver-step1-end.txt"],
    "accept-b-step2": ["accept-b-step2.txt"], "accept-c-step2": ["accept-c-step2.txt"],
    "accept-step2": ["accept-step2.txt", "interserver-step2-end.txt"],
    "accept-enforce-indexer-b": ["accept-enforce-indexer-b.txt"],
    "accept-enforce-indexer-c": ["accept-enforce-indexer-c.txt"],
    "accept-enforce-network": ["accept-enforce-network.txt"],
    "keeper-enforce-accept": ["probe-keeper-enforce.tsv"],
}[name]
# The immutable body must actually own every aggregated tee destination.
for filename in native:
    literal = filename.replace(n, "$n") if name == "accept-move" else filename
    if '"$si_backup/' + literal + '"' not in original:
        sys.exit("p4-user-block: native evidence mapping differs from the confirmed body")
execution = first + "\nkey_file=" + shlex.quote(key) + "\n" + "\n".join(rest) + "\n"
costs = {"tables": 0, "accept-move": 3, "accept-b-step1": 1, "accept-c-step1": 1,
         "accept-step1": 3, "accept-b-step2": 1, "accept-c-step2": 1, "accept-step2": 3,
         "accept-enforce-indexer-b": 1, "accept-enforce-indexer-c": 1,
         "accept-enforce-network": 3, "keeper-enforce-accept": 3}
cost = len(re.findall(r"^\s*si_p4_accept\b", original, re.M))
if cost != costs[name]:
    sys.exit("p4-user-block: the confirmed block's promotion cost differs from the contract")
with open(out, "x") as f:
    f.write(execution)
data = {"state": "prepared", "name": name, "operation": Path(out).stem[len("user-"):],
        "runbook_sha256": hashlib.sha256(Path(runbook).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
        "original_block_sha256": hashlib.sha256(original.encode()).hexdigest(),
        "execution_sha256": hashlib.sha256(execution.encode()).hexdigest(), "native_evidence": native,
        "substitutions": ["key_file operand"] + (["move n operand"] if name == "accept-move" else []),
        "promotion_cost": cost, "aggregate_is_independent_live_proof": False}
with open(receipt, "x") as f:
    json.dump(data, f, indent=2); f.write("\n")
PY
chmod 600 "$block"
cd "$P"
echo "running the runbook block $name (kept as $block, output in $si_backup/user-$name.out)"
budget_receipt=""
if [ "$name" != tables ]; then
  p4_budget_gate "$name" || exit 1
  budget_receipt="$p4_last_budget_receipt"
fi
current_head="$(git -C "$P" rev-parse HEAD)" || exit 1
python3 -I - "$si_backup/user-$name.receipt.json" "$budget_receipt" "$current_head" "$P/docs/storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p4-hardening.md" <<'PYSTART'
import hashlib,json,os,re,sys
from pathlib import Path
p=Path(sys.argv[1]);gate,head,runbook=sys.argv[2:]
r=json.loads(p.read_text())
if r.get("state")!="prepared" or re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}",head)is None:
```

`p4-check-identities.py`, the complete paginated REST primary-author/trailer validator used before the ledger docs PR merge:

```python
"""Fail-closed REST primary-author and trailer check for a pinned PR head."""
import json,re,subprocess,sys
head=sys.argv[1]
if re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}",head)is None:sys.exit("invalid checked PR head; stop")
pages=json.load(sys.stdin)
if not isinstance(pages,list)or not pages or any(not isinstance(p,list)or not p or len(p)>100 for p in pages):sys.exit("missing or malformed paginated PR commits; stop")
commits=[c for p in pages for c in p]
if len(commits)>=250:sys.exit("REST commit listing reached its limit; stop")
trailer="Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>";seen=set()
for c in commits:
 if not isinstance(c,dict)or not isinstance(c.get("sha"),str)or re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}",c["sha"])is None or c["sha"]in seen:sys.exit("malformed or duplicate PR commit; stop")
 seen.add(c["sha"]);a=c["commit"]["author"];message=c["commit"]["message"]
 if not isinstance(message,str)or(a["name"],a["email"])!=("poetry","chen@sentio.xyz"):sys.exit("unexpected primary author; stop")
 coauthors=re.findall(r"(?im)^[ \t]*co-authored-by[ \t]*:.*$",message)
 parsed=subprocess.run(["git","interpret-trailers","--parse"],input=message,text=True,check=True,capture_output=True).stdout.splitlines()
 if coauthors not in ([],[trailer])or parsed.count(trailer)!=len(coauthors):sys.exit("unexpected or duplicated coauthor trailer; stop")
if commits[-1]["sha"]!=head:sys.exit("REST listing head differs from the checked head; stop")
print("PR commit identities and pinned head verified")
```

Spec §14 "Exits from the release refusals" (the settle half) and §16 row P4 (the same-identity owner rebuild with a Keeper fence, `hg_safe` restored through the gate, the RTO recorded), as clarified by K51 (the signer key is kept), K52 (the rebuilt `hg_safe` meets the owner audit by hash, sources and journal), K53 (settle is a leader-local RPC plus an SNode capability) and K54 (the Keeper fence), bound by contract §33–§37 and run in contract §37.4's order. The task executes `docs/storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p4-owner-rebuild.md` (Task 54, merged in `P4_PR`) section by section and block by block: the offline replay (§2.1), the verifiers on `ARBITER_TAG_P4` (§2.2), the three hosts on `SN_COMMIT_P4` one at a time with an acceptance write each (§2.3), the voters followers first and leader last (§2.4), `GRANT READ ON S3` for `si_snode` on every SI ClickHouse (§4.1), then the drill on indexer-c: quarantine (§5.1), a settle only when the leader withholds promotions (§5.2 with §3.2), a backup taken after the quarantine and a dry run that covers every part (§5.3), the loss (§5.4), the old volume isolated and the old Keeper session expired (§5.5), the ClickHouse re-created unchanged (§5.6), `rebuild-safe` as the host's init container (§5.7), a clean owner audit (§5.8), the init container removed (§5.9), the release (§5.10), one signed INSERT on indexer-c's track (§5.11) and the end (§6). The runbook is the source of truth for every check, helper and evidence name (decision D19); this task adds the exact content of every single-service commit, a render check of the rebuild commit before its push, the gates, its own read-only checks and the ledger record of `P4_REBUILD_RTO` and `P4_END` (run record `settle rollout and owner rebuild run`, contract §37.3).

No step changes a consensus format (contract §33.1): the RPCs are leader-local, the quarantine and the release are the stage-2 commands, and the acknowledgements a settle brings are ordinary ones. Every image step has a way back (runbook §7). Irreversible: from runbook §5.4 on there is no way back to the old ClickHouse (IRREVERSIBLE POINT 1, Step 16: it is deleted, and its volumes stay only as fenced evidence, never rebound), and `rebuild-safe`'s fence drops `snode-3`'s old Keeper replica of every table indexer-c owns for good (IRREVERSIBLE POINT 2, Step 19); the acceptance rows are permanent on their tracks (`4004` and `4005` in `devnet101.swap_new2`, `4003` and `4001` in `<db>.s3e_e2e`; `4002` until §6 drops `devuser1.s3_p4`).

Notes:
- **The runbook decides.** Every check, stop condition and expected output of a runbook block is the runbook's; where this task adds a read-only check it says so and gives its exact output. Before every one-way step (Steps 16 and 19) this task repeats the read-only facts the step depends on.
- **Generated block files.** Every runbook block runs from a block file that `p4r-runbook.py block` writes from the merged runbook (section, block number, an anchor string the block must contain, and whether it is preceded by `Confirm before running.`), so a block is never copied by hand and a runbook that differs from the one this task names stops at once. A runtime placeholder (`'<indexer id>'`, `'<n>'`, `/path/to/…`) is replaced only through `--replace`, one whole line for one whole line; a block that still holds one is refused.
- **Generated edits.** Every commit's content is produced by `p4r-edit.py` with the ledger's values, so the committed text is exactly the text below whatever the earlier plans added around its anchors, and `p4r_commit` refuses any other change. The backup name of R-on is the one runbook §5.3 wrote (`backup-name.txt`), never typed.
- **Passwords and keys (K16, K51).** No step reads, prints or passes a password or key. The restore key goes from Secret `storage-integrity-si-v2-restore-c` into the host container's stdin for the dry run (runbook §5.3) and into the init container through `secretKeyRef` (R-on; `p4r_check rebuild-render` refuses an inline value); ClickHouse logins go through the lockdown runbook's `si_ch_admin` and `si_ch_exec`; the devuser1 owner key stays in the user's terminal (only its file path is an argument); the signer key Secret `sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-c-private-key` is never read, copied or rotated.
- **Cross-task dependency.** The host commits pass the render tests only when Task 53 lists the P4 host image in every reviewed-image set a host's values are checked against: contract §36.5 names `WRITER_AUTHORIZATION_IMAGES` and `STAGE3_HOST_IMAGES`, and Plan S3-C4's `test_replica_reads_need_a_reviewed_host_image` needs it in `REPLICA_READ_HOST_IMAGES` too (the hosts serve replica reads since P3); Step 2's `preflight` checks all four (and `REBUILD_SAFE_IMAGES`) before anything changes. The grant commits pass only when Task 53's tests let one installation hold the restore grant before the others (runbook §4.1's order). If any render test fails at a commit, stop: the live task never edits a test or another constant.
- **The RTO includes the confirmations.** `P4_REBUILD_RTO` runs from the `loss` mark (Step 16) to the `accepted` mark of the user's write (Step 23) and so includes every gate in between; ask each question as soon as the previous check has passed, and record the wait in the chat record.

**Conventions for this task.**
- Every task and runbook Bash body runs from a reviewed D24 file, never pasted into a tool heredoc. The two Step1 bootstrap files precede the frozen session: the first is a fresh session scratchpad file; the second is `$T/blocks/001-assemble-helpers.sh`. Every later file uses the immutable registration protocol below. The tool invokes only the printed registered file as `bash -eo pipefail <file> < /dev/null`; the user-only scripts follow their separate TTY path. Long waits run in the background and their terminal output must be checked before the next step.
- **Task block preparation and immutable execution (D24).** After the two bootstrap files of Step1, write each task-owned Bash body, exactly as printed below and without an extra source/cd preamble, into a fresh file under `$T/task-source/`. Register it with `python3 -I "$T/p4r-runbook.py" task-file NAME EXPECT SOURCE_FILE`, using a concrete descriptive name, the step's actual `confirmed` or `read-only` kind, and that absolute source-file path. Review the printed immutable `$T/blocks/NNN-NAME.sh` file and run only that file after the applicable gate; never run the mutable preparation source. Its independent pre-source parser hash, frozen source inventory, payload SHA and attempted/done receipts use the same protocol as runbook blocks. Each of the five acceptance wrappers runs `p4r_check promotion-result LABEL "$si_backup"` after the producer and before writing its completion receipt. This binds the claimed frozen command/row and actual native safe read-back (the A producer's final bare count must be exactly one); a zero exit from the producer alone is insufficient. Failure retains the unknown attempted operation and stops before any following drill step. A confirmed operation with a failed or unknown receipt cannot be retried under another filename; reconcile its actual state first. User scripts remain the separate TTY-only path, never run by the agent. The two bootstrap files precede freeze and are never silently reused.
- **Runbook blocks.** "Run runbook §X block n" means: write its block file with `p4r-runbook.py block` exactly as the step gives the command, then run that file. A block preceded by `Confirm before running.` runs only after the step's gate has its yes. A confirmed block that stopped is never re-run as is: report its output. If it stopped before its first write (its `si_head_is`, the render tests, a server dry run), fix the cause (for a moved `main`: drop the local commit with `git -C "$P" switch -q --detach origin/main`, which is safe because it was never pushed, and make it again with `p4r_fresh_main` first) and ask again. The runbook's confirmed commit blocks check that HEAD is exactly this task's commit on `origin/main` (`si_head_is`), record their `-commit` evidence, push it as `HEAD:main` and sync or apply; this task makes the commit beforehand.
- **Explicit user confirmation.** Every remote or live action waits for an explicit yes in chat, given for that block only: each read of a remote (`git fetch`, including the one inside `p4r_fresh_main` of every commit block, `gh` reads, the registry inspects of runbook §1.1, the tag fetch and module downloads of runbook §2.1; one yes covers the remote reads of one block), each push and sync, each voter replacement, the `partstates` copy, each acceptance write of indexer-a, each CHI apply, the quarantine, a settle, the backup Job, the dry run, the loss, the isolation, the re-creation, the release, each acceptance write and the drop the user runs (asked before the command is handed over), every revert, the housegate push, PR and merge. Before asking, the agent states the step's Gate sentence, saying exactly what will change. Read-only cluster reads need none.
- **The user's terminal.** The user runs the four scripts of `$HOME/.cache/s3d-task56/user/` in their own fish terminal, each only after the agent hands it over and says what it writes; the agent never runs them. Each handed-over command ends with `/path/to/their/devuser1-owner.key`, which the user replaces with the path of their own devuser1 owner key file (the path is not the key; the key never leaves their terminal, S3-B Task 21's pattern). Keys and passwords never appear in chat, on argv or in a log.
- **One window per step.** One host per window in Steps 7–9, one voter per window in Step 10, one installation per window in Step 11. Steps 16–23 are one window without a pause other than the gates (the RTO runs). From Step 3 until Step 24, run no other sync, apply, pod deletion or consensus update against devnet2-si-v2's installations, hosts or voters, and no helmfile against `k8s-sea/clickhouse` (K22); from Step 10's first replacement until its checks passed, no Raft membership change.
- **Stop rules.** Stop on any unexpected output and report it; never improvise a fix on the cluster. Above all: a ledger value that differs from the runbook's pins; a render test that fails at a commit; a render delta other than the one the step names; a host, verifier or voter that does not return Ready on its image, or a voter that reports fewer than three active verifiers or three active SNodes once a window is over; an acceptance write that does not read `1`; a settle that does not end `TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_SETTLED`; a dry run that does not cover every part; `snode-3` still active in Keeper five minutes after the loss; any `rebuild-safe` refusal; an unclean owner audit after the rebuild; a partition-state difference before the acceptance. A window that fails right after its push: ask for the runbook §7 revert at once (the revert needs its own yes); from Step 16 on there is no revert of the drill, only runbook §7's fix-forward, each action with its own yes. A local commit whose push the user declined stays on the detached HEAD and makes `p4r_fresh_main` stop: report it, and only on the user's word drop it with `git -C "$P" switch -q --detach origin/main` (local; it was never pushed).

**Execution stop.** This task cannot start until formal S3-C2/Task36, S3-C3 and P3 acceptance, the Task50 deployed-image mechanics/rebuild proof, releases49–52 and the final Task54/55 records have passed their owning gates. Static fixture checks below do not establish a deployed version, a successful live drill, RTO or a ledger value. No key is read by the agent. Each confirmed immutable operation is attempted once: an unsuccessful or unknown attempt requires evidence reconciliation and a new user decision; never rename a block to bypass its claim. User scripts require all three standard streams and a controlling TTY before sourcing helpers, handling a key path or opening their tee.

`p4r-runbook.py`, the session helpers and the block files:

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Session helpers and block files from the P4 owner-rebuild runbook (Plan S3-D Task 56).

  p4r-runbook.py chain DOCS_DIR RUNBOOK.md
  p4r-runbook.py block SECTION N ANCHOR EXPECT NAME [--replace OLD NEW]...
  p4r-runbook.py user SECTION N ANCHOR NAME [--replace OLD NEW]...

chain prints the session helpers exactly as a runbook's "## 0. Session
helpers" says to define them: depth first and each runbook once, the first
bash block of every earlier runbook's section 0 that the section links before
its own first bash block, then that block, each behind a comment naming its
source (decision D20; the extraction code of Plan S3-B Tasks 15, 18 and 21).

block and user read docs/storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p4-owner-rebuild.md
in the live checkout named by the file live-path next to this script. SECTION
is a heading number ("5.3" for "### 5.3 ...", "6" for "## 6. ..."); N counts
the bash blocks of that section from 1, up to its next heading. The block must
contain ANCHOR, and it must be preceded by the line "Confirm before running."
exactly when EXPECT is "confirmed" (EXPECT "read-only" otherwise). Every OLD
must be one whole line of the block, once; @NAME@ in NEW is replaced by NAME's
value in ledger.env next to this script. A block that still holds a runtime
placeholder ('<...>' or /path/to/) is refused. block writes
blocks/<nnn>-NAME.sh (the next free number) with the two header lines of
decision D24 and prints its path; user writes user/NAME.sh, a script the user
runs in their own terminal as "bash <script> <devuser1 owner key file>": its
only change besides the replacements is the block's line
key_file=/path/to/devuser1-owner.key, which takes the key file's path from
$1. Blocks are found by their fences, line by line (decision D24): a fence
opens on a line of three or more backquotes and closes only on a line of at
least as many backquotes and nothing else, so a heredoc or a string that
mentions backquotes never ends a block. Nothing is overwritten.
"""

import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

FENCE = re.compile(r"(`{3,})([^`\s]*)\s*$")
HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
RUNBOOK = "docs/storage-integrity-devnet2-stage3-p4-owner-rebuild.md"
CONFIRM = "Confirm before running."
PLACEHOLDER = re.compile(r"'<[^'>]*>'|/path/to/")
KEY_LINE = "key_file=/path/to/devuser1-owner.key"
KEY_FROM_ARG = 'key_file="${1:?usage: bash <this script> <devuser1 owner key file>}"'


def fail(message):
    sys.exit(f"p4r-runbook: {message}; stop")


def section_zero(path):
    lines = path.read_text().split("\n")
    if "## 0. Session helpers" not in lines:
        fail(f"{path} has no '## 0. Session helpers' section")
    intro, block, fence = [], None, None
    for line in lines[lines.index("## 0. Session helpers") + 1:]:
        if fence is None:
            opening = FENCE.match(line)
            if opening:
                fence = opening.group(1)
                if opening.group(2) == "bash":
                    block = []
            elif line.startswith("## "):
                break
            else:
                intro.append(line)
        elif re.fullmatch(re.escape(fence) + r"`*\s*", line):
            if block is not None:
                earlier = re.findall(r"\]\((storage-integrity-devnet2-[a-z0-9-]+\.md)\)", "\n".join(intro))
                return earlier, "\n".join(block) + "\n"
            fence = None
        elif block is not None:
            block.append(line)
    fail(f"{path}: no complete bash block in section 0")


def collect(docs, name, seen, out):
    if name in seen:
        return
    seen.add(name)
    earlier, block = section_zero(docs / name)
    for other in earlier:
        collect(docs, other, seen, out)
    out.append((name, block))


def chain(args):
    if len(args) != 2:
        fail("usage: chain DOCS_DIR RUNBOOK.md")
    out = []
    collect(Path(args[0]), args[1], set(), out)
    for name, block in out:
        print(f"# --- §0 of docs/{name}")
        print(block, end="")
    print("# --- end of runbook helpers: " + " ".join(name for name, _ in out), file=sys.stderr)


def section_blocks(lines, section):
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?", section):
        fail(f"section {section!r} is not a heading number like 5.3 or 6")
    if "." in section:
        head = re.compile(r"### " + re.escape(section) + r" \S")
    else:
        head = re.compile(r"## " + re.escape(section) + r"\. \S")
    starts = [i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if head.match(line)]
    if len(starts) != 1:
        fail(f"{RUNBOOK} has {len(starts)} headings for section {section}, not one")
    blocks, fence, body, prev = [], None, None, []
    for line in lines[starts[0] + 1:]:
        if fence is None:
            if line.startswith("## ") or line.startswith("### "):
                break
            opening = FENCE.match(line)
            if opening:
                fence = opening.group(1)
                if opening.group(2) == "bash":
                    before = [p for p in prev if p.strip()]
                    body = {"confirmed": bool(before) and before[-1].strip() == CONFIRM, "lines": []}
                else:
                    body = None
            else:
                prev.append(line)
        elif re.fullmatch(re.escape(fence) + r"`*\s*", line):
            if body is not None:
                blocks.append(body)
            fence, body, prev = None, None, []
        elif body is not None:
            body["lines"].append(line)
    if fence is not None:
        fail(f"section {section}: an unclosed fence")
    return blocks


LEDGER_NAMES = '''ARBITER_TAG ARBITER_DIGEST INDEXER_C_ID INDEXER_C_CHI_NODE INDEXER_C_HOST_NODE P1_END UNSAFE_INC_ROOT HG_TAG_P3 SN_COMMIT_P3 SN_DIGEST_P3 P3_END PROTO_TAG_P4 CORE_TAG_P4 P4_MECHANICS ARBITER_TAG_P4 ARBITER_DIGEST_P4 SN_COMMIT_P4 SN_DIGEST_P4 P4_PR HARDENING_END DEVNET2_FAILURE_DOMAINS'''.split()

def typed_ledger(path):
    import datetime
    values = {}
    for line in Path(path).read_text().splitlines():
        name, sep, value = line.partition('=')
        if not sep or name not in LEDGER_NAMES or name in values or not value:
            fail('malformed, unknown, duplicate or empty ledger input')
        values[name] = value
    if set(values) != set(LEDGER_NAMES):
        fail('ledger input does not contain the exact declared names')
    for name, value in values.items():
        if name in ('P1_END', 'P3_END', 'P4_MECHANICS', 'HARDENING_END'):
            try:
                if not re.fullmatch(r'[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}', value):
                    raise ValueError()
                datetime.date.fromisoformat(value)
            except ValueError:
                fail('invalid UTC ledger date')
        elif 'DIGEST' in name:
            if not re.fullmatch(r'sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}', value):
                fail('invalid image digest')
        elif name.startswith('SN_COMMIT'):
            if not re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{40}', value):
                fail('invalid full source commit')
        elif name == 'INDEXER_C_ID':
            if not re.fullmatch(r'0|[1-9][0-9]*', value) or int(value) > 2**64-1:
                fail('invalid indexer id')
        elif name == 'P4_PR':
            if not re.fullmatch(r'[1-9][0-9]*', value):
                fail('invalid P4 pull request number')
        elif name.endswith('_NODE'):
            if len(value) > 253 or not re.fullmatch(r'[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9.-]*[a-z0-9])?', value):
                fail('invalid node hostname')
        elif name == 'UNSAFE_INC_ROOT':
            if value != '/storage-integrity/devnet2/devnet2-si-v2/sentio/0/unsafe_inc':
                fail('invalid public Keeper root')
        elif name == 'DEVNET2_FAILURE_DOMAINS':
            entries = value.split(',')
            if len(entries) != 3 or any(not re.fullmatch(r'(0|[1-9][0-9]*)=node:[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]*', p) for p in entries):
                fail('invalid three-source failure-domain roster')
            ids = [int(p.partition('=')[0]) for p in entries]
            hosts = [p.partition('node:')[2] for p in entries]
            if ids != sorted(set(ids)) or len(set(hosts)) != 3:
                fail('unordered/duplicate failure-domain roster')
        elif not re.fullmatch(r'v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+', value):
            fail('invalid release tag')
    pair = values['INDEXER_C_ID'] + '=node:' + values['INDEXER_C_CHI_NODE']
    if pair not in values['DEVNET2_FAILURE_DOMAINS'].split(','):
        fail('failure-domain roster does not bind source ClickHouse node')
    return values

def ledger():
    return typed_ledger(HERE / 'ledger.env')

def ledger_check(args):
    if len(args) != 1:
        fail('ledger-check takes one ledger file')
    typed_ledger(args[0])
    print('ledger: exact %d declared values validated' % len(LEDGER_NAMES))


def substitute(text):
    values = ledger()

    def one(match):
        name = match.group(1)
        if name not in values:
            fail(f"@{name}@ is not a name of {HERE / 'ledger.env'}")
        return values[name]

    return re.sub(r"@([A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*)@", one, text)


def pick(args, kind):
    verify_sources()
    want = 5 if kind == "block" else 4
    if len(args) < want:
        fail("usage: block SECTION N ANCHOR EXPECT NAME [--replace OLD NEW]... | user SECTION N ANCHOR NAME [--replace OLD NEW]...")
    section, n, anchor = args[0], args[1], args[2]
    expect = args[3] if kind == "block" else "confirmed"
    name = args[want - 1]
    rest = args[want:]
    if expect not in ("confirmed", "read-only"):
        fail(f"EXPECT {expect!r} is confirmed or read-only")
    if not re.fullmatch(r"[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{0,60}", name):
        fail(f"NAME {name!r} is not [a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]*")
    if not n.isdigit() or int(n) < 1:
        fail(f"N {n!r} is not a block number from 1")
    replaces = []
    while rest:
        if rest[0] != "--replace" or len(rest) < 3:
            fail(f"unexpected arguments {rest!r}")
        old, new = rest[1], substitute(rest[2])
        allowed = {
            "arbiter_repo=/path/to/arbiter": {"arbiter_repo=/Users/uranuswch/Dev/projects/sentio-network/arbiter"},
            "x=b": {"x=a", "x=c"},
            "inst=indexer-b": {"inst=indexer-c", "inst=network"},
            "indexer='<indexer id>'": {"indexer='" + ledger()["INDEXER_C_ID"] + "'"},
            "indexer='<indexer id>'; n='<n>'": {"indexer='" + ledger()["INDEXER_C_ID"] + "'; n='1'", "indexer='" + ledger()["INDEXER_C_ID"] + "'; n='2'"},
        }
        if old not in allowed or new not in allowed[old]:
            fail("replacement is outside the documented task substitutions")
        replaces.append((old, new))
        rest = rest[3:]
    live = (HERE / "live-path").read_text().strip()
    path = Path(live) / RUNBOOK
    if not path.is_file():
        fail(f"{path} does not exist")
    blocks = section_blocks(path.read_text().split("\n"), section)
    if int(n) > len(blocks):
        fail(f"section {section} has {len(blocks)} bash block(s), not {n}")
    block = blocks[int(n) - 1]
    lines = list(block["lines"])
    text = "\n".join(lines)
    if anchor not in text:
        fail(f"bash block {n} of section {section} does not contain {anchor!r}: the runbook is not the one this task names")
    if block["confirmed"] != (expect == "confirmed"):
        fail(f"bash block {n} of section {section} is {'confirmed' if block['confirmed'] else 'read-only'}, not {expect}")
    if kind == "user":
        replaces.insert(0, (KEY_LINE, KEY_FROM_ARG))
    for old, new in replaces:
        hits = [i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if line == old]
        if len(hits) != 1:
            fail(f"bash block {n} of section {section} has {len(hits)} line(s) {old!r}, not one")
        lines[hits[0]] = new
    body = "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
    if PLACEHOLDER.search(body):
        fail(f"bash block {n} of section {section} still holds a placeholder: {PLACEHOLDER.search(body).group(0)!r}")
    rev = subprocess.run(["git", "-C", live, "rev-parse", "--short=9", "HEAD"], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
    origin = f"# runbook §{section}, bash block {n} ({expect}), {RUNBOOK} at {rev or 'unknown'}"
    return section, n, name, body, origin


def write_new(path, text, mode):
    if path.exists():
        fail(f"{path} exists: a block file is never edited or reused")
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL, mode)
    with os.fdopen(fd, "w") as out:
        out.write(text)
    print(path)


def block_file(args):
    section, n, name, body, origin = pick(args, "block")
    blocks = HERE / "blocks"
    taken = [int(m.group(1)) for p in blocks.iterdir() if (m := re.match(r"([0-9]{3})-", p.name))]
    number = max(taken, default=0) + 1
    expected = args[3]
    bind_block(blocks / f"{number:03d}-{name}.sh", section, n, expected, body, origin)


def user_file(args):
    section, n, name, body, origin = pick(args, "user")
    bind_block(HERE / "user" / f"{name}.sh", section, n, "confirmed", body, origin, user=True)

# Inserted into the owning p4r-runbook.py; only local task-session state.
import hashlib
import json
import shlex
import time

def digest(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()

def unique_json(path):
    def pairs(items):
        out = {}
        for key, value in items:
            if key in out:
                fail("duplicate JSON key")
            out[key] = value
        return out
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text(), object_pairs_hook=pairs)

def atomic_new(path, value):
    encoded = json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n"
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL, 0o600)
    with os.fdopen(fd, "w") as f:
        f.write(encoded)
        f.flush()
        os.fsync(f.fileno())

def source_files():
    live = Path((HERE / "live-path").read_text().rstrip("\n"))
    if not live.is_absolute() or str(live) == "/" or any(c in str(live) for c in "\n\r\x00"):
        fail("invalid retained live path")
    sources = []
    collect(live / "docs", Path(RUNBOOK).name, set(), sources)
    paths = [live / "docs" / name for name, _ in sources]
    paths += [HERE / n for n in ("p4r-runbook.py", "p4r-edit.py", "p4r-check.py", "p4r-task.sh", "local-render.py", "helpers.sh", "ledger.env", "live-path", "live-worktree.json")]
    paths.append(Path.home() / ".cache/s3-ledger/s3-ledger.py")
    paths.append(Path.home() / "si-devnet2-stage3-indexer-c/acceptance-db")
    paths.append(HERE / "p4-mechanics-record.txt")
    if any(p.is_symlink() or not p.is_file() for p in paths):
        fail("missing or symlinked frozen session input")
    return live, paths

def freeze(args):
    if args:
        fail("freeze takes no arguments")
    live, paths = source_files()
    typed_ledger(HERE / "ledger.env")
    receipt = unique_json(HERE / "live-worktree.json")
    if not isinstance(receipt, dict) or receipt.get("action") != "created" or receipt.get("path") != str(live):
        fail("live path does not match Task55's retained creator JSON")
    value = {"version": 1, "live": str(live), "sources": {str(p): digest(p) for p in paths}}
    atomic_new(HERE / "frozen.json", value)
    print("frozen task sources: %d files" % len(paths))

def verify_sources():
    value = unique_json(HERE / "frozen.json")
    if not isinstance(value, dict) or set(value) != {"version", "live", "sources"} or value["version"] != 1:
        fail("malformed frozen source manifest")
    live, paths = source_files()
    if value["live"] != str(live) or set(value["sources"]) != {str(p) for p in paths}:
        fail("frozen source inventory changed")
    if any(digest(Path(p)) != h for p, h in value["sources"].items()):
        fail("frozen runbook/tool/session input changed")
    return value

def verify(args):
    if args:
        fail("verify takes no arguments")
    verify_sources()
    print("frozen task sources verified")

def checked_block(path):
    verify_sources()
    p = Path(path)
    if p.is_symlink() or p.parent not in (HERE / "blocks", HERE / "user"):
        fail("block is outside the owned session")
    meta = unique_json(Path(str(p) + ".json"))
    if not isinstance(meta, dict) or set(meta) != {"file", "sha256", "operation", "kind", "source"}:
        fail("malformed immutable block binding")
    if meta["file"] != str(p) or meta["sha256"] != digest(p) or meta["source"] != digest(HERE / "frozen.json"):
        fail("block bytes/source binding changed")
    return p, meta

def check_block(args):
    if len(args) != 1:
        fail("check-block takes one file")
    checked_block(args[0])

def claim(args):
    if len(args) != 1:
        fail("claim takes one file")
    p, meta = checked_block(args[0])
    claims = HERE / "claims"
    claims.mkdir(mode=0o700, exist_ok=True)
    name = meta["operation"] if meta["kind"] == "confirmed" else hashlib.sha256(str(p).encode()).hexdigest()
    attempted = claims / (name + ".attempted")
    atomic_new(attempted, {"file": str(p), "sha256": meta["sha256"], "source": meta["source"], "started_unix": int(time.time())})

def complete(args):
    if len(args) != 1:
        fail("complete takes one file")
    p, meta = checked_block(args[0])
    name = meta["operation"] if meta["kind"] == "confirmed" else hashlib.sha256(str(p).encode()).hexdigest()
    attempted = unique_json(HERE / "claims" / (name + ".attempted"))
    if attempted.get("file") != str(p) or attempted.get("sha256") != meta["sha256"] or attempted.get("source") != meta["source"]:
        fail("attempt does not bind this block")
    atomic_new(HERE / "claims" / (name + ".done"), {"file": str(p), "sha256": meta["sha256"], "source": meta["source"], "exit_code": 0})

def bind_block(path, section, n, kind, body, origin, user=False):
    verify_sources()
    operation = hashlib.sha256((section + "\0" + n + "\0" + body).encode()).hexdigest()
    tool = HERE / "p4r-runbook.py"
    # The independent tiny pre-source guard verifies the exact parser bytes before invoking it.
    pre = "#!/usr/bin/env bash\nset -eo pipefail\n"
    if user:
        pre += '[ -t 0 ] && [ -t 1 ] && [ -t 2 ] && (exec 9</dev/tty) || { echo "run this script in your own terminal; stop" >&2; exit 1; }\n'
    pre += "python3 -I -c 'import hashlib,pathlib,sys; assert hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==sys.argv[2], \"task parser changed; stop\"' " + shlex.quote(str(tool)) + " " + shlex.quote(digest(tool)) + " || exit 1\n"
    pre += 'python3 -I ' + shlex.quote(str(tool)) + ' check-block "$0" || exit 1\n'
    pre += 'source ' + shlex.quote(str(HERE / "helpers.sh")) + ' || exit 1\ncd "$P" || exit 1\n'
    pre += 'python3 -I ' + shlex.quote(str(tool)) + ' claim "$0" || exit 1\n'
    pre += 'export P4R_ACTIVE_BLOCK=\"$0\"\n'
    label=re.sub(r'^[0-9]{3}-','',path.stem)
    if label in {'accept-b-4002','accept-c-4003','accept-a-4004','accept-a-4005','accept-c-4001'}:
        pre += 'p4r_budget_checkpoint '+shlex.quote(label)+' || exit 1\n'
    post = ''
    if label in {'accept-b-4002','accept-c-4003','accept-a-4004','accept-a-4005','accept-c-4001'}:
        post += 'p4r_check promotion-result '+shlex.quote(label)+' "$si_backup" || exit 1\n'
    post += 'python3 -I ' + shlex.quote(str(tool)) + ' complete "$0" || exit 1\n'
    text = pre + origin + "\n" + body + post
    write_new(path, text, 0o700 if user else 0o600)
    atomic_new(Path(str(path) + ".json"), {"file": str(path), "sha256": digest(path), "operation": operation, "kind": kind, "source": digest(HERE / "frozen.json")})

def task_file(args):
    if len(args)!=3:fail('task-file takes NAME EXPECT SOURCE_FILE')
    name,kind,source=args
    if not re.fullmatch(r'[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{0,60}',name) or kind not in ('confirmed','read-only'):
        fail('invalid task block name or confirmation kind')
    p=Path(source)
    if p.parent!=HERE/'task-source' or p.is_symlink() or not p.is_file():
        fail('task body is outside its owned preparation directory')
    body=p.read_text()
    if not body.endswith("\n"):body+="\n"
    if not body.strip() or PLACEHOLDER.search(body):fail('empty or unresolved task body')
    blocks=HERE/'blocks';taken=[int(m.group(1)) for p in blocks.iterdir() if (m:=re.match(r'([0-9]{3})-',p.name))]
    number=max(taken,default=0)+1
    bind_block(blocks/('%03d-%s.sh'%(number,name)),'task',hashlib.sha256(body.encode()).hexdigest(),kind,body,'# reviewed task body: '+p.name)


COMMANDS = {"chain": chain, "block": block_file, "user": user_file, "freeze": freeze, "verify": verify, "check-block": check_block, "claim": claim, "complete": complete, "ledger-check": ledger_check, "task-file": task_file}
if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) < 2 or sys.argv[1] not in COMMANDS:
        fail("usage: p4r-runbook.py chain|block|user|freeze|verify|check-block|claim|complete ...")
    COMMANDS[sys.argv[1]](sys.argv[2:])
```

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Structure-checked edits of the live checkout for Plan S3-D Task 56.

Run from the root of the production checkout. Every subcommand edits one file
and writes it only when the parsed result differs from the parsed original by
exactly the intended change (YAML documents compared with yaml.safe_load_all,
Python by ast: the edited constant takes the new value and every other
top-level statement keeps its ast.dump). Anchors are found by structure, so
the edits apply on top of whatever the earlier plans added around them.

  arbiter-pin FILE TAG COMMIT CORE PROTO PREV_TAG PREV_DIGEST REPLAY_DATE DIGEST
      arbiter.image of the network overlay: the lines from "repository:" to
      "digest:" become the P4 pin and its comment; the old digest must be
      PREV_DIGEST.
  host-pin FILE a|b|c COMMIT DIGEST CORE HG PREV_COMMIT PREV_DIGEST
  fresh-example FILE COMMIT DIGEST CORE HG PREV_COMMIT PREV_DIGEST
      a source-image values file (or docs/examples' copy of indexer-a's): its
      leading comment becomes the P4 header and node.image.tag moves from
      sha-PREV_COMMIT@PREV_DIGEST to sha-COMMIT@DIGEST; nothing else changes.
  snode-grant FILE
      a CHI manifest: "GRANT READ ON S3" appended to
      spec.configuration.users["si_snode/grants/query"].
  access-grant FILE
      the network overlay: clickhouse.access.snodeRestoreGrant: false changed in place to true;
      the existing comment and every other byte remain unchanged.
  rebuild-on FILE BACKUP SAVE
      indexer-c's overlay: storageIntegrity.snode.rebuildSafe (enabled,
      backup BACKUP, restoreKeySecret.name storage-integrity-si-v2-restore-c)
      appended to storageIntegrity.snode; the inserted lines and the file's
      sha256 before and after go into SAVE (JSON, never overwritten).
  rebuild-off FILE SAVE
      removes exactly the lines rebuild-on inserted; the file must be the one
      rebuild-on wrote, and becomes byte for byte the one it read.
  image-constant FILE NAME OLD_IMAGE NEW_IMAGE
      a top-level NAME = <image string> of test_render.py becomes the
      two-line literal of NEW_IMAGE; its old value must be OLD_IMAGE.
  constant FILE NAME KEY OLD NEW
      a top-level constant (KEY "-") or one entry of a top-level dict literal
      (KEY a Python literal) of test_render.py, OLD to NEW (Python literals).
  preflight P3_IMAGE P4_IMAGE ARBITER_DIGEST INDEXER_C_CHI_NODE

EXAMPLE_HEADER = """\
```
