```python
def fail(message):
    sys.exit(f"p4r-edit: {message}; stop")


def fill(template, **values):
    def one(match):
        if match.group(1) not in values:
            fail(f"template token {match.group(1)} has no value")
        return values[match.group(1)]

    return re.sub(r"<<([A-Z_]+)>>", one, template)


def read(path):
    p = Path(path)
    if p.is_symlink() or not p.is_file():
        fail(f"{path} does not exist")
    return p.read_text()


def docs(text, path):
    try:
        return [d for d in yaml.safe_load_all(text)]
    except yaml.YAMLError as err:
        fail(f"{path} does not parse as YAML: {err}")


def write_checked(path, old, new, expected_docs):
    if new == old:
        fail(f"{path}: the edit changes nothing")
    got = docs(new, path)
    if got != expected_docs:
        fail(f"{path}: the edited file does not parse to exactly the intended change")
    Path(path).write_text(new)


def indent_of(line):
    return len(line) - len(line.lstrip(" "))


def is_content(line):
    s = line.strip()
    return bool(s) and not s.startswith("#")


def block_end(lines, start, parent_indent):
    """Index after the last content line of the block that begins below lines[start] (a 'key:' line at parent_indent)."""
    last = None
    for i in range(start + 1, len(lines)):
        line = lines[i]
        if not is_content(line):
            continue
        if indent_of(line) <= parent_indent:
            break
        last = i
    if last is None:
        fail(f"line {start + 1} ({lines[start].strip()!r}) has an empty block")
    return last + 1


def find_key(lines, indent, key, start=0, stop=None):
    pat = re.compile(r"^" + " " * indent + re.escape(key) + r":\s*(#.*)?$")
    stop = len(lines) if stop is None else stop
    hits = [i for i in range(start, stop) if pat.match(lines[i])]
    if len(hits) != 1:
        fail(f"expected one line '{' ' * indent}{key}:' in lines {start + 1}-{stop}, found {len(hits)}")
    return hits[0]


def arbiter_pin(args):
    path, tag, commit, core, proto, prev_tag, prev_digest, date, digest = args
    for name, value, pat in (("TAG", tag, r"v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+"), ("PREV_TAG", prev_tag, r"v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+"),
                             ("CORE", core, r"v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+"), ("PROTO", proto, r"v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+"),
                             ("COMMIT", commit, r"[0-9a-f]{8,40}"), ("DATE", date, r"20[0-9]{2}-[01][0-9]-[0-3][0-9]"),
                             ("DIGEST", digest, r"sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}"), ("PREV_DIGEST", prev_digest, r"sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}")):
        if not re.fullmatch(pat, value):
            fail(f"{name} {value!r} is not {pat}")
    old = read(path)
    lines = old.splitlines(keepends=True)
    top = find_key(lines, 0, "arbiter")
    end = block_end(lines, top, 0)
    image = find_key(lines, 2, "image", top + 1, end)
    image_end = block_end(lines, image, 2)
    repo = [i for i in range(image + 1, image_end) if lines[i].rstrip("\n") == "    repository: ghcr.io/sentioxyz/arbiter"]
    dig = [i for i in range(image + 1, image_end) if re.fullmatch(r"    digest: (sha256:[0-9a-f]{64})", lines[i].rstrip("\n"))]
    if len(repo) != 1 or len(dig) != 1 or dig[0] < repo[0]:
        fail(f"{path}: arbiter.image is not 'repository: ghcr.io/sentioxyz/arbiter', comments, 'digest: sha256:…'")
    for i in range(repo[0] + 1, dig[0]):
        if is_content(lines[i]):
            fail(f"{path}: line {i + 1} between repository and digest is not a comment")
    current = lines[dig[0]].strip().split(": ", 1)[1]
    if current != prev_digest:
        fail(f"{path}: arbiter.image.digest is {current}, not the previous pin {prev_digest}")
    block = fill(ARBITER_PIN, TAG=tag, COMMIT=commit[:8], CORE=core, PROTO=proto, PREV_TAG=prev_tag,
                 PREV_DIGEST=prev_digest, DATE=date, DIGEST=digest)
    new = "".join(lines[:repo[0]]) + block + "".join(lines[dig[0] + 1:])
    expected = docs(old, path)
    if len(expected) != 1:
        fail(f"{path} is not one YAML document")
    expected = copy.deepcopy(expected)
    expected[0]["arbiter"]["image"]["digest"] = digest
    write_checked(path, old, new, expected)
    print(f"{path}: arbiter.image.digest {prev_digest} -> {digest} ({prev_tag} -> {tag}, comment rewritten)")


def image_tag_edit(path, header, commit, digest, prev_commit, prev_digest, what):
    for name, value, pat in (("COMMIT", commit, r"[0-9a-f]{40}"), ("PREV_COMMIT", prev_commit, r"[0-9a-f]{40}"),
                             ("DIGEST", digest, r"sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}"), ("PREV_DIGEST", prev_digest, r"sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}")):
        if not re.fullmatch(pat, value):
            fail(f"{name} {value!r} is not {pat}")
    old = read(path)
    lines = old.splitlines(keepends=True)
    first = next((i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if not line.startswith("#")), len(lines))
    if first == 0:
        fail(f"{path} has no leading comment")
    old_tag = f'    tag: "sha-{prev_commit}@{prev_digest}"\n'
    new_tag = f'    tag: "sha-{commit}@{digest}"\n'
    rest = lines[first:]
    hits = [i for i, line in enumerate(rest) if line == old_tag]
    if len(hits) != 1:
        fail(f"{path}: expected one line {old_tag.strip()!r}, found {len(hits)}")
    rest[hits[0]] = new_tag
    new = header + "".join(rest)
    expected = docs(old, path)
    if len(expected) != 1 or set(expected[0]) != {"node"} or set(expected[0]["node"]) != {"image"}:
        fail(f"{path} is not one document holding only node.image")
    image = expected[0]["node"]["image"]
    if image.get("repository") != "ghcr.io/sentioxyz/sentio-node":
        fail(f"{path}: node.image.repository is {image.get('repository')!r}")
    expected = copy.deepcopy(expected)
    expected[0]["node"]["image"]["tag"] = f"sha-{commit}@{digest}"
    write_checked(path, old, new, expected)
    print(f"{path}: {what} node.image.tag sha-{prev_commit[:12]}… -> sha-{commit[:12]}… (header rewritten)")


def host_pin(args):
    path, host, commit, digest, core, hg, prev_commit, prev_digest = args
    if host not in HOST_HEADERS:
        fail(f"host {host!r} is a, b or c")
    header = fill(HOST_HEADERS[host], COMMIT=commit, CORE=core, HG=hg, PREV_COMMIT=prev_commit, PREV_DIGEST=prev_digest)
    image_tag_edit(path, header, commit, digest, prev_commit, prev_digest, f"indexer-{host}")


def fresh_example(args):
    path, commit, digest, core, hg, prev_commit, prev_digest = args
    header = fill(EXAMPLE_HEADER, COMMIT=commit, CORE=core, HG=hg)
    image_tag_edit(path, header, commit, digest, prev_commit, prev_digest, "fresh example")


def snode_grant(args):
    (path,) = args
    old = read(path)
    lines = old.splitlines(keepends=True)
    keys = [i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if re.fullmatch(r"\s+si_snode/grants/query:\s*", line.rstrip("\n"))]
    if len(keys) != 1:
        fail(f"{path}: expected one 'si_snode/grants/query:' line, found {len(keys)}")
    k = keys[0]
    key_indent = indent_of(lines[k])
    items = []
    for i in range(k + 1, len(lines)):
        line = lines[i]
        if not is_content(line):
            continue
        if indent_of(line) < key_indent or (indent_of(line) == key_indent and not line.lstrip().startswith("- ")):
            break
        if not line.lstrip().startswith("- ") or (items and indent_of(line) != indent_of(lines[items[0]])):
            fail(f"{path}: line {i + 1} of si_snode/grants/query is not a one-line list item")
        items.append(i)
    if not items:
        fail(f"{path}: si_snode/grants/query lists nothing")
    item_indent = " " * indent_of(lines[items[0]])
    expected = docs(old, path)
    if len(expected) != 1 or expected[0].get("kind") != "ClickHouseInstallation":
        fail(f"{path} is not one ClickHouseInstallation")
    grants = expected[0]["spec"]["configuration"]["users"]["si_snode/grants/query"]
    if READ_ON_S3 in grants or any(line.strip() == SNODE_GRANT_COMMENT for line in lines):
        fail(f"{path}: restore grant/comment already exists; reconcile the prior edit")
    engines = [i for i in items if re.fullmatch(r'\s+- "GRANT TABLE ENGINE ON [A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9]*"', lines[i].rstrip("\n"))]
    if not engines:
        fail(f"{path}: no reviewed P2 engine grant anchor; stop")
    expected = copy.deepcopy(expected)
    expected[0]["spec"]["configuration"]["users"]["si_snode/grants/query"] = grants + [READ_ON_S3]
    # The existing P2 text formatter keeps ordinary comments while rebuilding engine lines.
    # Keep its canonical comment position; the SQL grant itself remains the last item.
    updated = list(lines)
    updated[items[-1] + 1:items[-1] + 1] = [f'{item_indent}- "{READ_ON_S3}"\n']
    updated[engines[0]:engines[0]] = [f"{item_indent}{SNODE_GRANT_COMMENT}\n"]
    write_checked(path, old, "".join(updated), expected)
    print(f"{path}: {expected[0]['metadata']['name']} si_snode/grants/query gains \"{READ_ON_S3}\" ({len(grants)} -> {len(grants) + 1} grants)")


def access_grant(args):
    (path,) = args
    old = read(path)
    lines = old.splitlines(keepends=True)
    top = find_key(lines, 0, "clickhouse")
    end = block_end(lines, top, 0)
    access = find_key(lines, 2, "access", top + 1, end)
    access_end = block_end(lines, access, 2)
    expected = docs(old, path)
    if len(expected) != 1:
        fail(f"{path} is not one YAML document")
    current = expected[0]["clickhouse"]["access"]
    if not isinstance(current, dict) or type(current.get("snodeRestoreGrant")) is not bool or current["snodeRestoreGrant"] is not False:
        fail(f"{path}: clickhouse.access.snodeRestoreGrant must be the existing boolean false")
    hits = [i for i in range(access + 1, access_end) if re.match(r"^    snodeRestoreGrant:", lines[i])]
    if len(hits) != 1 or lines[hits[0]] != "    snodeRestoreGrant: false\n":
        fail(f"{path}: expected one canonical snodeRestoreGrant: false line")
    updated = list(lines)
    updated[hits[0]] = "    snodeRestoreGrant: true\n"
    expected = copy.deepcopy(expected)
    expected[0]["clickhouse"]["access"]["snodeRestoreGrant"] = True
    write_checked(path, old, "".join(updated), expected)
    print(f"{path}: clickhouse.access.snodeRestoreGrant: false -> true")


def sha(text):
    return hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest()


def rebuild_on(args):
    path, backup, save = args
    if not BACKUP_NAME.fullmatch(backup):
        fail(f"backup {backup!r} is not <YYYYMMDDThhmmssZ>-full|incr")
    if os.path.lexists(save):
        fail(f"{save} exists: rebuild-on ran already")
    old = read(path)
    if "rebuildSafe" in old:
        fail(f"{path} mentions rebuildSafe already")
    lines = old.splitlines(keepends=True)
    top = find_key(lines, 0, "storageIntegrity")
    end = block_end(lines, top, 0)
    snode = find_key(lines, 2, "snode", top + 1, end)
    at = block_end(lines, snode, 2)
    expected = docs(old, path)
    if len(expected) != 1:
        fail(f"{path} is not one YAML document")
    expected = copy.deepcopy(expected)
    expected[0]["storageIntegrity"]["snode"]["rebuildSafe"] = {
        "enabled": True, "backup": backup, "restoreKeySecret": {"name": RESTORE_SECRET}}
    block = fill(REBUILD_BLOCK, BACKUP=backup)
    new = "".join(lines[:at]) + block + "".join(lines[at:])
    # Reserve the receipt path before touching the source; symlinks/races cannot redirect it.
    # Any later failure retains an incomplete receipt and requires reconciliation, never silent retry.
    fd = os.open(save, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL, 0o600)
    with os.fdopen(fd, "w") as receipt:
        write_checked(path, old, new, expected)
        receipt.write(json.dumps({"file": path, "line": at, "block": block, "before": sha(old), "after": sha(new)}) + "\n")
        receipt.flush()
        os.fsync(receipt.fileno())
    print(f"{path}: storageIntegrity.snode.rebuildSafe on, backup {backup} (lines {at + 1}-{at + block.count(chr(10))}); saved to {save}")


def rebuild_off(args):
    path, save = args
    record = json.loads(read(save))
    if not isinstance(record, dict) or set(record) != {"file", "line", "block", "before", "after"} or type(record["line"]) is not int or record["line"] < 0 or not isinstance(record["block"], str) or any(not isinstance(record[k], str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", record[k]) for k in ("before", "after")):
        fail("malformed immutable rebuild edit receipt")
    if record.get("file") != path:
        fail(f"{save} is for {record.get('file')}, not {path}")
    old = read(path)
    if sha(old) != record["after"]:
        fail(f"{path} is not the file rebuild-on wrote (sha256 differs): it changed since")
    lines = old.splitlines(keepends=True)
    at, block = record["line"], record["block"]
    n = block.count("\n")
    if "".join(lines[at:at + n]) != block:
        fail(f"{path}: lines {at + 1}-{at + n} are not the block rebuild-on inserted")
    new = "".join(lines[:at]) + "".join(lines[at + n:])
    if sha(new) != record["before"]:
        fail(f"{path}: removing the block does not give back the file rebuild-on read")
    expected = copy.deepcopy(docs(old, path))
    del expected[0]["storageIntegrity"]["snode"]["rebuildSafe"]
    write_checked(path, old, new, expected)
    print(f"{path}: storageIntegrity.snode.rebuildSafe removed (lines {at + 1}-{at + n}); the file is byte for byte the one before rebuild-on")


def module_constants(text, path):
    try:
        tree = ast.parse(text, path)
    except SyntaxError as err:
        fail(f"{path} does not parse: {err}")
    found = {}
    for stmt in tree.body:
        if isinstance(stmt, ast.Assign) and len(stmt.targets) == 1 and isinstance(stmt.targets[0], ast.Name):
            found.setdefault(stmt.targets[0].id, []).append(stmt)
    return tree, found


def resolve(node, found, depth=0):
    if isinstance(node, ast.Name) and depth < 5 and len(found.get(node.id, [])) == 1:
        return resolve(found[node.id][0].value, found, depth + 1)
    return ast.literal_eval(node)


def splice(text, start, end, replacement):
    """Replace the span (line, col)-(line, col) of ast positions (1-based lines) in text."""
    lines = text.splitlines(keepends=True)
    offsets = [0]
    for line in lines:
        offsets.append(offsets[-1] + len(line))

    def at(pos):
        line, col = pos
        return offsets[line - 1] + len(lines[line - 1].encode()[:col].decode())

    return text[:at(start)] + replacement + text[at(end):]


def check_rest(old_tree, new_text, path, name):
    new_tree, new_found = module_constants(new_text, path)
    old_rest = [ast.dump(s) for s in old_tree.body if not (isinstance(s, ast.Assign) and len(s.targets) == 1 and isinstance(s.targets[0], ast.Name) and s.targets[0].id == name)]
    new_rest = [ast.dump(s) for s in new_tree.body if not (isinstance(s, ast.Assign) and len(s.targets) == 1 and isinstance(s.targets[0], ast.Name) and s.targets[0].id == name)]
    if old_rest != new_rest:
        fail(f"{path}: the edit changes more than {name}")
    return new_found


def one_constant(found, name, path):
    stmts = found.get(name, [])
    if len(stmts) != 1:
        fail(f"{path}: expected one top-level assignment of {name}, found {len(stmts)}")
    return stmts[0]


def image_constant(args):
    path, name, old_image, new_image = args
    for image in (old_image, new_image):
        if not IMAGE_RE.fullmatch(image):
            fail(f"{image!r} is not ghcr.io/sentioxyz/sentio-node:sha-<40 hex>@sha256:<64 hex>")
    text = read(path)
    tree, found = module_constants(text, path)
    stmt = one_constant(found, name, path)
    current = resolve(stmt.value, found)
    if current != old_image:
        fail(f"{path}: {name} is {current!r}, not {old_image!r}")
    repo_tag, digest = new_image.split("@")
    replacement = f'{name} = (\n    "{repo_tag}"\n    "@{digest}"\n)'
    new = splice(text, (stmt.lineno, stmt.col_offset), (stmt.end_lineno, stmt.end_col_offset), replacement)
    new_found = check_rest(tree, new, path, name)
    if resolve(one_constant(new_found, name, path).value, new_found) != new_image:
        fail(f"{path}: {name} does not read {new_image} after the edit")
    Path(path).write_text(new)
    print(f"{name}: {old_image.split(':', 1)[1][:16]}… -> {new_image.split(':', 1)[1][:16]}…")


def constant(args):
    path, name, key_src, old_src, new_src = args
    try:
        old_value, new_value = ast.literal_eval(old_src), ast.literal_eval(new_src)
        key = None if key_src == "-" else ast.literal_eval(key_src)
    except (ValueError, SyntaxError) as err:
        fail(f"OLD, NEW and KEY must be Python literals: {err}")
    text = read(path)
    tree, found = module_constants(text, path)
    stmt = one_constant(found, name, path)
    if key is None:
        node = stmt.value
        label = name
    else:
        if not isinstance(stmt.value, ast.Dict):
            fail(f"{path}: {name} is not a dict literal")
        hits = [v for k, v in zip(stmt.value.keys, stmt.value.values) if k is not None and ast.literal_eval(k) == key]
        if len(hits) != 1:
            keys = [ast.literal_eval(k) for k in stmt.value.keys if k is not None]
            fail(f"{path}: {name} has {len(hits)} entries {key!r}; its keys are {keys}")
        node = hits[0]
        label = f"{name}[{key!r}]"
    try:
        current = resolve(node, found)
        before = None if key is None else ast.literal_eval(stmt.value)
    except ValueError:
        fail(f"{path}: {label} is not a literal this task can read")
    if type(current) is not type(old_value) or current != old_value:
        fail(f"{path}: {label} is {current!r}, not {old_value!r}")
    new = splice(text, (node.lineno, node.col_offset), (node.end_lineno, node.end_col_offset), new_src)
    new_found = check_rest(tree, new, path, name)
    after = one_constant(new_found, name, path).value
    try:
        got = resolve(after, new_found) if key is None else ast.literal_eval(after)
    except ValueError:
        fail(f"{path}: {label} does not read as a literal after the edit")
    want = new_value if key is None else {**before, key: new_value}
    if got != want:
        fail(f"{path}: {label} does not read {new_value!r} after the edit, or another entry changed")
    Path(path).write_text(new)
    print(f"{label}: {old_value!r} -> {new_value!r}")


def preflight(args):
    p3_image, p4_image, arbiter_digest, chi_node = args
    sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(TEST_RENDER).resolve().parent))
    sys.argv = [TEST_RENDER]
    import test_render as t  # noqa: E402  (this checkout's tests, read-only)

    problems = []

    def need(ok, message):
        if not ok:
            problems.append(message)

    def names(*wanted):
        missing = [n for n in wanted if not hasattr(t, n)]
        need(not missing, f"test_render.py defines none of {missing}")
        return all(hasattr(t, n) for n in wanted)

    if names("DEVNET2_STAGE3_P4_SOURCE_IMAGE", "STAGE3_HOST_IMAGES", "WRITER_AUTHORIZATION_IMAGES", "REPLICA_READ_HOST_IMAGES", "REBUILD_SAFE_IMAGES"):
        need(t.DEVNET2_STAGE3_P4_SOURCE_IMAGE == p4_image, f"DEVNET2_STAGE3_P4_SOURCE_IMAGE is {t.DEVNET2_STAGE3_P4_SOURCE_IMAGE!r}, not {p4_image!r}")
        for group in ("STAGE3_HOST_IMAGES", "WRITER_AUTHORIZATION_IMAGES", "REPLICA_READ_HOST_IMAGES", "REBUILD_SAFE_IMAGES"):
            need(p4_image in getattr(t, group), f"{group} does not list the P4 host image")
    if names("FRESH_SOURCE_IMAGE", "INDEXER_B_SOURCE_IMAGE", "INDEXER_C_SOURCE_IMAGE"):
        for n in ("FRESH_SOURCE_IMAGE", "INDEXER_B_SOURCE_IMAGE", "INDEXER_C_SOURCE_IMAGE"):
            need(getattr(t, n) == p3_image, f"{n} is {getattr(t, n)!r}, not the P3 host image")
    if names("DEVNET2_ARBITER_DIGEST"):
        need(t.DEVNET2_ARBITER_DIGEST == arbiter_digest, f"DEVNET2_ARBITER_DIGEST is {t.DEVNET2_ARBITER_DIGEST}, not ARBITER_DIGEST {arbiter_digest}")
    if names("DEVNET2_REBUILD_SAFE"):
        need(set(HOST_RELEASES) <= set(t.DEVNET2_REBUILD_SAFE) and all(v is None for v in t.DEVNET2_REBUILD_SAFE.values()),
             f"DEVNET2_REBUILD_SAFE is {t.DEVNET2_REBUILD_SAFE!r}, not None for every release (the three hosts among them)")
    if names("DEVNET2_SNODE_RESTORE_GRANT"):
        need(set(t.DEVNET2_SNODE_RESTORE_GRANT) == set(SI_CHIS) and not any(t.DEVNET2_SNODE_RESTORE_GRANT.values()),
             f"DEVNET2_SNODE_RESTORE_GRANT is {t.DEVNET2_SNODE_RESTORE_GRANT!r}, not False for each CHI of {list(SI_CHIS)}")
    if names("DEVNET2_INTERSERVER_STEP"):
        need(set(t.DEVNET2_INTERSERVER_STEP.values()) == {2}, f"DEVNET2_INTERSERVER_STEP is {t.DEVNET2_INTERSERVER_STEP!r}: the hardening's step 2 is not everywhere")
    if names("DEVNET2_NETWORK_POLICY_MODE", "KEEPER_INGRESS_MODE"):
        need(set(t.DEVNET2_NETWORK_POLICY_MODE.values()) == {"enforce"}, f"DEVNET2_NETWORK_POLICY_MODE is {t.DEVNET2_NETWORK_POLICY_MODE!r}")
        need(t.KEEPER_INGRESS_MODE == "enforce", f"KEEPER_INGRESS_MODE is {t.KEEPER_INGRESS_MODE!r}")
    if names("DEVNET2_NODE_PINS"):
        pin = t.DEVNET2_NODE_PINS.get(("storage-integrity-si-v2-indexer-c", "source"))
        need(pin == chi_node, f"DEVNET2_NODE_PINS pins indexer-c's source to {pin!r}, not INDEXER_C_CHI_NODE {chi_node!r}")
    if problems:
        for p in problems:
            print("preflight: " + p)
        fail(f"{len(problems)} constant(s) are not as this task expects")
    print(f"preflight: P4 host image reviewed in STAGE3_HOST_IMAGES, WRITER_AUTHORIZATION_IMAGES, REPLICA_READ_HOST_IMAGES and REBUILD_SAFE_IMAGES; "
          f"the three host mirrors at the P3 image; DEVNET2_ARBITER_DIGEST {arbiter_digest}; rebuild-safe off and the restore grant off everywhere; "
          f"interserver step 2, every policy and the Keeper allowlist enforced; indexer-c's source pinned to {chi_node}")


COMMANDS = {
    "arbiter-pin": (arbiter_pin, 9), "host-pin": (host_pin, 8), "fresh-example": (fresh_example, 7),
    "snode-grant": (snode_grant, 1), "access-grant": (access_grant, 1), "rebuild-on": (rebuild_on, 3),
    "rebuild-off": (rebuild_off, 2), "image-constant": (image_constant, 4), "constant": (constant, 5),
    "preflight": (preflight, 4),
}
if len(sys.argv) < 2 or sys.argv[1] not in COMMANDS:
    fail("usage: p4r-edit.py " + "|".join(COMMANDS) + " ...")
fn, argc = COMMANDS[sys.argv[1]]
if len(sys.argv) - 2 != argc:
    fail(f"{sys.argv[1]} takes {argc} argument(s), not {len(sys.argv) - 2}")
fn(sys.argv[2:])
```

`p4r-check.py`, the read-only render, init-container and record checks:

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Read-only checks of Plan S3-D Task 56; none prints a password or a key.

  p4r-check.py rebuild-render RENDER BACKUP IMAGE INDEXER_ID
      RENDER is release sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-c rendered from HEAD with
      rebuildSafe on: the host StatefulSet carries the init container
      si-rebuild-safe on IMAGE running "storage-integrity rebuild-safe
      --config-path <file> --backup BACKUP" (no --dry-run), its ClickHouse
      password and both S3 key halves only from Secrets (the halves from
      storage-integrity-si-v2-restore-c), the host's /data and /config; the
      file it reads is an indexer config with storage_integrity enabled and a
      storage_integrity.backup naming INDEXER_ID and the bucket of the
      release's own backup job (ConfigMap sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-c-si-backup).
  p4r-check.py rebuild-render-off RENDER
      the same release rendered with rebuildSafe off: no si-rebuild-safe init
      container, no rebuild-safe argument and no storage_integrity.backup in
      the host's node config.
  p4r-check.py initc
      reads a StatefulSet (kubectl get -o json) on stdin and prints its init
      containers: name, image, command and arguments, and where each env value
      comes from (secretKeyRef name/key, or "literal" for an inline value,
      never the value).
  p4r-check.py record LEDGER_ENV RECORD_ENV SI_BACKUP OUT
      writes the run record of Appendix C (one paragraph, then "- " lines)
      from ledger.env, record.env and the runbook's evidence files.
"""

import json
import os
import posixpath
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

import yaml

RELEASE = "sentio-node-devnet2-indexer-c"
INIT = "si-rebuild-safe"
RESTORE_SECRET = "storage-integrity-si-v2-restore-c"
KEY_ENVS = {"STORAGE_INTEGRITY_S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID": "access-id", "STORAGE_INTEGRITY_S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY": "secret"}
PASSWORD_ENV = "STORAGE_INTEGRITY_CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD"


def fail(message):
    sys.exit(f"p4r-check: {message}; stop")


LEDGER_NAMES = '''ARBITER_TAG ARBITER_DIGEST INDEXER_C_ID INDEXER_C_CHI_NODE INDEXER_C_HOST_NODE P1_END UNSAFE_INC_ROOT HG_TAG_P3 SN_COMMIT_P3 SN_DIGEST_P3 P3_END PROTO_TAG_P4 CORE_TAG_P4 P4_MECHANICS ARBITER_TAG_P4 ARBITER_DIGEST_P4 SN_COMMIT_P4 SN_DIGEST_P4 P4_PR HARDENING_END DEVNET2_FAILURE_DOMAINS'''.split()

def typed_ledger(path):
    import datetime
    values = {}
    for line in Path(path).read_text().splitlines():
        name, sep, value = line.partition('=')
        if not sep or name not in LEDGER_NAMES or name in values or not value:
            fail('malformed, unknown, duplicate or empty ledger input')
        values[name] = value
    if set(values) != set(LEDGER_NAMES):
        fail('ledger input does not contain the exact declared names')
    for name, value in values.items():
        if name in ('P1_END', 'P3_END', 'P4_MECHANICS', 'HARDENING_END'):
            try:
                if not re.fullmatch(r'[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}', value):
                    raise ValueError()
                datetime.date.fromisoformat(value)
            except ValueError:
                fail('invalid UTC ledger date')
        elif 'DIGEST' in name:
            if not re.fullmatch(r'sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}', value):
                fail('invalid image digest')
        elif name.startswith('SN_COMMIT'):
            if not re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{40}', value):
                fail('invalid full source commit')
        elif name == 'INDEXER_C_ID':
            if not re.fullmatch(r'0|[1-9][0-9]*', value) or int(value) > 2**64-1:
                fail('invalid indexer id')
        elif name == 'P4_PR':
            if not re.fullmatch(r'[1-9][0-9]*', value):
                fail('invalid P4 pull request number')
        elif name.endswith('_NODE'):
            if len(value) > 253 or not re.fullmatch(r'[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9.-]*[a-z0-9])?', value):
                fail('invalid node hostname')
        elif name == 'UNSAFE_INC_ROOT':
            if value != '/storage-integrity/devnet2/devnet2-si-v2/sentio/0/unsafe_inc':
                fail('invalid public Keeper root')
        elif name == 'DEVNET2_FAILURE_DOMAINS':
            entries = value.split(',')
            if len(entries) != 3 or any(not re.fullmatch(r'(0|[1-9][0-9]*)=node:[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]*', p) for p in entries):
                fail('invalid three-source failure-domain roster')
            ids = [int(p.partition('=')[0]) for p in entries]
            hosts = [p.partition('node:')[2] for p in entries]
            if ids != sorted(set(ids)) or len(set(hosts)) != 3:
                fail('unordered/duplicate failure-domain roster')
        elif not re.fullmatch(r'v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+', value):
            fail('invalid release tag')
    pair = values['INDEXER_C_ID'] + '=node:' + values['INDEXER_C_CHI_NODE']
    if pair not in values['DEVNET2_FAILURE_DOMAINS'].split(','):
        fail('failure-domain roster does not bind source ClickHouse node')
    return values

def ledger():
    return typed_ledger(HERE / 'ledger.env')

def ledger_check(args):
    if len(args) != 1:
        fail('ledger-check takes one ledger file')
    typed_ledger(args[0])
    print('ledger: exact %d declared values validated' % len(LEDGER_NAMES))

def strict_json(text):
    def pairs(items):
        value = {}
        for key, item in items:
            if key in value:
                fail("duplicate JSON key in public evidence")
            value[key] = item
        return value
    return json.loads(text, object_pairs_hook=pairs)

def uint(value, label, maximum=(1 << 64) - 1):
    if type(value) is not int or not 0 <= value <= maximum:
        fail(label + " must be an unsigned integer")
    return value

def strict_report(path, mode):
    if mode not in ("dry", "real"):
        fail("report mode must be dry or real")
    raw = Path(path).read_text().splitlines()
    if not raw or any(not line.strip() for line in raw):
        fail("missing or blank report row")
    try:
        objects = [strict_json(line) for line in raw]
    except (ValueError, TypeError):
        fail("report contains non-JSON data")
    if any(not isinstance(row, dict) for row in objects):
        fail("report row is not an object")
    final_fields = {"phase", "dry_run", "already_rebuilt", "tables", "partitions", "parts", "from_own_unsafe", "from_object_store", "missing"}
    done = objects[-1]
    if set(done) != final_fields or done["phase"] != "done" or type(done["dry_run"]) is not bool or type(done["already_rebuilt"]) is not bool or done["dry_run"] != (mode == "dry"):
        fail("wrong report final schema or execution mode")
    if mode == "dry" and done["already_rebuilt"]:
        fail("dry run cannot report already_rebuilt")
    for field in final_fields - {"phase", "dry_run", "already_rebuilt"}:
        uint(done[field], "report total " + field)
    fences, partitions, identities, paths = [], [], set(), set()
    phase = "fence"
    for row in objects[:-1]:
        if row.get("phase") == "fence":
            if mode == "dry" or phase != "fence" or set(row) != {"phase", "table_id", "path", "present", "dropped"}:
                fail("unexpected fence schema/order in report")
            if not isinstance(row["table_id"], str) or not row["table_id"] or not isinstance(row["path"], str) or not row["path"].startswith("/sentio/") or "/unsafe/" not in row["path"]:
                fail("invalid pre-purge fence identity/path")
            if type(row["present"]) is not bool or type(row["dropped"]) is not bool or row["dropped"] and not row["present"]:
                fail("invalid fence flags")
            if row["table_id"] in identities or row["path"] in paths:
                fail("duplicate fence identity/path")
            identities.add(row["table_id"]); paths.add(row["path"]); fences.append(row)
        else:
            phase = "partitions"
            fields = {"phase", "table_id", "partition_id", "publish_seq", "parts", "from_own_unsafe", "from_object_store", "missing", "root"}
            if set(row) != fields or row["phase"] != ("plan" if mode == "dry" else "restore"):
                fail("wrong report partition schema or mode")
            if any(not isinstance(row[k], str) or not row[k] for k in ("table_id", "partition_id", "root")):
                fail("invalid report partition identity/root")
            for k in ("publish_seq", "parts", "from_own_unsafe", "from_object_store"):
                uint(row[k], "report partition " + k)
            if row["missing"] != [] or row["from_own_unsafe"] + row["from_object_store"] > row["parts"]:
                fail("uncovered or impossible report partition")
            if mode == "dry" and row["from_own_unsafe"] + row["from_object_store"] != row["parts"]:
                fail("dry run must cover every target part: local hg_safe is not retained through loss")
            # Only real restore subtracts already-held local hg_safe parts (actual rebuild.go planPartition).
            ident = (row["table_id"], row["partition_id"])
            if any((p["table_id"], p["partition_id"]) == ident for p in partitions):
                fail("duplicate report partition")
            partitions.append(row)
    sums = {k: sum(p[k] for p in partitions) for k in ("parts", "from_own_unsafe", "from_object_store")}
    expected = {"tables": len({p["table_id"] for p in partitions}), "partitions": len(partitions), **sums, "missing": 0}
    if any(done[k] != n for k, n in expected.items()):
        fail("report totals do not match its complete partition census")
    if done["already_rebuilt"] and (fences or done["from_own_unsafe"] or done["from_object_store"]):
        fail("already_rebuilt cannot claim a new fence or fetched parts")
    return {"fences": fences, "partitions": partitions, "done": done}

def strict_rto(path, end_path):
    from datetime import datetime, timezone
    labels = ['loss', 'lost', 'recreated', 'rebuilt', 'released', 'accepted']
    marks = []
    for line in Path(path).read_text().splitlines():
        fields = line.split('\t')
        if len(fields) != 3 or not re.fullmatch(r'0|[1-9][0-9]*', fields[2]):
            fail('malformed RTO mark')
        label, stamp, epoch_text = fields
        epoch = int(epoch_text)
        try:
            if not re.fullmatch(r'[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}T[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}Z', stamp):
                raise ValueError()
            moment = datetime.strptime(stamp, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ').replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
            if int(moment.timestamp()) != epoch:
                raise ValueError()
        except (ValueError, OverflowError):
            fail('RTO UTC timestamp and epoch disagree')
        marks.append((label, stamp, epoch))
    if [m[0] for m in marks] != labels or any(a[2] > b[2] for a,b in zip(marks, marks[1:])):
        fail('RTO marks are incomplete, duplicate or out of order')
    end = {}
    for line in Path(end_path).read_text().splitlines():
        name, sep, value = line.partition('=')
        if name in ('P4_REBUILD_RTO', 'P4_END'):
            if not sep or name in end:
                fail('duplicate or malformed end record')
            end[name] = value
    if set(end) != {'P4_REBUILD_RTO', 'P4_END'} or not re.fullmatch(r'0|[1-9][0-9]*', end['P4_REBUILD_RTO']):
        fail('missing or invalid end record')
    if int(end['P4_REBUILD_RTO']) != marks[-1][2] - marks[0][2]:
        fail('recorded RTO differs from exact loss-to-accepted interval')
    try:
        day = datetime.strptime(end['P4_END'], '%Y-%m-%d').date()
        if day.isoformat() != end['P4_END'] or day < datetime.fromtimestamp(marks[-1][2], timezone.utc).date():
            raise ValueError()
    except ValueError:
        fail('invalid end date or end before acceptance')
    return marks, end

def strict_volumes(path, source_node, before_path):
    rows = [line.split('\t') for line in Path(path).read_text().splitlines()]
    before = [line.split('\t') for line in Path(before_path).read_text().splitlines()]
    if len(rows) != 3 or len(before) != 3 or any(len(r) != 6 for r in rows+before):
        fail('volume evidence must contain exactly three six-column rows')
    for roster in (rows, before):
        if any(not r[0] or not r[1] or r[4] != source_node for r in roster) or len({r[0] for r in roster}) != 3 or len({r[1] for r in roster}) != 3:
            fail('volume claims/volumes are duplicate or on another source node')
    if {(r[0],r[1]) for r in rows} != {(r[0],r[1]) for r in before}:
        fail('isolated volume identities differ from pre-loss census')
    if any(r[2:4] != ['Retain', 'Released'] or r[5] != 'true' for r in rows):
        fail('old volume is not Retain, Released and fenced true')
    return rows

def required_evidence(directory, names):
    for name in names:
        p = directory/name
        if not p.is_file() or p.is_symlink() or not p.stat().st_size:
            fail('missing, empty or symlinked required evidence: '+name)

RECORD_NAMES = set('TESTS REPLAY_DATE DRILL_START SETTLES BACKUP_NAME DRY_RUN_PARTITIONS LOSS_UTC REBUILD_LINE RELEASE_UTC P4_REBUILD_RTO P4_END'.split()) | {'PROBE_'+x+'_'+when for x in 'ABC' for when in ('BEFORE','AFTER')}

def record_values(path):
    values = {}
    for line in Path(path).read_text().splitlines():
        name, sep, value = line.partition('=')
        if not sep or name not in RECORD_NAMES or name in values:
            fail('unknown, malformed or repeated record key')
        validate_record_value(name, value)
        values[name] = value
    return values

def validate_record_value(name, value):
    from datetime import datetime
    if name not in RECORD_NAMES or not value or any(ord(c) < 32 or ord(c) == 127 for c in value):
        fail('invalid record key/value')
    if name in ('TESTS','SETTLES','DRY_RUN_PARTITIONS','P4_REBUILD_RTO'):
        if not re.fullmatch(r'0|[1-9][0-9]*',value) or int(value) > 2**64-1 or name == 'TESTS' and int(value) == 0:
            fail('invalid unsigned record count')
    elif name in ('REPLAY_DATE','P4_END'):
        try:
            day=datetime.strptime(value,'%Y-%m-%d').date()
            if day.isoformat()!=value:raise ValueError()
        except ValueError:fail('invalid record date')
    elif name in ('DRILL_START','LOSS_UTC','RELEASE_UTC'):
        try:
            if datetime.strptime(value,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ').strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ')!=value:raise ValueError()
        except ValueError:fail('invalid UTC record time')
    elif name.startswith('PROBE_'):
        if value != ('Code: 497' if name.endswith('_BEFORE') else 'allowed'):
            fail('invalid recorded grant probe outcome')
    elif name=='BACKUP_NAME' and not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.:/-]*',value):
        fail('invalid backup name token')
    elif name=='REBUILD_LINE' and value!='rebuild: already rebuilt, nothing written; this report does not re-prove a historical fence' and not re.fullmatch(r'rebuild: [0-9]+ fence lines, [0-9]+ stale replicas dropped, [0-9]+ partitions restored, [0-9]+ parts from the own hg_unsafe replica, [0-9]+ from the object store',value):
        fail('invalid rebuild summary')

def record_value(args):
    path, name, value = args
    validate_record_value(name,value)
    values=record_values(path)
    if name in values:fail('record key exists: unknown/repeated attempt requires review')
    fd=os.open(path,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_APPEND)
    with os.fdopen(fd,'w') as stream:stream.write(name+'='+value+'\n')
    print('recorded '+name+'='+value)

def record_read(args):
    path,name=args
    values=record_values(path)
    if name not in values:fail('required record key is missing')
    print(values[name])

def partition_census(path):
    out = {}
    for line in Path(path).read_text().splitlines():
        row = strict_json(line)
        if not isinstance(row,dict) or any(not isinstance(row.get(k),str) or not row[k] for k in ('table_id','partition_id','base_partition_root')):
            fail('invalid public partition-state identity/root')
        ident=(row['table_id'],row['partition_id'])
        if ident in out:fail('duplicate partition-state identity')
        for k in ('publish_seq','last_acked_promotion_seq','unacked_promotion_seq'):uint(row.get(k),'partition-state '+k)
        parts=row.get('safe_parts')
        if parts is None:parts=[]
        if not isinstance(parts,list) or any(not isinstance(p,str) or not p for p in parts) or len(parts)!=len(set(parts)) or row['unacked_promotion_seq']!=0:
            fail('invalid or unsettled public partition state')
        out[ident]=(row['publish_seq'],row['base_partition_root'],tuple(sorted(parts)),row['last_acked_promotion_seq'])
    if not out:fail('empty before-loss partition-state census')
    return out

def safe_multiset(path):
    from collections import Counter
    rows=[]
    for line in Path(path).read_text().splitlines():
        row=line.split('\t')
        if len(row)!=4 or any(not v for v in row[:3]) or not re.fullmatch(r'0|[1-9][0-9]*',row[3]):
            fail('malformed four-field physical safe-parts census')
        uint(int(row[3]),'safe part rows');rows.append(tuple(row))
    if not rows:fail('empty physical safe-parts census cannot prove this drill')
    return Counter(rows)

def bind_rebuild_inventory(directory):
    b=Path(directory)
    baseline=partition_census(b/'partstates-c-before.jsonl')
    rebuilt=partition_census(b/'partstates-c-rebuild.jsonl')
    if baseline!=rebuilt:fail('partition state moved or changed during quarantined rebuild')
    before=safe_multiset(b/'safe-parts-c-before.tsv');after=safe_multiset(b/'safe-parts-c-after.tsv')
    if before!=after:fail('restored physical hash/rows inventory differs from pre-loss multiset')
    expected={ident:(p[0],p[1],len(p[2])) for ident,p in baseline.items() if p[2]}
    if not expected:fail('drill baseline has no published safe parts')
    physical={tid.replace('.','__'):tid for tid,_ in baseline}
    if len(physical)!=len({tid for tid,_ in baseline}):fail('ambiguous logical-to-physical table identity')
    counts={}
    for (table,partition,hash_value,rows),count in before.items():
        if table not in physical:fail('physical safe inventory contains an unknown table')
        ident=(physical[table],partition);counts[ident]=counts.get(ident,0)+count
    if counts!={ident:value[2] for ident,value in expected.items()}:
        fail('physical inventory does not contain exactly the baseline safe-parts census')
    dry=strict_report(b/'dry-run.jsonl','dry');real=strict_report(b/'rebuild-report.jsonl','real')
    for report in (dry,real):
        got={(r['table_id'],r['partition_id']):(r['publish_seq'],r['root'],r['parts']) for r in report['partitions']}
        if got!=expected:fail('report partition roster/root/publish sequence/part count differs from frozen baseline')
    if real['done']['already_rebuilt']:
        required_evidence(b,['rebuild-first-fence.jsonl','rebuild-first-fence.receipt.json'])
        fences=strict_report(b/'rebuild-first-fence.jsonl','real')['fences']
    else:
        fences=real['fences']
    physical_roster=Path(b/'snode-3-tables.txt').read_text().splitlines()
    if not physical_roster or any(not t or not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9_]+',t) for t in physical_roster) or len(physical_roster)!=len(set(physical_roster)):
        fail('invalid/duplicate owned-table Keeper roster')
    if {r['table_id'].replace('.','__') for r in fences}!=set(physical_roster):
        fail('rebuild fence roster differs from all owned Keeper tables')
    if any(r['path']!='/sentio/0/unsafe/'+r['table_id'].replace('.','__') for r in fences):
        fail('rebuild fence path is not the exact pinned public table path')
    if not {tid for tid,_ in expected}<={r['table_id'] for r in fences}:
        fail('restored partition table is absent from the owned-table fence')
    return dry,real

def bind_dry_baseline(args):
    report_path,state_path=args
    states=partition_census(state_path)
    expected={ident:(row[0],row[1],len(row[2])) for ident,row in states.items() if row[2]}
    report=strict_report(report_path,'dry')
    got={(p['table_id'],p['partition_id']):(p['publish_seq'],p['root'],p['parts']) for p in report['partitions']}
    if not expected or got!=expected:
        fail('dry report does not cover exactly the quarantined nonempty safe-parts baseline')
    print('dry baseline: %d nonempty safe partitions, every root/publish sequence/part covered'%len(expected))

def disk_headroom(args):
    (path,)=args
    rows=[line.split('\t') for line in Path(path).read_text().splitlines()]
    used_rows=[r for r in rows if r[0]=='active_part_bytes'];disks=[r for r in rows if r[0]!='active_part_bytes']
    if len(used_rows)!=1 or len(used_rows[0])!=2 or not disks or any(len(r)!=5 for r in disks) or len({r[0] for r in disks})!=len(disks):
        fail('incomplete/duplicate active-parts or disk census')
    def decimal(value):
        if not re.fullmatch(r'0|[1-9][0-9]*',value):fail('disk count is not a canonical unsigned integer')
        return uint(int(value),'disk bytes')
    used=decimal(used_rows[0][1]);room=[]
    for name,path,free,total,keep in disks:
        free,total,keep=map(decimal,(free,total,keep))
        if not name or not path.startswith('/') or free>total or keep>total:fail('invalid public disk capacity/census')
        room.append(free-keep)
    needed=(used*6+4)//5
    if min(room)<needed:fail('insufficient disk headroom for retained old volumes and new data; ask the user')
    print('active parts %d bytes; tightest disk %d bytes above keep_free_space; needed %d (integer ceil 6/5)'%(used,min(room),needed))

def canonical_uint_text(value,label):
    if not isinstance(value,str) or not re.fullmatch(r'0|[1-9][0-9]*',value):fail(label+' is not a canonical decimal string')
    return uint(int(value),label)

def settle_terminal(path,indexer,generation,promotions):
    value=strict_json(Path(path).read_text())
    fields={'indexer_id','expected_generation','promotion_seqs','state','unacked_promotion_seqs','sends'}
    if not isinstance(value,dict) or set(value)!=fields:fail('settle CLI terminal schema differs from actual51 six-field result')
    if canonical_uint_text(value['indexer_id'],'settle indexer')!=indexer or canonical_uint_text(value['expected_generation'],'settle generation')!=generation:
        fail('settle terminal belongs to another indexer/generation')
    canonical_uint_text(value['sends'],'settle sends')
    seqs=value['promotion_seqs']
    if not isinstance(seqs,list) or not seqs:fail('settle terminal has no signed promotions')
    actual=[canonical_uint_text(seq,'settle promotion') for seq in seqs]
    if actual!=sorted(set(actual)) or actual!=promotions:fail('settle terminal list differs from exact requested promotions')
    if value['state']!='TRACK_SETTLE_STATE_SETTLED' or value['unacked_promotion_seqs']!=[]:
        fail('this settle did not settle all its requested promotions')
    # CLI internal polling binds started/final term, expiry, source, list and signed generation.
    # These fields are deliberately not invented in the six-field terminal JSON.
    return value

def completed_blocks(session, required, active=None):
    import hashlib
    t=Path(session);frozen=t/'frozen.json'
    manifest=strict_json(frozen.read_text())
    if not isinstance(manifest,dict) or set(manifest)!={'version','live','sources'} or manifest['version']!=1 or not isinstance(manifest['sources'],dict):
        fail('invalid frozen session manifest before recording')
    for name,expected in manifest['sources'].items():
        p=Path(name)
        if p.is_symlink() or not p.is_file() or hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()!=expected:
            fail('frozen session source/tool bytes changed before recording')
    source_hash=hashlib.sha256(frozen.read_bytes()).hexdigest();successful=set();active_seen=False
    for attempted in (t/'claims').glob('*.attempted'):
        if attempted.is_symlink():fail('symlinked attempt receipt')
        start=strict_json(attempted.read_text())
        if not isinstance(start,dict) or set(start)!={'file','sha256','source','started_unix'} or type(start['started_unix']) is not int or start['started_unix']<0:
            fail('malformed attempted receipt')
        p=Path(start['file']);metadata=Path(str(p)+'.json')
        if p.parent not in (t/'blocks',t/'user') or p.is_symlink() or metadata.is_symlink():fail('attempt is outside owned session blocks')
        meta=strict_json(metadata.read_text())
        if not isinstance(meta,dict) or set(meta)!={'file','sha256','operation','kind','source'} or meta['kind'] not in ('confirmed','read-only') or meta['file']!=str(p):
            fail('malformed bound block metadata')
        if any(not isinstance(meta[k],str) or not re.fullmatch(r'[0-9a-f]{64}',meta[k]) for k in ('sha256','operation','source')):
            fail('invalid block metadata hash')
        if hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()!=meta['sha256'] or start['sha256']!=meta['sha256'] or start['source']!=source_hash or meta['source']!=source_hash:
            fail('attempt/block/frozen source binding drift')
        key=meta['operation'] if meta['kind']=='confirmed' else hashlib.sha256(str(p).encode()).hexdigest()
        if attempted.name!=key+'.attempted':fail('attempt filename does not identify this semantic operation')
        done=attempted.with_suffix('.done')
        if not done.exists():
            if active is not None and str(p)==str(active):active_seen=True;continue
            if meta['kind']=='confirmed':fail('a confirmed attempt has no successful completion receipt; reconcile before recording')
            continue
        if done.is_symlink():fail('symlinked completion receipt')
        result=strict_json(done.read_text())
        if not isinstance(result,dict) or set(result)!={'file','sha256','source','exit_code'} or type(result['exit_code']) is not int or result['exit_code']!=0 or result['file']!=str(p) or result['sha256']!=meta['sha256'] or result['source']!=source_hash:
            fail('invalid successful completion receipt')
        successful.add(re.sub(r'^[0-9]{3}-','',p.stem))
    if active is not None and not active_seen:fail('recording is not inside its claimed active immutable task block')
    if not set(required)<=successful:fail('required reviewed blocks lack successful completion receipts')
    return successful

def validate_init_proof(value):
    from datetime import datetime
    fields={'pod_uid','container_id','started_at','finished_at','exit_code'}
    if not isinstance(value,dict) or set(value)!=fields or type(value['exit_code']) is not int or value['exit_code']!=0:
        fail('init termination evidence does not show the unique actual rebuild container exited zero')
    if any(not isinstance(value[k],str) or not value[k] or any(ord(c)<32 for c in value[k]) for k in fields-{'exit_code'}):
        fail('invalid public init identity/timestamp')
    try:
        start=datetime.fromisoformat(value['started_at'].replace('Z','+00:00'));end=datetime.fromisoformat(value['finished_at'].replace('Z','+00:00'))
        if start.tzinfo is None or end.tzinfo is None or end<start:raise ValueError()
    except ValueError:fail('invalid init termination interval')
    return value

def validate_first_fence(directory,owner):
    import hashlib
    b=Path(directory);required_evidence(b,['rebuild-first-fence.jsonl','rebuild-first-fence.receipt.json','rebuild-init-proof.json','keeper-before.txt','partstates-c-before.jsonl','backup-name.txt'])
    receipt=strict_json((b/'rebuild-first-fence.receipt.json').read_text())
    fields={'format','owner_indexer_id','backup','keeper_before_sha256','baseline_sha256','report_sha256','init'}
    if not isinstance(receipt,dict) or set(receipt)!=fields or receipt['format']!='si-p4-first-fence-v1' or type(receipt['owner_indexer_id']) is not int or receipt['owner_indexer_id']!=owner or receipt['backup']!=(b/'backup-name.txt').read_text().strip():
        fail('first-fence receipt belongs to another owner/backup or has malformed producer schema')
    for key,name in [('keeper_before_sha256','keeper-before.txt'),('baseline_sha256','partstates-c-before.jsonl'),('report_sha256','rebuild-first-fence.jsonl')]:
        if receipt[key]!=hashlib.sha256((b/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest():fail('first-fence custody hash drift')
    validate_init_proof(receipt['init']);validate_init_proof(strict_json((b/'rebuild-init-proof.json').read_text()))
    original=strict_report(b/'rebuild-first-fence.jsonl','real');current=strict_report(b/'rebuild-report.jsonl','real')
    if original['done']['already_rebuilt']:fail('prior already-rebuilt report cannot prove the original fence')
    states=partition_census(b/'partstates-c-before.jsonl');expected={k:(p[0],p[1],len(p[2])) for k,p in states.items() if p[2]}
    actual={(p['table_id'],p['partition_id']):(p['publish_seq'],p['root'],p['parts']) for p in original['partitions']}
    if actual!=expected:fail('archived first-fence report differs from the original safe baseline')
    keeper=(b/'keeper-before.txt').read_text().splitlines()
    if not keeper or keeper[0]!='table\treplica\thost\tactive':fail('invalid pre-loss Keeper census header')
    rows=[r.split('\t') for r in keeper[1:]]
    if any(len(r)!=4 for r in rows):fail('invalid pre-loss Keeper census row')
    old={r[0] for r in rows if r[1]=='snode-3'}
    dropped={r['path'].rsplit('/',1)[-1] for r in original['fences'] if r['dropped']}
    if not old or dropped!=old:fail('archived first fence does not account for the exact old Keeper replica roster')
    if not current['done']['already_rebuilt'] and hashlib.sha256((b/'rebuild-report.jsonl').read_bytes()).hexdigest()!=receipt['report_sha256']:
        fail('different normal report cannot replace first-fence custody')
    return original

def public_json_lines(path):
    values=[]
    for line in Path(path).read_text().splitlines():
        if line.startswith(('{','[')):
            values.append(strict_json(line))
    return values

def track_snapshot(path,indexer,quarantined):
    needed={'indexer_id','published','applied_promotion_seq','generation','quarantined','rejected'}
    rows=[v for v in public_json_lines(path) if isinstance(v,dict) and needed<=set(v)]
    if len(rows)!=1:fail('missing or ambiguous exact si_track evidence')
    row=rows[0]
    for key in needed-{'quarantined','rejected'}:uint(row[key],'track '+key)
    if row['indexer_id']!=indexer or row['quarantined'] is not quarantined or row['rejected']!=[]:
        fail('track snapshot is not the expected indexer/quarantine/empty rejection state')
    return row

def settle_evidence(directory,recorded,indexer,generation):
    b=Path(directory);count=canonical_uint_text(recorded,'recorded settle count')
    paths=sorted(b.glob('settle-[0-9]*.json'))
    if count==0:
        if paths:fail('record says no settle but a settle attempt is present')
        return []
    if count!=1 or [p.name for p in paths]!=['settle-1.json']:
        fail('non-default settle retry history requires explicit reviewed reconciliation before this record')
    views=[v for v in public_json_lines(b/('settle-read-%d.txt'%indexer)) if isinstance(v,dict) and {'indexer_id','quarantine_generation','unacked_promotion_seqs','state'}<=set(v)]
    if len(views)!=1:fail('settle request lacks an independent exact leader preview')
    view=views[0]
    if canonical_uint_text(view['indexer_id'],'preview indexer')!=indexer or canonical_uint_text(view['quarantine_generation'],'preview generation')!=generation or view.get('quarantined') is not True:
        fail('settle preview belongs to another indexer/generation')
    if not isinstance(view['unacked_promotion_seqs'],list):fail('invalid settle preview list')
    requested=[canonical_uint_text(v,'preview promotion') for v in view['unacked_promotion_seqs']]
    if not requested or requested!=sorted(set(requested)):fail('settle preview is empty/duplicate/unordered')
    terminal=settle_terminal(paths[0],indexer,generation,requested)
    return [terminal]

def clean_owner_audit(path,startup=False):
    import decimal
    lines=Path(path).read_text().splitlines();unclean=[];runs=[]
    for line in lines:
        match=re.fullmatch(r'sentio_node_storage_integrity_owner_audit_unclean_tables(?:\{[^}]*\})? ([^ ]+)',line)
        if match:unclean.append(match[1])
        match=re.fullmatch(r'sentio_node_storage_integrity_owner_audit_runs_total\{([^}]*)\} ([^ ]+)',line)
        if match and re.search(r'(?:^|,)trigger="startup"(?:,|$)',match[1]):runs.append(match[2])
    def number(value):
        try:n=decimal.Decimal(value)
        except decimal.InvalidOperation:fail('invalid owner-audit numeric evidence')
        if not n.is_finite() or n<0:fail('nonfinite/negative owner-audit numeric evidence')
        return n
    if len(unclean)!=1 or number(unclean[0])!=0:fail('owner audit is missing, ambiguous or unclean')
    if startup and (len(runs)!=1 or number(runs[0])<1):fail('owner startup audit did not run')

def acceptance_closure(directory,indexer,db):
    b=Path(directory);before=partition_census(b/'partstates-c-rebuild.jsonl');after=partition_census(b/'partstates-c-after.jsonl')
    if set(before)!=set(after):fail('acceptance changed the partition roster unexpectedly')
    changed=[key for key in before if before[key]!=after[key]]
    if len(changed)!=1 or changed[0][0]!=db+'.s3e_e2e':fail('acceptance changed something other than its exact one target partition')
    old,new=before[changed[0]],after[changed[0]]
    if new[0]<=old[0] or new[3]<=old[3] or not new[2]:fail('acceptance did not publish/acknowledge the target partition')
    lines=(b/'acceptance-insert.txt').read_text().splitlines()
    if lines.count('indexer-c row 4001 in '+db+'.s3e_e2e: safe count 1')!=1:fail('exact owner acceptance row did not read back once in safe mode')
    clean_owner_audit(b/'acceptance.txt')
    globals=[]
    for line in (b/'acceptance.txt').read_text().splitlines():
        match=re.fullmatch(r'global=(0|[1-9][0-9]*) published=(0|[1-9][0-9]*) sealed=(0|[1-9][0-9]*)',line)
        if match:globals.append([uint(int(v),'global safe evidence') for v in match.groups()])
    if len(globals)!=1 or len(set(globals[0]))!=1:fail('global safe/published/sealed tips do not agree')

def verify_record_session(session):

def bind_report_baseline(args):

P4_PROMOTION_ORDER=('accept-b-4002','accept-c-4003','accept-a-4004','accept-a-4005','accept-c-4001')
P4_PROMOTION_BLOCKS=set(P4_PROMOTION_ORDER)


def check_budget_output(path,remaining):
    lines=Path(path).read_text().splitlines()
    if len(lines)!=1:fail('budget output must be exactly one successful finished-snapshot estimator line')
    pattern=r'snapshot (\S+) \(index ([0-9]+)\): ([0-9]+) bytes at promotion ([0-9]+); live promotion ([0-9]+); budget to L/4 \(([0-9]+) bytes\): ([0-9]+) promotions; a drill spends at most ([0-9]+)'
    match=re.fullmatch(pattern,lines[0])
    if not match:fail('budget estimator did not return its exact success schema')
    _,index,state,snapshot_seq,live,target,budget,half=match.groups()
    index,state,snapshot_seq,live,target,budget,half=map(int,(index,state,snapshot_seq,live,target,budget,half))
    if target!=134217728 or state>=target or live<snapshot_seq or half!=budget//2 or remaining<0 or half<remaining:
        fail('fresh finished-snapshot half-budget cannot cover every remaining Task56 promotion; ask about voter capacity before proceeding')
    return {'snapshot_index':index,'snapshot_promotion':snapshot_seq,'live_promotion':live,'half_budget':half,'remaining':remaining}

 'accept-b-4002':'si_p4_accept "$key_file" b 4002 rollout 2>&1 | tee "$si_backup/accept-b-rollout.txt"',
 'accept-c-4003':'si_p4_accept "$key_file" c 4003 rollout 2>&1 | tee "$si_backup/accept-c-rollout.txt"',

def budget_command(path,label):

def budget_completions(session, labels):
    import hashlib
    t=Path(session);result={}
    for done in (t/'claims').glob('*.done'):
        value=strict_json(done.read_text());label=re.sub(r'^[0-9]{3}-','',Path(value['file']).stem)
        if label not in labels:continue
        if label in result:fail('duplicate promotion completion receipt')
        budget_command(value['file'],label)
        result[label]=hashlib.sha256(done.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    if set(result)!=set(labels):fail('promotion prefix lacks exact successful completion evidence')
    return result

def budget_native(directory, labels):
    import hashlib
    b=Path(directory);result={}
    db=(Path.home()/'si-devnet2-stage3-indexer-c/acceptance-db').read_text().strip()
    if not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*',db):fail('invalid acceptance database')
    evidence={
      'accept-b-4002':('accept-b-rollout.txt','indexer-b row 4002 in devuser1.s3_p4: safe count 1'),
      'accept-c-4003':('accept-c-rollout.txt',f'indexer-c row 4003 in {db}.s3e_e2e: safe count 1'),
      'accept-a-4004':('accept-a-rollout.txt','1'),
      'accept-a-4005':('accept-a-voters.txt','1'),
      'accept-c-4001':('acceptance-insert.txt',f'indexer-c row 4001 in {db}.s3e_e2e: safe count 1')}
    for label in labels:
        name,line=evidence[label];p=b/name
        if p.is_symlink() or not p.is_file() or p.read_text().splitlines().count(line)!=1:fail('promotion lacks its exact native safe read-back evidence')
        if label in ('accept-a-4004','accept-a-4005') and p.read_text().splitlines()[-1]!='1':fail('indexer-a native safe count did not end in one')
        result[label]=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    return result

BUDGET_ORACLE_PY='import base64, json, math, struct, sys, tarfile\narchive, live, limit = sys.argv[1], int(sys.argv[2]), int(sys.argv[3])\ntarget = limit // 4\n# hashicorp/raft FileSnapshotStore: a snapshot being written lives in "<id>.tmp" and is renamed to\n# "<id>" only once state.bin is complete and meta.json carries its final Size and CRC (crc64 ECMA,\n# big-endian, base64). Only finished snapshots whose bytes match their metadata are used.\nPOLY = 0xC96C5795D7870F42\nTAB = []\nfor i in range(256):\n    c = i\n    for _ in range(8):\n        c = (c >> 1) ^ POLY if c & 1 else c >> 1\n    TAB.append(c)\ndef crc64(b):\n    crc = 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF\n    for x in b:\n        crc = TAB[(crc ^ x) & 0xFF] ^ (crc >> 8)\n    return (crc ^ 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF).to_bytes(8, "big")\nfinished = []\nwith tarfile.open(archive) as t:\n    members = {m.name: m for m in t.getmembers()}\n    for name in members:\n        parts = name.split("/")\n        if len(parts) != 3 or parts[0] != "snapshots" or parts[2] != "meta.json":\n            continue\n        if parts[1].endswith(".tmp"):\n            continue  # unfinished, never used\n        meta = json.load(t.extractfile(members[name]))\n        state_name = "snapshots/%s/state.bin" % parts[1]\n        if state_name not in members:\n            print("snapshot %s has no state.bin; stop" % parts[1]); sys.exit(1)\n        blob = t.extractfile(members[state_name]).read()\n        if len(blob) != meta.get("Size") or not meta.get("CRC") or crc64(blob) != base64.b64decode(meta["CRC"]):\n            print("snapshot %s does not match its metadata (size %d, meta size %s); stop" % (parts[1], len(blob), meta.get("Size"))); sys.exit(1)\n        finished.append(((meta["Term"], meta["Index"]), parts[1], meta, blob))\nif not finished:\n    print("no finished snapshot in the leader\'s store; stop"); sys.exit(1)\n_, snap_id, meta, data = max(finished, key=lambda f: f[0])\nbest = ("snapshots/" + snap_id, meta)\nif data[:4] != b"AFSM":\n    print("not an arbiter snapshot container; stop"); sys.exit(1)\n(doc_len,) = struct.unpack(">Q", data[5:13])\nstate = len(data) - 13  # the document plus the spent-ids dump, as arbiter_state_bytes counts it\nseq = json.loads(data[13:13 + doc_len]).get("promotion_seq", 0)\nif seq <= 0 or live < seq:\n    print("snapshot promotion_seq %d, live %d: not a usable pair; stop" % (seq, live)); sys.exit(1)\nif state >= target:\n    print("state %d bytes at promotion %d: no promotion budget left before L/4; stop" % (state, seq)); sys.exit(1)\n# The state grows about quadratically in the promotion count (spec §2: 11.4 MB at promotion 53), so the\n# marginal cost of a promotion is about twice the average: never divide the headroom by an average.\n# S = a*n^2 through the origin overstates a (it ignores the constant term), so the budget is understated.\na = state / seq ** 2\nbudget = max(math.isqrt(int(target / a)) - live, 0)  # minus every promotion made since that snapshot\nprint("snapshot %s (index %d): %d bytes at promotion %d; live promotion %d; budget to L/4 (%d bytes): %d promotions; a drill spends at most %d"\n      % (best[0].rsplit("/", 1)[-1], best[1]["Index"], state, seq, live, target, budget, budget // 2))\n'

def budget_capture(path, start):
    import hashlib
    p=Path(path);b=p.parent
    required_evidence(b,['capture-status.json','budget-snapshots.tgz','budget-live-seq','budget-voter','budget.txt'])
    v=strict_json((b/'capture-status.json').read_text())
    fields={'format','leader','live_promotion','snapshot_sha256','live_sha256','captured_unix'}
    if not isinstance(v,dict) or set(v)!=fields or v['format']!='si-p4-budget-capture-v1':fail('missing exact successful capture producer status')
    if type(v['leader']) is not int or v['leader'] not in (0,1,2) or type(v['captured_unix']) is not int or v['captured_unix']<start:fail('capture predates this claimed operation or has invalid leader')
    uint(v['live_promotion'],'capture live promotion')
    if (b/'budget-voter').read_text()!=str(v['leader'])+'\n' or (b/'budget-live-seq').read_text()!=str(v['live_promotion'])+'\n':fail('capture leader/live output binding drift')
    hashes={name:hashlib.sha256((b/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in ('capture-status.json','budget-snapshots.tgz','budget-live-seq','budget-voter','budget.txt')}
    if v['snapshot_sha256']!=hashes['budget-snapshots.tgz'] or v['live_sha256']!=hashes['budget-live-seq']:fail('capture archive/live hash drift')
    import subprocess,sys
    replay=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-',str(b/'budget-snapshots.tgz'),str(v['live_promotion']),'536870912'],input=BUDGET_ORACLE_PY,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=60)
    if replay.returncode!=0 or replay.stdout!=(b/'budget.txt').read_text():fail('retained finished-CRC estimator does not reproduce the exact recorded budget output')
    return v,hashes

def budget_gate_expected(session, directory, label):
    import hashlib
    t=Path(session);b=Path(directory);index=P4_PROMOTION_ORDER.index(label);prefix=P4_PROMOTION_ORDER[:index]
    matches=[]
    for attempted in (t/'claims').glob('*.attempted'):
        start=strict_json(attempted.read_text())
        if re.sub(r'^[0-9]{3}-','',Path(start['file']).stem)==label:matches.append(start)
    if len(matches)!=1:fail('budget gate is not bound to one exact claimed promotion operation')
    start=matches[0];budget_command(start['file'],label);capture=b/('task56-budget-'+label);v,hashes=budget_capture(capture/'budget.txt',start['started_unix'])
    remaining=len(P4_PROMOTION_ORDER)-index
    observed=check_budget_output(capture/'budget.txt',remaining)
    if observed['live_promotion']!=v['live_promotion']:fail('budget estimator used a different live promotion capture')
    return {'format':'si-p4-budget-gate-v1','label':label,'required_remaining':remaining,
      'source_sha256':hashlib.sha256((t/'frozen.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
      'block_sha256':start['sha256'],'capture_sha256':hashes,
      'prior_completions':budget_completions(t,prefix),'prior_native':budget_native(b,prefix)}

    for label in P4_PROMOTION_ORDER[:count]:
        expected=budget_gate_expected(session,directory,label)
        path=Path(directory)/('task56-budget-'+label)/'budget-gate.json'

def budget_check(args):
    import json
    (path,)=args;t=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
    verify_record_session(t)
    active=os.environ.get('P4R_ACTIVE_BLOCK')
    if not active:fail('budget gate must run inside its claimed immutable block')

    index=P4_PROMOTION_ORDER.index(label);successful=completed_blocks(t,set(),active)
    if successful&P4_PROMOTION_BLOCKS!=set(P4_PROMOTION_ORDER[:index]):fail('promotion completions are not the exact ordered prefix before this write')
    p=Path(path);b=p.parent.parent

        json.dump(expected,f,sort_keys=True);f.write('\n');f.flush();os.fsync(f.fileno())

def validate_backup(directory, owner, published):
    b=Path(directory)
    values=[v for v in public_json_lines(b/'backup-c-p4.json') if isinstance(v,dict) and v.get('format')=='si-backup-index-v1']
    if len(values)!=1:fail('backup must contain one exact actual backup index record')
    v=values[0]
    if uint(v.get('owner_indexer_id'),'backup owner')!=owner:fail('backup belongs to another owner')
    if not isinstance(v.get('name'),str) or not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*',v['name']) or (b/'backup-name.txt').read_text()!=v['name']+'\n':fail('backup index and recorded name disagree')
    if v.get('kind') not in ('full','incr') or uint(v.get('chain_length'),'backup chain length')<1:fail('invalid backup kind/chain length')
    def text(value,label):
        if not isinstance(value,str) or not value:fail(label+' must be nonempty')
        return value
    text(v.get('snapshot_id'),'backup snapshot')
    entry=v.get('entry')
    if not isinstance(entry,dict) or uint(entry.get('safe_block_seq'),'backup safe frontier')!=published:fail('backup is not at the measured quarantined published frontier')
    uint(entry.get('applied_promotion_seq'),'backup applied promotion')
    tables=v.get('tables')
    if not isinstance(tables,list) or not tables:fail('backup lists no table')
    ids=set();physical=set()
    for table in tables:
        if not isinstance(table,dict):fail('invalid backup table')
        tid=text(table.get('table_id'),'backup table id');name=text(table.get('physical_table'),'backup physical table')
        if tid in ids or name in physical:fail('duplicate backup table identity')
        ids.add(tid);physical.add(name);uint(table.get('incarnation_seq'),'backup incarnation')
        parts=table.get('parts')
        if not isinstance(parts,list):fail('invalid backup parts')
        seen=set()
        for part in parts:
            if not isinstance(part,dict):fail('invalid backup part')
            key=(text(part.get('partition_id'),'backup partition'),text(part.get('name'),'backup part name'))
            if key in seen:fail('duplicate backup part')
            seen.add(key);text(part.get('phys_hash'),'backup part hash');uint(part.get('rows'),'backup part rows')
    return v

def validate_replay(directory,env):
    import hashlib
    b=Path(directory);required_evidence(b,['replay.txt','replay-baseline'])
    baseline=(b/'replay-baseline').read_text().split()
    if len(baseline)!=3 or baseline[:2]!=[env['ARBITER_TAG'],env['ARBITER_DIGEST']]:fail('replay baseline does not bind the recorded old release')
    lines=(b/'replay.txt').read_text().splitlines()
    for i in range(3):
        for text in ('old and new replay identically','both builds write the same v20 container'):
            if lines.count('arbiter-%d: '%i+text)!=1:fail('replay lacks each exact voter success')
        for suffix in ('cmp','txt'):
            old=b/('digest-%d-old.'%i+suffix);new=b/('digest-%d-new.'%i+suffix);required_evidence(b,[old.name,new.name])
            if suffix=='cmp' and old.read_bytes()!=new.read_bytes():fail('replay old/new comparison differs')
            if suffix=='txt':
                for p in (old,new):
                    values=p.read_text().splitlines()
                    if any(v.startswith('apply_error ') for v in values):fail('replay contains an apply error')
                    applied=[v.split(' ',1)[1] for v in values if v.startswith('applied_commands ')]
                    if len(applied)!=1 or not re.fullmatch(r'[1-9][0-9]*',applied[0]) or values.count('written_version 20')!=1:fail('replay did not apply commands/write version20')
        paths=[b/('written-%d-%s.container'%(i,v)) for v in ('old','new')]
        required_evidence(b,[p.name for p in paths])
        if hashlib.sha256(paths[0].read_bytes()).digest()!=hashlib.sha256(paths[1].read_bytes()).digest():fail('replay containers differ')
    if sum(v.startswith('restore_ok version 20') for v in lines)!=6 or any('apply_error' in v or 'DIFFERENT' in v for v in lines):fail('replay lacks both successful cross-version restores for each voter')

class UniqueLoader(yaml.SafeLoader):
    pass

def unique_mapping(loader, node, deep=False):
    result = {}
    for key_node, value_node in node.value:
        key = loader.construct_object(key_node, deep=deep)
        if key in result:
            fail('duplicate YAML mapping key in render/config')
        result[key] = loader.construct_object(value_node, deep=deep)
    return result
UniqueLoader.add_constructor(yaml.resolver.BaseResolver.DEFAULT_MAPPING_TAG, unique_mapping)

def strict_yaml(text):
    try:
        return yaml.load(text, Loader=UniqueLoader)
    except yaml.YAMLError:
        fail('invalid rendered YAML/config; raw content withheld')

def strict_render_identity(objs, pod, init, backup):
    main = one_container(pod.get('containers', []), 'sentio-node')
    inits = pod.get('initContainers') or []
    if not inits or inits[0] is not init:
        fail('rebuild-safe must run first before any other init container')
    expected = ['/sentio-node', 'storage-integrity', 'rebuild-safe', '--config-path', '/config/standalone.yaml', '--backup', backup]
    if tokens(init) != expected or init.get('command') != ['/sentio-node']:
        fail('rebuild-safe argv is not the exact reviewed executable/operation/options')
    for container in (init, main):
        if container.get('envFrom'):
            fail('ambiguous envFrom is not permitted in the same-identity proof')
        env_sources(container)  # Strict duplicate/env-shape validation below.
        mounts = container.get('volumeMounts') or []
        if len({m.get('mountPath') for m in mounts}) != len(mounts):
            fail('duplicate container mount path')
    private = env_sources(init).get('PRIVATE_KEY')
    if not private or not private.startswith('secret ') or not private.endswith('/private-key') or private != env_sources(main).get('PRIVATE_KEY'):
        fail('rebuild-safe signer must reference the exact host PRIVATE_KEY Secret/key')
    if main.get('image') != init.get('image'):
        fail('rebuild-safe image differs from its host image')
    config_mount = [m for m in init.get('volumeMounts', []) if m.get('mountPath') == '/config']
    if len(config_mount) != 1 or config_mount[0].get('readOnly') is not True or config_mount[0].get('subPath') or config_mount[0].get('subPathExpr'):
        fail('rebuild-safe config mount is not an exact read-only ConfigMap directory')
    volumes = [v for v in pod.get('volumes', []) if v.get('name') == config_mount[0]['name']]
    if len(volumes) != 1 or set(volumes[0]) != {'name','configMap'}:
        fail('rebuild-safe config volume is not a unique ConfigMap')
    ref = volumes[0]['configMap']
    if ref.get('items') or ref.get('optional'):
        fail('ConfigMap key remapping or optional config is ambiguous')
    cm = one(objs, 'ConfigMap', ref['name'])
    cfg = strict_yaml(cm.get('data', {}).get('standalone.yaml',''))
    if not isinstance(cfg, dict):
        fail('rebuild-safe mounted configuration is not an object')
    si = cfg.get('storage_integrity') or {}; snode = si.get('snode') or {}
    if si.get('clickhouse_username') != 'si_snode' or snode.get('node_id') != 'snode-3' or snode.get('table_ids') != [] or not isinstance(snode.get('state_dir'), str) or not snode['state_dir'].startswith('/data/'):
        fail('rebuild-safe requires the same snode-3 journal/si_snode identity and no genesis tables')
    return cfg

def one_container(containers, name):
    hits = [c for c in containers if c.get('name') == name]
    if len(hits) != 1:
        fail('missing or duplicate required container')
    return hits[0]

def render_release(args):
    import importlib.util
    import hashlib
    root,name,output=args
    if name!=RELEASE or Path(output).exists() or Path(output).is_symlink():
        fail('unexpected render release or existing output: reconcile without overwriting')
    tool=Path(__file__).resolve().parent/'local-render.py'
    if tool.is_symlink() or hashlib.sha256(tool.read_bytes()).hexdigest()!='772915de4c737cfc38b640bb43eb707efb14fa1e1c32c58a8ca7a4f6d0329fb2':
        fail('Task54 exact audited direct renderer bytes changed')
    spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('p4r_direct_renderer',tool);module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    module.render(root,'k8s-sea/sentio-network-devnet2/storage-integrity-si-v2.helmfile.yaml',name,output)
    print('render: exact audited direct Helm renderer completed for owner host')
```
